tei:titleStmt.tei:title: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/
thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/

tei:div.tei:p: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /pad+ma shel phug gter byon thugs chen rmad/ /'khor 'das zil gnon chos sde'i them byang 'god/

de yang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la gsum/ rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag kha skong gi skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor ro/ ༈ dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: bka' tho lung gi grangs yig 1-5 kha) kha byang gsal ba'i sgron me/ 6-18 ga) rtsa rgyud 'od zer phreng ba/ 19-39 nga) rdo rje'i tshig rkang khrid gzhung*/ 40-52 ca) dbang chog 'gro ba kun grol/ 53-69 cha) btags grol sku yi 'khor lo/ 70-77 ja) chos sku ye shes sgrub pa/ 78-89 nya) longs sku pad phreng sgrub pa/ 90-99 ta) sprul sku khrag 'thung sgrub pa/ 100-109 tha) 'jam dpal tshe yi sgrub pa/ 110-126 da) sgrol ma 'ja' lus sgrub pa/ 127-139 na) phyag rdor pha rol rgol 'joms/ 140-152 pa) tshogs rdzogs sgyu lus mchod sbyin/ 153-162 pha) gtor ma byang chub chu rgyun/ 163-173 ba) me gsur longs spyod gter mdzod/ 174-180 ma)gsol 'debs dri med shel phreng*/ 181-185 tsa) byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gdung dbyangs/ 186-188 tsha) las byang dug lnga ye grol/ 189-241 dza) rgyud bskang rin chen phreng ba/ 242-250 wa) gshin don bag chags sbyong byed/ 251-279 zha) gter srung gza' yi sgrub thabs/ 280-289 za) dge bsnyen klu yi gsol mchod/ 290-295 'a) bka' skyong lha btsan gsol mchod/ 296-301 ya) lo nad srung ba'i gdams pa nad bdag dpung 'joms/ 302-319 ra) sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar/ 320-348 ༈ gnyis pa yan lag kha skong gi skor la/ la) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub bde chen gsang lam/ 349-464 sha) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi stong thun skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi/ 465-591 sa) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: myong grol bdud rtsi'i pho brang sgrub thabs ye shes bcud len/

592-607 ha) rdor sems thugs kyi thig le las/ bdud rtsi sman gyi byin 'bebs dngos grub chu 'dzin/ 608-717 a) thugs rje chen po sogs rtsa gsum rigs mthun spyi la'ang sbyar chog pa'i bdud rtsi phye ma dang ril bu khyad med sgrub thabs bsdus gsal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i snying po/ 618-621 ki) bdud rtsi sman mchod mchog gsum pañca/ 622-625 khi) dzap dmigs/ 626-626 ༈ gsum pa chog khrigs sna tshogs kho bos gsar bgyis kyi skor/ gi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa lam bzang gsal snang*/ 627-744 ngi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ chos sku ltar sgrub thabs ye shes snying po bklag chog tu bkod pa/ 745-760 ci) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa pad+ma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 761-779 chi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ sprul sku he ru ka rta nag lcags ral gyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs rab 'jigs rdo rje'i me phreng*/ 780-798 ji) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i tshe sgrub bklag chog tu bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes/ 799-821 nyi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs 'don khrigs su bgyis pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ 822-836 ti) sgrol ma rigs lnga'i rlung sgrub dmigs rim/ 837-838 thi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ phyag rdor pha rol 'joms byed kyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs log 'dren klad 'gem gnam lcags thog char/ 839-857 di) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po dril ba/ 858-869 ni) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa thar pa'i them skas/

865-875 pi) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar bklag chog bkod pa/ 876-929 a) spar byang smon tshig / 930-932 bcas re zhig rdzogs so/ rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ chad nye smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: bka' tho lung gi grangs yig bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: chos tshan bka' yi tho yig las: them byang rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba dgod par bya: ka) kha byang gsal ba'i sgron me: kha) rtsa rgyud 'od zer phreng ba: ga) rdo rje'i tshig rkang khrid gzhung : nga) dbang chog 'gro ba kun grol: ca) btags grol sku yi 'khor lo: cha) chos sku ye shes sgrub pa: ja) longs sku pad phreng sgrub pa: nya) sprul sku khrag 'thung sgrub pa: ta) 'jam dpal tshe yi sgrub pa: tha) sgrol ma 'ja' lus sgrub pa: da) phyag rdor pha rol rgol 'joms: na) tshogs rdzogs sgyu lus mchod sbyin: pa) sgyu lus mchod sbyin 'bring po/ pha) gtor ma byang chub chu rgyun: ma) gtor ma byang chub chu rgyun pad gling bsgrigs chog tsa) me gsur longs spyod gter mdzod: tsha) gsol 'debs dri med shel phreng : dza) byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gdungs dbyangs: wa) las byang dug lnga ye grol: zha) sman mchod/ za) dzap dmigs/ 'a) rgyud bskang rin chen phreng ba: ya) gshin don bag chags sbyong byed: ra) gter srung gza' yi sgrub thabs: la) dge bsnyen klu yi gsol mchod:

sha) bka' skyong lha btsan gsol mchod: sa) lo nad srung ba'i gdams pa nad bdag dpung 'joms/ ha) sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar/ a) me lhar gtang rag 'bul ba/ oṃ) mchod rdzas thams cad kyi 'bag bsang*/ ma) 'gres byang*/ ṇi) gzod gsol dang mjug bsdu/ pad) me lha'i byon skyems/ me) gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs/ hūm̐) chos longs sprul gsum sgrub thabs/ hrīḥ) 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi stong thun skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi/ de ltar chos tshan tho yig ste: las phran them med ma gtogs pa: 'di yi chos bka' yongs su rdzogs: 'di yi rgyud kyi tho yig ni: gsang rgya mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhir 'dug: de phyir 'di ru sbyar ma bde: 'di nyid ngag nas bkod pa'o: sa ma ya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor sprel zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyi shar dus khrom sum brgya skor dang bcas te kun gyis mthong bar brag gad shel phug gi mtsho nang nas gza' klu btsan gyis shog ser dngos su phul bzhin gdan drangs te yos zla ba'i tshes pa bco lnga nas bzung shog ser las phab pas sbrul zla ba'i tshes gsum la grub pa dge legs 'phel// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: kha byang gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: zab gsang brda yi kha byang gsal bkod bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang zab chos 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi 'gro don gdul zhing sa rtags dus gnad la sogs bstan pa ni: slob dpon chen po mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas ke'u tshang za hor mkha' 'gro'i gling dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i bka' brgyad yang gsang phug mo cher bzhugs pa'i dus su:

tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams shing : rin po che sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal phul te: rje 'bangs grogs lngas zhus pa: kyai slob dpon chen po lags: da lta dus dang gnas skabs phun sum tshogs pa lags kyang : ma 'ongs bod 'di bde skyid dang 'phel 'grib: khyad par zab mo'i chos 'di'i 'dul zhing dang 'gro don rnams ma hā gu rus gsung du gsol: zhes zhus pas: slob dpon gyis rdo rje mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing : ma 'gags pa'i rang mdangs las 'di skad ces gsungs so: kye ho nyon dang rje 'bangs grogs lnga rnams: ma 'ongs bod kyi bde sdug 'phel 'grib dang : zab chos dus bab 'gro don gdul zhing bstan: yar ldan mar 'grib dus dang bskal pa yi: bzang ngan 'phel 'grib sna tshogs 'di ltar 'byung : 'og min bkod nas kun bzang snang mtha' yi: rgyal sras sprul pa'i ring lugs rnam gnyis dang : in+d+ra rgyal po sde bzhi zung 'brel nas: rdo rje gdan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: de yang mu stegs gīrti ban+dza yis: paṇ+ḍi ta yi bshad smra mi snyoms rkyen: rab tu brnyed nas chos kyi bud shing bsregs: de yang phan tshun res mos gsum gsum 'thab: de yi tha ma lcang kha'i byi'u khyu 'dra: res 'ga' rgud cing res 'ga' dar la smin: za hor yul du klu yi rdzing bu 'khyil: phyag na rdo rjes mngon lam byang chub bstan: rim gyis rnal 'byor dpa' bo ḍāk+kir gyur: phyi nang bslab pa'i rkyen kha sman mos 'dzin: res 'ga' babs tshul res 'ga' the tshom za: de yi tha ma sngags gling dgu ru 'gyur: srin mo'i snying khar gnam ri'i pho brang chags: srong btsan sgam pos sgrol ma dbus su dgugs: thugs rje chen pos 'dzam gling sgron me sbar: de yang mtha' 'khob ma gor khri sde yi: bya la 'phrin bskur chos rigs lde'us grub: de yi tha ma bre stong tsam zhig lus: de tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos su byon:

thugs rje chen pos mdo sngags bstan pa skyong : dpal gyi gtsug lag rdo rje gdan dang mnyam: khri srong lde'u btsan dpal gyi bsam yas 'grub: bstan gnyis lung gi dpal phreng drwa ba 'gyed: de yang mgo la rwa skyes ru lag bshig: de yi tha ma skra yi ba dan 'phyar: de tshe bzlog thabs gtsug lag zhig gsos bya: bsam pa lhun grub badz+ra gu ru'i rgyun: rab gnas yang bskyar bgyis pas yun ring gnas: dbus 'gyur gru 'dzin lte bar 'jam dpal 'byung : bshad sgrub bstan pa'i snyan grags mkha' la 'phyar: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs kyi rnam rol pa: bzang po'i mtshan can thugs rje'i mgon du shar: ba dan bzhi yi dar lce phyogs su 'khyug: stod phyogs ngam grog tsher mar ma 'brel na: drug cu rtsa bzhir bde zhing skyid par 'byung : bye ma'i gling du lcags kyi sgong ba skyes: gri yi mgar bas zhun 'thar mtshon cha brdung : sgro yi phyogs nas dug gi sa bon stobs: ling tshe dgu yi nyi ma bsil bur gtub: de yi tha ma srin po'i sha khrom sdud: nyi zla'i srub nas lcags kyi mi chung skye: bar snang khams la zhabs bro lan gsum 'khrab: chu 'dzin de dang lhan cig 'grogs nas kyang : 'ol mo ljongs kyi lo thog ser bas bkang : de yi tha ma me rlung chu gsum sbyor: de dag dus kyi bye brag phran bu'i skor: gnyis pa rtags 'byung ba yi grub tshul ni: gnam la sprin mdog dmar sngo nag lam chags: rlung dmar 'tshub cing char chu shin tu dkon: nyi zla gza' skar 'khrug cing stong sgra 'byung : ri brag sa rnams 'bir zhing khol chen nyil: gnyan nad lhog rgod tre tre me ltar 'bar: rgyal 'gong 'khrugs pas mi smyon khyi smyon mang : sman mo 'khrugs pas bud med lha bab gdon: dam sri 'khrugs pas ban bon sdom pa shor: gre bo 'khrugs pas pha tshan nang log 'thab: lha srin 'khrugs pas dmag khrims chu ltar khol: sngags pa dam med yi dam dbyings la gshegs:

srin mo mir brdzu pha tshan dug gis gsod: sgom chen ri shor grong la nag chang sred: btsun ma dam log byi phrug dong la sba: bu rgyud khrel med pha ma sgo ru 'don: mo btsun tshugs shor khog smad g.yog la btsong : chos pa khrims ral 'phrog bcom mna' la za: zog pos mgo skor khrims ral lung pa 'gengs: ban bon shi tshad phal cher gdug 'drer skye: mi skya pho mo phal cher dmyal bar ltung : lo zla zhag dus bzhin du rang lugs 'gyur: dgos pa'i mi dge sdig par mi 'dzem par: rang shes yin zer nga rgyal gshob sgros brjod: gtan gyi 'dun ma dkon mchog khyad du gsod: tshe 'dir phan pa'i bran g.yog ar la gtad: drin gyis gsos pa'i sgo nor srog gcod gtub: nyam chung don med ri dwags ku dir gtong : dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma snying nas smad: pad 'byung rjes 'jug rig 'dzin skyon du lta: snying med g.yang sar mchong la spro ba'i dus: mi dge sna tshogs tshang ba'i dus shig 'byung : srid pa'i g.yo 'khrug dus rtags de 'byung tshe: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag phal cher 'jig: sa yi me btsa' rim 'jig had por lus: chos khrims ltar na mi dge thabs spyod mang : rgyal khrims ltar na nor 'dod phyogs ris phye: yul khrims ltar na gcig zer gcig mi nyan: rang khrims ltar na dam tshig lkog mi thub: sems can gsha' ma'i rang spyod zad pa'i dus: bod yul mi rnams sbas yul smon pa'i dus: rong chen bzhi la gab ri btsal ba'i dus: mi med lung par sems blo 'phyo ba'i dus: srog mgo kheb tsam pha yul dor ba'i dus: bstan 'dzin skyes bu dben rir bsnyeg pa'i dus: ru bzhi nang 'khrug mtshon char g.yo ba'i dus: rgya bod thams cad chu bzhin khol ba'i dus: dus dang sa rtags lung bstan mthun pa yin: ma 'ongs de dus zab chos 'di nyid kyis: mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ba dang : rten 'brel kun gyi gtso bo 'di yin pas:

'gro don dus bab gdul bya smin par 'gyur: mtshams bzhi lung bstan de bzhin shar ba'i tshe: thugs rje chen po rigs gsum rdzogs nas su: 'khor 'das zil gnon 'di nyid 'don pa'i dus: 'di nas nyi ma shar gyi phyogs dag la: sbas yul gnas chen pad+ma bkod zhes bya: de dang nye ba'i rong chen zhig la ni: kho bos rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i shel phug yod: zab chos 'di nyid sba zhing sgrub pa'i gnas: rten 'brel bka' yi zab rgya gter 'byed tshe: lha btsan gza' dang klu sman legs par mchod: gter srung bka' yi rgya de 'khrol ba'i grogs: sbrul rta lug dang glang gi lo zhig la: bkra shis tshe dang bsod nams 'dzoms zhes 'byung : grogs su 'grigs na zab chos 'thon zhing 'phel: grogs dang sa rtags rten 'brel ma mthun na: mi lo nyi shur thon par mi 'gyur ro: des na dus dang rten 'brel shin tu gtso: chos bdag 'dul zhing yul grub bstan pa ni: gru 'dzin 'jig rten dbang phyug nga nyid ni: bzang po'i mtshan can 'byung der chos 'phrod na: stod hor sde gsum mi lo drug cu bzlog: dbus kyi chos bdag bka' brgyud rig 'dzin la: kun bzang byang chub rdo rje phrin las dang : don grub chos rgyal dge legs dpal bzang 'byung : rig 'dzin de rnams kun la chos 'di sprod: lho kha bal yul mon gyi phyogs dag la: dpal dang 'jigs med grags pa'i dbang phyug dang : ye shes rnam rgyal pad+ma'i mtshan can 'byung : rig 'dzin skyes bu de la chos 'di sprod: yar stod lte rgyud kong po'i phyogs dag la: dpal dang smra ba grags pa'i dbang phyug dang : mkhas mchog rnam rgyal rdo rje'i mtshan can 'byung : rig 'dzin skyes bu de la chos 'di sprod: sbas yul gter gnas de yi phyogs dag la: gsang sngags pad+ma rgyal dang bsod nams dang : mi 'gyur chos dang mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshan: rig 'dzin skyes bu de la chos 'di sprod:

mdo khams rong bzhi yul gyi cha dag la: dkon mchog ngag dbang rnam rgyal phrin las dpal: chos dang rgya mtsho tshe dbang bkra shis mtshan: rig 'dzin skyes bu de la chos 'di sprod: sa smad rong bzhi yul gyi cha dag la: dge legs dpal dang bsod nams bstan dang mchog: pad+ma grags pa phrin las yon tan rgyal: rig 'dzin skyes bu de la chos 'di sprod: ji bzhin ldan te chos 'di 'phrod gyur na: mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me legs par dar: gzhan yang chos 'dir 'brel ba'i skal ldan ni: theg chen mngon du gyur pa mang rab 'byung : de phyir 'brel tshad don ldan khyad par 'phags: nyung zab bcud kyi yang snying dril ba 'di: skal ldan las 'phro can gyi don du bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas ye shes grogs lngas slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phul zhing phyag 'tshal: slob dpon gyi bka' yis rgyas btab pa'i shog dril dam rdzas kun grogs rnams kyi mgo bor bzhag ste smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar: khyad par ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan dang zhal gdams mang du gnang ste rgyas legs par btab bo:

sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs ma 'ongs sems can don slad du: thugs rje chen po yang snying sgrub pa bzhag: bka' yi rgya 'di gza' klu btsan gyis srungs: dpal gyi shel phug mi nub a thaṃ rgya: skal chad log lta bdud kyis ma reg par: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas bsgyur ro// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: rtsa ba'i rgyud 'od zer phreng ba bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang gsang sgrub pa'i snying thig gdams pa bstan: dbang gi mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : gnubs kyi lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes pa: legs par nyon la mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ki kang gza' dang klu sman rnams la bcol: pad+ma shel phug gdengs kaṛ atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya gar skad du: tsit+ta badz+ra a ti hrī dha kṛ ya ma hā: bod skad du: thugs rdo rje bla med snying po'i rgyud chen po: o rgyan skad du: hi ri ṇi lam sha ra ho ti: bod skad du: yang gsang sbas pa thugs rje chen po'i snying thig: gu h+ya ḍāk+ki'i skad du: he laṃ ni ti gha ri taṃ bī dzaḥ bod skad du: don thig gcig sgril chen po sgra myur ba'i rgyud: gsum ldan mdzod kyi man ngag rlabs po che zhes bya: theg pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis thos pa'i dus gcig na: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing : 'dzin khyon mtha' yas dpag par dka' ba'i dbus su: thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: ka dag zang thal gyi ting nge 'dzin la gdod mar bzhugs so:

yang de'i tshe chos sku'i rang sgra las: hūm̐ ā hrīḥ zhes bka' stsal te: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis zhus pa: e ma ka dag chos kyi sku: skye med rang byung snying po'i sgra: hūm̐ ā hrī zhes bka' stsal pa: de don dgongs pa gsung du gsol: thog ma'i mgon pos bka' stsal pa: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon: hūm̐ zhes ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: āḥzhes ma 'gags sgra tshig bral: hrīḥzhes skye med snying po can: don ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gsum: gnad ni rig pa'i 'phrul 'khor ro: snang mtha' chos skus bka' stsal te: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis zhus pa: e ma snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: skye med chos sku'i sgra de nyid: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bla med tshig: yang dag don chen gsung du gsol: snang mtha' chos skus bka' stsal pa: e ma gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro nyon: drang don nges don theg pa yi: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs 'bras bu bstan: ma yengs dran pa lcags su chug: hūm̐ zhes rdzogs rim 'od gsal ni: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum bstan: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni: mos gus 'dun pa'i khri gdan du: dam tshig snying rje'i 'od zer gyis: gsol 'debs drug cu'i dbyangs kyis 'bod: dkyil 'khor rig pa'i tshom bu 'bul: sku gsum sa bon 'od zhu bstim: rjes shes mi rtog dbyings la bzhag: sa ma ya: thog ma'i mgon po'i sngon 'gro brda yi le'u ste dang po'o: ྀatsha: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ngo sprod rim pa ni: e hoḥ.āḥ gshis lugs rgya yan stong pa'i dbyings: rol rtsal ma 'gags zang thal 'gyu: chos dbyings drwa ba'i klong du chags: bdag med rlung gi rta la zhon: gtad med kun mtha' khyab par nyul: bya rtsol bral yang sna tshogs 'char: 'od gsal nyag gcig thig le'o: sa ma ya: thog ma'i mgon pos dngos gzhi ngo sprad le'u ste gnyis pa'o: ྀatsha: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni: e ho hrīḥ

bag yod brtan pa'i klong chen du: gnad gsum mi 'gul so mar bzhag: snang ba 'od kyi rgya la 'ching : bdag 'dzin mun pa'i klong du gtad: 'byung ba lnga yi gzugs 'ching gdams: dus gsum srid pa'i 'gyu ba bcad: sna tshogs du ma ro gcig myong : mtha' bral gsum gyi rgyal sa bzung : rjes shes rgya yan nga bdag bcom: rtog med mtshams rgya 'dod blo bshig: sna lnga'i 'ching dril gcer bur bud: ye shes drwa ba mngon rdzogs so: sa ma ya: thog ma'i mgon pos rjes shes spyod lam mthar phyin bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: ྀatsha: bzhi pa bskyed rim sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur ram longs sku sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rim pa ni: sku gsum gyi tshig rkang las kyi byang bu'i don tshan ni: e hoḥ gdod nas snang srid rang byung lha: ma bcos chos dbyings de bzhin skyabs: rang gsal yan lag bdun pa 'bul: bdag 'dzin 'gong po dbyings su dengs: phra rags rtog pa mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ hoḥ rang byung mchod pa bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: hoḥ rnam dag bum rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ ga lak+ṣa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hoḥ dbyings nas ye shes byin phob cig: phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ ma rig sgo bcad zang thal phyes: badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ stong nyid ting 'dzin mi gtong bzung : oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: sa ma ya: thog ma'i mgon pos sngon 'gro las rim bstan pa'i le'u bzhi pa'o: ྀatsha: lnga pa dngos gzhi longs sku'i bskyed rim lha yi dkyil 'khor ni: e hoḥ ye nas ka dag mtha' dbus bral: zang thal dmigs med rgya yan pa: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gnas: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na sam+bha trām̐ hrī āḥ hoḥ rang byung rol rtsal sna tshogs shar: kun tu rtog bcas rtog med kyi: dran rig stong gsal 'gag med 'phro: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma:

rang bzhin lhun grub ngang nyid la: ma bcos spros bral rgyu yig hrīḥ kun gzhi khyab brdal dbyings las shar: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dharma hrī a hoḥ hoḥ dbyings las 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs steng : oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ti baṃ oṃ dharma hrī āḥ e s+pha ra ṇa: yaṃ ha ra ṇa: raṃ tsakra ṇa: khaṃ dha ra ṇa: suṃ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa: keṃ swa bhā ṇa: bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa: ma sūr+ya ṇa: a tsan+d+ra ṇa: paṃ pad+ma ṇa: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: hoḥ sna tshogs lnga ldan khri 'phang steng : ma bcos longs sku thabs kyi mdog: mnyam gzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: shes rab rdo rje pad+ma 'khyud: zung 'jug snang la phyed skyil bzhugs: cod pan dmar gsal mnyam gzhag can: hoḥ tshogs brgyad rnam shes gnas dag pa: mthing ser dmar ljang tshad med bzhi: longs sku gar thabs rgyan ldan mdzes: shel phreng pad dkar phyag rgya bzhi: 'byung bzhi rdo rje dung dmar 'khyud: rigs bzhi tshad med sgo skyong ma: ma bcos gdod nas de ltar gsal: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ sa ma ya: longs sku'i rtsa ba'i bskyed rim gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o: ྀatsha: drug pa las rim so sor brgyud pa'i sgrub skor ni: hoḥ stong zhing bdag med ye nas stong : gsal zhing dran rig zang thal sku: chos kun sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul las: bdag med nga zhes rig pa'i rgyal: thog ma'i sku ste sku yi mchog: chags mdangs chags med ngo bo nyid: bde stong rdo rje skyil mo krung : thabs shes mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can: stong pa'i rang mdangs de ltar shar: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ sa ma ya: chos sku ltar sgrub pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o: sa ma ya: bdun pa longs sku kun 'dus ltar sgrub pa ni: hoḥ ma bcos klong las rtsal chen spros: sna tshogs skye 'gag bral ba la: bde chen dpa' bo dkar bzhad 'dzum: longs spyod rdzogs sku phyag bzhi pa: shel phreng pad dkar thal mo can:

mngon rdzogs rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: hoḥ rigs bzhi longs spyod rab rdzogs pa: mthing ga mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin can: lhun grub brkyang bskum phyed skyil mdzes: sa snying chos 'chad mnyam par bzhag: sgeg bzhad phyed skyil rol pa'i stabs: dmar gsal phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol: rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: sngo ljang mchod sprin zil gnon rtsal: 'gyings ldan bzhengs stabs sa gsum gnon: hoḥ rigs bzhi 'jigs pa sgrol mdzad ma: kha dog bzhi ldan gnas lnga rgyas: mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin phyag rgya 'chang : mnyen lcug dgyes pa'i gar mdzad ma: ma 'dres gsal snang lam mer shar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya tā re tu re ye swā hā: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re swā hā: sa ma ya: sna tshogs longs sku'i zhing khams bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: ྀatsha: brgyad pa sprul sku ltar bsgrub pa'i ngo sprod spra khrid ni: hoḥ ma skyes rtsal chen lhun grub che: rol pa'i cho 'phrul he ru kaḥ khros pa'i bzhin mdangs sa bcu sngangs: shes rab ral gris bdud bcom pa: thugs rje lcags kyu bla na med: gar dgu'i chas dang ber chen mdzes: rigs lnga gyad kyi dor stabs can: sna tshogs dpa' bo'i shugs 'chang rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya: he ru ka ngo sprod pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o: ྀatsha: dgu pa spro bsdu rnam bzhi ni: hoḥ ka dag rtsal gyi klong nas gshegs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ rnam dag mkha' dbyings dbus su bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rtog med de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ rang byung ye shes rdzas kyis mchod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hoḥ skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can:

mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku: mi dmigs blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod: 'byung 'jug tshangs dbyangs drug cu stong pa'i sgra: du mar ma grub lhan skyes gnyug ma'i gshis: 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus zang thal 'od sku ldang : oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ sa ma ya: gdams pa bzhi yi le'u ste dgu pa'o: ྀatsha: rgya: cha lag rjes kyi rim pa ni: hoḥ ye shes byin rlabs tshogs chen rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sbyor sgrol mchod pas dgyes par bskyed: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: 'khrul 'dzin bshags shing dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: a la la hoḥ hoḥ las grub rnams kyis lhag ma bzhes: rtsal snang yi dam dbyings nas bzhengs: chad mdo'i srung ma dam ma g.yel: bstan skyong phrin las 'grub par mdzod: yang dag ye shes dngos grub stsol: dug lnga phra rags dbyings su mnan: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi: oṃ kro ta ya ti ya khā hi: oṃ bhak+ṣa si khā hi: oṃ ma ma ting ting khā hi: oṃ sarba sid+dhi dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: oṃ dam sri ya ma nan: hoḥ stong pa'i rang rtsal dbyings la yal: smra med brjod bral shis pa'i tshig: bsngo yul gshis lugs gdod nas dag: mtshams sbyar ma bcos so mar rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgyud lung sgrub pa'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o: ྀatsha: bcu gcig pa las tshogs phran bu dang cha lag bstan pa ni: hoḥ bskyed rdzogs thabs shes cho 'phrul gyi: rtsal chen ma 'gags lam la spro: bla med rdzas mchog sman pa'i rgyal: sgrub pa'i las rim cha rkyen 'grub: bka' yi 'khor lo rim pa lnga: thig le 'od tshom kā li'i sgra: gnad du bsnun pa'i them med sogs: gsang rgya bzhi yi ri mor gnas: sa ma ya: las tshogs them med bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o: ྀatsha: de nas gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mas:

thog ma'i mgon po'i rgyud lung brda bka' bkral te: theg pa phyi nang gi gnad ma lus pa gsungs pa'i don la spro ba skyes te: gtang rag maṇ+ḍal gyi tshigs su bcad pa: e ma snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: skye med rang byung snying po can: ka dag klong dgu'i rgyud tshig rnams: ngo mtshar che ba'i gsang sngags nyid: sngon chad bdag gis thos ma myong : deng 'dir bka' stsal bla med spro: klong dgu theg chen gnang ba'i yon: kun gzhi rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul: khyab brdal chos dbyings dkyil 'khor la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bus brgyan: bdag 'dzin ye grol ngang nyid kyis: blo 'das thog ma'i mgon por 'bul: ngos 'dzin bral bar bzhes su gsol: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtang rag tshul gyis maṇ+ḍal phul nas: thog ma'i mgon po'i gsungs bzhin ḍāk+kis brda'i yi ger btab nas: dbyings 'od gsal gong bu can gyi drung : ye shes 'khor lo lnga yi pho brang du gter la sbas: gter srung sgra gcan 'khor lo can dang : mkha' 'gro kun 'dus drwa ba'i dbang mor bcol: sa ma ya: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi rgyud bsdus te gter du sbas pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o: de nas thog ma'i mgon po rang dbyings rtsal la thim pa'i tshe bka' stsal pa: e hoḥ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro 'khor rnams nyon: ka dag rang sgra stong pa'i mdangs: ma 'gags rig pa'i klong du thim: lta ba zang thal mtha' dbus bral: nga ni bdag med chos kyi dbyings: rnam pa kha dog blo las 'das: gsang ba ḍāk+ki brda yi grogs: ye nas rang byung rang sar gnas: khyed rnams ye shes rtsal la thim: a āḥhūm̐ āḥ zhes sgra de skad thos pa dang chos sku yang stong pa'i rang mdangs yin par thag chod gnas lugs kyi don rtogs te: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro yang 'ja' tshon dbyings la yal ba ltar chos sku'i rang mdangs la thim mo: sa ma ya: gsang ba mkha' 'gro mngon rdzogs dbyings la thim pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o:

ྀatsha: e ma hoḥ bla med yang gsang chen po bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi rgyud: dang po lo rgyus kyi rnam dbye bstan pa ni: sngon bskal pa lhun grub bkod pa zhes bya ba'i dus su: 'og min snang mtha'i pho brang dbyibs dang bkod pa blo las 'das pa'i dbus su: yon tan thams cad rab tu rdzogs pa'i khri'i steng du: ston pa thog ma'i mgon po rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so: yang de'i tshe: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar mas thog ma'i mgon po la dgongs brgyud kyi tshul du theg pa mtha' dag zhus te: mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ge ru bsgyur nas dbyings la sbas: yang de yi tshe: klong dgu rgyud kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa: longs sku thugs rje'i bdag nyid dbyings kyi dga' rab rdo rje'i brda bzhi'i tshul du rgyud rnams gdan drangs te rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la snyan brgyud mu tig rtsal phreng gi tshul du rgyud lung gnang : gu ru rin po che'i gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal dang : lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes: lha lcam dhe wa dha ra rnams kyis tshig brgyud brda yi shog ser la btab ste: bka' yi rgya gtad: ma 'ongs pa'i don du smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar: rten 'brel mi nyams pa'i gnas sbas yul pad+ma rong du gter rgya'i lung bstan: gter srung ki kang rā hu lar gnyer gtad: khyad par 'gro don dang gdul zhing rnams ma 'ongs nyi shu'i mgo tshugs te: bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib bskal pa'i rlung g.yos par 'byung : ru bzhi'i dmag khrims thams cad chu tshan khol ba ltar 'khrug: sems can bde skyid zad: khyad par nad rigs sngar ma grags pa rnams dar: mi rnams tshe 'phrang bdud kyi dbang du 'gro: chos byed nyung zhing sdig spyod mang bas: sems can bde 'gro mtho ris kyi them skas chag ste ngan song gi g.yang du lhung : de'i tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon 'di nyid zab cing 'brel tshad byang chub thob cing phyir mi ldog pa mang du 'byung :
gzhan yang lam sna zin pa ni 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya:

e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab snying thig thugs rje chen po yi: rgyud dang las rim cha tshang don dril bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: thugs sras rtsa gsum gling dang 'phrad par shog: skal ngan bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor sbas yul brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing : gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las bsgyur ro// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: bla med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi khrid bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: zab don khrid kyi gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang a ti bla med 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i rgyud khrid bstan pa ni: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum ste: dang po sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa zung du 'jug pa gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro thun mong gi rim pa ni: dus dang gnas skabs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par dgos zhes na: ji ltar nyams su len pa'i dgos pa bzhi ni: yul phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam gling kha ba can: yul ljongs dben zhing rnam g.yeng med pa: ston pa phun sum tshogs pa byin rlabs kyi rgyud 'brel ba'i rig 'dzin lung nas zin pa: slob ma phun sum tshogs pa shes rab che la ngang rgyud ring zhing dad pa brtan pa: maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa bdag lus longs spyod bu dang chung ma yul dang bcas pa 'bul: de ltar dus dang gnas skabs phun sum tshogs nas: gnyis pa zung 'jug sngon 'gro gnad kyi gdams pa ni: kyaiḥ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i tshig:

rig pa'i khye'u chung legs par nyon: lta ba sangs rgyas lag bcang 'di: bstan par byed pa'i gzer bu gsum: lus ni ma bcos rtsa bzhi lhod: ngag ni ma bcos smra ba chod: sems ni ma bcos 'du shes shig: rlung ni gcun pa'i 'phrul 'khor bdun: rtsa rnams drang phyir sgal tshigs bsrang : shes pa phebs phyir mgrin pa dgug: snal ma dal phyir mig 'bras lhod: rtsol ba gzhol phyir lce rkan sprod: tshigs pa bsrang phyir dpung pa brgyang : lhod la bsgrim phyir skyil krung bca': rlung rig bsre phyir dbugs sna lhod: gzer bu spyi chings 'phrul 'khor ro: sa ma ya: don gnyis pa la yang gsum ste: dang po shes rgyud bstan pa la: grogs snying rje dang phan sems bskyed pa ni: bdag ni bla med theg pa chen po'i sgor zhugs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam du sems bskyed cing nges 'byung gi shes pa skye bar bya: gnyis pa de las byung ba'i ngang nas: dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus su don chen zhig bsgrub dgos te: yang yang 'di 'dra rnyed pa shin tu dkon: de yang 'jig sla ba ni mi rtag sgyu ma dang rmi lam glog gi rang bzhin: deng 'chi sang 'chi cha ma mchis pa: 'di lta bu'i dus su so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis 'chi ba mi dran nas sdig pa rngam po che bsags pa 'di rnams snying re rje: bdag kyang dus de ring nas dam pa'i chos kho na byed pa cog bzhag go zhes dam bca' bzung : gsum pa la: bdag cag 'khor ba thog ma med pa tha ma da lta yan chod du 'khrul zhing 'khyams: de yang rgyu dge ba'i 'bras bu bde 'gro ste: mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna zin: mi dge ba'i 'bras bu ngan song ste: rigs drug gi duḥkha myong zhing thar pa'i dus ma mchis pas der mi skye ba'i thabs bya'o bsam pa'i blo rgya bskyed:

sa ma ya: kyai: rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: sems bskyed dge ba'i smon lam kyang : ma gyur rigs drug sems can rnams: yang dag don chen 'grub pa yi: byang chub sems kyis dam bca' bzung : sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi lus 'di: 'jig sla yang yang thob pa dka': don chen 'bras bu 'thob pa la: mi dge spang zhing nyes ltung 'dzem: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: dge bcu bsod nams stobs dag gis: bde 'gro mtho ris go 'phang thob: mtshams med pham ltung rnam smin gyis: rigs drug ngan song duḥkha myong : de phyir rgyu 'bras kho na'o: sa ma ya: de yang byin rlabs 'jug pa gsol 'debs skyabs yul: tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rim pa ste: don gsum las: dang po skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dkon mchog rnam gsum mos te gsol ba btab: rgyud la byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol zhes smon lam bya: gnyis pa gling bzhi ri rab bdag lus longs spyod dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par sems bskyed: gsum pa skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim ste: mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: gtan gyi skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum: gsol 'debs smon lam mtshams kyis sbyar: theg chen bsod nams maṇ+ḍal nyid: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa 'bul: sku gsum 'od zhu rang la bstim: rjes shes mi rtog so mar bzhag: sa ma ya: de yang 'bras bu dngos gzhi ngo sprod la gsum ste: gzhi lam 'bras bu lus dang rlung rig skye 'gag gnas gsum ngo bo rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes so: dang po gzhi bca' ba'i rten gzer bu ngo sprad pa'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: tshogs drug lhug pa'i lus gnad la: lta stangs bral la so mar zhog: gang tshe 'gyu ba phra mo nyid: rlung gi rta dang bcas te 'gyu:

phyi yul snang ba'i gzugs la chags: gnas pas nang du khyam me ba: gzugs la 'dzin pa skyes pa'i tshe: gzugs rnams snang yang ngo bo stong : 'gyu ba rang byung rang la shar: phyi yul snang ba'i cho 'phrul nyid: phyam gyis gnas pa de yang stong : rdzogs pa chen po 'gro 'ong bral: sa ma ya: gnyis pa gsung ma 'gags grags stong du ngo sprad de sgra med la bslab pa'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: smra brjod bral ba'i ngag gnad la: sgra tshig bral te so mar zhog: gang tshe tshor ba phra mo yis: legs nyes dbyangs kyi rta la chags: gnas pa nang du ban ne bun: bdag 'dzin rtog pa shar ba'i tshe: sgra ni ye nas grags shing stong : tshor ba bdag med stong pa nyid: 'gyu 'ong phyi nang sa mtshams med: ban bun shes pa bdag med grol: rdzogs pa chen po skye 'gag bral: sa ma ya: gsum pa yid ma bcos byar med lhun grub 'dus ma byas kyi ngo sprad te so mar bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: bsam gzhig bral ba'i sems gnad la: dran rig gsal stong so mar zhog: gang tshe 'du shes phra mo yis: sna tshogs gzung 'dzin ro la chags: rnam rtog phra rags tho ro ro: dgag sgrub rtog pa shar ba'i tshe: sems ni gsal stong ngo bor ltos: dran rig zang thal skye 'gag bral: gshis lugs bzhag pas 'gyu ba dag: rdzogs chen smra bsam brjod 'das so: sa ma ya: gzhi lam ma bcos lhun grub gsal stong dbyings rig la ngo sprad cing gzhi khregs chod bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: gzhi ni gnyug ma khyab cing brdal: lam ni zang thal ma 'gags 'gyu: 'bras bu rang byung snying po'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: tshad bzung bral ba rig pa'i klong : gting dpag rgya khyon gzhal las 'das: ka dag dbyings rig mtha' dbus bral: skye med ye shes blo 'das so: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: rtsa ni dbu ma mkha' spyod dbyings:

rlung ni sgra gcan kun tu rgyu: thig le stong pa chen po nyid: sems ni kun rtog mtshan ma bral: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: ngo bo sna tshogs stong pa nyid: rang bzhin bdag med ci yang 'char: thugs rje 'gag med kun tu khyab: de phyir gzhi yi rig pa'o: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: chos sku skyes pas nyon mongs 'gag: nyon mongs ngo bo chos skur grol: ye shes skyes nas 'khrul pa 'gag: 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ye shes so: de phyir ro gcig ngang du gnas: sa ma ya: kyai rig pa'i khye'u chung nyon: nga ni bdag med chos kyi sku: rang byung ma 'gags rig pa'i klong : sna tshogs dran rig sgyu ma'i chos: 'khor 'das ro gcig so mar gnas: dge sdig 'bras bu kha las 'das: re dogs bde sdug ming yang med: ka dag rang byung zang thal nyid: gshis lugs lta ba khregs chod la: bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis su med: blo bral 'od gsal snying po ste: ye grol rang byung rang shar ro: gdod nas ka dag e ma hoḥ sa ma ya: ma chos sku dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros bu rig pa'i khye'u chung la gdams pa: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki'i brda lung bzhi pa: gu rus shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga nas gdan drangs pa'i ngo sprod tshig rkang bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: tshig rkang rdo rje'i ngo sprod bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas khrom gter du bgyis shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ro// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: btags grol sku 'khor gyi gdams pa bzhugs so: 'jig rten dbang phyug dkyil 'khor lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs sems can don slad du: btags grol sku yi 'khor lo bstan:

yi ger thob la gter du sbos: 'di nyid 'chang ba'i skal ldan rnams: rigs drug sdug bsngal las sgrol zhing : skye gnas rnam bzhi'i sgo khegs te: sa bcu lam lnga cig car bgrod: tshe 'dir bkra shis byang sems 'phel: nam zhig phung po yal ba'i tshe: 'ja' 'od gur dang me tog char: 'bab cing ri bo tā la nas: zhing khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: rol mo dbyangs bcas mchod sprin gyis: legs par bsu zhing ya mtshan gyi: sna tshogs bkod pa khyad 'phags 'byung : skye ba longs sku'i zhing du bzhugs: rnam sprul byang chub sems dpa' yi: 'gro don dpag med mthar phyin cing : mi brjed gzungs kyang rab tu thob: mtshan 'dzin 'khrul pas mi bslad cing : 'khrul med ye sangs rgyas pa'i mchog: ngo mtshar bla med sprul sku 'byung : de phyir gdams pa khyad par 'phags: skal ldan rnams kyis 'chang gyur na: rtse gcig rang byung ye shes 'char: skal med dred po yin gyur kyang : tshe rabs las sgrib bag chags byang : gang zhig mang po 'gyur ba'i lam: dkyil 'khor gdugs ltar mar 'bubs bris: rigs drug sems can ma lus kun: lan gcig 'og tu 'dzul gyur na: bskal stong bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams: mun khang sgron mes khengs pa ltar: nges par byang 'gyur the tshom med: gzhan yang tshe 'phos shi ba'i rigs: spyi bor 'khor los dbang bskur bas: rnam shes mkha' spyod myur lam bgrod: phung po sreg sbyong dor ba'i tshe: gdung dang ring bsrel sna tshogs 'byung : 'di nyid bri ba'i gdams pa ni: bkra shis dge ba'i nyi ma la: mthing shog dwangs ma'i ngos dag la: rin chen zhun ma'i khu bas bris: sman mchog drug gi nus pa sbyar: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po yi: rab tu gnas shing 'chang ngam phub: rin chen khu ba ma 'grig na: rgya mtshal lam ni rgya snag gis: yi ge lhag chad med pa gces: 'bri tshe sems bskyed ldan par bya: spar la 'khod cing spel gyur na:

bka' 'gyur bsgrags pa'i phan yon mnyam: yang snying gdams pa sa ma ya: dang po lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma lnga la: oṃḥhūm̐ḥtrām̐ḥhrīḥ.āḥ rtsibs mchan la: mūm̐ḥlām̐ḥmām̐ḥpām̐ḥtām̐ḥ mu khyud la: oṃ bho dhi sa twa sa ma ya: dharma dz+nyā na ma ma pā paṃ bi shwa dha na pa ri wā re ye swā hā: de'i phyi rol 'dab ma drug la: oṃḥmaḥṇiḥpadaḥmeḥhūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: aḥnuḥtaḥraḥhrīḥdhaḥ mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra dharma hrī dha ya ta thā ga ta ār+ya lo ki shwa ra dz+nyā na pañca pra bha rasmi sarba sa twa na mo hūm̐: ma ma a tri su+u nṛ pre du sarba pā paṃ dā ha na bha smiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de'i phyi rol pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la: oṃ bud+dha sa twa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: oṃ karma sa twa hūm̐: oṃ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: oṃ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: oṃ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: rtsibs brgyad la: dpe khag gcig la rtsibs mchan bris 'dug mchan/ oṃ ak+ṣo bhe hūm̐: oṃ mā+ai tri mūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ k+ṣi triṃ gar+bha hūm̐: oṃ khaṃ ghar+bha hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐: oṃ wā gī shwa ri hūm̐: oṃ lo ki shwa ri hūm̐: oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ karma ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ sa ma ya ḍāk+ki hūm̐: oṃ bi shwa ḍāk+ki hūm̐: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ a wa lo ki te bo dhi sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: bo dhi sa twa te no pa: tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhiṃ m+me pra yañca: sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ: shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: bo dhi sa twa mā me muñca: a wa lo ki te hṛ da ya ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ de yi phyi rol rtsibs kyi thig le 'ja' gur nyer gcig gi dbus su:

hrīḥ dkar po muṃ dmar po tshom bu'i grangs ltar bya: hrī muṃ: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bris: sgrib sbyong sham bu sogs sbyar: de yi phyi rol sku 'khor bya na: 'ja' gur dang lha yi stong ra: dkyil 'khor ltar na rang gzhung gi thig rtsa mtshon mdog: yang 'khor lo ltar na rdo rwa pad phreng me ri bya: yang 'ja' 'od nyi zer gyis 'khyud pa bya yang rung : de ltar btags grol sku yi 'khor lo gsung sngags kyi sgra don gyi dbyings dang rnam pa gnad gsum gcig tu dril ba'o: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: ma 'ongs skal ldan las can don: btags grol sku yi 'khor lo bzhag: drang srong ki kang rā hu la: dam chos 'di yi gter rgya srungs: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: mi zad pa: gter rgya: mi mthong ba: sbas rgya: chos kyi yang snying : zab rgya: snod min gyis mi rig par: gsang rgya: skal ldan dang 'phrad pa: gtad rgya: chos bdag la sprod: spel rgya: bgrang yas la: mi nub rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor sbas yul brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas khrom gter du bgyis te gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ro// //

thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: chos sku ltar sgrub thabs ye shes snying po bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: chos sku rigs bdag sgrub thabs ni: dkyil 'khor las gzhung lta bu la: dbus su zla gam sgo gcig pa: pad+ma 'dab bzhis mtshan par bya: tshom bu ye shes lnga ldan tshul: dbus dmar shar kar lho ser zhing : nub mthing byang ljang rim bzhin bya: dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa ni: dri bzang chu yis sum gnyis bkang : de steng bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : li khri byugs pa'i ril bus gtams: dar tshon sna lngas kha bcad de: rdo rje dag gis rgyas gdab bo: gang yang 'tshams pa'i gzhi yi khar: pad gzhong rin chen nang du ni: chos sku'i gtor ma zlum po la: ril bus bskor zhing rgyan bkra ni: mdzes tshon nyi zla nor bus spras: gdan yang pad+ma 'dab bzhi'o: gzhan yang phyi nang mchod rdzas bsham: 'di dag spros pa che na bya: spros med bya na rang nyid kyi: phung po gzhal yas dkyil 'khor lha: rang byung rang shar ngang la bsgrub: sngags bzlas 'byung 'jug rlung gi sgra: 'gyu 'gros dag dang bstun te bzla: rang rig lta ba chos kyi sku: gang shar 'dzin med lhug par bsgrub: spros bcas spros med zung 'jug ni: phyi ltar spros pa'i mchod pa yang : bskyed rim sgyu ma'i ngang tshul bya: nang ltar sngags bzlas dmigs pa yang : rdzogs rim dri med zung 'jug bya: de ltar gnyis med bsgrub pa ni: rang nyid bde ba'i gdan la 'khod: rnam snang rdo rje skyil krung bya: rang rig yid kyi mdung mo de: kun snang sgyu ma'i mkha' la gtad: mi rtog gnyug ma'i rten bca' ste: rtog pa rtsal sbyong bsgrub pa bya: sa ma ya: dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing sgrub pa byed pa ni: spros pa ltar na las gzhung nas sngon 'gro blangs te: dngos gzhi dran rdzogs wal gyis dkyil 'khor dang lha gsal zhing sngags kyi spro bsdu sogs spyi rgyud ltar bya:

bsnyen tshad kyang 'bum ther las mi nyung bar bzlas pas grub rtags ni: rab chos sku ro gcig gi rtogs pa bcos min 'khrungs shing : mi rtog ye shes la rgyun du gnas: gnas skabs kyang bde gsal 'od lus drwa ba 'khor yug tu 'gyur: phyi ltar snang srid sgyu mar rtogs: nang ltar rnam rtog phra rags kyi 'dzin pa chad: nga bdag 'gong po'i 'du shes 'jig: rkyen bzang ngan gyi dbang du mi 'gro: yid kyi rtog pa phra mos gzhan gyi shes rgyud mthong : kun rtog ma rig mun pa'i the tshom spangs: lus yang bkrag mdangs bde ba rgyas: 'bring gi rtags su yi dam gyi lha zhal mjal: longs sku lnga ldan gyi zhing khams bgrod pa'i nyams 'char: sngags kyi bden tshig 'grub: thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung : 'jig rten rnams dbang du 'du: gzhan gyi bskur te rim gro bgyid: bskyed rim brtan: lus kyi nad gdon zhi: mi kha byams: bkra shis ltas 'byung : tha ma yang : dag snang rmi lam gyi skabs su: lus la nyi zla shar ba: hūm̐ zhes sogs sngags sgras stong gsum khengs pa: lus la me 'bar ba: sngar shes mi shes kyi mi sna tshogs dbang du 'du ba: chos bshad pa: dam tshig bdud rtsi'i ro myong ba sogs rmi ltas bzang po 'byung : khyad par gyi grub rtags ni: mchod pa'i bdud rtsi khol ba: yon chab dang gtor ma mi 'khyag pa: mchod pa bkrag mdangs rgyas pa: dri zhim gyi bcud snom pa: sngags sgra dang dmigs pa gsal ba: phyi nang rkyen gyis bar mi chod pa: gtor ma'am rol mo'i sgra skad la rta bskyon nas sngags sgra sgrog pa: nyams za zi la lus la 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba sogs 'byung : ji ltar nyams rtags bzang ngan gang byung yang yid blos mi dpyad par 'dzin med la bzhag go: sa ma ya: dang po dran rdzogs dang dkyil 'khor gsal gdab cing byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ: mtshan ldan brdal khyab stong nyid e yi snod: āḥ rang byung snying po ye shes mchod pa'i rdzas:

hūm̐: kun tshang yid 'ong zad med gter gyi mdzod: hrīḥ byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i sprin phung spros pa yi: haḥ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag yas 'geng ba'i tshogs: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig: phaiṃḥ snang srid zang thal dkyil 'khor lha ru gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī ha ho phaiṃ phaiṃ: zhes phyi nang dkyil 'khor rnams dus gcig la byin gyis brlabs: de nas dran rdzogs wal gyis lha gsal ba ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shu+ud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las e las rang byung nam mkha' 'byung lnga yongs su gyur pa las: chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa: rtse mor rin po che sna tshogs tog gis mdzes pa: 'ja' 'od thig le pha gu rin chen drwa bas legs par spras pa: de yi dbus su zla gam sgo gcig pa'i nang du: gyad dang seṅge rta mchog rma bya shang shang gis btegs pa'i khri yi steng du: pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru nyi zla kha sbyor gdan dang sa bon srog yig hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'ub kyis sdud: hrī la thim: hrī dran rdzogs ngo bo snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba: sku mdog dmar gsal dri med pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ltar gzi brjid cher 'bar ba: thugs rje'i spyan gyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs shing : zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa: lta ba mi shigs rdo rje'i gtsug tor 'khyil zhing mtho ba: gsal stong phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zung gis 'jug pa: mi 'gyur ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te: gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs mnga' 'od klong gong bu rab tu rgyas te: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi la ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi thig le zer phreng dang bcas pa'o:

thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng 'khor bas: lus phyi nang thams cad gang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag: slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snang srid snod bcud kyi tshe bsod bkrag mdangs thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas: thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim pas: gzi brjid dang mthu stobs rgyas shing : kun gzhi rgyu yi rig pa mngon du gyur par bsam: sngags rlung 'byung 'jug la bstun te phyi nang rlung la tshar re re yid bzlas bya: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags lhag chad med pa sgra ma nyams pa gces: yang spros pa ltar na: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing khams nas: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma skyes skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: mi shigs 'khor lo rgyas pa'i khri steng du: snang mtha' chos sku ye shes lha tshogs rnams: chu zla lta bur rnyog med brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skye med snying po sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kha dog bral yang ma 'gags sna tshogs 'char: kun rgyu shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba'i sku: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi:

de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings rig 'od stong rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: ka dag dang po kun gzhi rig pa'i rgyal: skal bzang thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces spros pa ltar na mtshams 'dir: hoḥ rang rig bla ma chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mtha' skor du: a mi dhe wa'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: lus kun khyab ste bde gsal mi rtog ngang : 'byung 'jug rlung gi rang sngags sgrog par gyur: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pas bsgrub: sham bu las bzhi ltar spyi mthun bya: de nas sgrub pa grol te ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba ni: bum pa gnas lngar bzhag la: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang : dkyil 'khor bsdu: bkra shis brjod: bsngo smon bya: rjes stong nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skal ldan don: rigs bdag chos sku'i sgrub thabs bzhag: lnga brgya nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: rtsa gsum gling dang 'phrad par shog: gter srung gza' mchog ki kang rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor sbas yul pad+ma shel phug nas khrom gter du bgyis te gdan drangs shing : gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ro// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: longs sku ltar sgrub thabs pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma yang snying 'dus pa las: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal po nyid: longs sku lta bur sgrub thabs bstan:

sngon 'gro las kyi rim pa ni: dben zhing spro la dge ba'i yul: bkra shis yid 'ong byin chags gnas: rgyud dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su: yar tshes dge ba'i nyin dag la: dkyil 'khor spyi mthun gzhung bzhin gdab: dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris: dkar ser dmar ljang lha yi mdog: tshom bu sa bon zhib tu bkod: mu khyud 'ja' 'od gur kyang bris: longs sku'i 'dra 'bag gsung rten bkram: bum pa rgyan dang sngags phreng bcas: rigs lnga me long shel rdo dang : dam rdzas sman raka phud kyang bsham: gtor ma rin chen nor bu'i gzugs: pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba la: 'khor yang bshos chung brgyad kyis bskor: rtse mor phyag mtshan mdzes tshon spras: gzhan yang phyi nang mchod pa bshams: las byang dag nas sngon 'gro blang : sngags bzlas grub rtags chos sku ltar: gzhan rnams thams cad spyi dang mthun: sa ma ya: de yang thugs rje chen po sgrub par brtson pa ni: rdzas dang lag len rnams zhib tu khrid: dbang dang rgyud kyis phyug par byed: myong grol spyi sman ltar ril bu'am 'dig gu gang rung byas la sgrub rdzas brtsam: de yang longs sku phyi nang gi sgrub pa: phyi ltar na bskyed rim sgyu ma'i sku: kun rdzob thabs la brten pa ste: mchod pa dang dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsham: nang ltar na rdzogs rim 'od gsal la brten pa: rang lus lha yi pho brang gdod nas gnyug mar gnas pa de thog tu rang byung rang shar la spros med ltar mchod pa dang dkyil 'khor ma grub kyang rang tshang yin: gsang ba phyi nang zung du 'jug pa: bdag mdun dbyer med dang : bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug zhes pas: phyi ltar bsod nams rgyu yis tshogs bsags mchod pa bsham: 'bras bu ye shes kyis tshogs bsags bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas sogs gzhung bzhin bya ba longs sku ltar sgrub pa 'bring po 'di'i lugs: rtogs pa yang 'bring pos nyams len du 'dod: dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni:

dang po skyabs yul sngon 'gro song nas: mchod pa byin rlabs la sogs gzhung chen mo nas blang : dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni: phyi nang don dang ldan pa'i ngang nas: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid zang thal klong : khyab brdal rang bzhin 'byung lnga bsnol ba yi: lhun grub gsal stong 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo rdzogs rgyan dang rta babs mdzes: rin chen tog mdzes 'ja' zer 'od klong gtibs: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshugs longs sku'i dbu rgyan la: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan dbyings la bskyod: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu thal mo sbyar: sku stod lha rdzas dar sngon rgyan gyis bklubs: sku smad dar dmar mdzes pa'i ang rag gsol: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs par spras: rdo rje skyil krung mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i tshul: snang stong 'ja' lus sgrib med gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: shar phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po kha sar+pa ṇi mthing : longs sku'i cha lugs mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin tshul: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐: lho phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po sa snying sku mdog ser: dgyes bzhad mdangs mnga' longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas chos 'chad g.yon pas mnyam bzhag can: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal po dmar: mdzes chags 'dzum ldan longs sku'i rgyan spras ldan: phyag gnyis las kyi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol:

zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: hūm̐: byang phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ljang : khro 'dzum mdzes ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas zil gnon can: zhabs gnyis gshib cing ldem pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: thams cad shel phreng pad dkar mdzes tshul bsnams: gsal stong gzi 'bar ma bcos lhang nger gsal: hūm̐: mtshams bzhi pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar sgeg mdzes pa mo: ral pa'i thor tshugs rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis spras: zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin mdzad: sna tshogs mdzes ldan 'greng thabs tshul gyis bzhugs: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: chu zla dang ni 'ja' tshon lhags pa ltar: gsal stong ma bcos spros bral ngang la bskyed: lhun grub rang shar lha tshogs gtso 'khor gyi: thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar: sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas phyi nang sdig sgrib dag: lus kun khyab pas mchog thun dngos gru+ub thob: slar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod: tshur 'dus byin rlabs gzi brjid bdag la thim: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya tā re tu re swā hā:

gcig dril sgrub sngags ni: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags phreng rnams rgyud ltar pho g.yas mo g.yon du 'khor bar bsam: yab yum so sor phral ba gong gi sngags ltar la: gnyis med sgrub pa gcig sgril lta bur g.yas su 'khor kyang rung : sngags kyang bya rgyud spyod rgyud g.yas su 'khor: bla med rnal 'byor g.yon du 'khor kyang rung : yang longs sku'i sgrub pa spros bcas 'dod na: las byang rgyas pa nas spyan 'dren bstod pa blang bar bya: spyir sgrub pa spyi mthun ltar na bsdus pa spros med ltar 'don: 'on kyang gang zag rab 'bring gi dbang po dang bstun te bsgrub par bya: dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs mos na las byang nas blang : sgrub pa grol nas dbang bzhi yang gzhung ltar bya yang rung : spros med ltar na: sku gsum yig 'brus dbang blang : rjes bsngo smon sogs rgyas gdab par bya: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: longs sku lta bu'i sgrub pa bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sa rtags lung bstan mthun pa'i tshe: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: rnam sprul o rgyan rtsa gsum gling : las can thugs sras de nyid la: chos 'di sprod cig ki kang rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: thim rgya: spel rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ glang lor sbas yul pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: sprul sku he ru ka ltar sgrub thabs bzhugs so: dbang chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma yang snying 'dus pa las: longs sku cho rol rtsal chen gyis: gnyis med he ru ka par sprul: rab khros sprul sku khro bo'i rgyal: rta nag lcags ral sgrub pa'i thabs: dus dang gnas skabs cha rkyen te: dang po bca' gzhi'i rim pa ni:

dkyil 'khor mthing nag dal kyang bcag: thig gdab las rim spyi mthun bya: dbus su lte ba chos 'byung dang : phyi rol rtsibs chen bzhi ru bya: tshom bu lha mdog legs par bkod: gzhan yang sku 'bag rten sogs bkram: bum pa rnam rgyal rdzas kyis gtams: sman raka dang ni phyi mchod bsgrig: gtor ma zlum po zur gsum pa: lte bar chos 'byung gdengs ka can: pad 'dab bzhi dang gtor zur bzhi: legs par bskor te bhan+dhar bskyil: rtse mor me ri dag kyang 'dzugs: mthing nag gur phub spyan gzigs bkram: gzhan yang spyi mthun zhal shes gces: sa ma ya: de yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni: rang nyid skad cig dpa' bo rta mgrin du gsal te: sngags phreng rnams lha rang rang gi thugs kar 'khor bar bsgom: yang spros pa bya na sngon 'gro longs sku'i cho ga nas blangs shing mchod pa byin gyis brlab: dngos gzhi la 'jug pa bdag mdun dbyer med ngang nas: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e nam mkha' mthing nag rgya gram rlung gis btegs shing 'byung ba bsnol brtsegs su chags pa'i steng du: bh+rūm̐ las sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod kyi bkod pa shin tu 'jigs pa: de yi dbus su bhan+dha skam rlon gyi pho brang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa: bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag 'khrigs pa'i dbus su: paṃḥlas pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor cher 'bar ba: rgyal bsen pho mo gan rkyal du bsnol ba'i steng du: yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: dgra bgegs 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad: 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyil zhing : sma ra dang smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba:

dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad lhang lhang 'tsher ba: thod skam gyi dbu rgyan: sbrul nag gi skra chings: dar nag gi cod pan sogs rgyan du mas spras pa: phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gri klad la phyar bas: dgra bgegs dum bur gtub pa: g.yon pas 'dzin byed me yi lcags kyus dam nyams gdug pa'i snying rtsa 'dren pa: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing : dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba: zhabs gnyis gyad kyis dor stabs bgrad cing dam sri'i snying khar brdzis pas sa gsum rab tu sngangs pa: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal bar gyur: gtso bo'i shar du dam sri dang pad nyi'i gdan la zhi ba'i rta mgrin dkar po: lhor gre bo dang pad nyi'i gdan la rgyas pa'i rta mgrin ser po: nub tu 'byung po dang pad nyi'i gdan la dbang gi rta mgrin dmar po: byang du klu srin dang pad nyi'i gdan la drag po'i rta mgrin ljang nag: de rnams kyang gtso bo'i cha lugs dang mthun pa: bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil du gsal ba'o: gtso 'khor rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur: zhes gsol ba btab bas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes pas dbang bskur zhing bzhugs par bsam: oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ham̐'u: dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis mchod pa'i bcud drangs te gsol bas: mnyes shing tshim par gyur te sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag sel zhing thugs dam bskang bar mdzad du gsol:

oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul: de nas bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo: chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags mchog dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag gyur pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang rigs kyi bdag po chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: longs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku he ru ka dbang chen rta mgrin nag po dpa' bo lha lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma sring ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang rigs drug sems can thams cad dbang chen rta mgrin chen po'i lha tshogs gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi phul: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung lhun grub pho brang nas: rig rtsal mngon gyur dpal chen he ru kaḥ mthu stobs gzi byin dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: phyi nang gdon tshogs 'byung po tshar gcod pa: dbang chen rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod cing snying po sngags kyi spro bsdu ni: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs kar yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' bskor sngags phreng mgal me ltar 'khor bas: lus kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas snod bcud brtan cing g.yo ba'i rang bzhin thams cad me ri dang khro bo'i rang bzhin du gyur:

oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gcig dril sngags ni: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kro ta pañca hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams lhag chad med par bzlas: sham bu las bzhi sogs spyi dang mthun: skabs su rgyal bsen dam btags sham bu ni: oṃ badz+ra tri gha ta ya rgyal bsen gyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bdud gcod sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra he raṃ ti du shag kha la yam bdud tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pa sngags gang 'os gzhung ltar bzlas: tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig las mi nyung bar bya: sgrub pa grol tshe las gzhung chen mo nas dbang blang : rjes rang la bstim zhing bkra shis bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang gsang sgrub pa snying gi don tshan bzhag: mi nub brtan pa rgya mtsho'i klong du sbos: drang srong gza' mchog ki kang rā hu la: klu sman chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan gyis: zab chos 'di nyid thub par srungs shig rgya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rgyal sras pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas glang lor sbas yul pad+ma shel phug nas khrom gter du gdan drangs pa'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: 'jam dpal dmar po'i tshe sgrub bzhugs so: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mkhyen rab 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho bo ye shes kyis: 'jam dpal tshe sgrub nyi zla gwa'u bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yang zab snying po bcud kyi ril bu 'di: gang gis sgrub kyang 'ja' lus myur du 'grub: gdams ngag kun gyi mthar thug sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bstan pa ni: tshe bum rnam rgyal kha rgyan mgul chings spras: myong grol sgrub sman rdzas kyis sum gnyis bkang : sngags 'di bris pa'i me long kha rgyan bya:

oṃ a ra pa tsa na: dbus la dhīḥ bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang du sngags 'khor ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ wā gī shwa ra ā yur+dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru bh+rūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags 'di lag len lta bur bris: de dbus tshe bum nor bus mtshan pa la: sa bon spras pa'i kha rgyan legs par 'dzugs: mda' dar dag la sku 'khor shog dril ni: lte bar rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus su: dhīḥbh+rūm̐ ha ri ni sa: mu khyud la: oṃ wa gī shwa ri muṃ ā yur dha ra sa pa ri wā ra ye swā hā: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ puṇ+yai puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ aṣ+ṭi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ mu tra puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ār+ya pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ yo gi pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ ri dhi pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ sau k+ṣa pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mu khyud la: oṃ mañju shrī wā gī shwa ri ṇi ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru bh+rūm̐ sarba a pa ra mi ta te dz+wa dz+nyā na ye swā hā: bdag 'chang ba po la brtan g.yo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa 'byung ba'i bcud thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas thim ste rab tu rgyas par gyur cig swā hā: de yi phyi rol pad+ma'i phreng ba dang rdo rwa me ri: rdzas ni myong grol sman legs par byugs shing tshe yi rten du bzhag: sgrub pa grol nas dbang blang rang nyid 'chang : sin+dhu ra yi sngags ni thugs kar bstim: myong grol sman ni 'gro don spel kyang rung : shin tu zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gcig brgyud yin: mang du ma spel dam du 'chang bar gyis: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro skyabs yul gang rung song nas: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ swā hā: hūm̐: 'dzam gling khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sna bdun rnam lnga mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: sman gtor rak+ta spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas:

sku 'khor srog rten 'chi med bsgrub pa'i sman: bum pa gzhal yas bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams: sku gsum yig 'bru'i byin rlabs rab bskul nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ga lak+ṣa pā da dharma o ṇa a mṛ ta badz+ra hrī dha ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā: zhes phyi nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs byin gyis brlabs: gnyis pa dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med sku mchog rdo rje'i dal bzung nas: mi 'da' dam tshig snying gi srog lta bur: mi gtong bsgrubs te rtse gcig gnas byas nas: 'jam dpal tshe bdag go 'phang thob gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐: gsum pa gzhal yas gdan dang lha gsal ba ni: hūm̐: e mthing nam mkha' rlung ljang rgya gram brtsegs: me mched chu khol sa gzhi ri rab brjid: de steng sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram steng : bh+rūm̐ las 'chi med tshe yi gzhal yas ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor tog: phyi nang mtshan nyid kun tshang rgyan gyis spras: srung gur pad+ma rdo rwa dur khrod dang : ral gri bsnol thabs me ri phyogs bzhir 'khrigs: phra mo'i rlung yang mi bgrod gzhal yas dbus: dhīḥyig dmar po gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: mkhas mchog gzhon nu shes rab 'jam dpal dbyangs: tshe bdag mgon po li khri dbang gi mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro 'dzum chags pa'i mdangs: dkar dmar mthing zhal spyi bor rigs lngas brgyan: rin chen rgyan ldan dar ljang stod g.yogs gsol: g.yas g.yon dang pos ral gri po ti phyar: bar gnyis rdo rje pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzin: mtha' gnyis mnyam gzhag 'chi med tshe bum bsnams: dar dmar smad dkris zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs:

gsang ba'i yum mchog dmar mo dbyangs can ma: mda' dar tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gsal: phyogs bzhir tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: gzhon tshul gnyen lcug nu ma bha ga rgyas: lang tsho mdangs mnga' mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur bzhi: 'byung bzhi'i tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i tshul du gsal: gtso 'khor gnas lnga'i yig 'bru'i 'od zer gyis: dbyings rig 'od stong 'chi med pho brang nas: tshe bdag 'jam dpal gtso 'khor spyan drangs gyur: oṃ ā yur pa ti mañju shrī ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi shigs 'od stong drwa ba'i pho brang nas: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: mi g.yo rdo rje nyi zla pad gdan steng : deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs su gsol: bdag cag rtse gcig sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: mos gus rab tu gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i gar ma gzugs: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya glu dbyangs gar: sgeg mo phreng ba la sogs yid 'ong gis: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs mchod par bgyi: rang byung snod mchog rin chen 'dzam gling khyon: legs par bkang ba'i sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs mchod par bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin shrī singha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐:

yi dam tshe bdag 'jam dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba dbyangs can mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshe bdag mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ḍāk+ki ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang snang srid rigs drug thams cad tshe bdag 'jam dpal gyi skur gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐:

rang gi srin lag gis bdud rtsi blangs te gnas lngar thig le bya: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub par bsgom: lnga pa bstod cing bsnyen pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag 'od gsal 'chi med klong yangs dbus: tshe bdag mgon po 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi phyed skyil bzhugs: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku la rab bstod pa: rtsa zhal dmar po chags mdangs mdzes pa ni: 'jam dpal gzhon nu tshe bdag mgon po'i brda: g.yas zhal dkar po 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa ni: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: g.yon zhal mthing nag dgyes la khro ba ni: bar chad tshe bdud ma rungs bsgral ba'i brda: dbu skra lcang lo spyi bor bcings pa ni: mi bskyod rigs bdag theg chen gter mdzod brda: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i brda: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa ni: dgos 'dod re skong dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: dar ljang na bza' stod la g.yogs pa ni: tshogs drug sna tshogs sgyu mar grol ba'i brda: phyag g.yas dang po ral gri phyar ba ni: shes rab mtshon gyis nyon mongs gcod pa'i brda: g.yon gyi dang pos po ti bsnams pa ni: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i brda: g.yas kyi bar pas rdo rje gdengs pa ni: 'khor 'das zil gnon ting 'dzin brtan pa'i brda: g.yon gyi bar pas pad phreng bsnams pa ni: thugs rje'i 'od zer 'gro drug 'dren pa'i brda: mtha' gnyis 'chi med tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mchog grub pa'i brda: sku smad dar dmar ang rag dkris pa ni: nyon mongs srid pa'i skyon gyis ma bgos brda: zhabs bzhi phyed skyil pad zlar bzhugs pa ni: tshad med bzhi ldan lam bzhi mthar phyin brda: mdzes pa'i sku la gzi brjid ldan pa ni: sku gsum ngang la 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: yon tan rab rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: dbyangs can dmar mo lang tsho ldan pa ni: ma dad log lta zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i dbus na 'gying ba'i brda: thugs rjes chags pas yab la gzigs pa ni: yid 'phrog gzugs 'dzin mchog gi gtso mo'i brda: mda' dar tshe bum mgul nas 'khyud pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang lam yin pa'i brda: nu 'bur bha ga rgyas shing bde drod ni: tsaṇ+ḍa gtum mo a haṃ bskul ba'i brda: zhabs gnyis zung 'jug sked la 'khril ba ni: mi zad dga' bzhi bde stong 'byung ba'i brda: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing brda skad 'byin pa ni: gsung dbyangs drug cus rig 'dzin sdud pa'i brda: rat+na'i rgyan dang dar dpyangs mdzes pa ni: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rtsa rlung grogs mo'i brda: sku la nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar ba: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod lam gyi sa mkhan brda: mtshan dpes rab brgyan dpa' mo'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: tshe 'dzin lha mo gar mo yid 'phrog bzhi: rdo rje tshe 'dzin dkar gsal mdzes pa ni: sa yi bcud 'dzin nad gdon zhi ba'i brda: rin chen tshe 'dzin ser gsal sgeg pa ni: chu yi bcud 'dzin longs spyod 'phel ba'i brda: pad+ma tshe 'dzin dmar gsal chags pa ni: tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba'i brda: las kyi tshe 'dzin ljang gsal bzhad pa ni: bdud bzhi tshar gcod tshe srog brtan pa'i brda: thams cad thor tshugs rigs lnga mdzes pa ni: 'byung lnga'i dbang bsgyur ye shes lnga ldan brda: phyag gnyis mda' dar tshe bum bsnams pa ni: phyogs bcu'i tshe 'gugs byin rlabs bskyil ba'i brda: nu ma bha ga rgyas shing ldem pa ni: dug lnga'i bag chags rang sar dag pa'i brda: mnyen lcug ldan zhing zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ni: ye shes rtsal bcus mkha' dbyings bgrod pa'i brda: 'od sku drwa ba'i rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ni: phyi nang dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i ma sring tshogs la bstod:

hūm̐: de ltar bla med brda bzhi'i bstod pa yis: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char chen phob: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje srog sgrub la: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad dbyings su gtor: mi shigs sra brtan g.yung drung gzhi tshugs nas: sra mkhregs tshe yi pho brang bh+rūm̐ stsol cig: de nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ston pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid tshe bdag 'jam dpal gsal ba yi: thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab drug steng : g.yung drung ljang gsal sra shing brtan pa'i dbus: nyi ma yar bstan zla ba mar phub pa'i: gwa'u kha sbyor nang du hrī dhīḥnṛ: ye shes rlung gi g.yo 'gul med par 'dzin: phyi rol pad+ma 'dab drug lte ba ru: oṃ dang a ra pa tsa na drug gsal: pad+ma nyi zla'i mtshams kyi mu khyud la: 'chi med tshe 'dzin yi ge dmar ser nyid: 'od zer dmar po'i phreng thag rnam par sbrel: 'byung 'jug rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer de las gcig las gnyis mched tshul: rang lus gang ste sngags phreng zhal nas thon: yum gyi lam brgyud thugs ka'i muṃ la phog: gzi brjid cher 'bar sngags phreng mgal me ltar: chos 'byung gnas nas lte bar yar drangs te: bar med 'khor bas snod kyi gzi brjid dang : tshe bsod thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas su: snying kha'i hrī dhīḥnṛ yig la thim pas: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe srog 'grub gyur cig: oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ ā yur nṛ dhīḥtshe bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐: tshe bsod thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa ba'i sngags ni: oṃ ā yur nṛ dhī muṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: bdag gi tshe bsod thams cad rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe yi gwa'u sgrub pa'i sngags ni: oṃ pad+ma rā ga ā yur ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: 'gro ba'i tshe bcud gzi byin dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

sngags ring thung rnams snga dro gung dang srod la bzlas: bsnyen tshad 'bum ther bya'o: sgrub pa grol tshe ting 'dzin gyi dbang ngam thugs rje chen po'i las gzhung nas blang yang rung : drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ zhes bkra shis bsngo smon sogs gang rung bya: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: yang zab gcig sgril tshe sgrub zab mo bzhag: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha dar mgo tshugs nas: tshe la long med glo bur bar chad sdang : bcos thabs ma mchis nad kyis sa steng khyab: gzhan yang dus 'khrug mtshon gyis bar chad sdang : de phyir 'chi med bsgrub pa'i snying po 'di: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur sku la 'dud: e ma bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: rgyal yum sgrol ma'i rlung sgrub gdams pa bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan las can la: tshe ni nyi zla shugs ni rdzu 'phrul rlung : rtsal ni seṅge stobs ni glang po che: mdangs ni rma bya 'dab rtsal bya rgyal khyung : dpa' ba stag la blo che gyad dang mtshungs: de phyir bsgrub pa kun gyi yang snying mchog: zab rgya bzhi pa thugs kyi thig le can: 'di nyid gsang shing gud du sba bar gyis: skal med dred po bya shor blo kha mang : snying ring phyi bshol mkhan der shin tu gsang :

'di nyid bstan par 'os pa'i snod ldan ni: shes rab che zhing yid blo brtan pa dang : dag snang 'byong zhing shes rgyud dul ba yi: byang sems snying rje can der bstan par bya: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan gsang ba'i grogs: rigs bzang khungs btsun blo brtan snying nye zhing : gsang rgya thub la gcong nad med pa dang : gzhan gyis ma spyad bdag tu ma bzung ba'i: bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma btsal: khrus gsol dbang bskur chos bshad smin par byas: mkho ba'i rdzas dang cha rkyen legs par bsags: bum pa me long rdo rje tsa ka li: ljang gsal dkyil 'khor dang bcas tshang bar bya: tshogs dang mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par bshams: dang po rang nyid sgrub par 'jug pa ni: dam par mtshams bcad gzhan gyis mi tshor bya: dkyil 'khor g.yas su yab dang g.yon du yum: so so'i gdan la bde bar bag pheb 'khod: rnam snang chos bdun lus gnad bsrang ba'i ngang : dang po skyabs yul gsol ba 'di ltar btab: e ma ho: ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen dpa' bo 'khor lo sdom pa la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dus gsum rgyal yum sgrol ma rigs lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig 'dzin kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyi rlobs: snyan brgyud mthar phyin ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:
