bka' bab lung zin sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dkyil 'khor slob dpon rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang 'grub gyur cig: ces gsol ba btab: 'byung ba'i dug yin pas rlung ro lan dgu bsal: de nas lus lha yi rnal 'byor ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung lnga rnam dag pa'i: sna tshogs 'ja' 'od las grub gzhal yas khang : phyi nang zang thal ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: mtshan nyid bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'khor lo sdom pa khyab bdag he ru kaḥ mthing nag khro gtum rdo rje dril bu bsnol: thor tshugs rigs lnga rin chen rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyad kyi 'gros thabs bzhugs: gsang ba'i yum mchog rje btsun sgrol ma mthing : bcu drug lang tsho ldan zhing rigs lngas brgyan: rdo rje pad+ma yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum zung 'jug snang stong bskyed pa yi: khog pa'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: yaṃ dang a haṃ la sogs gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: mdun du rtsa rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma dkar mo zhi tshul tshe 'dzin ma: g.yas su sa rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma ser mo dpal bskyed sgeg pa mo: rgyab tu me rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma dmar mo dbang sdud chags pa mo: g.yon du las rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma ljang mo bdud dpung 'joms mdzad ma: thams cad mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can: g.yas pas nor bu g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs kar tāṃ yig rang mdog lta bur gsal:

oṃ ār+ya tā re tu tā re swā hā: yab yum gcig dril sngags ni: oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ tāṃ tu tā re swā hā: zhes sngags nyer gcig re bzlas te: rlung yang bum pa can nyer gcig bzung : yab kyis rang nyid 'khor lo sdom par bsgom: yum gyis dam tshig sgrol mar bsgom: de yi tshe rlung gi ngo bo tho rangs sgrol ma dkar mo 'od du zhu ste chu rlung dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam: des zhe sdang gi rtog pa 'gag: sku yi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gyur ro: de bzhin du nam langs sgrol ma ser mo: nyin phyed yab yum gyi rlung zung 'jug: phyed yol sgrol ma dmar mo: srod la ljang mo sogs gong gi 'gres bzhin du rlung kha dog bzhi ldan: rtog pa yang dug lnga 'gag: sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad 'char ro: rim bzhin sgrol ma re re la rlung khug nyer gcig: thun lnga la rlung brgya dang bcu yis chag sor 'dzin: bar skabs su sngags 'di bzlas: oṃ yaṃ dz+nyā na pañca tāṃ tu tā re dza dzaḥ gong gi las sngags rnams snga ma ltar nyer gcig bya: rlung thun bzhag pa'i dus yan lag lnga yi 'khrul 'khor dang : 'byung ba lnga yi 'khrul 'khor gnyis las: dang po yan lag lnga yi 'khrul 'khor ni: mgo bo bskor zhing mjing pa shad: lag pa shad cing bzhag sha brdab: stod dang sked pa bskor bar bya: rkang pa shad de brkyang bskum bya: de nas 'bebs chen dgu tsam brgyab: 'byung ba lnga yi 'khrul 'khor ni: yan lag rtsa bzhi 'phur zhing 'bebs: gzhogs phab yan lag brkyang bskum bya: langs shing yan lag brkyang bskum bya: drang srong 'gros kyis rkang pa 'then: pus mgo 'then zhing 'bebs 'dren bkram: de yis 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub: de nas zhag bcu tho rangs dus: dkyil 'khor dbang blang dga' bzhi skyong : bde gsal mi rtog chos skur bzhag:

sa ma ya: nyin phyed kha bskang mchod pa ni: dkyil 'khor bran zhing mchod pa gso: bdag bskyed gsal ba'i mtshams su ni: hoḥ de ltar lha tshogs gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur: slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma spyi gtsug nas yar lud de snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: de nas mchod bskang ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: phyi mchod sna tshogs mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod dang : sbyor sgrol tshogs mchod mthun pa'i yo byad tshogs: 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum rigs bzhi la: mchod pa 'bul zhing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub mchog stsol zhing : rtsa rlung dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐:

bshags pa ni: hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi: dam tshig nyams pa bshags shing gsos su gsol: gzhan yang so thar nyan thos bslab pa yi: khas blangs dam 'gal bag med bshags su gsol: mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: khyab bdag drug pa'i rnam rol 'khor lo sdom: in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs can 'khyug pa'i sku: bde stong gzi 'bar drwa ba'i dpa' mo 'khyud: dri za'i dbyangs can bskrun pa'i sgeg mos bskor: mkhyen brtse'i dpung chen rab bkod rgyas la bstod: dkyil 'khor grol ba'i tshe dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings 'od stong 'khyil ba'i klong yangs nas: zab rgya'i dbang phyug kun 'dus 'khor lo sdom: gsang mdzod rig pa'i gter chen shes rab sgron: 'ja' lus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bzhi bskur thob shog: oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ tāṃ tu tā re pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs shing dkyil 'khor lha bcas bdag la bstim: rjes su bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab cing : dmigs med ka dag ngang la lham mer bzhag: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ rang byung sgyu ma bdag med stong pa'i klong : brdal khyab gnyug ma 'khor 'das ye grol lha: ma 'gags shar grol ye shes ngang la gshegs: a a āḥ zhes gnas lugs rig pa gsal bzhag zab mo lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: yang zab rlung gi nyams len bzhag: tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i lam: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas phab pa dge'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las:

phyag na rdo rje pha rol 'joms byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: thugs mchog rdo rje gtum por 'dud: e ma bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: pha rol bdud bzhi rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa'i: yang sgrub zab mo spu gri 'khor lo bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes mi brjed legs par zungs: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: mthing nag dal gyi lte ba ru: gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje bris: de steng bum pa bdud rtsis gtams: rdo rje me long tsakli bzhag: dar nag gur phub srog sngags gzugs: bhan+dhar chos 'byung bsnol ba'i steng : dpal gtor zlum po zur gsum la: 'khor lo me ri'i rgyan kyang brgyab: spyi mthun mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsham: sa ma ya: dang po bsgrub pa'i lha bskyed pa ni: hū?m̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid drag po'i zhing : gtum drag 'byung ba rim bzhin bsnol mar brtsegs: sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod me dpung klong : bh+rūm̐ las sra mkhregs gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog: de dbus nyi zla ti ra bam chen steng : mthing nag hūm̐ la gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhan+dha skam po'i rigs lnga dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcings lhu tshigs brgyan: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la: za byed rngam pa'i khro bcu me ltar 'bar: g.yon pas me yi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu+u las: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal: hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can:

phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pa'i drag sngags can: g.yas pas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i byad ma 'joms par bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer las: gsang bdag gtum po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po pha rol g.yul 'joms kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: byad bzlog khro mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag shul rngam pa'i dpa' stobs gar dgus brgyan: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs: las la chas byed srog bdag khro mo'i tshogs: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms mdzad bzhi la bstod: de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me dpung nyi ma 'khor lo'i steng :

hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: phar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: yang 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs 'joms: tshur 'dus snod kyi gzi byin thim: slar yang khro mo 'khor la phog: rab 'phros pha rol byad kha bzlog: kun kyang gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo'i sngags: oṃ kro ti baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtum po'i sngags grub rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla: khro mo'i las su rung tsam khri yis chog: byad bzlog gi zor thun sngags ni: hūm̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he kro ta kā la so na tsakra lo hi tsakra raṃ ṭi tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: oṃ badz+ra kro ti ma tri baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha raṃ ha la ya pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zlog sngags ni: hūm̐ trig rā dza ya thun bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la rbad: raṃ ha la mā ra ya bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: krag had pa nā ga ya bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: shag rak+ṣa rbad tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bh+yo dun bh+yo thun bh+yo rak+sha bh+yo byad ma rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: las mtha' byad bzlog ni: lcags snod nang du 'bru nag gi gtor ma zur gsum che ba gcig la gzhi gdan chos 'byung dang bcas pa rtsang gis brgyan cing : zor rdzas brgyad kyis bskor: liṅga la dgra bo lan gsum bkug nas bsgral te gtor ma la bran te rtsa sngags kyis phul: de nas bzlog pa la bran te dpal 'bar btsugs la dgra bo byad ma'i phyogs su 'phen pa ni: rnga brdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran: khyad par srog gcod drag mo rigs bzhi la lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs kyis bskor te zor thun gyi char phab pas:

pha rol rdul du brlags nas ming yang med par bsam: de nas bskul bzlog zor las ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ thod mkhar nag po me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng nas: srog gcod ma mo rigs bzhi skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dmar chen gtor ma dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon: pho nya las mkhan shan pa rtsang gis brgyan: myur mgyogs gzir 'debs thun rdzas 'bar bas bskor: dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i zor chen 'dis: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol: yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: sde brgyad dregs pa'i pho nya bzlog tu gsol: phyogs skyong bcu yi dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi skye bo'i mda' zor bzlog tu gsol: yugs sa bud med dmod zor bzlog tu gsol: 'dre rgod 'byung po'i glags lta bzlog tu gsol: yul lha gzhi bdag cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: ma yams srin mo'i sun ma bzlog tu gsol: ban de sngags pa'i hom sbar bzlog tu gsol: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad bzlog tu gsol: drag sngags sna tshogs sbyor ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rigs bzlog tu gsol: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi bar chod bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan khri 'bum bzlog tu gsol: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bsgyur ro zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: hūm̐: dmar nag gtor zor dam nyams dgra la ya: sreg byed me zor dmar po dgra la ya: gtor byed chu zor sngon po dgra la ya: rdeg byed rdo zor skya bo dgra la ya: sgrol byed phur zor nag po dgra la ya: 'debs byed khram zor nag po dgra la ya: 'joms byed tshe mda' drag po dgra la ya:

bshig byed nyungs zor drag po dgra la ya: smyo 'bog dug zor nag po dgra la ya: myog byed khrag zor dmar nag dgra la ya: myur mgyogs kong zor dbal kha dgra la ya: hūm̐: rngam byed stag gdong dmar nag dgra la bh+yoḥ mche gtsigs kham nag dred gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ gtum pa'i mthing nag dom gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ sha za ljang nag spyang gdong dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog drag po'i zor chen bh+yoḥ rbad do g.yab bo srog bdag ma mo bzhi: myur du las mdzad dgra bo shor ra re: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlags nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ma tri mu kha ye raṃ ha la byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zor bh+yoḥ thun bh+yoḥ khraṃ bh+yoḥ taṃ bh+yoḥ rbad bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces zor 'phang ste dgra bo byad ma yul rjes med par brlags par bsgom: de nas khro mo bzhi la gtang rag gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas rtsa sngags kyis phul: mchod pa bran de lha tshogs rnams la dmigs pa spro bsdu yis phul: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa mthar phyin nas dbang blang ba ni: bum pa sogs rdzas thams cad la: hūm̐: yang gsang snying po bla med he ru kaḥ gsang bdag gtum po'i sku gsung thugs yon gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la dbang bskur stsol: mchog thun dngos grub 'dod rgu thob gyur cig: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta ghu ya gu h+ya sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blang zhing dngos grub la rol ba sogs las gzhung spyi dang mtshungs: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: yang dag ye shes dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: skye med ngo bo rang byung stong pa'i dbyings: ma skyes lhun grub chos dbyings mkha' la thim: snod bcud gzugs snang sgyu ma'i ngo bor ldang : a a a āḥ zhes dmigs med rgya yan chos sku'i klong du bzhag: bkra shis smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya:

e ma bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs skal ldan las can bu yi don: byad zor ngan gtad la sogs bzlog pa'i ched: dus mtha'i sngags pa dug sbrul 'dra ba yi: dregs pa bsgrubs nas chos pa kun la 'tshe: de phyir ma rungs de dag rnams la bsngags: zor bzlog zab mo spu gri reg chod rgya: shes rab snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas phab pa'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: sgyu lus mchod sbyin bsdus pa bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: sgyu lus mchod sbyin bdag 'dzin rang grol bstan: yang zab bcud kyi gdams pa khyad par 'phags: rig pa shes rab ral gri phyung rdeg gis: nyon mongs phra rags rtog pa'i lo 'dab gcod: bsdus bya sgyu lus 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las: sgrol ba'i ded dpon bdag med khye'u chung : rnam rtog lha 'dre'i yo lang sbyor ba'i gnad: ma gcig rdo rje'i tshig rkang sa ma ya: gcod mchod ka dag zang thal bstan pa'i gdams pa 'di: spros bcas dang ni shin tu spros med de: 'di nyid spros med a ti bya bral lugs dang rgyud mthun te: gnyan sa spros bcas rkang gling ḍā ru sogs med kyang rung : rdzogs chen spyi rgyud la spros bcas bskyed rim gyi gcod mang du gsungs kyang : thabs kyi sngon 'gro gnad du bsnun pas: rten 'brel gyi shes rab rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod: de bzhin du kun rdzob tsam du gcod yul nyams su len pa ni: dang po rang nyid gnas gang yin la gdan du 'khod: sngon 'gro skyabs yul btang ba ni: rig pa ngar bskyed stong pa'i rang sgra las: phaṭḥ na mo: skyabs yul ngo bo stong pa'i rang rtsal nyid:

rigs drug a 'thas byang chub 'thob bya'i phyir: bdag gzhan ro gcig rtogs pas sems bskyed do: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnyis pa rnam shes spar zhing rang nyid dbyangs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ru gsal ba ni: phaṭḥ rang rig rnam shes ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bor skar mda' 'gyu bzhin gyen du 'phros: rje btsun mthing 'od 'bar ma'i thugs kar thim: gsal stong bde chen rnal 'byor ma ru gsal: dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin cing khro mo'i chas: dur khrod chas rdzogs kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: brkyang bskum gar stabs bam ro'i gdan la gsal: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gsum pa sha khrag phung po bdud rtsir bsgyur ba ni: phaṭḥ bdag lus phung po stong gsum khyab pa yi: mgo bo bhan+dha zangs gris rbad kyis bcad: snang srid khyab par yangs shing rgya che'i nang : phung po gtub pa srid pa'i dbyings dang mnyam: gri gug 'bar bas lan gsum dkrugs pa yis: sha khrag zad med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bzhi pa lha 'dre dbang du sdud pa ni: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bdag gi thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje ni: rwa dgu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phyogs bcur 'phros: hūm̐ las dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag drag mo'i tshul: phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi me 'bar bsnams: g.yon pas mi rkang tser tser drag tu 'bud: rtog med snying rje drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'khrul rtog lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul zhi: bzod glags med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang : ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis zil gyis gnon: brdal khyab sa gzhi rdo rje'i zhu lam la: khab len rdo yis lcags phye 'dzin pa ltar: ci bcol bka' nyan 'bros dbang med par gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ

lnga pa zil gyis gnon cing sha khrag 'gyed pa ni: phaṭḥ rang nyid dbang sdud drag mo'i thugs ka nas: gri gug bhan+dha thogs pa grangs med 'phros: sha khrag stong gsum 'geng ba'i mchod sbyin 'di: ting 'dzin rtse gcig zas su byin brlabs nas: zangs gris dkrug cing bhan+dhar rab bskyil nas: sangs rgyas byang sems dam chos 'phags pa'i tshogs: pad 'byung rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho dang : rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'bul lo bzhes shig dgyes pa bskyed gyur nas: bka' chad 'khu ldog mi dmigs dbyings su thim: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ drug pa dregs chen rnams dang spyi la 'bul ba ni: phaṭḥ ro mchog bcud ldan sha khrag dmar mchod 'di: srid pa'i rtse dang mnar med yan chod kyi: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad bye ba 'bum: nag phyogs gnod byed bgegs rigs lan chags sogs: 'byung po gdug sems ldan pa'i tshogs la bsngo: lan chags bu lon sha 'khon byang gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bdun pa dkar 'gyed 'bul ba ni: phaṭḥ sha khrag bdud rtsi dkar zhing snum pa 'di: rgyal ba'i bka' btags bstan srung dkar po'i phyogs: srid pa chags pa'i gzhi bdag lha dang klu: dge bsnyen bka' skyong mthu ldan rnams la sbyin: dge bcu la 'god nag phyogs tshogs spang shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ brgyad pa lhag ma ging dang khas zhan dbang chung rnams la sbyin pa ni: phaṭḥ ma phung po sha khrag lhag ma 'di: dur khrod bdag mo bye ba 'bum: keng rus gar bsgyur pho mo ging : dpag tshad khyab pa'i gnas nyul tshogs: gzhan yang khas zhan dbang chung rigs: snga phyi ma thob lha 'dre'i tshogs: sha khrag rus pa'i lhag ma bzhes: bsngos pa bzhin du tshims gyur nas: re ba'i bsam pa khengs gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ dgu pa chos ston cing byang chub lam du dgod pa ni: phaṭḥ na mo: nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: rang rig chos sku ma mthong bas: 'khrul 'dzin las kyi 'byung por grub:

lta ba ngo sprod ma thob pas: ma rig gnyis 'dzin ru trar skyes: ting 'dzin mchod sbyin ma thob pas: yid lus srid pa'i za 'dre grub: dbang sdud tshogs gral ma tshud pas: dge bcu phan sems snying rje bral: rigs drug 'khrul par grub pa yi: gnod byed lha 'dre bgegs kyi tshogs: deng nas byang chub ma thob bar: mi dge ba yi gnod sems spongs: phan dge'i rgyu 'bras chos bcu spyod: snang stong yid lus rang mdangs ltos: grags stong rdo rje'i tshig la nyon: ro gcig sems nyid gnyug ma skyongs: dge des don gnyis mthar phyin nas: bla med 'bras bu yongs rdzogs shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bcu pa mi dmigs mgron rnams mkha' la bstim pa ni: bdag gi rnam shes rang sar phab pa ni: phaṭḥ rnam shes mkha' 'gro gnas gyur thig le ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bo mar babs snying kha chos dbyings su: thim pas mi rtog dran 'dzin rjen par shar: ka dag gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bcu gcig pa bsngo smon bgyis pa ni: phaṭḥ gcod yul mchod sbyin zab mo bgyis pa'i mthus: rnam rtog lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul las: re dogs bral zhing gdeng tshad ldan pa yi: sha khrag mchod pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces phaṭ ces pa dmigs pa gsal ba'i drag sngags yin pas skabs dang bstun pa rgyas pa sogs gcod yul spyi mthun ltar bya: rjes mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: zab don yang snying gcod yul mchod sbyin bzhag: gza' mchog drang srong bka' yi rgya 'di srungs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho dpal chen pos sbas yul pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs pa'o//

// ༁ྃྂ: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gtor ma bsdus pa byang chub chu rgyun bzhugs so: 'khor 'das zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gtor mgron byang chub chu rgyun bstan: dang po chung ngu'i sbyin pa yis: dge tshogs dpag yas 'byung ba'i thabs: sems bskyed mchod sbyin 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni: rin chen snod mchog gang rung du: rab ni sman bzang sbrang bu ram: dkar gsum dag gi ril bu sgril: 'bring ni nas 'bras gro khre til: phye ma zhib 'thag ril bu sgril: tha ma nas sam gang rung 'bru: snod gtsang dag tu legs par bsham: ting 'dzin rnam gsum mi dmigs ngang : khrus dang gtsang sbra dang bcas te: lha bskyed dmigs pa gsal bar bya: de yang theg pa che chung ste: rab ni stong nyid mchod yul bral: 'bring yang zung 'jug rten 'brel gces: tha ma dmigs pa sems bskyed gtso: sa ma ya: dang po sngon du skyabs yul ni: na moḥ bla ma bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs yul lha yi tshogs: rtse gcig 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyis: bla med byang chub thob phyir skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa rang nyid lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig pad zla'i steng : rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bdud rtsi na ra ra: g.yon pas skyabs sbyin rigs drug sdug bsngal sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gsal: oṃ lo ki shwa ra ya a wa lo ki te hri da ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: gsum pa khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gnas lnga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas: sangs rgyas byang sems rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: dbang bskur sku gang khrus bstsal sdig sgrib dag: chu yi lhag ma 'od dpag dbu rgyan gyur:

oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas spyi khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la: sku gsung thugs yon nyon mongs mi mnga' yang : rigs drug sems can sdug bsngal sbyang slad du: ye shes lnga yi khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: shes bya'i las sgrib nyon mongs dag gyur nas: 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca a bhi ṣe ka te kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes khrus bya zhing sems bskyed dang ldan par mos: bzhi pa snod du gtams te yi dwags la sbyin pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyi shu'am bdun gyis bsngo la: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'phags mchog kha sar pa ṇi yi: phyag nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi mchod sbyin gyis: stong gsum srid pa'i yi dwags tshims byas nas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod ldan par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum mam grangs med dang dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo: de nas snod bshal te dor nas gtsang ma bya: sa ma ya: dang po rin po che'i snod du gtor mchod bshams la: oṃ aḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo: hūm̐: blo 'das chos dbyings yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: zad med bcud mchog ting 'dzin rdzas kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di: bstan gnyis gtso bo shāka thub pad+ma 'byung : sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde: rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob brgyud par bcas: rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor lha gter gyi bdag: rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

lha grangs sam nyer gcig brjod: skabs 'dir kha bsngos brgyab kyang rung : gnyis pa mas mgron la 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: gtor snod du rdzas gsar pa bshams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo: hūm̐: snang srid snod mchog yangs pa'i snod nang du: bcud kyi 'byung lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas su bsgyur: byin gyis brlabs pa'i longs spyod rgya mtsho 'di: dpal mgon bdun cu lha srin dregs sde brgyad: gza' klu rgyu skar brtan ma sa bdag sman: lo zla zhag dus chu tshod tshes kyi bdag: mgul lha bcu gsum gzhi bdag zo dor dang : bgegs rigs lan chags rigs drug snying rje'i mgron: bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: bsngo'o lan chags sha 'khon 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: zhes nyer gcig gis bsngo: de nas gtor gzhong bshal te gtor ma nang du blugs la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan bdun gyis bsngo: hūm̐: rin chen yangs pa stong gsum snod kyi nang : zag med gtor mchod lhag ma bcud kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di: glo bur lhags shing ming nas ma smos dang : khas zhan dbang chung ma rig ma thos sogs: gzhan yang sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gyur pa: rku 'phrog bcom gsum rdung rdeg srog bcad gtub: bu lon sha 'khon lan chags 'khor ba dang : lhag mar dbang ba'i 'byung po ma lus la: bsngos shing tshims nas re ba khengs gyur te: rnam mkhyen byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: nyer gcig gis bsngo bar bya: de nas chos ston pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams rgyu med stong pa'i dbyings:

rkyen gyis ma bsgyur dngos po med: 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin can: gsal stong ye shes snying po'i ngang : bla med theg chen sdom par gyis: byang chub so thar bslab sdom gyis: sdig pa mi dge bcu po dang : mtshams med lnga yi las rnams spongs: dge bcu sems bskyed ldan par gyis: srid par grub pa'i mgron rnams kun/ phan dge byang sems ldan gyur nas: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur thob shog: ces bsngo smon bya zhing : mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa ni: oṃ: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: āḥ mgron du gyur pa ma lus kun: hūm̐: dmigs med rang dbyings klong du gshegs: oṃ badz+ra muḥ bkra shis ni: hoḥ mtha' yas thugs rje sems can mgon gyur pa: gangs ri'i mdog can mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin can: 'gro mgon dpal du lham mer shar ba'i sku: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas gdab kyang chog: rjes kyi bya ba ni: 'khor 'das thams cad chos sku'i klong ma 'gags pa'i rtsal las: sems can so so'i snang ngor longs sku sgyu ma'i sprul sgyur dang : bsdus bya kun rdzob tsam ma gtogs don la mchod yul sbyin mkhan ma grub pa: stong pa'i rang mdangs yin par thag bcad de: 'khor 'das ro gcig mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: yang zab don bsdus mchod sbyin man ngag mchog: tshig nyung don che tshogs chen rab rdzogs pa'i: byang chub chu rgyun dge ba'i rgya mtsho bzhag: 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams: tshe 'dir bkra shis phyi ma byang chub thob: snying nas chos byed rnams kyis nyams su longs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe: rgyal sras pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// ༁ྃྂ: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gtor ma bsdus pa byang chub chu rgyun bzhugs so: 'khor 'das zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gtor mgron byang chub chu rgyun bstan: dang po chung ngu'i sbyin pa yis: dge tshogs dpag yas 'byung ba'i thabs: sems bskyed mchod sbyin 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni: rin chen snod mchog gang rung du: rab ni sman bzang sbrang bu ram: dkar gsum dag gi ril bu sgril: 'bring ni nas 'bras gro khre til: phye ma zhib 'thag ril bu sgril: tha ma nas sam gang rung 'bru: snod gtsang dag tu legs par bsham: ting 'dzin rnam gsum mi dmigs ngang : khrus dang gtsang sbra dang bcas te: lha bskyed dmigs pa gsal bar bya: de yang theg pa che chung ste: rab ni stong nyid mchod yul bral: 'bring yang zung 'jug rten 'brel gces: tha ma dmigs pa sems bskyed gtso: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na moḥ bla ma bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs yul lha yi tshogs: rtse gcig 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyis: bla med byang chub thob phyir skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang gsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don rtogs phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa rang nyid lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig pad zla'i steng : rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bdud rtsi na ra ra: g.yon pas skyabs sbyin rigs drug sdug bsngal sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gsal: oṃ lo ki shwa ra ya a wa lo ki te hri da ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: ci nus bzlas/ bzhi pa khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gnas lnga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas: sangs rgyas byang sems rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: dbang bskur sku gang khrus bstsal sdig sgrib dag: chu yi lhag ma 'od dpag dbu rgyan gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas brten khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la: sku gsung thugs yon nyon mongs mi mnga' yang : rigs drug sems can sdug bsngal sbyang slad du: ye shes lnga yi khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: shes bya'i las sgrib nyon mongs dag gyur nas: 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca a bhi ṣe ka te kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes khrus bya zhing*/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥkā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā:

sku phyi/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ na bza' 'bul/ lnga pa khrus chu snod du gtams te yi dwags la sbyin pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: chu rgyun sbreng bzhin/ lan nyi shu'am bdun gyis bsngo la: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'phags mchog kha sar pa ṇi yi: phyag nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi mchod sbyin gyis: stong gsum srid pa'i yi dwags tshims byas nas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod ldan par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum mam grangs med dang : oṃ dz+wa la i daṃ sarba pre ta bh+ya swā hā: lan bdun/ sbyin pa 'di yis bsod nams gang*/ /de dag yi dwags phyi bzhin song*/ /yi dwags 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ /de dag myur du grol bar shog dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo/ de nas snod bshal te dor nas gtsang ma bya: sa ma ya: dang po rin po che'i snod du gtor mchod bshams la: chu rgyun sbreng*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo: hūm̐: blo 'das chos dbyings yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: zad med bcud mchog ting 'dzin rdzas kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di: bstan gnyis gtso bo shāka thub pad+ma 'byung : sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde: rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob brgyud par bcas: rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor lha gter gyi bdag: rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha grangs sam nyer gcig brjod: skabs 'dir kha bsngos brgyab kyang rung : gnyis pa mas mgron la 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: gtor snod du rdzas gsar pa bshams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo:

hūm̐: snang srid snod mchog yangs pa'i snod nang du: bcud kyi 'byung lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas su bsgyur: byin gyis brlabs pa'i longs spyod rgya mtsho 'di: dpal mgon bdun cu lha srin dregs sde brgyad: gza' klu rgyu skar brtan ma sa bdag sman: lo zla zhag dus chu tshod tshes kyi bdag: mgul lha bcu gsum gzhi bdag zo dor dang : bgegs rigs lan chags rigs drug snying rje'i mgron: bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: bsngo'o lan chags sha 'khon 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: zhes nyer gcig gis bsngo: de nas gtor gzhong bshal te gtor ma nang du blugs la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan bdun gyis bsngo: hūm̐: rin chen yangs pa stong gsum snod kyi nang : zag med gtor mchod lhag ma bcud kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di: glo bur lhags shing ming nas ma smos dang : khas zhan dbang chung ma rig ma thos sogs: gzhan yang sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gyur pa: rku 'phrog bcom gsum rdung rdeg srog bcad gtub: bu lon sha 'khon lan chags 'khor ba dang : lhag mar dbang ba'i 'byung po ma lus la: bsngos shing tshims nas re ba khengs gyur te: rnam mkhyen byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: nyer gcig gis bsngo bar bya: dzam lhar chu sbyin bya na 'dir sbyar/ mdun du pad zlar dzam las dzam lha ser/ /shing 'bras ne'u le bsnams shing brjid ldan bzhugs/ /pad nyir hūm̐ las dzam nag sbrul rgyan can/ /zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs thod khrag ne'u le bsnams/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes bstim/ /dbang lhas dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu brgyan gyur/ /rang gi lag mthil zla steng yig 'bru lnga/

/rigs lnga zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /rma dang me yi zug rngu zhi bar bsam/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hāḥ oṃ iṇ+ṭa ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā: dzam lha mnyes nas phyag gi ne'u le las/ /nor bu bskyugs nas gnas khang gang bar bsam/ oṃ dzam+luṃ swā hā: oṃ sarba yak+sha dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ dzaṃ sid+dhi pha la a la la hoḥ sa dngos grub blang*/ dzam lha ye shes pa rten la bzhugs shing dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ mas mgron rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthar bzlas bya'i gzungs sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las sgra dang 'od zer gyis khams gsum snang bar byas/ dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni sogs? oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs? oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe/ ma ṇi pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta/ dha ri sha ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ su pra bhe bi ma le sā ga ra/ gam+bhi re hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bud+dha bi lo ki te/ gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā/ pad+mo dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hri da a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ a mi te/ a mi to bha be/ a mi te saṃ bha be/ a mi te bi krān+te gā mi ni/ ga ga ni kirti ka ri/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma dhā ri hūm̐/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai bhai ṣa dz+yai ma hā bhai ṣa dz+yai rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐/ oṃ hrī trai lokya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ oṃ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭḥ.oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐/ badz+ra sa ra pra mar+dha na sarba karma a bā ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ bhurkuṃ ma hā pra ṇa ya/ bhur tsi bhur ku bi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro dha rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ na maḥtsan+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ṭa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yaṃ ho? raṃ ho? baṃ ho? laṃ ho? e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ a a a swā hā/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sarba shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na ma saṅgā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha sogs? sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs/ de nas chos ston pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams rgyu med stong pa'i dbyings: rkyen gyis ma bsgyur dngos po med: 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin can: gsal stong ye shes snying po'i ngang : bla med theg chen sdom par gyis: byang chub so thar bslab sdom gyis: sdig pa mi dge bcu po dang : mtshams med lnga yi las rnams spongs: dge bcu sems bskyed ldan par gyis: srid par grub pa'i mgron rnams kun/ phan dge byang sems ldan gyur nas: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur thob shog: ces bsngo smon bya zhing : mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa ni: oṃ: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: āḥ mgron du gyur pa ma lus kun: hūm̐: dmigs med rang dbyings klong du gshegs: oṃ badz+ra muḥ bkra shis ni: hoḥ mtha' yas thugs rje sems can mgon gyur pa: gangs ri'i mdog can mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin can:

'gro mgon dpal du lham mer shar ba'i sku: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas gdab kyang chog: hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum kun bsags rnam dkar dge: 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings su bsngos pa'i mthus: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ /'gro ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas shing*/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral pa'i/ /skye dgu'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas sgrol gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*/ /rtsod pa med cing tshad med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang*/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /tshe 'di'i pha ma shi gson 'brel thogs dang*/ /sha khrag 'o zho bkol spyod dud 'gro sogs/ /bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i sems can rnams/ /myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /snang srid rnam dag ri bo po tā lar/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo ye nas rdzogs/ /grags stong 'gag med yi ge drug ma'i sngags/ /rig stong 'phags pa'i rang zhal 'du 'bral med/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes gter gzhung sor bzhag ste cung zad rang lugs kha skong byed pa po ka ma rā dzas so// // rjes kyi bya ba ni: 'khor 'das thams cad chos sku'i klong ma 'gags pa'i rtsal las: sems can so so'i snang ngor longs sku sgyu ma'i sprul sgyur dang : bsdus bya kun rdzob tsam ma gtogs don la mchod yul sbyin mkhan ma grub pa: stong pa'i rang mdangs yin par thag bcad de: 'khor 'das ro gcig mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis:

yang zab don bsdus mchod sbyin man ngag mchog: tshig nyung don che tshogs chen rab rdzogs pa'i: byang chub chu rgyun dge ba'i rgya mtsho bzhag: 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams: tshe 'dir bkra shis phyi ma byang chub thob: snying nas chos byed rnams kyis nyams su longs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe: rgyal sras pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: me gsur btang ba longs spyod gter mdzod bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: me gsur bya ba'i rim pa ni: phye mar dag la gzhi byas te: phun sum tshogs pa'i zas sna bsres: dri zhim bzang drug sman sogs sbyar: de dag me hom chung ngur bsreg: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsreg gtor bkru: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs: mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : pha ma rigs drug la sogs la: 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i phan yon ni: yi dam dkyil 'khor dri yis mnyes: yul lha gzhi bdag gsur gyis tshim: sngon las rigs drug sdug bsngal byang : lha srin rnams kyang re kha khengs: sbyin pas bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs: 'bras bus smon lam bden tshig 'grub: ces bslab pa byang sems spyi rgyud las: bla med nam mkha'i mdzod chen gyis: phyag rgya rgyu yi bsod nams tshogs: snying rjes sbyin sreg 'bras bu ste: tshogs drug mchod pa 'di kho na: zhes gsungs pa ltar: sbyin sreg gyi phan yon blo las 'das shing : sngon srin mo grong rgyun ma zhes bya bas: nyin re la 'dzam gling nas mi lnga lnga sha khral du bla khyer ba la: ston pa mar me mdzad kyis nam langs zhogs la dri zhim ro mngar bsregs shing smon lam mdzad:

nyin gung longs spyod phud kyis bsngos: dgong mo sha khrag dmar gyi gsur mchod mdzad de: ting nge 'dzin gyis srin mo dbang du bsdus: deng phyin chad mi yi bla tshe mi 'phrog par byed pa srog gi glud du sbyin pa gsur gyi mchod pa 'di'i gyis la dam tshig bka' la gnas par dam longs gsungs te: srin mos snying rje bslab pa'i sdom pa zhus nas 'dzam gling 'dir gsur mchod sbyin pa ma chag na: bdag kyang snying rje la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro: zhes khas blangs shing dam du gnas: de ltar shin tu phan yon che bar grags: spyir nyin re bzhin gsur mchod ma chad par thon na: bka' yi mdo sde stong phrag brgya pa bklags pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam mo: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum brjod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes me thab tu: sreg rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod: byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dge 'dun tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can nor lha gter bdag srung ma la: 'bul lo thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sol: hūm̐: phyi rgyud dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: lha klu sde brgyad gza' chen rgyu skar bdag: rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bcas: lo zla zhag dus bdag dang yul lha la: 'bul lo phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: dri za gsur bdag bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: pha ma rigs drug bar do'i sems can dang : tshe rabs bu lon sha 'khon ma 'khor ba'i: sngon las 'phral rkyen khas zhan dbang chung la: bsngo'o sbyin no lan chags 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti hā sa bha dra su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: zhes 'di yi mtshams su ming nas ma smos pa kha bsngos byas kyang chog:

dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ mdang da nangs shi ba lus snga lus bor zhing phyi lus ma thob pa rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa'i bar do'i sems can rnams la 'bul lo/ mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes par gyur cig /rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan par gyur cig /sna yi yul du dri zhim par gyur cig /lce yi yul du ro mngar bar gyur cig /lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam par gyur cig /yid kyi yul du rig shes dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs par gyur cig oṃḥhūm̐ḥtrām̐ḥhrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ḥlām̐ḥmām̐ḥpām̐ḥtām̐ḥ oṃ bo dhi sa twa sa ma ya: dharma dz+nyā na ma ma pā paṃ bi shwa dha na pa ri wā re swā hā: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ ma rig srid pa'i nang tshan bar do yi: yid lus la sogs rigs drug sems can rnams: bdag gis sbyin tshogs bsngo smon dge ba yis: bla med byang chub 'bras bu myur thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes bsngo smon ci rigs sna tshogs gang rung rgyas gdab pas chog:

sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs so// thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dri med shel phreng bzhugs so: thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro skyabs yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni: na moḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan: chos sku snang mtha' mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: dmar gsal gzi brjid mdangs ldan lham me ba: 'ja' lus mi shigs rdo rje'i sku ru bsgom: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du: thugs rje chen po dkar gsal shel gyi mdog: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: sna tshogs rgyan ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur bsgom: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du: gu ru pad+ma he ru ka pa'i chas: rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer 'dzin: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: rgyab tu nyi zla pad+ma'i khri steng du: ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar mo yum chen tshul: sna tshogs rgyan ldan ral gri glegs bam 'dzin: 'dzum mdangs phyed skyil dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: mdun du pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i steng : dbang chen rta mgrin mthing nag ber chen gsol: ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin cing dor stabs bzhugs: rtsa gsum skyabs yul lnga ldan lha tshogs la: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskor: ma skyes 'ja' tshon gsal stong sku ru bsgom: hoḥ bdag lus phung po ri rab maṇ+ḍal la: rtsa 'khor ye shes lnga ldan tshom bus brgyan: dug lnga rnam dag rang rig maṇ+ḍal 'di: mchog gsum skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bla med byang chub bde dge'i mthu stobs kyis: 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol shog: na mo: chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas: dug lnga bag chags brdzis pa'i gdan steng du:

snang mtha' 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: gnas lugs mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rang byung zhing khams nas: bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams nas: ma dad 'khrul snang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: pad 'byung rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab spyod bde chen drwa ba'i zhing khams nas: mtshan 'dzin phung po brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: ye shes mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs: rtsa rlung bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs: gtum drag me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas: rta mchog dbang chen sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi'i bar chad sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog pad+ma shel gyi sgrub phug nas: dam chos zil gnon rgyud la gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya gnyer gtad drag po'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong gza' mchog rgyal por gsol ba 'debs: bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs: gdung bas rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: ma gyur pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog: ces dbyangs snyan pos gsol ba btab: de nas sku gsum 'od zhu rang la bstim pa ni: hoḥ skyabs yul mchog gsum brgyud pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thams cad 'od zhu snang mtha'i sku la thim: snang mtha'i gnas gsum yig 'bru 'od du zhu: rang la zer 'phros sgo gsum bag chags dag: dbang bzhi rdzogs nas dbyer med chu thim ltar: sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu mngon gyur cig:

ces pas skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par bsam: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: las gzhung sngon 'gro kun gyi rim pa bzhag: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal rgyas so// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gdungs dbyangs bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: byin 'bebs bya ba ni: rol mo dbyangs snyan bya zhing dri zhim spos kyi dud pa btang : de nas spyan 'dren byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ khyab brdal chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang ba mtha' yas byin phob cig: lhun grub gsang mdzod pho brang nas: ye shes ḍāk+kis byin phob cig: ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: spyan ras gzigs dbang byin phob cig: rtsal chen klong dgu'i pho brang nas: dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig: bde byed brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: yang rdzong shel brag gnas mchog nas: sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: sham po gangs chen gnas mchog nas: de wa dha ras byin phob cig: bka' gtad dkyil 'khor mchims phu nas: gnam lcags rdo rjes byin phob cig: pad+ma shel phug gnas mchog nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon byin phob cig: gter rgya gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin gter gling byin phob cig: gnyer gtad bka' bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i: dam can gter srung byin phob cig: hūm̐: chos sku'i byin 'bebs thibs se thib: longs sku'i bkrag mdangs ta la la: sprul sku'i 'ja' tshon kyi li li: dpa' bo'i gar sgyur shigs se shig: ma sring mkha' 'gro spungs se spung : dam can gter srung sha ra ra: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob:

dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes byin dbab cing rol mo bsgrag: nyams 'bar zhing ba spu g.yo ba sogs byung na: byin phebs pa'i rtags yin: rtags ma byung na lan gcig bskyar: rang dang dkyil 'khor la dbyer med thim par bsgom: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs te gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal rgyas pa dge'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: las byang dug lnga ye grol ye shes phreng ba bzhugs so: 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'od rab gsal 'byin pa: nam mkha'i snying po 'jig rten phyug gi: sgrub pa'i cho ga las byang don tshang bstan: dbyings phyug dbang mo ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal dang : sangs rgyas ye shes thugs kyi sras gcig nyon: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: da lta spel ba'i gnas min ma 'ongs la: rtsod ldan skal pa mar 'grib 'byung ba nyams: snod bcud sems can dpag med dug lngar 'byams: las dbang rnam smin bag chags zad mtha' med: kye ma rigs drug sdug bsngal kyi re hud: tshe yang long med bar chod bdud kyis sdang : sems can phal cher grir 'chi btsan du skye: mnga' 'bangs bod khams sdug bsngal rdzing du bskyil: chos dbang bdud bsgyur log lta rkyen gyis g.yeng : ma rig dbang btsan srid pa'i btson rar tshud: gdung shugs dben pas chos kyi sum cha yal: bsnyen sgrub g.yel bas yi dam dbyings la phyogs:

khengs sems dregs pas dkar phyogs lha rnams 'khrugs: sha za sde brgyad sman mo mkha' 'gro yi: lo zla khug par mtshon gyi char pa 'bebs: 'dzam gling mi rnams me chu rlung sbyor 'dra: sems can rnams kyang yi mug zhum pa'i tshe: de yi dus su 'jig rten dbang phyug gi: sgrub par brtson zhing snying po lhur len rnams: don gnyis 'bras bu bde blag 'grub ste mchis: ma 'ongs de dus bod 'bangs skyob pa dang : bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgron me 'degs byed pa: kho bo bdag gi rnam sprul thugs rje'i zer: gnubs kyi lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes pa: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu mar 'grib dus: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling zhes yongs grags nas: bka' bab lung gi gter la spyod pa'i tshe: nam mkha'i rgyal po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: snying thig zab mo yang gsang shog dril 'di: kho bo'i thugs kyi sras la sprod cig rgya: bka' yi srung ma drang srong ljang sngon zhal: klu sman chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan rnams: dam chos 'di nyid mi nub mel tshe gyis: sbas yul pad+ma ke'u tshang shel phug rgya: dus la bab tshe pad+ma'i ming la sprod: skal ldan las can de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: 'phags mchog byang chub sems dpa' yi: zhabs kyis bcags shing dben pa'i yul: yid 'ong dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal: g.ya' gangs sam ni ri yi sul: yang na sa gzhi pad+ma'i mthil: 'dab brgyad rgyas pa lta bu'i sa: gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs: shin tu yid 'ong lha yi gnas: rnam rgyal khang bzang lta na sdug: legs bkod mdzes pa'i dbus shed du: rnam g.yeng bag med rab gzhom nas: mthun pa'i rdzas dang cha rkyen bsags: dkar zhing 'jam pa'i sa dag la: dkyil 'khor bcag cing thig gdab bo: tshon dang lha mdog tshom bur bsgyur: sku rten bkram zhing mchod rdzas bsham: bde ba'i gdan la 'khod byas nas:

rnal 'byor zhal kha shar du gyu: sngon 'gro sems bskyed bzhi ldan bya: sa ma ya: dang po sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni: na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: bzhi pa bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la dgug pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rta mchog khro rgyal dbang chen gyi: thugs ka'i zer las pho nya dpag yas 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ kro ta hūm̐ gardza ya: gnod byed 'byung po aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma kha phyir bsgyur la: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro rgyal khrag 'thung thugs khros nas: gzi byin stobs kyis drag po'i mtshon char 'bebs:

phye mar brlag cing rdul phran bzhin du gtor: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo'i rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu dha dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom zhing ting 'dzin brtan pa'i ngang la: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bdun pa sman raka gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: glang chen rta mchog khyi dang ba glang sha: mchog chen māṃ sa mi yi sha la sogs: dri chu dri chen dmar chen byang sems rnams: dung khang rdo rjes bsrubs pas bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: dung dmar snod du rak+ta rba klong phyur: zhag g.yo kyu mo lang ling rba rlabs phyur: an dza mu la mu ṭa pad+ma dang : 'bri mog rgya skag rang byung 'byung ba'i khrag: mkha' dbyings rak+ta dmar chen bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: rin chen las grub gtor snod yangs pa'i dbus: dam rdzas bha ling bshos bu ri ltar spungs: dbang po lnga sogs dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: mdangs ldan bcud mchog rgyas pa'i gtor kyus bskor: rmad byung gtor mchod bla med mchod rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes pas bdud rtsi dkrug cing bdun nam gsum gyis sbyang : brgyad pa bum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus: bh+rūm̐ dang paṃ las bum pa gzhal yas khang : kha khyer rgyas shing mgrin pa ring la mdzes: lto ba che la mchu ni rab tu 'phyang : zhabs mthil zhum ste pa tras rnam mdzes pa: le brgan dkar dmar zung gi chun po spras: sgro phod mdangs ldan dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing : gzungs thag sna lnga rdo rje'i cod pan mdzes: snang gsal 'od 'byin me long la sogs pa: kha rgyan rten 'brel bla med rdzas mchog gsal: nang ni gzhal yas bcud ni yi dam lha: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar lhags: snang stong so so'i thugs kar hrīḥmuṃḥmathar: rang sngags sgrogs shing thugs dam bskul bar gyur: oṃ ga lak+ṣa a mṛ ta dhe wa ga na sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa swā hā: zhes bum pa byin rlabs lan bdun bzlas: dgu pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang mtha' yab yum byin phob cig: ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: spyan gzigs yab yum byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig: mi 'gyur longs spyod pho brang nas: yi dam lha tshogs byin phob cig: dam tshig gsang ba'i pho brang nas: ma sring mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: thogs med las kyi pho brang nas: dam can gter srung byin phob cig: rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs byin phob cig: hūm̐: thugs rje gzi byin spungs se spung : nus rtsal dbang bskur sha ra ra: bkrag mdangs 'ja' zer kyi li li: gnas 'dir 'od dpung thibs se thib: dkyil 'khor gzi brjid ta la la: sgom pa'i lha tshogs sangs se sang : ma bsgoms ting 'dzin lhun gyis grub: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la:
dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

bcu pa brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skye med ka dag zhal mjal phyir: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'thib sgo bcad: zang thal rig pa'i 'char sgo phyes: gsal stong de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis 'dzin mnyam pa nyid du bshags: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta bas mchod: bla med ye grol chen por bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya badz+ra a ti pu ho dz+nyā na shud+dhe hūm̐: bcu gcig pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: stong nyid ting 'dzin ngang can gyi: rang bzhin rtsal las longs spyod rdzogs: 'phags mchog dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dran rig mi gtong de bzhin sgrub: auṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes pas dam bca' drag po 'dzin par bya: sa ma ya: dang po kun gzhi khyab pa'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: ye nas ka dag mtha' dbus bral: zang thal dmigs med rgya yan pa: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gnas: thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na saṃ bha trām̐ hrī āḥ gnyis pa kun snang rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni: āḥ rang byung rol rtsal sna tshogs shar: kun tu rtog bcas rtog med kyis: dran rig shes pa phra mo 'gyu: stong gsal 'gag med lam gyis 'phro: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma: gsum pa kun rgyu bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni: oṃ: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang nyid las: ma bcos spros bral rgyu yig hūm̐: kun gzhi khyab brdal dbyings la shar: 'od gsal klong dgur sa bon bh+rūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ.a hoḥ bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: e las chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram ljang : ram̐ las ye shes me ri dmar: kham̐ las chu yi dkyil 'khor sngo: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi dkar: keṃ las rang byung ri rab brjid: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas gsal: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ti ra baṃ dharma hrīḥ e sa ra ṇa: yam̐ ha ra ṇa: ram̐ tsakra ṇa: kham̐ dha ra ṇa: sum̐ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa: keṃ swa bhā ṇa:

bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa: ma sūr+ya ṇa: a tsan+d+ra ṇa: paṃ pad+ma ṇa: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ de nas lnga pa gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rnam bzhi mdzes: ka ba brgyad ldan bcu drug gdung ma bres: dral lcam thog steng rin po che las grub: sna lnga'i rtsig pa 'dod snam lha mo'i gar: pha gu drwa phyed g.yer kha'i sgra snyan sgrog: mda' yab pu shu sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rta babs bzhi ldan chos 'khor nyi zlas brgyan: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dar dpyangs 'phur: 'ja' 'od thig le zer thag bkrag mdangs rgyas: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa pad+ma'i phreng : ye shes me dpung srung ba'i gur bcas gsal: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa: snang gsal 'od 'khyil nyi zla'i gdan khri'i steng : thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon sku: dkar gsal 'od sku shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi 'bar lham me ba: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: rin chen sna tshogs snyan rgyan mgul rgyan spras: g.yas g.yon mnyam gzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: stod g.yogs lha rdzas mthing kha'i dar yug gsol: sku smad phyed skyil dar dmar ang rag bklubs: phyag gdub zhabs gdub ga shal dar dpyangs mdzes: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyangs can sku la 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: lcang lo thor tshugs dar ljang cod pan 'phur: rus pa'i rgyan dang phyag gdub zhabs gdub mdzes: rdo rje pad phreng yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis bde stong zung 'jug sked la 'khril: snang stong lhun grub ma bcos ngang la gsal: yab yum spyi gtsug sna tshogs pad zla'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: dmar ser mnyam gzhag skyil krung ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i khri 'phang du:

rnam snang spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog mthing : rat+na spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ser: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dmar: karma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ljang : bzhi ka 'gying bag brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: rin chen phyag gdub zhabs gdub rus pa'i rgyan: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan nor bu pad+ma 'dzin: gsang ba'i rig ma 'byung bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: sngo ser dmar ljang rin chen rgyan kun rdzogs: lcang lo thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis bde chen sku la 'khril: thabs shes mtshan dpe gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lcags kyu pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i zhags pa nor bu 'dzin: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i lcags sgrog dung dmar 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dril bu me long 'dzin: thams cad gar stabs rgyan ldan ling nge ba: nyon mongs bdud bzhi dug lnga khegs par bsgom: gzhan yang phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: gsal snang 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rang bzhin ltar: 'dzin med zang thal ngang nas gsal bar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas yi dam 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ drug pa spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po gshegs su gsol: rnam dag lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: 'phags mchog longs sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas: thugs rje'i bdag nyid rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: tshad med rnam thar sgo 'byed pho brang nas:

sgo skyong phyi nang dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: sra brtan mi shigs sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya: skyon bral yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs pa: lhun grub rang byung pad+ma nyi zla'i khrir: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgyad pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: gnas lugs skye med rang byung ngo bo'i rtsal: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'khor 'das zil gnon 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ dgu pa phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul yid 'phrog mdzes ma 'phro: lang ling gang ba mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu pa dbang po lnga yi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin dga' ba'i mdangs ldan ma: dbang po rnam lnga'i reg byas tshim mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor lo nor bu glang po rta mchog mdzes: btsun mo blon po dmag dpon rin chen 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra sarba swa na ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la sa mu dra āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rin chen gdugs dang bum pa dpal be'u rgyan:

'khor lo pad+ma gser nya chos dung sgra: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ maṅga la ku ṭa badz+ra bha me dz+nyā na s+pha ra ṇa āḥhūm̐: bcu gsum pa gar gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gar sgyur brda skad bde ba'i sgra sgrogs ma: glu ma gar ma ging mo sgeg pa mo: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ mā l+ye lā s+ye gīrti nīrti badz+ra pra mo ti āḥhūm̐: bcu bzhi pa sman mchod ni: hūm̐: stong gsum yangs pa'i snod mchog bhan+dha ru: bdud rtsis khengs pa'i mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bco lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dung chen snod du rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil: bla med gsang mchod mkha' dbyings bdud rtsi 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: stong gsum nyi zla yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: brjid chags bha ling dkar dmar rgyan ldan 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu bdun pa bstod pa ni: dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas: hūm̐ hrīḥ skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can: mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku: me shel mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'khyud pa'i dpal: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' 'od dpag med: rtog med chos sku'i spyan rtsa phyogs bcur gzigs: ma rig nyon mongs gzhom pa'i 'dzum mdangs can: 'od gsal ngang tshul mnyam bzhag skyil krung mdzad: dus gsum mtha' yas mgon gyur lham me ba:

snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla med 'od gsal rdo rje lta ba'i sku: ting 'dzin sna tshogs drwa ba'i gar sgyur ba: longs spyod rdzogs sku thugs rje'i gter chen po: legs par 'byin pa'i dbang po 'phags mchog sku: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku: shel dkar mdangs ldan 'dzum bag spyan rtsa 'khyil: ral pa'i zur phud thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan: nor bu snyan rgyan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i dar mthing stod g.yogs gsol: rin chen sna tshogs mgul rgyan gdub bu 'khrol: dar ljang ga shal sna tshogs se mo do: phyag g.yas 'od zer rdo rje shel phreng dkar: g.yon pas bde stong pad dkar yu ba 'dzin: dar dmar ang rag smad g.yogs rgyan mdzes bklubs: rdo rje skyil krung thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: zil gnon thugs rje chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shes rab rang byung bde stong bskyed pa'i yum: mdangs ldan rā ga 'od stong gzi 'bar ba: mdzes 'dzum chags la gsang ba'i brda skad sgrog: thor tshugs lcang lo sil bus sku rgyab gnon: rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan dbyings su bskyod: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan 'phyangs khro lo lo: rus pa'i chas mdzes g.yer kha si li li: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas shes rab pad phreng chun po bsnams: bde ba'i rang bzhin nu ma bha ga rgyas: zung 'jug ldan phyir zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: gsal stong 'dzin med drwa ba'i rnal 'byor ma: dbyangs can lha mo dbyings phyug yum la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi rim pa bzhin: rnam thar bzhi ldan tshad med ngo bo nyid: shar phyogs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku: rnam snang spyan gzigs in+d+ra nī la'i mdog:

khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: tshogs lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: rnam snang spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: lho phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku: rin 'byung spyan gzigs swa na sa snying mdangs: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog ser mo mā ma kī: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: sbyor lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: rin 'byung spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku: snang mtha' spyan gzigs pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug gos dkar mo: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: mthong lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: pad+ma spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: byang phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: don grub spyan gzigs sgra gcan rlung gi mdog: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma ljang : rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: sgom lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: don grub spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi tshad med bzhi ldan sgo skyong ma: rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i:

zhi ba'i rang bzhin dkar gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: lha bu'i bdud bcom lcags kyu pad+ma 'dzin: byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: shar sgo lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i: rgyas pa'i rang bzhin ser gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: phung po'i bdud bcom rin chen zhags pa 'dzin: snying rje tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: lho sgo zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bde bar lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i: dbang gi rang bzhin dmar gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: nyon mongs bdud bcom lcags sgrog dung dmar 'dzin: dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: nub sgo lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sdug bsngal lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa: drag po'i rang bzhin ljang gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: 'chi bdag bdud bcom dril bu me long 'dzin: btang snyoms tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: byang sgo dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor phyi nang khor yug la gnas pa'i: ging dang laṅka ma sring gnas nyul ma: phra men la sogs skyong ma bye ba 'bum: yang 'khor phrin las sna tshogs grub mdzad pa'i: pho brang 'bar ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab pa'i lha: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: gzi byin phrin las gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: sems can sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i dus la bab: mtha' yas sems can 'dren pa'i dus la bab: mtha' med 'khor ba stong pa'i dus la bab: nyon mongs rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor bshig pa'i dus la bab: dug lnga'i bag chags gtor ba'i dus la bab:

las ngan rnam smin byang ba'i dus la bab: rigs drug sa bon bsreg pa'i dus la bab: sgo lnga'i skye sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: thugs rje'i byin rlabs lcags kyu myur du phyungs: mtha' yas sems can 'gro drug ma lus kun: sdug bsngal rab dben phyir mi ldog pa'i lam: rnyed de 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub gyur nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sbubs su mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog:

de nas rtsa sngags bsnyen pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes pa'i sgra rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin rtsa sngags bye ba bzlas: de nas las sngags ni: oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes rtsa sngags bye ba: las sngags 'bum ther ro: sham bu rnams ni khri tsho dag tu 'don: de ltar bsgrubs pas 'jig rten dbang phyug gi: lha zhal mjal zhing go 'phang thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: zhi ba'i rtsa sngags la: nyon mongs bdud bzhi dug lnga las gyur pa'i bag chags ngan pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: ye shes lnga dang rtsa rlung thig le thams cad rgyas shing tshe bsod nams thams cad 'phel bar gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: snang ba dbang du 'dus shing snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bran du 'byung bar gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: sngon las 'phral rkyen dang byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces las bzhi rim bzhin shes par bya'o: sa ma ya: de ltar sngags phreng rnams lu gu rgyud sbrel ba ltar 'phros nas bum pa'i lha la phog ste thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar bsam: skabs su dzap bskul ni: hūm̐: yang gsang bla med thugs dam gcig bsdus pa: byin rlabs gter chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rmad byung ting 'dzin 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hūm̐: ka dag rang byung chos sku ngo mtshar che: rang rig lhan skyes gnyug ma'i lha zhal mjal: bde gsal mi rtog 'dzin med lhag ge ba:

chos sku snang mtha' kun bzang logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ bhi dh+wa swa bhā dharma hūm̐: hūm̐: ma skyes klong nas rtog med 'gyu ba yi: grags stong ngo bo zang thal lam gyis rtogs: stong gsal dbyer med ma bcos sa le hrig: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ dz+nyā na lo ki shwa ra hūm̐: hūm̐: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i rig pa so mar gnas: shar grol ngo bo 'dzin med rjen ne ba: sangs rgyas sprul sku byang sems logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ saṅgā bo dhi kun+dha hūm̐: hūm̐: ma 'gags rtsal chen dbang po'i gzhu lta bu: shar ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar: gsal la ris med mtha' gnyis ngo bo stong : legs par rtogs mdzad dran rig skyes bu'i mchog: dbyings kyi rang bzhin gzhal ba'i yul las 'das: dpag yas khyon gyi bkod pa lhug par rdzogs: smra brjod bral ba'i dmigs med rgyun gyis phyug: ci bzhin mkhyen pa'i dgyes mdzad rang rig sems: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hṛ da ya badz+ra sa ma ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes sku gsum rang byung lhan skyes kyi ngang la snying po grags stong bsam blo bral bar rang rig lta ba'i rnal 'byor gyis shugs la bzlas: sgrub pa bya na thun gtor 'bul: rgyun mchod dang cho ga yin na med kyang rung : spro na gtor snod du thun gtor bzhag la: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: thugs dam bskul phyir rgyan ldan mchod pa bzhes: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod: zhes thun gtor 'bul: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni:

chu gtsang gis bran zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhes lan gsum gyis sbyang : dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhan+dha lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar khengs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bhi sho dha ya bh+yo bhi sho s+pha ra ṇa me gha āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: spos dud phyur zhing : hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang snang mtha' chos sku'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang byung lhun grub 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon longs sku lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs ma 'gags drwa ba'i pho brang nas: sprul sku rig 'dzin pad 'byung lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs yon lnga ldan zhing khams nas: thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnam thar bzhi ldan tshad med pho brang nas: rigs bzhi sgo ma ḍāk+ki'i tshogs bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ngo mtshar bkod pa lhun grub pho brang nas: bka' sdod srung ma dam can gter bdag rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lha tshogs rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u g.yer kha si li li: rus pa'i rgyan ldan gar thabs shigs se shig: snang glu brda skad ldem 'gros khyugs se khyug: thugs rje'i nus rtsal byin rlabs sha ra ra: tshogs la gshegs shing gnas 'dir byin chen phob:

dbang bzhi bskur la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ: gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ka dag zang thal chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags zang thal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: longs sku spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : ma bcos spros bral gnas lugs ngo bo nyid: sprul sku yab yum rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : tshad med bzhi ldan rnam thar lam 'byed pa: rigs bzhi sgo ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor srung zhing mu ran skyong mdzad pa: yongs rdzogs lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med gzhi yi bskang : mchod du med de 'gag med lam gyi mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ro gcig sbyor: bsgral du med de 'khor 'das gnyis med sgrol: bshags su med de blang dor bral bar bshags: brjod du med de rang byung chen por gsal: bcol du med de khams gsum stongs par mdzod: lnga pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la ma bcos bzo med shes pas bshags:
