drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni: tshogs kyi tha ma gtor snod du bzhag: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang phyag rgya sngags dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma'i liṅga 'di dang gnyis su med par khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag chos sku'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin thugs rje'i sa bon 'phros: gnas 'gyu dran rig phur bu 'di: khyab brdal gnyug ma'i ngang gis bsgril: rtsol ba gzhom pa'i stobs kyis 'debs: sgrol cig ma rig bdud la ya: gtub bo dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: ye shes chen po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya ha la pañca mā ra ya rbad rbad: brgyad pa gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hoḥ blo 'das khyon ltar yangs pa'i zhal phyes shig: rgyud drug dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: a 'thas 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: byang chub 'thob phyir dgyes par bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: dgu pa tshogs la rol pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas chen mchog: rmad byung yon tan kun tshang 'di: 'dir 'dus ya mtshan gnang bar stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ gzigs shig gsang gsum bla med chos: ro gcig ting 'dzin zas mchog 'di: bzang ngan blang dor bral bar spyod: rtog med ye shes a la la hoḥ zhes tshogs la rol zhing dga' ston dgyes tshul rgya che bar bya: bcu pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dang po'i phud bdag bla ma yi dam lha: bar du tshogs la ma sring mkha' 'gro dgyes: tha ma lhag sdud dbang phyug laṅka ging : dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can: la la dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshul: la la dam tshig mkha' 'gro sha za'i tshul:

la la sman mo dur khrod ma mo'i tshul: la la bud med rgas shing 'khogs pa'i tshul: la la mdangs ldan sman shar btsun mo'i tshul: la la yid 'ong mdzes ldan bran mo'i tshul: la la 'dod sred smad tshong nag mo'i tshul: la la srin mo dur khrod 'dre mo'i tshul: la la 'bar ma yams bdag ma mo'i tshul: la la gcan spyang dur bya sha rngam tshul: sku mdog ma nges don la chos sku yi: klong las sprul pa'i ma sring phra men ma: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing ro la za: skyems bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing rgyu ma 'dren: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhan+dha thogs: rnal 'byor drod nyul rtogs pa'i stangs byed ma: sgyu 'phrul dbang gis mi bzad skur ston tshogs: dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma dam tshig can: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍi ma bhak+ṣa si i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag stobs bcu 'gyed pa'i lha: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang snang mtha' yas: rol pa las byung 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: rang bzhin dbyings nas thugs rjes skur bzhengs shig: bdud bzhi nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: bdag 'dzin ru tra 'joms pa'i dus la bab: dug lnga'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma dag rigs drug 'dren pa'i dus la bab: 'khor ba'i sa bon skem pa'i dus la bab: srid 'khor skye sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: bskul lo thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i rtsal phyungs shig: du ma ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khams gsum stong zhing sdug bsngal byang gyur nas: bla med 'bras bu thob pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hiḥ gnyis pa chad mdo bya ba ni: rnga rol chem pa'i sgra 'bir zhing : hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog tu: thog ma'i sangs rgyas dbyings phyug yab yum gnyis: ris med chos sku'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: dug lnga zil gnon 'gyu bas khas blangs bzhin: rang rig lta ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings rig zang thal phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og tsit+ta ri bo tā la ru: spyan ras gzigs dbang dbyangs can rig ma gnyis: rtsal snang longs sku'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: phyi nang ro gcig tshogs drug khas blangs bzhin: kun tu shes pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ka dag khregs chod mngon pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og brag dmar ār+ya pa gling du: rig 'dzin chen po pad 'byung yab yum gyis: slob ma'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: dkyil 'khor bka' gtad kha byang 'bogs pa'i tshe: ma sring srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: mthun rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byin chen thugs rje mngon pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sbas yul pad+ma shel phug gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum gling pa gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnyis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: gza' klu gter srung khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: tha tshig dam la gnas pa yi: rin chen gter gyi srung ma'i tshogs: sngon gyi khas blangs ma g.yel bar: dam tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍāk+ka ḍāk+ki sarba bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dam tshig bka' la bzhag pa yi: 'jig rten skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: ma sring ya ma bcu gnyis po: sna tshogs ma nges rta la chibs:

phyung rdeg mtshon cha phyag na thogs: lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan g.yer kha'i sgra chen sgrog: rgyangs glu bshugs sgra di ri ri: dur khrod gnas brgyad nyul mdzad ma: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang srung : dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs: bod khams skyong mdzad bcu gnyis kyis: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le taṃ taṃ dza dza i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: skye med klong yangs chos dbyings pho brang nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin chen rgyud bskul la: 'chi med tshe dpal 'dzad med nor gyis phyug: zab chos rgyas shing snyan dang grags pa'i gtam: khams gsum dbang sdud mthu stobs rtsal gyi mchog: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: mchog thun thob cing dbang bzhi bskur du gsol: oṃ gu ru rat+na ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ dbang blang zhing dngos grub zhu: lnga pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe dbang chen mkha' dbyings su: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: mtshan 'dzin ru tra rtsad nas bshig: de 'og zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: rigs bzhi ging chen bro brdungs pas: log lta bar chod rdul du brlag: da lta rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bro: dam sri bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: drag sngags nus stobs bro rdung ngo : g.yas pa za byed khro bo'i bro: g.yon pa gsod byed ma mo'i bro: gnyis med he ru ka pa'i bro: dug lnga'i bag chags mgo la chem: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ ru tra satwaṃ bha ya nan: a mu ka satwaṃ bha ya nan: ha la pañca satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya satwaṃ bha ya nan:

zhes 'khrab cing rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar slong zhing me tog 'thor: drug pa tshe 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar dang tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: tshe yi bdag po 'chi med dbang gi lha: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: 'ja' lus rdo rje tshe yi srog sgrub cing : rig ma mkha' 'gro ḍāk+ki mched lnga yis: steng 'og phyogs bcu kun gyi bcud bsdus la: sgrub po'i lus la 'od dpung ltem gyis thim: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na pad+ma dha ra hrī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes dbang blang zhing tshe dpal thams cad 'dus par bsam: bdun pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag rang rig mngon gyur bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis rta mchog dbang gi rgyal: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mas: rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis ki kang rā hu las: dgra bgegs tshar bar gcod pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis gsang ba 'od ldan mas: zab gter mthar phyin rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis pad+ma shel gyi phug: gnas brtan byin chen 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog: lo yi bkra shis sra brtan lcags glang lo: brgyud 'dzin mi g.yo brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: zla ba'i bkra shis spre'u byang chub lo: bshad sgrub spel ba'i yul gling bkra shis shog: zhag gi bkra shis nyer lnga chu tshod rta: gegs med mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: zhal rgyas bkra shis zla tshes bcu yi nyin: sngags bstan gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar bkra shis shog: brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni:

hoḥ klong yangs rgyal ba rab 'byams longs sku'i zhing : sna tshogs sgyu ma cho 'phrul dkyil 'khor lha: rang byung rang shar rig pa'i klong du bsdu: skye med ka dag zang thal ngo bor āḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor bsdu: dgu pa bsngo ba ni: ho: bsngo bya chos dbyings ye grol lta ba'i klong : bsngo byed gnas lugs dran pa rig pa'i rgyal: bsngo yul 'khor 'das bdag gzhan blo las 'das: bsngo 'bras ka dag mtha' bral ngang du bsngo: dmigs med bsngo bas 'khor gsum yongs dag shog: bcu pa smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag 'dzin ru tra srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: myong bzhin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rigs drug tshogs: legs par sel mdzad sa gsum skye dgu'i mchog: mgon mdzad rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra yi: go 'phang grub ste don gnyis mthar phyin nas: ma 'ongs rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs par shog: ces bsngo smon rgyas pa bya zhing : rten 'brel rnam bzhi'i sgo nas byang sems rgyud dang ldan par bya: sa ma ya: e ma: kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin bod 'bangs skyob byed pa'i: thar lam them skas thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: sgrub pa'i las byang snying thig zab mo'i chos: 'brel tshad don ldan snying gi byang bu 'di: dbang gi mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : gnubs kyi lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal: gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki dhe wa dha rar gdams: da lta spel ba'i gnas min ma 'ongs la: tshe la long med lnga brgya tha ma'i dus: sems can sdug bsngal mi dge'i las la spyod: dge ba'i 'bras bu dben zhing khyad du gsod: chos med dred po stong lta ham zhing zhen: las su dmag 'khrug zas su sha khrag spyod: gtam du rdzun smra ngo tsha'i khrel kyang bral: de bzhin ma 'ongs nyi shu dus kyi rtags: ci bzhin shar te lo zla mthun pa'i tshe:

drang srong rgyal po ki kang rā hu la: klu sman chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan gyis: zab chos snying thig 'khor 'das zil gnon 'di: ma 'ongs thugs sras pad+ma'i ming dang sprod: dpal gyi shel phug mi nub a thaṃ rgya: skal med lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor sprel zla'i nyer lnga nyin khrom sum brgya skor dang bcas nas gdan drangs shing : gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser ḍāk+ki'i tshon bzhi pa gcig nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ slar yang dpal ldan stag lung thang pa'i gdan sa ri bo cher zhu dag bgyis so// // bdud rtsi sman mchod mchog gsum pañca bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ka ni srid gsum yangs pa thabs kyi snod/ /pā ni shes rab rtsa brgyad stong sbyar rdzas/ /la ni bde stong zung 'jug 'chi med bcud/ /sor bcu rigs lnga yab yum ngo bo nyid/ /sbyangs spel bsgyur zhing bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod/ hrīḥ rigs kun khyab bdag chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rab 'byams bde gshegs sku dngos spyan ras gzigs/ /rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs grub dbang pad+ma 'byung*/ /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ e waṃ zab gsang smin grol gdams pa'i mdzod/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro gter brgyud la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ skad gnyis smra ba bud+dha dz+nyā na'i mtshan/ /bka' bab tshig brgyud mchog gi brgyud pa la/

/sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ gter gling mi 'jigs mchog gi sprul sku sogs/ /shog ser brgyud pa gsang sngags sdong po la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mchog gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po che/ /byams mgon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ye shes bzhi po mngon gyur grub pa'i gzugs/ /'gag med rmad byung rigs bzhi yab yum la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ tshad med rnam bzhi bde stong rol pa'i rtsal/ /ye shes sgo skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ bka' gsang yang zab gnyan po'i lde mig 'dzin/ /gza' klu lha yi btsan rgod 'khor bcas la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ /sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ gzhan yang snang srid thams cad 'phags pa'i sku/ /sgra grags yig drug dran rig spyan gzigs tshogs/ /'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ /sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ /'bru gsum yi ge sku gsum sa bon mtshan/ /gnas gsum dbang bskur mchog gi dngos grub thob/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po dkyil 'khor kha skong mtshams sbyar du ār+ya'i ming gis bris pa'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: rgyud bskang rin chen chen phreng ba bzhugs so:

'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: bskang ba bya ba'i rim pa ni: mchod rdzas sna tshogs spyan gzigs bsham: rol mo dbyangs snyan dri zhim bcas: kun tshang 'byor ldan bgyis nas su: skong bshags cho gar 'bad par bya: sa ma ya: dang po thugs dam bskang phyir spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje sprul sku sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mi shigs 'khor lo pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: gdung shugs gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: lta ba rang rig ka dag mngon gyur pa'i: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags rtsal chen ngo bo so sor rdzogs: longs sku spyan gzigs yab yum thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes thabs mkhas gang 'dul der ston mchog: he ru ka pa sprul sku'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi sdug bsngal 'joms: rat+na spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi sdug bsngal 'joms: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : phrag dog rnam dag lha min sdug bsngal 'joms: karma spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gti mug rnam dag byol song sdug bsngal 'joms: bud+dha spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : ser sna rnam dag yi dwags sdug bsngal 'joms: kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sa khams rnam dag mngal skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs dam bskang :

chu khams rnam dag sgong skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen mā ma kī yi thugs dam bskang : me khams rnam dag drod skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen gos dkar mo yi thugs dam bskang : rlung khams rnam dag brdzus skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: byams pa tshad med tshogs lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong lcags kyu dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : snying rje tshad med sbyor lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang : dga' ba tshad med mthong lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong dmar mo lcags sgrog thugs dam bskang : btang snyoms tshad med sgom lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong dril bu ljang mo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: 'dzam gling dpag yas khyon ltar 'gengs pa yi: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos ma dang : glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin ma: mchod sprin lha mo spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med mchod pa'i sprin: ga ṇa longs spyod mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang :

'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: dngos 'byor sna tshogs snang stong mchod pa'i sprin: ḍā dril bla med grags stong so so'i skad: yid sprul blo bral kha dog brjod las 'das: don dam gnas lugs rang byung mchod sprin 'dis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐ bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ngang la sbyor: bsgral du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dam 'gal dbang gyur pa'i: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal sngags bzlas sgra zur nyams: mchod rdzas phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : lo zla dus kyi skong bshags mchod pa chad: so thar khas blangs bslab sdom dam tshig nyams: sbyor ba 'dod sred sgrol ba zhe sdang skyes: ting 'dzin ma rtogs tshogs drug 'khrul par 'khyams: nga bdag ru tras bdag gzhan dge ba bcom: rigs drug sems can pha mar chags sdang bsags: zang zing rgyu la dge bcu zong du bcug: rang 'dod ched du sangs rgyas sku la smad: snyan grags 'dod phyir gsang sngags khrom du gtor:

rang bslu dkor sdud dge 'dun ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor khas blangs nyams: bag med dam 'gal le lo rnam g.yeng sogs: mi dge'i sdig ltung ci mchis mthol lo bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing lhag chad bkang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan chos bzhin spyod pa rnams: las kyi dbang gis bar chad bdud btsan pas: bka' chad 'khu ldog nyams chag las gyur te: de dag bsal zhing don gnyis mthar phyin ched: skong bshags zab mo rin chen phreng ba bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: da lta spel ba'i gnas min gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: bod 'bangs byang chub thob pa'i btsas su bzhag: bka' yi rgya 'di gza' klu rnams kyis srungs: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: log lta bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// //

thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi khrus chog bag chags sbyong byed bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: gshin po rjes 'dzin bya ba ni: dang po dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs btang : tha ma las sbyor bya ba ni: bum pa me long khrus dar dang : rigs lnga rgyal srid sna bdun dang : til dkar til nag gang rung bsags: bgegs gtor la sogs gzhung ltar bya: byang bu sbyar na me hom sogs: zas mchog rnams kyang tshang bar bsags: 'byung bzhi dug sogs lag len ltar: slob dpon zhal lung lta bur bya: sa ma ya: dang po rang nyid sngon 'gro skyabs yul bya ba ni: na mo: sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing las ngan srid pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig: sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dam pa'i mchog don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od gsal rdo rje theg chen gyi 'bras bu dang ldan par gyur cig: sems can thams cad ma rig gzung 'dzin gyi rgyu re dogs bag chags kyi ngan goms nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la ji srid kyi bar du gnas par gyur cig: gnyis pa skyabs yul gsol 'debs ni: na mo: ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la skyabs su mchi'o ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams rnam dag ri bo tā la nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la skyabs su mchi'o 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par gyur cig: mkha' spyod ye shes dbyings kyi gzhal yas chen po nas: pad 'byung yab yum sku la skyabs su mchi'o tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog: thugs rje 'od klong mi shigs pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi'o ngan song las sgrol cig: ma skyes gsal stong rdzogs pa'i pho brang chen po nas: yongs rdzogs 'gro mgon rnams la skyabs su mchi'o byin rlabs myur thob shog:

gsum pa byang bu yin na: pad+ma'i gdan la bzhag la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsang chu 'thor: hoḥ mdun du pad+ma'i gdan la tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad can phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad rdzogs par gsal bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra rū pa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ bzhi pa rang nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje chen por gsal te hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas nas: hoḥ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du song ba'i chaiga'i rnam par shes pa srid pa gsum gang du gnas kyang rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na hūm̐ dzaḥ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs su gyur pa: snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pas: chaig mo'i rnam par shes pa rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra nṛ a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis bstim: lnga pa bgegs dang phral ba ni: gtor ma bsngo zhing thun kyang brdeg: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ sarba bhū ta rā dza ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: gnod byed 'byung po za 'dre shi gshed rigs: srog gcod dbugs sdud tshe len bla khyer dang : gson bdud gshin lcags thar lam gegs byed pa: tshe 'das 'di la gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs kun: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ drug pa bsngo zhing rdzong ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis:

ci ste mi 'gro thar lam gegs byed na: bdag nyid khro rgyal dpa' bo thugs khros nas: gti mug gzhom phyir rdo rje ser chen 'bebs: nga rgyal rtsad gcod rin chen phur bu 'debs: 'dod chags rab 'joms pad+ma zangs gri bsnun: phrag dog gtor mdzad las kyi drag sngags brdeg: dpa' bo brtul shugs stong khams me yis 'geng : kun rdzob don dam nyi zla cha lang brdeb: gzi byin stobs kyis nga bdag ru tra 'joms: gar dgu theg chen hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: nyon mongs tshogs skem phaṭ sgras sa gsum bsngang : che btsan mi bzad 'bar ba'i rtsal phyung gi: de bas bgegs rnams rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ ghṛ ha na ghṛ ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ghṛ ha na pa ya ghṛ ha na pa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a na ya ho bha ga wān bhū ta rā dza mā ra ya gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces thun gyis brab cing gu gul kyang bdug: bdun pa khrus bya ba ni: bum pa dang me long thogs la dang po sku gsung thugs kyi rten la khrus bstsal ba ni: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la kha dog mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das lus kyi bag chags sbyang slad du: thugs rje sprul skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos kyi gsung la sgra zur mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das ngag gi bag chags sbyang slad du: longs spyod rdzogs skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos kyi thugs la skye 'gag mtha' bral yang : tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du: ka dag chos skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: yang dag chos skur phyi nang ris med kyang :

tshe 'das dug gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas spyi khrus 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni 'od gsal bla med chu: dbyings rig ka dag thugs rje'i klong : byin rlabs ting 'dzin khrus bstsal bas: gnas lugs ye shes don rtogs shog: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza a dhiṣ+ṭha na a be sha ya ho bhi dh+wa na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni me long ye shes chu: zhe sdang dri ma sbyang slad du: snang stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: shes sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni sor rtog ye shes chu: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang slad du: grags stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: bag chags sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te wāk+ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes chu: gti mug sgrib pa sbyang slad du: gsal stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: las sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes chu: nga rgyal sgrib pa sbyang slad du: bde stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rmongs sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ka te ghu ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bya grub ye shes chu: phrag dog sgrib pa sbyang slad du: tshor stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rtog sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: brgyad pa sku phyi ba ni: hūm̐: rnam dag lha rdzas las grub 'jam legs mdzes: rang byung ye shes lnga yi dar tshon gyis:

rgyal ba'i sku la byi dor 'di bgyis pas: tshe 'das las kyi bag chags dag gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya wāk+ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: dgu pa mchod pa sna lnga 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: gzugs mdzes mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul: snang stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: sgra thogs la: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: sgra snyan mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul: grags stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: dri bzang thogs la: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: dri zhim mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la 'bul: tshor stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: ro mchog thogs la: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: ro mchog mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul: myong stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra rā sa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: reg mchog thogs nas: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: reg 'jam mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul: bde stong mchod pa bskyed gyur cig: oṃ lo ki shwa ra spar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: bcu pa 'byung bzhi'i dug bsal ba ni: sa thogs la: hūm̐: sa yi snying po byang chub sems: gti mug khyab rten rnam dag pa: tshe 'das ma rig las gyur tshogs: sangs rgyas spyan mas dug bcom mo: sha khams sa la bstim du gsol: oṃ bh+rūm̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa laṃ dz+nyā na mo ha ra ti ye bh+rūm̐ mi ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: chu thogs la: hūm̐: chu yi snying po byang chub sems:

'dod chags gsher brlan rnam dag pa: tshe 'das bag chags las gyur tshogs: mā ma kī yis dug bcom mo: khrag khams chu la bstim du gsol: oṃ khaṃ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa maṃ dz+nyā na rā ga ra ti ye khaṃ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: me thogs te: hūm̐: me yi snying po byang chub sems: zhe sdang 'bar mched rnam dag pa: tshe 'das shes sgrib las gyur tshogs: gos dkar mo yis dug bcom mo: drod khams me la bstim du gsol: oṃ ram̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa paṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra ra ti ye ram̐ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rlung g.yab thogs la: hūm̐: rlung gi snying po byang chub sems: phrag dog yang g.yo rnam dag pa: tshe 'das nyon mongs las gyur tshogs: dam tshig sgrol mas dug bcom mo: dbugs khams rlung la bstim du gsol: oṃ yam̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa taṃ dz+nyā na dhe wa kha ra ti ye yam̐ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bden pa gsum gyis dug bcom pa ni: hūm̐: dug gsum sku gsum ngo bo nyid: dkon mchog gsum la dug mi mnga': lnga ldan ye shes bden pa yis: tshe 'das dug lnga zhi gyur cig: oṃ dharma ka ya: sam+bho ka ya: nirmā ka ya: bud+dha bha ga: dharma hrī dha: saṅga rat+na: saṃ bha ro pa ya: ha la pañca ye swā hā: bcu gcig pa sdig sgrib bsreg pa ni: til srin mdzub dang mthe bong gi bar la thogs te: phyag rgya dang bcas nas: ho tshe las 'das pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ gyis mtshan pa'i rlung gyen du g.yos: lte 'og ram̐ la phog ste me rab tu 'bar: snying khar las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i paṃ nag po de: ye shes kyi me yis ded nas ro rkyang gi lam la brgyud de shangs sgor bslebs pas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pa can du gyur nas sbyong byed til la thim par gyur: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ye swā hā:

yi ge brgya pa sogs brjod de til la phu btab: de nas sngags re re dang sbrags nas til mer bsreg: ho skad cig gi mdun du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gdan gyi steng du: he ru ka khro bo rdo rje nag po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can du gsal ba'i zhal du til gsol bas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong zhing bsreg par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: lan gang rung gis: oṃ badz+ra a wa ra ṇa ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra rā ga he sha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra mo ha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ma hā tsar+ya ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a ri sha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ sarba ha la pañca ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ a su nṛ tri pre du ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: ho 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe dus las 'das pa chaig mo'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bcu gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa rnam dag ye shes gzhal yas khang : bcud ni yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mchog rab thob ste: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing der skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: sna tshogs rang byung thugs rje chen po'i lha: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: snang ba mtha' yas sku mchog rab thob ste:

bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: gsal stong ma 'gags 'od gsal snying po can: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste: 'thug po bkod kyi zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la: hūm̐: sdug bsngal g.yul las rgyal ba'i bla med rdzas: byang chub 'phags pa'i nor bdun mtshon pa'i brda: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rin chen 'byung ldan sku mchog rab thob ste: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sna tshogs rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: ting 'dzin mi shigs sna tshogs rdo rje'i sku: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: don yod grub pa'i sku mchog rab thob ste: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bcu gsum pa zas gtad pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song zhing tshe las 'das pa

chaig mo'i mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa: rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa: sna yi yul du dri zhim pa: lce yi yul du ro mngar ba: lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa: yid kyi yul du dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig: ces pas bsngo zhing gsur btang : hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: zad med rin chen mdzod kyi gzhong pa ru: 'dod yon longs spyod lnga ldan bcud kyis bkang : ting 'dzin hom du bsreg cing bsngos pa yis: zad mi shes pa'i gter la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: oṃ ma hā paṇ+ye s+pha ra ṇa pa ri wā ra ye kha kha khā hi: bcu bzhi pa dge legs mdzad cing lam bstan pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: 'jig rten mi yul 'di yi snang ba nub: gnas khang yul la skad cig sdod dbang med: pha ma spun zla mthong yang 'grogs dbang med: zang zing rgyu la chags kyang 'dzin thabs zad: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: rnam smin bar do'i yid lus mdun nas sgug: nyon mongs las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded: 'jigs gzugs gshin rje'i pho nyas 'dzin cing khrid: dri za lta bur bsam pas stong khams 'khor: skyabs dang gnas khang bral bas sdug bsngal skyes: las rlung mun rum bu yug kha char gtibs: shi bar thag chod dran bzod med pa yis: bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam shes gtad med khyod: skad cig sdod pa'i go skabs ma mchis pas: gnyen 'brel zang zing rgyu la ma chags shig: bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor dran par gyis: phyag 'tshal skyabs 'tshol rtse gcig 'dun pa bskyed: bco lnga pa tshe 'das bla rten bca' ba ni: hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: mtshan byang 'di la lus kyi bla rten chos: rol mo 'di la ngag gi bla rten chos: mar me 'di la sems kyi bla rten chos:

gdugs phran 'di la gos kyi bla rten chos: smyug ma 'di la srog gi bla rten chos: pad+ma 'di la sdod pa'i bla rten chos: 'dod yon 'di la zas kyi bla rten chos: rin chen 'di la rgyan gyi bla rten chos: dar thag 'di la grogs kyi bla rten chos: bla ma lha la skyabs pa'i bla rten chos: tshe 'das rnam shes rten du pheb pa bcu: sa bcu lam lnga bgrod par 'dun pa bskyed: ma rig las kyi bag chags sbyang slad du: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs chos shig: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bla rten gyi byang bu thogs la phyag 'tshal zhing nye dus bshags pa sogs bya'o: bcu drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: dkyil 'khor slob dpon sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thog ma'i sangs rgyas mngon rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: snying rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug 'dren mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zhe sdang ma spangs dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'dren: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: ser sna ma spangs yi dwags 'jig rten 'dren: don grub spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: gti mug ma spangs byol song 'jig rten 'dren: mi bskyod spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod chags ma spangs mi yi 'jig rten 'dren: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: phrag dog ma spangs lha min 'jig rten 'dren: mi 'khrugs spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: nga rgyal ma spangs lha yi 'jig rten 'dren: rin chen spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: sa khams ma spangs lha bu'i bdud bcom pa: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan mar phyag 'tshal lo: chu khams ma spangs phung po'i bdud bcom pa: yum chen mā ma kī la phyag 'tshal lo: me khams ma spangs nyon mongs bdud bcom pa: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung khams ma spangs 'chi bdag bdud bcom pa:

yum chen dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo: rtag lta ma spangs byams pa mtha' ru phyin: shar sgo lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: chad lta ma spangs snying rje mtha' ru phyin: lho sgo zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'dzin ma spangs dga' ba mtha' ru phyin: nub sgo lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo: stong lta ma spangs btang snyoms mtha' ru phyin: byang sgo dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas dge legs byed pa ni: hoḥ de ltar phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gsol 'debs pa'i: ma dag rigs drug skye ba'i sgo bcad nas: rnam dag 'od gsal lam la drang du gsol: pha rol song ba'i tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: byang chub lam bstan gegs med bgyis mdzad pa: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: rang byung ka dag 'od gsal snying po yi: gnas lugs mngon sum 'bras bu smin mdzad des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: zhi ba chags bral dam chos brgyad khri'i dpal: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gter chen des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde: drang srong grub thob kun gyi 'byung gnas des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: rtsa gsum ngo bo skyabs yul kun 'dus mchog: sna tshogs sprul sku dkyil 'khor lha tshogs des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i mched lcam bden pa'i tshig: rtse gcig thogs med 'grub pa'i smon lam des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: brgya byin la sogs stong gsum 'byung po'i tshogs: byang chub thob nas sdug bsngal bral ba des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: mthu chen stobs kyis tshe 'das byin brlabs nas: nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs 'byung gyur cig: lam bstan nas rnam shes 'og min rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim par bsam: hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu:

bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam shes gtad med khyod: sgrib med gsal stong yi ge a ru bsgom: dbu ma ka dag bde chen zhing khams su: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru: rtsal chen ye shes rlung gis rab btegs nas: rnam shes a yig skar mda' chad pa ltar: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim gyur cig: phaṭḥ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ ces chos sku'i thugs kar bstim: bcu bdun pa byang bu sbar ba ni: hoḥ mdun du skad cig gis khro bo dmar nag bag chags sreg pa'i he ru ka stobs ldan gsal bar gyur: oṃ he ru ka ram̐ pā paṃ bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu: bdag 'dzin srid pa'i phung po la: rang byung ye shes me sbar ro: rnam rtog dug lnga'i bud shing la: sku lnga lhun grub me sbar ro: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro: rnam shes tshogs drug bud shing la: pha rol phyin drug me sbar ro: yul brgyad bdag 'dzin bud shing la: sems dpa' brgyad kyi me sbar ro: shes bya brgyad kyi bud shing la: lha mo brgyad kyi me sbar ro: rtog pa dgu yi bud shing la: theg pa rim dgu'i me sbar ro: lus ngag yid kyi bud shing la: sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar ro: phung po nga bdag bsregs gtor nas: bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes byang bu sbar te sāts+tsha'am chu bor dor: bco brgyad pa bsngo ba gang rung bya: de nas smon lam ni: hūm̐: rnam dag bkod pa zhing khams bde ba can: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas dbus: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: rgyal sras sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: ngo mtshar bkod pa blo las 'das pa yi: ting 'dzin longs spyod gtum mo gos kyi mchog: byang chub chu rgyun mi zad longs spyod pa:

snang stong lha yi khye'u pho mo grogs: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rin chen gter mdzod can: ye shes lnga yi sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: 'od gsal snying po ma rig ka nas dag: kun tshang bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa yis: mkha' spyod phun tshogs zhing khams de nyid du: tshe 'das rnam shes skad cig 'phos ma thag: ma nor bstan pa'i lam mchog rab rnyed nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skyes nas kyang : sprul pas phyogs bcu'i gzhan don nus par shog: ces smon lam gang rung gis mtshams sbyor bya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: phyi rabs sems can don gyi phyir: gshin chog bag chags g.ya' bral bzhag: gang zhig 'di nyid thebs pa'i rigs: byang chub thob par the tshom med: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags glang lor brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs pa'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gter srung gza' yi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gtum po khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: snying thig srung ma'i sgrub thabs bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod phung shul gang rung la: dmar nag chos 'byung dal thig gdab: de dbus bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : 'bru nag dpal gtor smad zlum la: bya rog mgo dang me ri yis: mtshan pa'i rgyan bkra legs par btab: 'khor du gtor chung brgyad kyis bskor: rtse mor dar nag gdugs kyi dbus: bya rog snying dang srog yig bzhag: bla rdo gzi mig dgu pa dang : lcags kyi mda' gzhu la sogs gzugs: gzhan yang mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsham: mdun du brub khung dgra ling dang :

thun rdzas dag gis bskor ba bsham: sa ma ya: dang po bdag mdun bskyed chog ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid e yi klong : snod bcud thams cad rab 'jigs gzhal yas khang : de dbus dug rlangs dmar chen ro yi gdan: bdag nyid hūm̐ las ye shes gza' mchog ni: khra tsha mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rab khros srid gsum sngangs: thod skam dbu rgyan spyi bor bya rog zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri gnam lcags mda': g.yon gsum rgyal mtshan me thab rwa yi gzhu: dur khrod chas rdzogs lhu tshigs spyan gyis spras: zhabs bzhi dor stabs ma rungs 'byung po brdzis: gsang ba'i yum mchog klu mo 'od ldan ni: khro 'dzum mthing 'od dgyes pa'i mdangs mnga' ma: phyag gnyis nor bu sgrom bcas mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum yab la 'khril: me 'od tshwa tshwa 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ hrī dz+nyā na khra tsha nā ga te dz+wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: mdun du dug rlangs khrag mtsho khol ma'i dbus: k+ṣaṃ yig nag po gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: gza' rgod ljang sngon ki kang rā hu la: srin po'i gzugs can zhal dgu rab tu khro: spyi bor sgra gcan bya rog nag po'i mgo: g.yas gnyis ral gri gnam lcags mda' gzhu bsnams: g.yon gnyis chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags thogs: lte bar khro zhal sku lus mig gis brgyan: sku smad dug sbrul rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil: gza' brgyad gdong mo rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor: bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral ba'i ngo bor gsal: oṃ hrī rā hu la ki kang hrī shag ru raṃ gra ha bīmiṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis drang srong gza' mchog 'khor bcas spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i pho brang nas: gza' mchog rgyal po gshegs su gsol: yang 'khor bka' nyan gshegs su gsol:

dug sbrul nag po'i khri la bzhugs: hūm̐: khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod nang du: dmar nag gtor ma liṅgas brgyan: dar nag gdugs phub srog sngags btags: dgra bgegs sha khrag don snying dang : dgyes pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: hūm̐: drang srong chen po'i thugs dam bskang : ki kang chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sgra gcan 'bar ba'i thugs dmabaskang : rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : ljang sngon chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sde brgyad dmag dpon thugs dam bskang : gza' brgyad 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : rgyu skar nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud de: phrin las thogs med khyod kyis sgrubs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho'i klong : thog char bu yug dkyil 'khor dbus: gza' bdud chen po mi bsrun pa: dbu dgu khros pas stong gsum sngangs: bya rog gdong gi bstan pa srung : phyag bzhi mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: spyan stong gzigs pas srid gsum sngangs: sbrul mjug 'khyil bas klu srin 'dul: sku la me 'od tshwa tshwa 'khrugs: gza' bdud nag por bdag bstod do: skabs su dgra ling 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐ rā hu la ki kang ya ma dgra bgegs raṃ tri ta ha la mā ra ya khug khug dza dzaḥ dgra bo ngag mnan ni: oṃ tri gra ha kham lo ka ya dgra bo wāka satwaṃ bha gzer nan: dgra bor thun brdeg pa ni: oṃ ki kang hrī shag nā ga ha la dgra bo'i bla srog gzer thum bhi sha bhi sha ka ra tri ya rbad rbad: de nas dgra bo bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ yak+ṣa kā la thun thun dgra bo bhan+dha bhan+dha baṃ ril kham myog ma tri ya ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta la rbad rbad:

de nas gtub pa ni: oṃ ya ma baṃ log pra ha si ta dgra bo mā ra ya rbad rbad nṛ tri myog thuṃ thib rtsa shig shig: dgra bo bsreg pa ni: oṃ raṃ shag kā la ki kang ya ma dun dun dgra bo raṃ ha la raṃ ha la rbad rbad: dgra bo mnan pa ni: oṃ yak+sha mā ra ya tri hur hur thuṃ thuṃ dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes sngags rnams skabs dang bstun te liṅga bsgral zhing gtor ma la bran: gzhan mnan gtad la sogs zhal du shes: de nas tha tshig bsgrag cing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: thun gtor la dgra bo 'gugs shing : hūm̐: sngon tshe rdor 'chang shāka thub bka': bar du gsang bdag pad 'byung bka': ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam tshig dus la ma 'da' bar: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams myur du sgrol: hūm̐: ki kang nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ bya rog gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ khra tsha sgra gcan dgra la bh+yoḥ stobs ldan ljang sngon dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' brgyad gdong mo dgra la bh+yoḥ lha srin sde brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ yang 'khor ru 'dren dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i sha khrag don snying rol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hrī rā hu la ki kang gra ha na ga raṃ wa nā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgra bo byad ma'i snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ sha la rbad rbad: rus pa la gtub gtub: srog la rngub rngub: thun thun ha ya de sha de sha rbad bh+yoḥ

zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang : dmod pa bor: thal mo brdab: sgrub pa'i skabs yin na srog yig dang bla rten 'chang : rjes bsngo smon bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: phyi rabs bstan dgra bsgral ba dang : gnyer gtad bka' bstan skyong ba'i phyir: drang srong ki kang sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: las 'phro can dang 'phrad bar shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: rma rkong dge bsnyen gsol mchod bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po'i sku la 'dud: dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod ni: rin chen snod mchog gtsang ma'i nang : bshos bu stod zur smad zlum la: sbrul gyis dkris shing dkar rgyan bya: phyi rol mtheb skyu brgyad kyis bskor: phud dang skyems bcas dkar mchod rigs: g.yag sngon bya sngon sbrul sngon dang : nam mkha' sngon po la sogs bzhag: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid klu yi dge bsnyen mched brgyad: khyad par gter srung drag po mthu bo che rnams la dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor rgya chen po 'bul lo: bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag gis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las ci bcol ba thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: hūm̐: rab 'jigs ri bo'i khong seng dbus: rgya mtsho mer ba'i nang shed nas: klu yi dge bsnyen gshegs su gsol: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gter srung chen po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni: g.yag sngon bya sngon sbrul sngon dang : bshos bu nam mkha' sngon po sogs: gser skyems phud dang dkar mchod 'di:

dge bsnyen klu mo 'khor bcas la: 'bul lo mchod do lha gsol lo: bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: klu yi skyes bu dge bsnyen ni: zhi mdzum mdzes pa'i mdangs mnga' ba: g.yu khrab sngon po sku la gsol: mthing rmog ru dar lhabs se lhab: phyag g.yas gter gyi sgrom bu bsnams: g.yon pas dar mdung sngon po bsgrengs: klu rta sga srab chas kyis brgyan: dar sngon ber chen swag lham gsol: ma sang dgra lha chen po ste: bstan pa skyong ba'i myur mgyogs can: srung ma chen po khyed la bstod: hūm̐: skyes bu klu yi dge bsnyen che: gnas ni rma rkong mtsho la gnas: chags pa shel phug mtsho la 'khor: 'gyu ba rong chen bzhi la 'gyu: rtsal chen klu yi dge bsnyen che: gsol lo mchod do phrin las sgrubs: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' btags bzhin: gter gnyan 'di yi bstan pa srungs: yul gru lo phyugs sa bcud spel: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs: sbas yul bstan pa'i srog shing tshugs: rig 'dzin bdag gis bos pa'i tshe: mngon spyod rtags dang chas te byon: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ nā ga ti pa ra tsa sa ma ya swā hā: zhes mchod gtor 'bul zhing phrin las 'grub: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor skyongs: bka' btsan las myur thogs med sgrubs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal rgyas so// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gter srung lha btsan gyi gsol mchod bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: gter srung chen po mchod pa'i thabs: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : dkar gtor 'dab ma bcu drug pa: gtor kyu brgyad dang sman mchod phud: byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: bsgrubs shing brten pa'i mchod rdzas rgya chen po 'di: gter srung lha btsan chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: 'gro ba'i bsod nams spel: khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang : 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog nas: lha btsan 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: hūm̐: lha btsan chen po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni: mda' dar rin chen sna tshogs dang : dar thod ru mtshon dkar dmar rgyan: bya dkar g.yag dkar lug dkar dang : phye mar ja chang dkar mngar phud: dam rdzas gser skyems dkar gtor 'bul: gsol lo mchod do phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lha yi btsan rgod mthu bo che: khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i cha byad can: sku la shel khrab si li li: shel rmog dang ru rlung ltar 'tshubs: phyag g.yas rin chen gter sgrom bsnams: g.yon pas dar mdung mkha' la phyar: sked la stag ral gzig shubs brgyan: dar dkar lhub ldan pu ru ru: zhabs la hor lham g.yu mthil gsol: rlung rta rag pa rting dkar chibs: sga srab g.yu mthur khrigs se khrig: 'khor ni rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor: klad na bya dkar kyi li li: dung khyi pho mo mdun na rgyug: yang 'khor dkar phyogs 'bum gyis bskor: gzi brjid bkrag mdangs ta la la: lha btsan 'khor dang bcas la bstod: hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: rin chen gter gyi srung ma che: gnas ni rgyang phu gangs la gnas: bzhugs gnas shel phug brag la bca': sbas gnas gnyan gyi srung ma che: rig 'dzin sgrub la bu bzhin skyongs: 'bru nor lo phyugs bcud kyi bdag: chos 'khor yul ris skyong ba'i mchog:

dgra lha chen po mi bsrun pa: mthun rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin bdag gis bos pa'i tshe: mthu rtsal stobs kyis dmag dpung bskyed: pha rol dgra bo cham la phob: sgrub la longs spyod bsod nams spel: dus drug bsrung ba'i mel tshe mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus pa: deng 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ dhe wa shu la badz+ra tri hriṃ dza sa ma ya ye swā hā: zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las gang mos bcol: rin chen gter gyi srung ma khyad par can: 'di nyid dkar phyogs dag la shin tu dga': rig 'dzin sgrub pa po la phrin las bsgrub: lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'grogs par 'gyur: gang bcol thogs med 'grub pa'i srung ma'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas phab pa'o/ rdor gling o rgyan kun bzang chos 'khor gling gi gsung rab nyams gso rgyun spel khang nas glegs bam 'di nyid 'bad pa chen po'i bzhengs pas 'dis kyang kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa rin po che dang ring lugs 'di nyid nam yang mi nub zhing phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la de 'dzin gyi skyes chen rnams sku tshe rgyal dbang gnyis pa pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: lo nad srung ba'i gdams pa nad bdag dpung 'joms lags so: thugs rje chen po 'gro ba skyob la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: lung bstan rtags dang gdams ngag zab mo bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: sa ma ya: dang po sa rtags phran bu'i rnam dbye ni: dus tshod mar 'grib snyigs ma lnga bdo la: sems can phrag dog gdug rtsub che ba yis: srid pa rlung gi 'khor lo gyen du log: char med nam mkha' me yi bskal pa 'char:

rtsi shing 'bus za smyu gu skam: ri lung med pa sad ser skya yam chags: sa bon mang btab 'bras bu shin tu dkon: grong pa phal cher chus 'khyer yul stong lus: de ni phrag dog 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can 'dod chags srid pa che ba yis: 'byung ba las kyi me dpung rab tu 'khrugs: dbyar dgun go log zla ba khod mi snyoms: dus char rlung gyur dus min dug char 'bebs: me las gyur pa'i tshad rims mgo nad dang : sha khol stag brgya kha tham steng grib dang : sa glang nag po srin glang par+pa ta: dmar bshal la sogs bdun drug nad rigs dar: me dpung 'khrugs shing lo bcud than pas bskam: ri byi dkar nag khra gsum lo la sdang : byol song yod kyang zho mar shin tu dkon: longs spyod phal cher sngar gyi ro bcud yal: lo re bzhin du mu ge'i bskal pa dar: de ni 'dod chags 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can zhe sdang drag po bskyed pa la: rak+ta srid pa'i chu klung rab tu 'khrigs: de yi rkyen gyis bdud rigs 'byung po dar: lo re bzhin du mtha' dmag dbus su bsnyeg: dbus dang mtha' gnyis go log mi min chags: phyi rgyud bdud kyi dmag dpung sprin ltar 'khrigs: bar du lha sde mi sde dgon khag 'khrug: nang du dmag mi yul gru grong mi 'khrug: phyogs kyi sprang po bya bral rnams kyang 'khrug: phyug po rnams kyi tshe srog nor gyis gcod: dmangs po rnams kyi za 'dod gnyis med phung : khyad par rgyal bsen ma mo gre bo 'khrug: rgyal 'gong 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs cho 'phrul las: ban btsun dam med mi rnams phal cher smyo: bud med snying rlung langs pas lha bab mang : rgyal po yul 'dre 'thab pa'i kha rlangs nas: khyi rnams smyo 'bog ri klung nags chu nyul: ma mo rgyal po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs las: lo thog mi skye sa yi bcud rnams sdud: zhing kha rnams kyang dbus stong mtha' ru don: rlung dmar 'tshub dang sad ser rab tu ldang :

ma mo dang ni klu bdud 'khrugs pa yi: kha rlangs dug mda' nag po zhes bya ni: sa la gnas tshe lhog yams drag po 'khrug: mi dang srog chags phal cher de yis 'chi: bar du srin bu ra tsa zhes bya ni: sngo dang nag dang khra bo dmar po 'byung : nag po byung na phyugs nad glo gor sdang : khra bo mang na lo nad mu ge 'byung : dmar po mang na dkar lo shin tu ngan: sngon po mang na dmag 'khrug lung gzing 'byung : kham pa dang ni thal mdog byung ba na: yul stong 'byung zhing sa g.yo ri rnams nyil: byi ba la yang kha dog de bzhin 'byung : srin bu de dag zhing khar 'gyu ba'i tshe: ma mo bsdongs na mtha' nas rim par za: rgyal po bsdongs na dbus nas mtha' ru 'phro: klu dang bsdongs na mtha' dbus khyab par za: yul 'dre yin na phyogs re zur re za: gre bo yin na dum bu dum bu za: lo thog steng pa za na klu yi dug: lo thog sked pa za na rgyal po'i dug: lo thog 'bras bu za na ma mo'i dug: stod smad khyab par za na yul 'dre'i dug: zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i srin bu de ltar 'byung : gnyis pa mo 'dre btsa' sad 'di yi bu yig them byang nang na gsal mchan ser ba ni: klu dang rgyal po nam mkha' 'khrugs pa la: mi rnams phal cher chang 'thung smyo zhing 'bog: de yi rkyen gyis rang mtshon rang la bsnun: 'o ma dkar yang bcud kyi mar rnams med: lo thog skye yang 'bras bu rdog po chung : mi rnams thams cad chos kyi bag chags yal: srin po mi ma yin gyi gzugs ltar 'gyur: de ni sems can zhe sdang drag po yi: las kyi 'bras bu dus 'dir smin pa ni: sems can nga rgyal gdug rtsub skyes pa yis: srid pa sa yi rlung rnams shin tu ldang : de yi rkyen gyis pho lha dgra lha 'khrug: ma rungs rten 'brel de yis sna drangs nas: pha dang bu gnyis mi 'cham rtsod cing 'khrug: pha spun chags sdang rme 'khrug nang rgyas byed:

ka cha longs spyod 'thab rtsod zas la mdzad: pho tshod mi zin rang mgo mi la 'chor: sngar gyi spyod 'gros yul shul rnams kyang stong : don med 'khon lan rang srog mi sgor skyel: mtha' ma 'di phyi gnyis med don la thug: de ni phrag dog 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can gti mug drag po 'thim pa'i tshe: ma rig srid pa'i bdud bzhi rlung rnams 'khrug: de yi rkyen gyis lus gdon gnas gdon 'khrug: zog po dge bshes ban btsun pho mo dang : 'jig rten mi nag skyes pa las ngan rigs: chos la blo log mi dge sdig la dad: mtshan ldan bla ma sha gzugs sangs rgyas la: skyon du blta zhing smad pa'i rgyal mtshan phyar: gsang sngags ma bsgoms sangs rgyas chos la 'bar: rgyu 'bras bslu med dge bcu khyad du gsod: yon tan ldan la sgro skur khrag kyang byug: 'di phyi thar pa'i 'ju thag ma lus gcod: tshe rabs gtan gyi bde 'gro dag snang yal: cung zad 'dun pa skyes kyang phyi mjug thung : sems bskyed phan sems 'dod kyang bdud dbang 'gro: drin gyis bskyangs pa'i sgo nor log par gsod: bzang po 'dod kyang ngan dbang rkyen la shor: yin pa brgya bsags ngan pa gcig gis sgrib: sdug bsngal mi 'dod bzhin du khur gyis gnon: lus la nad mang sems la zug rngu che: lus sems dga' bde nyin gcig sdod dbang med: mi lus thob kyang mi tshe sdug la zad: ci byed thams cad mi dge mtshams med las: lto med gos dbul yi dwags grong khyer 'dra: sha za khrag 'thung srog gcod srin po 'dra: dge med sdig che shan pa'i yul gling 'dra: khrims med rku rdzun ya pho'i tshong 'dus 'dra: mna' za khrel med dam sri'i 'gyu lam 'dra: rgyu gnag gnyen sdang long ba'i 'thab rtsod 'dra: kha dkar zhe gyong chu rdo dar gtum 'dra: bsam ngan ma rab 'chi kha'i longs spyod 'dra: blo rmongs byed rgyug rkang bzhi'i bsam pa 'dra: grangs mang nad ngan rgyal 'gong tshogs lam 'dra:

de ni gti mug 'bras bu smin pa yin: de rnams thams cad snyigs ma lnga brgyar 'tshogs: rang byas las kyi rnam smin 'khor ba las: yid smad lha la byas pa ci la phan: sems can las ngan dug lnga hrag pas lan: bsod nams zad bzhin chos la khyad gsod pas: rim nas rim bzhin slar yang sdug tu 'gro: dper na btsan dug bza' bzhin langs pa 'dra: ban de log lta can la sangs rgyas rdugs: dper na chu bo gyen du ldog pa 'dra: mu stegs tshig la bden pa'i chos kyang rdugs: dper na g.yang sa lam 'phrang chad dang mtshungs: 'on kyang rung sa mi lus thob pa bzhin: dge bcu kun gyi nang nas dag snang gtso: mos gus kun gyi nang nas smon lam gtso: 'brel ba kun gyi nang nas dad pa gtso: yon tan kun gyi nang nas nyams len gtso: bsgom sgrub kun gyi nang nas 'dun pa gtso: gsog 'jog kun gyi nang nas chog shes gtso: rgod pa kun gyi nang nas chos rgod gtso: mkhas pa kun gyi nang nas tshod zin gtso: kha bshad kun gyi nang nas gnad 'gag gtso: shes pa kun gyi nang nas sdod shes gtso: de dag kun gyi nang nas nyams len gtso: de ni dgos pa dus bab rnam bzhi'i chos: go shes dbang po tshang rnams dang du longs: phyi ches 'phro bzang 'dod na bag yod gyis: blun rmongs dud 'gro'i tshogs kun ma lags na: lnga brgya'i dus 'dir bla mar mos gus gtso: 'di ni spyi bshad dus rim bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: da ni lnga brgya dus rtags mar 'grib la: gu ru bdag gis 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir: nad bdag dpung 'joms sngags dang sku rim sogs: phra zhib lag len gsal bstan gdams pa bkod: dang po nad bdag spo dang mnan pa'i thabs: dug shog ngos su spyi ltar liṅga bris: sa ma ya: gnas kyi yi ge

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ snying po tri tri zhes pa mtha' ru ni: trig na thun kha na sha tri ma ru tsi tsi tsit+ta dza ya ma ru sha ya be shag a pur sarba dza dzaḥ gnod byed rgyal bsen log 'dren 'byung po klu srin ma bdud yul 'dre la sogs lha 'dre ma rungs pa'i kha rlangs ngan pa thams cad khug dza dzaḥ log 'dren btsa' sad ser ba 'bu srin srog chags ma rungs pa'i rigs thams cad tri khug dza dzaḥ nad bdag gi stobs thams cad nyams par gyur cig dza dzaḥ nan na bigh+nān kra trag nan kra thum nan rbad ri chod chod: ces pa'i sngags kyis nang nas bskor: phyi nas sngags kyi tshar gcig gis: sham bu'i logs la gnod pa'i 'bu srin de brtag pa ltar zhib tu dpyad la 'byung po gang yin 'dra ba de khug ces dang gzhan 'dod gsol gang rigs bsgyur: rang nyid gter gsar rnying gang rung gi las byang gcig gtong yi dam bskyed la: bsnyen pa stong tsho tsam du bzlas: de nas yul phyogs rang rang gi zhing kha nas sa sna chu sna lo glud mu gdong rams shing la sogs glud bsdus la: liṅga'i nang du bzhag la: lo la gnod pa'i 'bu srin de gzugs shog bu la bris te khog par yi ge 'di gzugs: za ma ya ma ya lo 'dre nad bdag dza dzaḥnan nan: zhes liṅga chaig mo de'i nang du bzhag na nad bdag lan dgu tsam zhig bkug nas liṅga zhags pa nag pos bcings ra rgya bo'i thod pa'i nang du bcug: 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya: de nas phag nag po'i mgo mjug gi pags pa cha tshang zhig gi nang du bcug: yang 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya: de nas zhags pa nag pos bcings nas mdud pa dgu brgyab: yul gyi mi pho mo thabs sdug gang rung zhig la bskyag: yul rang gi zhing kha kun nas ded pa'i tshul zhing rtse nas bzung mtha' nas ma yol gyi bar la ki sgra dang bswo sgra ma chad pas 'ded: sngags pa gang rung gsum gyis sngags 'di thun la btab ste zhing khang gtor kha nas yang drag sngags 'di ma chad par bya'o:

oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ṭa tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐ ram̐ ram̐ ha ram̐ ram̐ lo 'dre 'bu srin nad bdag chum chum zhes pas gtor cing skyes pa stag lo pa gcig gi lag tu shing la ral gri 'dom gang ba bzo la thogs te nad bdag khur ba de dang ral gri'i logs su sngags 'di bris: oṃ badz+ra bha ra kro ti ha la tsakra ya nad bdag pho mo lo nad srin bu btsa' sad ser gsum bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces bris: de nas yul gru rang rang gi zhing kha yol ba'i mtshams de yi 'og zhig tu dong brus 'gugs gzhug lan gsum byas la mnan: de yi steng du btsa' gri nag po tho zur gsum pa brtsegs: steng du shing gi ral gri re du yi ge kha phyir bstan pa btsugs: nad bdag khur mkhan de la dga' ba'i gla byin: yul lha gzhi bdag la bsang btang 'di ni lo nad mnan pa'i gdams ngag bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i tshe: bod kyi lha 'dre rnams gdug rtsub skyes te lo nad sna lnga btang ba'i tshe khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon la zhus pas gnang ba'o: sa ma ya: yul thams cad la bsang brgya btang bas shin tu phan: da ni 'bu srin sngags kyis srung ba'i gdams pa ni: gtsang chen gser ldan gyi bye ma dang rang yul gyi zhing kha'i sa lha khang grags pa can gyi bskor lam gyi sa: de gsum gla rtsi chu yi thigs pa ral gri'i sngags 'di khri gsum bzlas zhing kha ru khyab pa yang yang gtor bas 'bu srin mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro: oṃ dza ra kha thun 'bu srin kha chings lo 'dre hag thaṃ nad bdag gzer nan chum chum swā hā: zhes sngags 'di bye ma la btab ste gtor ro: rang nyid mu stegs a tsa ra nag po 'jigs pa lus ri rab tsam du gyur bar bsgom: sngags 'debs pa'i tshe bye ma de lcags bsregs kyi tshwa tshwa dmar si li li zhig tu bsgom: bye ma zhing du gtor ba'i tshe lcags sngags me thun dmar po brabs pas nad bdag gang yin de 'bu srin gyi rnam par gyur gzhob thul du bsregs te ming yang med par bsgom:

de nas bzlas pa grangs tshad bzla zhing dmigs rkang zin na the tshom med par thub nges so: sa ma ya: yang gong gi sngags de skyer pa'am seng ldeng byang bu la bris: sngags kyang khris rab gnas bgyis te zhing la 'dzugs par yang thub nges so: sngags 'di shes rab can ban btsun sngags pa mi skya pho mo gang gis kyang sngags chog khyad par dag snang 'byung ba rnams phan che: sa ma ya: lhag par dus ngan so so'i lo nad dmag 'khrug mu ge sad ser ba la sogs zhi ba'i gsol 'debs dang sngags 'di grong mi yul sde thams cad kyis tho rangs skar ma ma yal gong dang dgong mo srod mun mtshams su 'ur 'don skad chen por bgyis pas lo legs shing dmag 'khrug dang mu ge zhi bar 'gyur ro: gsol 'debs lta bur mngon par bya'o: na mo phyogs dus rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs: rab 'byams thugs kyi rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dpal: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: rtsa gsum mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: gu ru o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs: dmag 'khrug lo nyes zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: sbas yul byin chen 'bebs par mdzad du gsol: yams nad 'byung po'i kha rlangs bzlog par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ par+ṇa pad+ma sha wa rī ma hā ut+pa ya dus 'khrug lo nyes thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gsol 'debs dang sngags 'di yul gru gang du bzlas pas bkra shis par 'gyur ro: 'di kun la spel cig thon cig 'chang zhig klogs shig: ma yengs par dran par gyis shig: dar chos la bris la ri mthon po'i rtse la tshugs shig: grong dang zhing kha thams cad la tshugs shig: de yis dus 'khrug dang lo nyes thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro: lung bstan 'di yi rtags ci bzhin shar nas gsol 'debs dang sngags 'di la ma brtson na:

lo nyes rgyun du 'byung de yi mjug la dus nad tre tre ho zhes bya bas mi thog 'bud: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa'i mgo tshugs ru bzhi'i so pa mngon: khyad par sbas yul gzhi ma yin pas sa phyogs gang du bde ba'i go skabs med: dus tshod gnas skabs 'gyur ba yin: zog po khrims ral gyis lung pa 'geng : yi dam lha rnams ri rab la zhal gzigs: chos kyi ngad yal: rdo rje theg pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas btsun chas byed: de yi tshe gu ru nga yi thugs rje'i phyi thag ring : 'dul ba dge slong gis grong nag 'grim: lkog tu bud med brten: kha nas sngags chos kyi skad 'don: de yi tshe shākya thub pa'i bstan pa phyed cha yal: sngags pas yi dam mi sgrub yul lha sgrub: tshogs 'khor sa gdan du bsham: bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi dmigs pa yal: de tshe chos skyong srung ma dbyings la dgyes: ban btsun sdom pa nyams pas byi phrug klog: ngan khag skra bcad kyi bla mar brjod: 'jig rten gyi g.yog tu 'khyams: de tshe dam sri rgyal 'gong dar: shi nas dmyal bar lhung : sde dpon dang pha spun nang dme byed: yul mi khyim mtshes dang sa yul rtsod cing 'thab: gri khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil: de tshe pho lha dang yul lha mnol te dgra la phyogs: sngar la med pa'i nad rigs dar: khyad par chu chen sum cu rtsa bdun gyi 'gram du: dam sri nag po lcags sdig dbyibs can 'gyu: de la gdong thug pa'i tshe: 'go nad dang dmag 'khrug dar: de yang lo drug tu sdod: khyad par lha sa'i khrod mi lus rwa co yod pa zhig dang sder gshog yod pa zhig 'byung : de yi dus pad+ma bkod che chung gnas sgo 'byed: rgya nag yul nas don pa'i mi ber nag can de stod mnga' ris seṅge rdzong rtsar zangs kyi mkhar rtse gsum pa zhig brdung : de tsho stod zla ro kha dmar gyi yul nas byis sba mgo dkar lcags kyi mchu yod pa spun gsum:

ti se gangs kyi la sgor bsnyeg de tshe byang g.yer mo thang nas rlung dmar 'ur sgra dang ldan pa zhig gnyan rgyal thod dkar gyi mdun du 'tshogs: de tshe sbas yul bzhir sku rim la 'bung dgos: nya nag po kha spu can de sa byi lor zhes bya ba nas mo 'debs yod pa skad: thon mi saṃ bho ṭa: tho tho ri: snyan rung tsakra li: gho hir li sha: bo dhi sa twa: de drug zangs mdog dpal ri la 'gro ran pa'i dus yin pa skad: me gro klu chen po des lcags po ri la sbrul bcud gsum bsdams nas nyal yod pa skad: lho dga' ba lung gi dam can ra khra bo zhon pa de'i nam zhig bstan du dgos pa'i rwa co de dang par bu gnyis pa de: mi dmar po skra ser po bswe theb gyon pa zhig la sbyin pa skad: de yan gyi dam tshig pa de brda bkrol ba yin: 'di mtshams su dus kyi lung bstan mi dgos pa rnams la dgos pa 'brel 'dug pas bri la bde ba yin: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug gud du sbas pa las: lung bstan zab brgya bgrang ba'i brda tho 'di: dbyangs can gzungs kyis bzung bzhin sbas pa nyid: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: them rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra dus mtha'i gter ston sngags nag zhwa nag gis brgyan cing grong nag mi skye pho mo tshogs kyis bskor nas lo nag lcags mo glang gi lo ru be nags bsil grib 'thug po'i tshal brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos gdan drangs shing chu pho stag gi lo ru mi dmar po zangs kyi ral pa can yon mchod gnyis lung rigs kyi rnam bshad mi mkhas kyang bal phug tsan dan ljon pa'i nags khrod du dag par phab pas skal ldan rnams kyi nyams su longs dad pa med pa rnams ni bla ma 'dra ni rgyang ring du yod chos 'di 'brel ba thob pa rang bslu mi phung 'dra/ tshig 'di rnams ma go na nyams len med na gos kyi mgo thum gyis kha lag pas bkab nas sdod dang rang mdzes/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyin sreg ye shes rab tu 'bar ba bzhugs so: thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon gcig pu: nam mkha'i rgyal po 'khor 'das kun la khyab: gcig tu ma nges kun kyang gzigs pa'i spyan: 'khor los dbang bsgyur srid zhi'i gnyen por 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang zab brgya'i mthar thug gsang sngags man ngag gi rgyud gcig tu dril te gshin don bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs ngan song sbyong ba'i cha lag dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' rten: 'du byed sgyu lus kyi khams kun snang stong g.ya' bral du bsgyur ba'i thabs te: de yang phyi tshogs drug dkyil 'khor du bsgyur ba dang : nang rig pa dkyil 'khor du sprad pa dang : don kho na nyid bden pa de'i thog tu thag gcod pa de la yang gsum: sngon du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi gzhung bsrang : bar du ting 'dzin mnyam bzhag gi gzhi bzung : tha ma las sbyor smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya: zhes pas: rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas: rnam pa so so'i myur lam bag chags bshig byed a ti'i rgyud gzhung ltar me ye shes su sbar nas: 'od lus chos sku'i 'pho ba chen po'i lam rim pa gnyis sam gsum gyi don de las gzhol ba gdams pa gnad du bsnun par byed pa la brtsam par 'os pa'i gang zag gdeng ldan pa de yi go rim 'di ltar du 'jug: spyi don gzhung bsrang gyi khog dbub ltar du 'jug par bya'o: de yang rdzas dang mkho ba'i cha rkyen rnams bsags nas dkyil 'khor gzhung bsrang zhing 'di ltar bri: bdag bskyed cho ga sngon du song nas: mdun bskyed sreg sbyong dang sbrags par bya zhes pas: thog mar me lha'i bskyed chog mchod phreng tshar gcig grub nas: yi dam lha bskyed pa la 'jug pa ces: spyi yi lag len phung po spur khang la skyel ba sogs zhal shes dang lag len mig mthong myong bcas shin tu phra bar bya dkyil 'khor gzhung gi mchod pa tshogs drug rnam lnga:

sman rag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma: yam shing ba lu 'om bu shug pa bcas gang 'grigs: rdzas ku sha dūrba bil ba gsum: zas mchog tam bu la: gzhan yang dri bzang gi sman sna tshogs: bcud bzang gi rtsi sna tshogs: rgyan bzang gi rin po che sna tshogs: 'phel byed kyi shing 'bras dang 'bru sna tshogs: gzhan yang yar gzhi la 'os pa dang : mar gzhi la 'os pa dang : me dar rlung g.yab sogs 'don cha'i tshig dang bstun: btags grol rig pa don ldan spyi bor btags: gnas lnga ru sngags 'di shog bu la bris la sbyar: oṃshrīmūm̐lām̐badz+ralok+kishwarimahātsit+tabodhisatwahūm̐hrīḥ tshelasa'adasapa'isdigasgribabagachagasathamasacada.abaranaduḥkhabhishwadhashān+tiṃkuruyeswāhā: zhes 'phreng gcig tu bris: btags grol ma rnyed na 'di shog dril byed nas spyi bor btags: phung po drang srong tsog pu bya: kha ni shar ram shar lhor bstan: de nas mchod pa bsang sbyang ni: thabs shes snod kyi reg tsam bya: oṃ e shu ne pradz+nyā su khaṃ su rtaṃ k+ṣe swā hā: ram̐ nṛ ra k+ṣaṃ: yam̐ su dz+nyā k+ṣaṃ: kham̐ kun+ta k+ṣaṃ: oṃ a i u aṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes reg tsam bya: de nas bgegs bskrad dang rnam shes 'gugs pa dang bcas gshin don nas blangs shing phung po spyi khrus shig byas nas: thab bsang sbyang gi sngags ni: oṃ ram̐ shu pa dhaṃ swa ra ta ye haṃ li la ye swā hā: de nas me lha bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ las phyi snod rang byung gi gzhal yas khang rgya chen po rgya khyon g.yo bas btegs pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar bsnol ba'i tshad dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su ma rig bud shing sreg pa'i ye shes kyi ram̐ dmar mthing cung zad dkar ba'i 'od 'phro ba: de yongs su gyur pa las nyon mongs zhi byed kyi me lha sku mdog srog yig mdangs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa he ru pa gyad kyi dor stabs can: g.yas tsan+d+ra dang g.yon sūr+ya bsnams pa:

sku yi cha ru 'khod pa'i rgyan ye shes kyi rigs lnga phar phyin gyi rgyan drug shes brgyad kyi dur khrod chas: ye shes dpal chas bcu ldan pa: yum las kyi g.yog mo rang bzhin du 'khril zhing bskul ba ste: skye mched bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa'i 'khor tshad med bzhi yi rang me kha dog 'bar zhing mched pa ltar la tshe 'das kyi phung po dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dam tshig can du gsal ba'o: de ltar min pa'i lugs ltar 'dod na: dug lnga ye shes su bsgyur bar phung po mchod pa ru bsgyur ba'i rgyud yod kyang : gcod yul thun mong rang sar 'dod na 'di nyid thugs rje bla med lugs zhes thun mong ma yin pa bde stong zung 'jug rang 'bar phung po'i g.ya' shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyang ba dang : las sgrib sbyong ba'i smon lam kha bsgyur du mos par snang bas: de ltar go rim len par mos pas: ye shes pa spyan 'dren shing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas me sbar bar bya ba la'o: de ltar brten snang ba mi dmigs chu zla ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar baṃ: lte 'og ram̐: gsang bar yam̐: zhabs gnyis kyi mthil du ha hus mtshan pa'i 'od 'phros pas: yam̐ yam̐ phaiṃ phaiṃ heṃ heṃ he he we we ltar mched pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas: dam tshig pa dang dbyer ma mchis par gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca ku la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las nam mkha'i snying pos dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ ga ga e a badz+ra a haṃ ti sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

zhes spur khang la khrus bstsal te: oṃ: gzugs rnams snang stong sku yi lha khrus gsol: āḥ sgra rnams grags stong gsung gi sngags khrus gsol: hūm̐: yid rnams gsal stong thugs kyi don khrus gsol: hrīḥ rgyal ba de bzhin ye shes khrus gsol nas: tshe 'das rnam shes phung khams skye mched rnams: ka dag bde chen 'od skur grol bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra he ru ka dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dbang rtags kyi ku sha bum pa'i kha nas blangs shing spur khang gi phyogs bzhir dbus lngar 'dzugs: hūm̐: sgyu lus mi dmigs snang stong bum pa'i dbyings: dug lnga gnas grol ye shes ston pa'i phyir: rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ku sha a wa rtswa: dbang rtags 'di phul ye sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ dz+nyā na mu ku ṭa bi shwa sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas spyan 'dren gyi thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: zhe sdang sreg byed rdo rje rigs kyi me: nga rgyal sreg byed rin chen rigs kyi me: 'dod chags sreg byed pad+ma rigs kyi me: phrag dog sreg byed karma rigs kyi me: gti mug sreg byed bud+dha rigs kyi me: rang byung ye shes me yi lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dam tshig dbyer med phyir: 'bar ba'i shugs 'chang ston phyir ram̐ gyi dal: nyon mongs bud shing bsreg phyir bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku tsam du phyag 'tshal nas: longs sku'i thugs dam sgyu mar bskul ba'i phyir: rang bzhin chos sku'i me dpung bskyed du gsol: oṃ ram̐ dz+nyā na pañca badz+ra sa ma ya dz+wa la de wa pradz+nyā ye badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: a ti pu hoḥ de nas me sbar ba ni: dpal 'bar dang rlung g.yab thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing gyen rgyu'i rlung g.yabs te: shar dkar zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer dkar po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ si ta ka swā hā:

rlung g.yab dang mda' dar dkar pos shar gyi phrin las bya: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing me nyams rlung g.yabs te: lho yi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer ser po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ rat+na dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ so na ka swā hā: rlung g.yab dang mda' dar ser pos lho yi phrin las bya: hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes ngang gi lha: sbar zhing thul ser rlung g.yabs te: nub kyi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer dmar po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ pad+ma dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ rā ga ti ka swā hā: rlung g.yab dang mda' dar dmar pos nub kyi phrin las bya: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing khyab byed rlung g.yabs te: byang gi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer ljang gu'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ karma dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ marga ti ka swā hā: rlung g.yab dang mda' dar ljang gus byang gi phrin las bya: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing srog 'dzin rlung g.yabs te: dbus kyi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer mthing kha'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ bud+dha dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ ni lam̐ ti ka swā hā: rlung g.yab dang mda' dar mthing khas dbus kyi phrin las bya: de bzhin phyogs su mda' dar btsugs: dbang rtags lha dang dkyil 'khor gzhung ltar gsal gdab: de nas tshogs drug gi zhan pa bshig pa'am: rgyu dngos bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs dag pa'i zhing du sbyar ram: gzugs kyi sku longs spyod rdzogs par bsdu zhing sbyang thabs kyi rdzas sam: longs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba la rdzas la bshad rung : thabs shes mtshon tsam rten 'brel gzhan gyi rgyud dang mi 'gal ba phyir chos snang tshul tsam mchod pa dang rdzas 'bul bar bya: rang gzhung bla med kho na klong du 'gyur ba'i rgyud gzu bor bzhag la: mtshan bcas spros pa'i dngos po bkram pa lag len phal cher gyi don go ba yin: mkhan po gang zhig gi nam mkha'i tshad du reg pa'i chos ltar snang :

snang ba'i go ba lcags su bcug pa'i gnad dang mi 'gal lo: de nas rang byung la rang grol gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: tshe 'das tshogs drug rnam shes mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: sham bu ka 'di kun la sbyar shes par bya: bcom ldan 'das rang byung ye shes lnga yi me lha'i dkyil 'khor la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas: gshin po tshe las 'das pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa: nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa: las kyi sgrib pa: bag chags kyi sgrib pa: kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa bcas dug lnga dug gsum du gyur pa'i las thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya gar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes ngan song sbyong ba'i gzungs dang bla med snying po zung 'jug 'di bzlas pa skabs dang bstun nas: rnal 'byor pa'i spangs rtogs la rag las: dbang po lnga la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das dug lnga rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she swā hā: rnam bzhi la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha:
