tshe 'das sgo bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta au ṇa rak+ta bha ling+ta ye swā hā: yam shing la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das tsaṇ+ḍa rang byung bud shing 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ mu la de wa mu la wa ra mu la shrī yaṃ ye swā hā: rdzas gsum 'bul la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das sgo gsum rang grol mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ su ram̐ ke ta pu le ha yan bhi wa shu ye swā hā: zas mchog la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das ro gcig lta ba'i zas mchog 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba puṇ+yai pur+ṇa gha na ma ye swā hā: sman la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das nyon mongs rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra au ṇa bhai ṣañja bi shwa dha swā hā: rtsi mchog la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das bde stong rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ a mṛ ta sarba me gha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: rin chen sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha:

tshe 'das sku bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sarba sid+dhi pū dza ye swā hā: dar zab la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das 'gag med shar grol mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ pañca li ka shrī rā sa spar+she ye swā hā: 'bru sna la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das zhen pa rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ge pa ra ti la tha su k+ṣa ye swā hā: shing 'bras la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das snang srid rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ bi ra dze bī wa dze bhi mu la ye swā hā: ming nas ma smos pa'i zas kun la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das snod bcud rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba bi pu ra pu ra a brta ya ho pū dza ye swā hā: mar khu la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das dga' bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ su khaṃ pra mo ti pa ra mi ta ye swā hā: de nas phrin las bcol ba gong bzhin kun la 'gres: de nas me lha'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan ye shes rab 'bar rol pa'i sku:

dug lnga sreg mdzad mdangs lnga lhun gyis grub: rnam dag pho nya rlung gi rab g.yo ba: 'bar zhing mched pa tsaṇ+ḍa'i gzi 'od kyis: nyon mongs rtsa mdud rgya yi 'tshang grol nas: a haṃ bskul ldan dngul chu 'dzags pa yis: mched cing 'bar ba'i 'od ldan 'khrugs 'khyil ba'i: bsdus bya snyigs lam sdong po'i 'khril gzhom ste: kun byed dbu ma'i zom du rab btegs pa'i: nus pas mkha' lding g.yo ba nyid la bstod: bskul bas 'pho ba chen po'i gsang lam du: ldog med ye shes 'phrul gyis rab 'degs nas: gdod ma'i dbang phyug go 'phang rtsal mngon shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra hṛ da ya sarba gar+bha hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dkyil 'khor gzhung bsrang bar bya ba ni: oṃ swa bhā sogs? stong pa'i ngang las ye shes ram̐ lnga rang bzhin du mched pa 'byung 'jug tu mched pa rdo rje'i rang sgra chen po kun nas kun tu g.yo ba'i dbus su gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gdan pad+ma nyi zla gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba'i lte bar hrī yig mdangs ldan nyi ma 'bum 'khyil ba'i zer ltar blta bas mi bzod pa de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu gzhal du med pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i 'khor lo rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i byin rlabs thugs rjes 'ub kyis 'dus srid pa de srid kyi sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs: ting nge 'dzin gyi go 'phang la bkod: slar yang tshur 'dus hrī yig mi 'gyur ba'i byad kyi gnas 'gyur de yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs mnyam bzhag gdod ma'i klong du ma 'dres so sor gsal zhing snang la rang bzhin bral ba 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o: de nas las byang lha bskyed ni: hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang : sogs nas phyi mchod du bskyal: de nas mar khu 'bul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba ni:

hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin pa: 'jig rten mgon gyur 'gro la spyan ras gzigs: thabs mkhas chen po 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bla med mngon sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: sngags 'di las byang gi mchod pa rnams thams cad mar khu dang sbyar nas 'bul: gtor ma'i mchod pa yar rtags thams cad tshogs kyang gzhung bzhin zur du bya: yam shing mar rtags thams cad sngags gong bzhin bya gzhung tshig 'di 'gres bshang bar bya: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: nyon mongs sreg mdzad yam shing phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ mu la dhe wa mu la wa ra mu la shrī yaṃ ye swā hā: rtsa sngags dang las sngags mthar: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ya ag+na ya swā hā: bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas: gshin po tshe las 'das pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las kyi sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa bcas dug lnga dug gsum du gyur pa'i las thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā:

zhes 'gres shes par bya: rdzas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rten 'brel rdzas mchog rnam gsum phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags oṃ su ram̐ ke ta pu le ha yan bhi wa shu ye swā hā: ??? tam bu la 'bul: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ro brgya'i bcud ldan zas mchog sna tshogs 'bul: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ sarba puṇ+yai pur+ṇa gha na ma ye swā hā: ??? sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug lnga'i nad sel sman mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ badz+ra au ṇa bhai ṣañje bi shwa dha swā hā: ??? rtsi mchog la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bcud bzang ngad ldan rtsi mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig:

rtsa sngags/ oṃ a mṛ ta sarba me gha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: ??? rin chen la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dgos 'dod yid bzhin rin chen 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sarba sid+dhi pū dza ye swā hā: ??? reg bya la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: lha reg mdzes ldan sna tshogs 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags: oṃ pañca li ka shrī rā sa spar+she ye swā hā: ??? 'bru 'bul ba na: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'phel byed 'bru mchog sna tshogs 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags: oṃ ge pa ra ti la tha su k+ṣa ye swā hā: ??? shing 'bras 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: shing 'bras dkar mngar skyur sogs phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ bi ra dze bī wa dze bhi mu la ye swā hā: ??? zas sna 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: longs spyod 'dzad med zas mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags: oṃ sarba bi pu ra pu ra a brta ya ho pū dza ye swā hā: rtsa sngags: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi? sogs oṃ a mi dhe wa lo ki? sogs las sngags sarba pū dza ram̐? sogs bcom ldan thugs rje chen po? sogs nas byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba durga te? sogs swā hā: phrin las bcol ba'i tshig lhug rnams gong nas blang :

bstod pa bya ba'i las sngags tshar gcig gam bdun brjod: zhi ba'i phrin las bcol: de nas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas rnam shes rgyal ba'i thugs su bsres pa mchod bstod bya na gshin don nas blang : ma byas kyang me ye shes lnga ldan chos skus bstod nas smon lam nas ye shes chen po'i 'pho ba 'grub pa yin: de la tha mal gyi shes pa gnas 'gyur nas dag pa lha sku'i stong ra bsre ba rnam gsum gyis 'pho ba rdo rje 'chang kha sbyor ram gzhon nu bum sku'i tshul gyi sangs rgyas kyang zer: de dag snang ba zhig pa'i bum pa'am 'chag pa'i nam mkha' lta bur bdag mdun las gsum gcig tu 'dres pa la zer bar snang snyam: spyir me lha'i dngos po ye shes rang 'od kyi ngo bo yin pa las: de kha dog rdzogs nas bskyed rim phyi yi dkyil 'khor la phyi mchod la dngos po 'bul ba ni: 'dod khams kyi lha gnyid log pa ltar snang rung : 'on kyang gang zag tha mal ba'i rtog pa bkag pa'i cha rkyen tsam las: gnyid log pa sad nas slar rmi lam sad pa'i 'phro dad pa gtad so ci la mchis: skyes bu med pa'i sku mkhar me chu gang gis zhig kyang bzang ngan gyi 'brel thag ci yod: de bzhin du rnam shes skye ba phyi ma'i lus ma rnyed skabs su bsreg sbyang bya nas rung 'dra zhing : lus rnyed nas bsreg sbyang ci byas rung gong gi dpe don ltar ro: de nas las byang gi bskul dang chad brtan kun rdzogs nas me lha'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag bde chen dbyings rig dkyil 'khor nas: ma 'gags longs sku rgyal ba he ru kaḥ sna tshogs sprul pa'i rtsal las shugs phyin pa: rang byung ye shes ngang nas sbar ba'i lha: nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms mdzad dkyil 'khor la: bsreg rdzas ba ling+ta yi gtor ma 'bul: dge 'dis tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs smin zhing : slar yang nga bdag phung po rab gshags nas: kun bzang ye grol snying po'i don rtogs stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na shrī la ye ghar+bha ram̐ dz+wa la sarba pū dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: mda' dar rnams blangs shing : hoḥ rang byung ye shes 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la: zhi ba me long rdo rje dbyings su bsdu: rgyas pa mnyam nyid rin chen dbyings su bsdu: dbang rnams sor rtog pad+ma'-i dbyings su bsdu: drag po bya grub las rab dbyings su bsdu: chos dbyings lhun grub skye med mkha' ru bsdu: phyi nang dkyil 'khor bdag med dbyings su bsdu: rmi lam 'ja' tshon chu zla ci bzhin du: zang thal ngo bo gnas lugs ā ru ldang : a a āḥ zhes dkyil 'khor rnams bsdu zhing bsngo smon bkra shis las byang nas bsdu: thal sol rnams ni sa mig bzang bar sba: rjes shes skye med ka dag ngang du bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bla med snying po a ti rang byung gyi: klong las rab bskrun nam mkha'i gos can gyi: dper brda rtsal gsum rdo rje lus kyi cha: 'bebs ldog go rim ye shes chen por mos: ma rig bud shing sreg pa'i cha lag bzhag: las 'phro shes rab can dang 'phrad par shog: gza' dang lha klus rgya 'di legs par srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor gdan drangs shing me lug lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // thog mar mchod rdzas thams cad kyi 'bag bsangs nas bgegs bskrad de dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ zhes pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod rin po che las grub pa so so'i nang du mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bcud phun sum tshogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin las byung ba zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur:

oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: gis byin brlabs: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la: oṃ swā hā: rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ āḥswā hā: zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī ri swā hā: 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dz+wa ri swā hā: rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā: thabs shes snod kyis reg tsam bya/ oṃ e shu ne pra dz+nyā su khaṃ sogs? oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes reg tsam bya'o/ tshe 'das kyi phung po sha khrag rus gsum dang dbyer med pa'i zhi ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams mang zhing rgya che ba'i bdud rtsi rang bzhin can du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab bo/ rtsa sngags las sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ri ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ sbyar shes par bya/ sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas: gshin po tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las kyi sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa kun las bslang ba'i sgrib pa bcas dug lnga dug gsum du gyur pa'i las thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: kun la sbyar dgos pa'i 'gres byang ngo*//

//dang po me lha'i byon skyems mar khu 'bul ba ni/ de nas/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur: bar bsams la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung dpal chen he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu can: ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: mar khu blugs gzar lan bdun gyis 'bul nas phrin bcol gsungs nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bcom ldan rang byung ye shes sogs?kha lag bkru de nas yungs dkar thab la gtor nas/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med? sogs gzhung ltar 'bul nas/ sarba gar+bha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bar yug 'don bya: de nas yungs dkar thab la gtor te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du stob dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol la ro sreg 'di ye shes me lha gshegs par gsungs pas: oṃ ag+ne ye gats+tsha: zhes dbyug gu'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la me lha ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bar gyur zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par phyag tshang mdzad nas dbul bar gyur: par bsam mo/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni: snga ma bzhin du me bsang ste/ oṃ swa bhā w sogs nas bya'o/ zhes lha bskyed la 'jug hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur? sogs nas pū ru sha ya hoḥ nas byon skyems mar khu 'bul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur:

par bsams la: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin pa: 'jig rten mgon gyur 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: thabs mkhas chen po 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i sreg rdzas 'bul: tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bla med mngon sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ sarba pū dza raṃ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bh+ya a dhi bh+ya ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: rtsa sngags mar khu'i sngags bcas lan bdun re 'bul lo: bcom ldan thugs rje chen po? sogs nas ag+na ye swā hā: bar 'don phyi mchod 'bul ba la/ hūm̐: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul yid 'phrog? sogs nas mchod sngags so so'i mgor rtsa sngags kyis mnan te rim bzhin re re la grangs bcu gsum re bsags/ so so'i mthar mar khu'i sngags phrin bcol bcas te kun la rigs 'gres so/ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bar yug 'don bya: mchod rdzas yam shing ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: nas gzhung tshig gis mgo 'dren te/ mchod sngags so so'i mgor rtsa sngags kyis mnan te yam shing nas zas sna 'bul ba yan re re la grangs nyung mtha' yang brgya rtsa brgyad re bsags nas mthar mar khu'i sngags phrin bcol bcas thams cad la rigs 'gres nas gzhung ltar 'don: dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad rnams kyi zhal du sreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba dang tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: yungs dkar thab tu gtor: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can: mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong zla ba'i sku: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod: ces gsol ba gdab pas bzod gsol ni: dgang blugs 'bul zhing : hūm̐: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du:

sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ yig brgya bzlas/ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad: bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: ci bder bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badz+ra muḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i skabs dkyil 'khor bdag dang tshe 'das rnam shes bcas dkyil 'khor gtso bo la bsdu gtso bo hūm̐ hūm̐ skar mda' 'phang ba ltar: bde ba can gyi zhing 'od dpag med la thim par dmigs: de rjes dmigs med du bzhag/ // rjes kyi las rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lhar gtang rag 'bul zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bsang sbyang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ lan bdun 'bul zhing me lha gsal gdab/ hūm̐: gzi brjid chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub cing : thugs rjes sems can don byed pa: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne ye sarba pū dza ram̐ sogs/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung sogs nas gzhung ltar me lha byon zin nas mar khu bar bdun re 'bul/ phrin bcol spyi ltar bya nas/ gong ltar mchan/ oṃ badz+ra tam bu la ye swā hā: zhes so rtsi 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā: zhes gos zung 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan ye shes rab 'bar? bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma dgang blugs khar bzhag la: hūm̐: ka dag bde chen dbyings rig? sogs khā hi: me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha: drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag: shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang :

dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang : longs spyod rgya chen kun thob nas: zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis: las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol: dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs: dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod: dus min 'chi ba'i nad rnams dang : gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod: rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan: bya byed ngan pa med par yi: 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs shing : 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba: bde legs phun gsum tshogs pa yi: yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod: ces gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs?yig brgya bzlas/ bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyod kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa pa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: me dar blang ba ni/ hoḥ rang byung ye shes 'bar ba'i sogs? a āḥ gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: drang srong chen po me yi lha: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badz+ra muḥ

ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ gnyis pa las gzhung tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐: tshe yi bdag po 'chi med? sogs pha la hūm̐: tshe rdzas rol mchod bstod bzod gsol yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya nas/ bkra shis bsdu chog bsngo smon bcas gzhung ltar bya'o// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar phyag len mchod g.yog pas chas dang yo byad bsags dgos rigs la/ thog mar dngos gzhi sbyor ba gong ltar la/ dang po sa thig chog skabs/ thub sku na bza' can/ sa lha'i gtor ma/ sa rin dkar gtor sa glud cha gsum gtor ma mchod pa sna bdun bskor bsham bya/ dung zhal nang dri bzang gi chu/ thig skud tshon sna lnga dkyil 'khor zhal kheb bcas me dkyil phur gdan/ las bum 'thor nas rdor dril/ bzhugs gdan bcas cha tshang bsnams dgos/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs skabs bsang chus bran/ dgang gzar rdzas rnams la reg tsam bya/ las bum 'thor nas yungs dkar me steng sdong bu lnga ldan dpal 'bar/ me dar rlung g.yab sna lnga ku sha rgya gram bcings pa lnga dgos/ ku sha me mgo gnon rdzas phon chung ba/ dri bzang gi chu mang ba/ rigs lnga'i me zhu/ gnas yig lus yig btags grol spur kheb mar khu bcas tshang dgos/ khrus chog la bgegs gtor mar me can mchod lnga me long thub sku khrus dar dug phyung til nag me kong gru gsum/ gsur rdzas sa chu glang ma rlung g.yab bcas so/ thab bsang sbyang skabs las bum chus bran/ khrus gsol me long nas thab khrus gsol/ gdan 'bul ku sha rgya gram dbus dang phyogs bzhir bzhag /mtha' nas ku sha ba glang mjug ma ltar mnan te dpal 'bar sbar/ me dar 'dzugs rlung g.yab bya/ tshur 'byon chas bya nas kha lag bkru/ mchod rdzas me lha'i byon skyems skabs/

dang po mar khu sna bdun/ phrin bcol skabs mar khu cung tsam mchod/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya spar btab pa'am bcas pa gang rigs/ bdud rtsi rak+ta gtor ma zur gsum pa rmad byung spar btab pa'am gang rigs sman mchod bhan+dha so so nas bran thur gyis bzed nas 'bul dgos/ yam shing bris ma dang sur dkar 'om bu'i yam shing*/ rdzas gsum la/ ku sha dūrba bil ba gsum/ zas mchog khrum go yus sbrus pa/ sman sna tshogs mngar gsum ka ra bu ram sbrang mar khu rin chen phye mo/ dar zab sna lnga 'bru sna 'bras/ gro swa ba sran ma'o/ shing 'bras la/ shug thog rgun 'brum se 'bru'o/ ming ma smos pa'i zas kun dkar gsum mngar gsum zhun sna tshogs pa'o/ mar khu 'bul ba lan grangs lnga bcu re 'bul dgos/ lha gzhung gong bsang chus bran/ mchod pa'i gong mar khu mchod/ phrin bcol la mar khu cung tsam re mchod rim bzhin 'gres so/ phyi mchod sna lnga gtsos sna bdun spar btab pa grangs bcu gsum re mchod/ dbang po rnam lnga'i gtsos/ gzugs sgra dri ro bcas pa'i spar btab pa bcu gsum re mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun bris 'bur spar btab pa bcu gsum re 'bul/ bkra shis rtags brgyad de 'dra bcu gsum re 'bul/ gar gyi lha mo bzhi bris 'bur gang red bcu gsum re 'bul/ sman mchod bcu gsum re 'bul/ rak+ta bcu gsum re 'bul/ gtor ma zhal zas sam tshogs gang red bcu gsum re 'bul/ rdzas la yam shing bris ma dang sur dkar a ru yam shing grangs brgya rtsa re 'bul/ rdzas ku sha'i gral zas zho zan khrum sman sna rigs mngar gsum rigs rin chen phye ma dar zab sna tshogs 'bru sna thams cad shing 'bras sna tshogs zhun sna tshogs mar khu'o/ de rnams grangs brgya re 'bul dgos so chad lhag med pa zhig dgos/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bye ma la zhal phu zhu/ thun gtor thab khung du 'bul/ rus chog bya rus pa chung ngu zhig mdun der bzhag byang chas gong ltar bsham/

zas gtad rgyas pa bya dgos/ lam bstan bsngo smon mtshams tshogs 'dren/ yang na bde chen zhing sgrub byang chog gi rus chog byas na/ byang chas la bgegs gtor/ changs bu mar me lnga blugs pa zhig dgos/ mchod lnga khrus bum me long dar gtso bum bcas bsham dgos/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rigs drug sa bon bcas 'du bya/ lhag ma gtsang lhag zhig thab tu phul/ de min gzhung ltar bskul gtor thab tu phul/ gter srung gtor ma dang gsol kha'i gtor ma bcas gtsang sar 'bul/ chad brtan gnyis thab tu phul/ rta bro spyi ltar dngos grub rdzas la rol/ lha gzhung gshegs skyems gong ltar mchod lnga dang rdzas snga ma rdzas lhag rim par 'bul lan gsum re bya/ me lha'i gshegs skyems mchod rdzas lhag ma sngar bzhin ma nor bar 'bul nas me dar rlung g.yab bsdu thab gshegs/ lha gzhung gi mchod kha gso nas spyi ltar byed/ mchod cha la phyi brdar byed nas ca ga byed zhu zhu/ na mo lo ki shwa ra ye/ thugs rje chen po'i las tshogs las/ /chos longs sprul gsum sgrub thabs ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las khol phyung ba/ /'dir 'bri bka' yis gnang ba stsol/ zhes spros med rgyun khyer ram spros bcas byas na sbyor ba'i chas yo byad dang maṇ+ḍal 'bru tshom bum pa nyer spyod sman gtor bcas 'du byas la brgyud 'debs dang sngon dngos rjes kyi las rim la 'jug pa ni/ e ma hoḥ gdod nas rang byung snang srid lha: ma bcos chos dbyings de bzhin skyong : rang gsal yan lag bdun pa 'bul: bdag 'dzin 'gong po dbyings su dengs: phra rags rtog pa mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ hoḥ rang byung mchod pa bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: hoḥ rnam dag bum rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ ga lak+ṣa a mṛ ta hūm̐: hoḥ dbyings nas ye shes byin phob cig: phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

hoḥ ma rig sgo bcad zang thal phyes: badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ stong nyid ting 'dzin mi gtong bzung : oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: sngon 'gro'i las rim pa'o: dngos bzhi longs sku'i bskyed rim lha'i dkyil 'khor ni: e hoḥ ye nas ka dag mtha' dbus bral: zang thal dmigs med rgya yan pa: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gnas: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na saṃ bha trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ hoḥ rang byung rol rtsal sna tshogs shar: kun tu rtog bcas rtog med kyi: dran rig stong gsal 'gag med 'phro: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma: hoḥ rang bzhin lhun grub ngang nyid las: ma bcos spros bral rgyu yi hūm̐: kun gzhi khyab brdal dbyings la shar: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ti baṃ dharma hrīḥ.āḥ e sa ra ṇa: yam̐ ha ra ṇa: ram̐ tsakra ṇa: kham̐ ha ra ṇa: sum̐ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa: keṃ swa bhā ṇa: bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa: ma sūr+ya ṇa: a tsan+d+ra ṇa: pam̐ pad+ma ṇa: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: oṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hoḥ sna tshogs lnga ldan khri 'phang steng : ma bcos longs sku thabs kyi mdog: mnyam bzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: shes rab rdo rje pad+ma 'khyud: zung 'jug ngang la phyed skyil gsal: cod pan dmar ser mnyam bzhag can: hoḥ tshogs brgyad rnam shes gnas dag pas: mthing ser dmar ljang tshad med bzhi: longs sku gar stabs rgyan ldan mdzes: shel phreng pad dkar phyag rgya bzhi: 'byung bzhi rdo rje dung dmar 'khyud: rigs bzhi tshad med sgo skyong ma: ma bcos gdod nas de ltar gsal: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ longs sku rtsa ba'i bskyed rim bstan pa'o/ las rim sku gsum sgrub bskor ni/ hoḥ stong zhing bdag med ye nas stong : gsal zhing dran rig zang thal sku: chos kun sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul las: bdag med nga zhes rig pa'i rgyal: thog ma'i sku te sku yi mchog: chags mdangs chags med ngo bo nyid: bde stong rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs:

thabs shes mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can: stong pa'i rang mdangs de ltar shar: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ chos sku ltar sgrub pa'o/ longs sku kun 'dus ltar bsgrub pa ni: hoḥ ma bcos klong las rtsal chen spros: sna tshogs skye 'gag bral ba la: bde chen dpa' bo dkar bzhad 'dzum: longs spyod rdzogs sku phyag bzhi pa: shel phreng pad dkar thal mo can: mngon rdzogs rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: hoḥ rigs bzhi longs spyod rab rdzogs pa: mthing ka mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin can: lhun grub brkyang bskum phyed skyil mdzes: sa snying chos 'chad mnyam par bzhag: sgeg bzhad phyed skyil rol pa'i stabs: dmar ser phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol: rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: sngo ljang mchog sbyin zil gnon rtsal: 'gying bzhengs dor stabs sa gsum gnon: hoḥ rigs bzhi 'jigs pa sgrol mdzad ma: kha dog bzhi ldan gnas lnga rgyas: mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin phyag rgya 'chang : mnyen lcug dgyes pa'i gar mdzad ma: ma 'dres gsal snang lam mer shar: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya tā re tut+tā re swā hā: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re swā hā: sna tshogs longs sku sgrub pa'o: sprul sku ltar bsgrub pa ngo sprod ni: hoḥ ma skyes rtsal chen lhun grub che: rol pa'i cho 'phrul he ru kaḥ khros pa'i bzhin mdangs sa bcu sngangs: shes rab ral gris bdud bcom pa: thugs rje lcags kyu bla na med: gar dgu'i chas dang ber chen mdzes: rigs lnga gyad kyi dor stabs can: sna tshogs dpa' ba'i shugs 'chang rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ he ru ka ngos sprad pa'o: de nas spro bsdu rnam bzhi yi: de ltar du gsal ba'i bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rang rang zhing nas spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs: hoḥ ka dag rtsal gyi klong nas gshegs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

rnam dag mkha' dbyings dbus su bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rtog med de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ rang byung ye shes rdzas kyi mchod: oṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hoḥ skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can: mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong zla ba'i sku: mi dmigs blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod: 'byung 'jug tshangs dbyangs drug cu stong pa'i sgra: du mar ma grub lhan skyes gnyug ma'i gshis: 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus zang thal 'od skur ldang : oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ gdams pa bzhi yi le'u'o: de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni: hoḥ ye nas byin rlabs tshogs chen rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sbyor sgrol mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: 'khrul 'dzin bshags shing dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: a la la hoḥ hoḥ las grub rnams kyis lhag ma bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi: rtsal snang yi dam dbyings nas bzhengs: oṃ kro ta ya ti ya khā hi: chad mdo srung ma dam ma g.yel: oṃ bhak+ṣa si khā hi: brtan skyong phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting khā hi: dug lnga phra rags dbyings su mnan: oṃ dam sri ya ma nan: yang dag ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba sid+dhi dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mchod bstod nongs bshags bya: hoḥ stong pa'i rang rtsal dbyings la yal: smra med brjod bral shes pa'i tshogs: bsngo yul gshis lugs gdod nas dag: mtshams sbyar ma bcos so mar rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgyud lung sgrub pa'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u 'o/ ྀatsha bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las: zhun mar smon lam bzhugs so// // gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dkyil 'khor bya ba rdzogs nas ni:

smon lam dga' ston rim pa bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar phyin nas: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : dkyil 'khor mdun du mar me brgya: gtams shing mched lcam 'dus byas te: rdo rje slob dpon gzungs ma dang : dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi dam tshig nyams: phyi nang sgrib dang bshags pa dang : nam yang gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i phyir: bshags pa smon lam 'di ltar brjod: thams cad pus btsugs thal mo sbyar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ las kong bu rin po che chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gyur cig: āḥlas mar khu 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin rgya mtsho'i klong dang mnyam par gyur cig: hūm̐ las sdong bu ye shes lnga yi me nyi zla chos kyi rang bzhin ltar gsal bar gyur: hrīḥde las mchod pa'i lha tshogs ā lo ke dpag tu med pa spros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'bul bar gyur: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: de nas mgrin gcig la 'di skad do: e ma hoḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye med rnam dag kyang : ma rig dbang gis bdag 'dzin so sor phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: thugs dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: longs sku ye shes ma 'gags 'char ba la: ngar 'dzin dbang gis sna tshogs rtag chad 'dzin: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: gsung dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku rang byung rtsol bral ba: yid dpyod blo yis 'khor 'das ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: sku dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: dkyil 'khor gcig tu dam tshig bka' mnos pas: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral grogs rnams la: log lta skyon gyur ma dag ci mchis pa: deng nas bzung ste mthol bshags bzod par gsol: phyi nang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang :

sdom pa nyams dang 'gal bar gyur pa dang : mchod rdzas ma tshang 'byor rdzas chung ba sogs: bag med ci mchis mthol bshags bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: e ma hoḥ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa phyi nang bcu: rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me sbar te 'bul: kun gzhi rnam dag skye med kong bu ru: ka dag khregs chod gshis kyi mar khus bkang : lta ba zang thal 'od gsal sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: sna tshogs rang shar ma 'gags kong bu ru: ye shes lnga ldan dran rig mar khus bkang : sna tshogs 'dzin med rang byung sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: rtsa khams rnam dag 'khor lo'i kong bu ru: byang sems bde chen dgyes pa'i mar khus bkang : rlung sems tsit+ta gsal ba'i sgron me sbar: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: rang byung ye shes sgron me sbar ba'i tshe: ma rig mun pa'i stong khams gsal ba dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar nang du mi ltung zhing : nyon mongs las kyi dbang du mi gtong shog: smon lam rten 'brel zhun mar 'di sbar bas: bdag 'dzin gcong rong zab mor mi ltung zhing : rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong shog: bsod nams tshogs chen zhun mar 'di sbar bas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi mchod pa mi nyams shing : zag med nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par shog: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag: shes rab gnyan gyi 'brel ba'i gzungs ma rnams: tshe rabs mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa gsum dkyil 'khor rten la 'tshogs par shog: rdo rje mched lcam 'brel ba'i dam tshig can: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog:

'da' ka rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po yi: rgyud dang lung gi 'brel ba'i skal ldan rnams: sa bcu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe rabs rtag tu bdag gi yi dam lha: 'dzin cing chos kyi sgra chen sgrog par shog: smon lam bzang po rten 'brel bslu med kyi: bden tshig skad cig dus 'dir 'grub par shog:

bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing slob dpon la phyag dang bskor ba bya: dga' ston gyi rten 'brel bzang po bsgrig: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: rdzas kyi rten 'brel bya ba gces: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kha thaṃ rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing pad+ma chos gling du zhal bsgyur ro: sarba bha wan+tu// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub bde chen gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'od mtha' yas/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /sna tshogs 'gro 'dul sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /dbyer med rig 'dzin bla mas shis pa stsol/ de'ang gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams su che thang du bsngags shing dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu 'grub par byed pa'i thabs zab rmad du byung ba tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i lag len spra khrid gzhung so so las mang du 'byung ba ltar/ rang lugs rtsa gsum zhi khro spyi dang*/ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi sogs sgrub khog spyir 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes 'khyer bde don gsal du bzhugs kyang rang 'dra'i blo rmongs rnams kyis gzhung so so dang zhi drag sogs kha bsgyur tshul bzhin mi shes pa dang nor 'khrul 'byung bar dogs te 'dir 'khor 'das zil gnon kho na'i dbang du byas te nar 'gros su bkod pa la gsum/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba/ rjes las kyi rim pa mtha' rgyas su bya ba'o/ dang po ni gter kha phal mo cher/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor dang dus/ /yo byad la sogs bzhir ldan pa/

/zhes 'chad pa mang yang*/ 'dir gsang sngags lam rim ltar na/ dang po sgrub pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gu ru rin po che dang grub thob du mas byin gyis brlabs la/ dben pa nyams dga' zhing dam nyams sde 'khrug sogs kyi grib kyis ma gos pa'o/ rang gter las/ dwangs shing snang ba dben pa'i gnas: phun tshogs zla gam dbang phug tu: dmar zhing dwangs pa'i sa gzhi la: dal bcag thig gdab dkyil 'khor bri: zhes dang gnyis pa dus ni/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi/ ra ba bzhi'i yar ngo*/ yar mar tshes bcu rnams dang ma 'dzoms na gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba la'o/ gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thebs gzungs mas gtso bor gyur pa'i ston 'khor thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid gzhung mthun dgos par gsungs kyang*/ spyi tsam du thugs rje chen po'i dbang lung rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa las rung du byas pas bsgrub bya la the tshom med cing dad pa rtse gcig dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa po nang phan tshun dam sel gtan nas med pa zhig gal che'o/ bzhi pa yo byad ni/ rab dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang*/ 'bring ras bris tshad ldan med thabs med cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ rgyan rdzas la sogs pa dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad tshags su tshud par bya'o/ lnga pa sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ yid ches rtsod bral gyi bka' ma dang gter ma las byon cing dam sel gyis brgyud pa ma bslad par rgyud lung man ngag khungs btsun gyi dgongs pa dang mthun zhing 'khrul pa med pa/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i las rim mo/ dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams gyi dpung bskyed pa/ sa yi cho ga bya ba'o/ dang po la bla ma dgongs 'dus las rim pa bcur bshad pa sogs dang*/ bder 'dus bsnyen sgrub chen mo'i pra khrid ltar na bzhi/

rang rgyud sbyong ba/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ gtor ma gtong ba/ sbyin gtong bya ba gsum/ de re re la bzhi bzhir 'byung ste/ dang po ni lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sāts+tsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya ba/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na rag dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzlas pa/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang ba dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ gzhan yang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i phyir du phyag bskor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs phyir sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ bdud gzhom phyir lhor stobs po che/ rgyu 'bras go phyir nub tu lang kar gshegs pa/ bar chad zhi phyir byang du tog gzungs dang gra nga bklag /gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs 'byung phyir sri zhu/ phrin las bcol phyir yon tan/ 'byor pa 'thob phyir snying rje/ bu lon 'khor phyir lan chags kyi mgron rnams la/ phyi chu gtor dang mdos glud/ nang gtor ma/ gsang ba lus kyi mchod sbyin bya bar gsungs so/ bzhi pa ni/ dngos su snang ba'i mgron la dngos 'byor ci rigs pas mnyes shing tshim par byed pa ste/ bla ma dang dge 'dun rje dpon dang yon tan can nad pa dang dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas bu lon lan chags pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba rnams yon dang bza' btung ci 'byor bstab la sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ gnyis pa sa yi cho ga la lnga/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba bzung zhing bsrung ba'o/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid rten 'brel lto 'phye brtag pa rnams te/ sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ gnyis pa snang ba mi las bslangs zin pa'i dbang du byas te/ mi snang bar bslang ba la gnyis/ sa lha dang mi min yul bdag spyi la'o/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhi stegs byi dor byas par tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa gnyis dang*/

gser skyems/ mtha' skor byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsam chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor du bkod/ bdag bskyed la mkho ba'i phyi nang gi mchod gtor gang dgos phug logs lta bur bshams shing 'og gi skabs so sor dgos pa'i yau byad rnams kyang tshags su tshud par bya'o/ de nas thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba'am lugs 'ga' zhig tu sku gtso rkyang dran rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa brgya rtsa byas pas chog pa yod kyang*/ spyi khyab ltar na tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyang bar gsungs pas/ 'dir spyi 'gros ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: e las rang byung gzhal yas khang : gnam lcags las grub mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus chos 'byung baṃ gyi steng : rang rig pad+ma he ru kaḥ h+ya ghṛ wa dmar nag gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: sma ra dbu skra me 'od 'khrugs: rta skad hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes bgegs dpung 'joms: g.yon pa'i phur pas tshe bdud bsgral: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham brjid: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: drag sngags hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: rang byung ye shes lnga ru gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mthar bsdu ldang bya/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas gsal gdab cing*/ ha ha: hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho: phaiṃ phaiṃ: de nas khro bo'i gad rgyangs sa gsum rab tu g.yo ba bsgrags par bsam/ hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs:

gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum 'tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ hūm̐: mdun du ri rab gling bzhi'i dbus: skyon bral pad+ma'i lte ba zlum: sa yi lha mo bstan ma ser: bum 'dzin pus btsugs gus pa'i tshul: 'khor du sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bcas: rang mdog phyogs mthun rgyan chas gsal: thugs srog laṃ las 'od 'phros pas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang gdan la dgyes par bzhugs: om̐ baṃ laṃ bhū mi pa ti badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ri rab rol mtsho bcud kyi bdag: sa la gnas pa'i lha mo che: sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bran g.yog 'khor: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rin chen gser gyi sa mchog stsol: de ring dbang chen dkyil 'khor 'debs: bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang drag gis: phrin las bya ba gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gdug pa'i sdang sems zhi gyur nas: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rogs dan dang : lo legs 'bru 'phel nad yams zhi: khyed cag sa mchog 'di phul mthus: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur: de ltar bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul la sa gnon gyis rgyas gdab/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las/

/rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam/ zhi rol bcas gtor ma phyir phul/ gnyis pa ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ s+d+yā na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa la lañca na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang la gnas pa'i/ /sa 'dzin sde dpon bcu gnyis dang*/ /spar kha sme ba lo skor dang*/ /gza' khyim dus 'gyu zhag gi lha/ /lha klu phyogs skyong sde brgyad dang*/ /'byung ba'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag la/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /sa rko ri bshig brag bsgyel zhing*/ /chu rlung me 'gyed zor 'phang dang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las gang yang*/ /legs nyes bya ba gang byas kyang*/ /ko long spangs shing rogs dan mdzod/ /gal te phrag dog sdang gyur tshe/ /bdag nyid khyung chen khro rgyal gyis/ /ri rab bsnyil zhing rgya mtsho dkrug /klu dang sa bdag dregs pa'i rigs/ /rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas dam srungs phrin las mdzod/ /om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa ma ya ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gāts+tsha/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ mchod pa rnams bsdu'o/ gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ stegs kyi mdun nas slob dpon gyis dbang mchog gi phur bu bzung*/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phur bu la thim: de nyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur par bsams la/ hrī pad+ma ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btab ste lan bdun bzlas pas/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos sa gzhi thams cad khyab/

bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ bzhi pa sbyang ba la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga ser po bsams nas/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /thams cad kyis rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sa la reg pa'i tshul byas nas/ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sa la bsnun/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ phra mo grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros: 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs: rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur: ces mos/ lnga pa bzung ba dang bsrung ba gnyis las/ dang po bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhengs te las phur thogs la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros pa'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang bar gyur/ phur bu rnams stod zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu 'dril ba/ smad lcags phur me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ phur pa bsgril zhing*/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: 'og min rdo rje'i pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang gis: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rngam stabs kyis: drag sngags me yis stong khams khengs: ma rig nyon mongs sa sri btul: dbyings phyug mi 'gyur sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: che mchog khrag 'thung khro rgyal gyis: bdud po mgo gsum btul ba'i tshe: drag sngags rdo rje'i char chen phab: bar gyi 'jig rten sa sri 'dul: gsang chen rmang btings sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: klu srin sa bdag kha rlangs las:

rims nad sa sri 'dul ba'i tshe: sprul pa'i bya khyung me gshog gyis: klu srin ma rungs sa bdag 'joms: 'og gi ma rungs sa sri 'dul: rlung ri rdo rje'i sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: lha 'dre ma rungs dam la btags: bod khams gling bzhi'i sa sri 'dul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rmang gzhi btsugs: de ring gsang ba'i sa 'dzin no: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi 'gros stabs kyis: shar gyi sa sri dam la btags: shar phyogs zhi ba'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba shing gi srung mkhar btsugs: shar gyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi 'gros stabs kyis: lho yi sa sri dam la btags: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba me yi srung mkhar btsugs: lho yi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yon tan ma mo'i 'gros stabs kyis: nub kyi sa sri dam la btags: nub phyogs dbang gi pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba chu yi srung mkhar btsugs: nub kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i 'gros stabs kyis: byang gi sa sri dam la btags: byang phyogs drag po'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba lcags kyi srung mkhar btsugs: byang gi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yang dag khrag 'thung 'gros stabs kyis: dbus kyi sa sri dam la btags: dbus phyogs che mchog pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba rlung gi srung mkhar btsugs: dbus kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig:

ces phur pa 'debs shing*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i khro chung dang me 'od kyis sa gzhi khengs par gyur: hūm̐: steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo phub: 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bcings: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rgya gram 'gros kyis sa bcag go /spro na 'dir stangs stabs dang bskor ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ye shes kyi lha bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa'i rim pa grub nas dngos grub len pa sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ dang po la bcu ste/ mtshams gsum rten bca' sta gon bya/ rgyan bkod mnga' gsol brda sbyar zhing*/ sri mnan bskos gdab byin 'bebs so/ zhes pa'i dang po phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyogs bzhir tho bzhi la rgyal chen so so'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa re dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bshams: sgrub pa po rnams rol chas sogs ser sbreng gi tshul gyis sgrub khang nas don te shar gyi tho mdun du 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/

gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas pi waṃ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: bar gyis mchod/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: dri za 'bum dang me lhas bskor: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis shar phyogs dung sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: srung zhing shar gyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ bi pa la rā dza badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ lho yi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐:

zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ral grir gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: om̐ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: gshin rje 'bum dang grul bum bskor: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis lho phyogs gser sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing lho yi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ ār+ya gu li rā dza rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐:

zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas sbrul zhags su gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba glang spyod la dbang bsgyur tshe: klu dbang 'bum dang rlung lha bcas: mos bzhi dbang sgyur mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis nub phyogs zangs sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing nub kyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ tsak+ṣu mu ta rā dza pad+ma āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/

gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ne'u lar gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las rnam thos sras ljang gu ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: rtsa sngags mthar/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur tshe: gnod sbyin 'bum dang dbang ldan bcas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis byang phyogs lcags sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing byang gi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā rā dza karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya'o/ gnyis pa bar mtshams la gnyis/ dam sri mnan pa sgo byang gdab pa'o/ dang po ni/ rang gzhung las stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/

yamadamasriyamaparimāradzadzaḥ nanan/ tri'utri'umārayanamashodzaḥ khuganan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dusadrugadangabacurargyuba'inyulaledamasrirgyala'agonga'abyungapo'itshogasadangabacasapa'ilusangagayidagasumamathustobasathamasacadanonacig bskalapastongagibaradumaldangazhig om̐lam̐hūm̐lam̐satwaṃbhayanan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khraṃ gyis bskor ba bris la/ 'grub na sgrub pa'i snga nyin ltar phur pa sogs drag po'i phrin las btang ba'i tshogs tha ma'i gdab kha dang 'brel bar 'gugs stim grangs mang byas la thun gdab zhes pa 'di sta gon gyi nyin snga mar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i ling khrus dang 'gugs gzhug drag po byas la/ ling lteb sogs snga tshags tshud par bya dgos pa yin no/ de'i tshul zur du shes par bya'o/ mchan gang ltar yang*/ 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcings/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ de tsam mi 'grub pa'i skabs liṅga dong nang du btings/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' gnyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems phul/

de nas rta mgrin gsal gdab la/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par du thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ de nas thun brdeg cing mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'chi bdag kha tham nag po bzhengs: nad rlangs dug gzer 'phro zhing bzhengs: za byed gdug pa'i khro zhal gdongs: 'joms byed rno ba'i sgrol mche gtsigs: 'jib byed g.yo ba'i dbal lce rkyongs: snyob byed 'chi bdag lag pa rkyongs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan dang : sgrub la bar gcod dam sri'i rigs: sgab 'dre yul 'dre rgyal 'gong dang : gson 'dre pho mo shi 'dre'i rigs: grib can la sogs gnod byed rnams: 'chi bdag gnod sbyin khyod la gtad: deng bzung bskal pa ma stong bar: ma shor zungs shig lag ma shor: gal te shor ram btang srid na: bdag nyid gtum drag he ru kas: srid gsum bshig cing stong gsum 'gul:

mthu chen drag rtsal rdul du brlag: de bas byang chub mchis kyi bar: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: om̐ tsaṇ+ḍa he ru ka ya ma rā dza kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: dam sri 'byung po waka thaṃ spur thaṃ nan: 'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod cing bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs gdab ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sāts+tsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcu bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan:

'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/ mched lcam rnams srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel te las bzhi'i bro gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdu na las byang nas 'byung ba'i bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ gnyis pa sgo byang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra yi sog pa'am ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/ dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang bar gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar bar gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar gdeng zhing g.yon pas lcags sgrog thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi gseb nas rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud cing zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril bas phung 'dre dam sri rgyal 'gong gi snying khrag gsol ba/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan cing*/ yum phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'jigs byed bya khyung rigs lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon pa/ sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gyings pa'i gnas gsum om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya ghṛ ba hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: sogs kyis mchod/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi lha: che mchog yongs 'dus gtso bo che: las kyi khro bo mi bzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms khrag 'thung sku: dmar nag rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril srid gsum g.yo: rab 'jigs gyad kyis dor stabs tshul: dbang sdud dmar mo gri thod 'dzin: 'jigs byed bya khyung sde lngas bskor: gser mig zangs rwa lcags sder bgrad: klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : dbang chen dregs pa khro chen tshogs: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bar sgo srung zhing gshegs mtshams chod: om̐ pad+ma ta kri ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra wā ra hī ga ru ṭa yak+ṣa badz+ra kro ta hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes lan gsum bzlas nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ zhes phyi'i sgo srung gi gzugs cing sgrub khang sgo yi ya them la zla ba/ ma them la nyi ma/ g.yas su g.yung drung*/ g.yon du 'khor lo bris te bkod la/ hūm̐: steng phyogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: 'og tu nyi ma'i sa gzhi bdal: g.yas su rlung gi g.yung drung la: g.yon du sa yi 'khor lo ste: 'byung ba'i kha sbyor srung ba'i gur: su yang bgrod par mi nus so: dam sri 'byung po mtshams chod cig: de nas nang sgo'i shing byang la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku sngags 'dod gsol skyer phur sngags ldan bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang ba gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/

om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi byin brlabs/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag g.yas bum pa 'khor lo g.yon rgya gram thogs pa yum gri thod 'dzin pa sbyor te bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba bdud rtsi 'khyil: dpal chen las kyi he ru kaḥ sngo sangs thabs shes phyag rgya yis: bum pa 'khor lo rgya gram 'dzin: mi zad zad med bdud rtsi 'khyil: dam tshig yum chen gri thod sbyor: khro bo'i rol stabs stangs stabs brjid: ye shes dam tshig mkha' 'gros bskor: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis sgo mtshams 'di srung zhing : dngos grub phyi ru ma gtong zhig: sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi mdzad cing : las kyi rtags rgya 'di srungs shig: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha ri ni sa baṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ sgo byang gnyis ma 'dzoms pa'am bsdu na phyi sgo'i rta mgrin kho nas chog go /sgo them gyi nang du brub khung zhig gi nang du zan ling la seng ldeng ngam skyer pa'i phur bu'i dbal la mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang*/ mgul du rgya shog la sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig ces bris te btags pas rgyas btab/ sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ gsum pa gsang mtshams la gnyis/ ma traṃ bsgral ba dang khro bcu'i phur gdab bo/ dang po ni/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod med pa'i rigs phal cher la mdzad srol mi 'dug pas 'di bzhag nas 'og gi phur gdab la 'jug pas chog

/'on kyang bla med yin phyir dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du lhun gyi grub pas sbyar yang 'gal ba med pas rata gling thugs gsang sogs las bshad pa ltar dang*/ khro bo'i rigs sogs dkyil 'khor dur khrod bcas pa la nges par gal che ba yin/ de yang slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i yang dag gsang 'grel dang*/ hūm̐ ka ra'i mnyam sbyor dkyil chog go /cho ga'i chings bcu gnyis gyis rtsis 'gos bsdus pa sogs phyag len rgyas bsdus mang yang gter ma'i phyogs su bka' brgyad bde 'dus nyid khungs zab cing don 'dus pas de ltar na/ dang po rang rgyud kyi ma traṃ bdag 'dzin 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nga bdag bsgral ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ma traṃ gi gzugs brnyan mgo lho nub tu bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag /stegs bu'i shar ngos slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs te phyag tu g.yab dar dril bu bsnams nas stong thun zur gsal ltar bshad pa'i rjes su las sngags om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brjod la/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur par bsam/ mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ phaṭḥ kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rig pa ma 'gags 'gyu ba las: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i ru tra byung : bag chags rim par brtsegs pa las: nga bdag nyon mongs las kyi rlung : ye shes sgrib pa'i gnod byed la: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyu yis: shes rig lta ba'i phur bus bsnun: gtub bo gcig chod sa ma ya: gtubs shig ka dag khregs chod mtshon: nga bdag ru tra dbyings su sgrol: ma ni 'khor 'das dbang chen gzhi: traṃ ni brdal khyab chos sku'i dal: ru ni ma bcos spros bral dbyings: tra ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg: ye grol chen po'i pho brang nas: zang thal rgya yan pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma dz+nyā na ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ

ces bdag lus ye nas gzhal yas khang du gsal: lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bcings te/ ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ lan bdun brjod/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po stong gsum dang mnyam pa las kyi bsad khang de'i dbus su nad rlangs sngo dmar yam yam 'phro ba'i rnam pa can gyi nang du gnod byed mo 'dre gdon bgegs sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri'i rigs lus sngo ba ham pa red pa nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gsal bar gyur: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum dkon mchog thugs rje'i bdag: rgyal sras rig 'dzin grub thob phyag rgya sngags: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar gcod tshogs: 'byung po mi min gnod byed dam sri dang : log 'dren gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus rnams: steng 'og phyogs bcu ri rab gling bzhi'i srang : ban bon lha srung skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di dag la: myur du khug cig rdo rje lcags kyu ma: chongs shig sdoms shig las byed zhags pa ma: gcun cig gzir cig mthu stobs lcags sgrog ma: myos shig gtor cig las byed ral gri ma: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: om̐ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes bkug bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: mthing nag rab rngam tshwa tshwa 'phro: rdo rje gdeng zhing phur bu 'debs: dam sri gnod byed byad ma rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlags par byed: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral zhing*/ ma hā dhe wa ru tra dza dza hūm̐: zhes lan bdun bzla zhing thams cad kyi lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum sbreng ba kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi rgyas snying khar bsnun tshul byas la/ gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig: ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs dang bral: rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūm̐ yig dkar por gyur bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par gyur

par bsam zhing*/ de nas snying dbus su dur khrod ma la ya: rtsib g.yas shar bsil ba tshal: mgo lho kī la rdzogs: rtsib g.yon nub laṅka brtsegs: gsang gnas byang pad+ma brtsegs: lag g.yon shar lho gsang chen rol: lag g.yas lho nub lhun grub gter: rkang g.yas nub byang 'jig rten brtsegs par gyur: rkang g.yon byang shar he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gyur cing lha so so'i pho brang du gyur par bsam la/ hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi la: dbang chen pho brang gzhi ru gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yas: shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yon: lho phyogs gad rgyangs dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yon: nub phyogs tshang tshing dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yas: byang phyogs rab rgyu dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i mtshams bzhi 'di: ha ha rgod dang bsil ba tshal: rngam pa sgra sgrogs kī la'i gnas: nang rol phyi nang rim pa bzhin: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas brgyad gsal: snying dbus dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dal: yongs rdzogs gzi brjid mdangs ldan gsal: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ: slob dpon shar du gnas pas bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: thugs ka nas bh+rūm̐ 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa ye shes rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por gyur: thams cad kyi lag g.yas phyi dang lag g.yon nang du byas pa'i khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces lan bdun bzlas nas rgya bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'gros gar gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ha ha: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur: zhes brjod la stegs bu'i dbus kyi khri'u khar slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du seng ldeng gi phur bu tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur zhing rtse mor me tog phreng ba bcings pa bcu bshams/

dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub rnams su phur gdan bcu bkod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros phur bu rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las stod khro bo'i gzugs can smad phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ thams cad hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sum+bha na ི'i sngags kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug pa la slob dpon gyis lag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon pas phur bu bzung la/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'jig rten kun: zhe sdang rdo rje bla na med: sku gsung thugs sprul stobs dang ldan: ta krita khrag 'thung khro rgyal bcu: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams brlag par mdzod: dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: rang byung khro rgyal chen po bcu: log 'dren bdud bgegs mtshams gcod phyir: khro bcu'i phur pa gdab par bya: steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar nas brtsam g.yas su rim par/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la: ma hā kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ār+ya a tsa le hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐:

gnod byed 'byung po tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi mdun du/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces 'bar ba'i stangs stabs dang bcas steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar/ shar nas shar lho sogs rim gyis byang shar bar g.yas bskor dang*/ 'og gi phur bu'i nub kyi nub tu gdab pas/ bgegs rnams kyi snying phug nas g.yo 'gul med cing 'od gsal bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer srung ba'i 'khor lo 'khrigs pas phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par bsam/ zhes dang*/ las gzhung nas 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod cing bsrung bya srung byed thams cad las 'das pa kho na nyid kyi srung 'khor yang bya/ bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bca' ba la/ thog mar chag chag gdab pa ni/ dung phor ram ka pā lar bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar sbyar ba'i dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la rdo rje khu tshur gyis byang shar nas g.yas bskor du khyab par khyams med par byug cing*/

hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gi byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhi chag chag 'debs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun rgyu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i steng : gsang ba ḍā ki'i dal bcag pas: dbang chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: om̐ sarba dharma bhū mi haṃ: zhes brjod cing zhi rol bya/ lnga pa sta gon la bzhi/ bum pa yo byad slob ma lha sta gon la gnas pa'o/ de'ang slob ma la dbang bskur dang 'brel na de rnams skabs dang sbyar/ ma 'brel na mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang yo byad sta gon ni nam du'ang dgos pas sgrub rdzas tshang bar bsags la thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu mos pas byin gyis brlabs/ lha sta gon ni gtso bor dkyil 'khor bri bar gnang ba zhu ba'i don yin pas grub na legs pa las lhag skyon du mi 'gyur bas de ltar na/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus gtso bo'i gnas su bdud rtsi dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab kyis thig le gru bzhi 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po re/ de rnams su lha sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥmathar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: btags pa brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu gtso 'khor dgu phyed par bkod/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor bsham la/ las byang ltar mchod pa byin brlabs dam tshig pa bskyed/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar du song nas thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs: dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris nas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang : sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis se gol gsum byas la/ lha rnams bar snang 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par

bsam/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ 'dir yang las byang gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi lcogs pa lta bu la/ sgrub pa'i gzhir rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen po thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ ces gdod nas grub pa'i sems kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la mchod bstod byas pas kyang chog go /sgrub pa'i mthar slob ma la dbang bskur ba sogs bum pa sta gon dgos pa'i rigs la bsdus pa 'dod na/ bum pa lha grangs sam rnam bum dang las bum tsam 'du bya/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pas bgegs bskrad/ bum pa chas su gzhug pa'i sngags bka' dgongs sogs nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la nang bcud mgul chings kha rgyan ldan pa bkod/ mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlab/ bum pa bsang sbyang bya/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las phyi rin po che bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus su thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mtsho rdzing dwangs par zla skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur: ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ zhes sngags tsam gyis mchod/ phyag 'tshal shau lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gzung thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha rnams la phog: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems ye shes bcud du 'khyil bar bsam: bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla/ mthar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i mchod yon phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur: las bum ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang pad+mar gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bum pa bsnams pa khro bo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor om̐:
