mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ ham̐'u: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar mos la/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzlas mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur te phrin las mdzad par mos la/ bsdu na las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang rten lta bur so sor las lha bskyed la sngags bzlas pas byin rlabs 'od zhu dang mchod bstod bya/ dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pa ni/ dbang gi sa gzhi 'jam zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam bya/ thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad tsam gyis 'debs pa'i ri mo dkar po dag tu 'dod/ sgrub pa po ni dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod: bkra shis mtshan ldan rig ma rgyan can de/ shar du sdod la thig skud sne mo btang : de nas thig skud rdo rje pad+mar mtshon/ dang po mkha' la ye shes dal thig gdab: thig skud rig ma'i spyi bor khru gang btegs: hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' lam du: bden gnyis 'bras bu ston pa'i phyir: rig pa rdo rje'i thig gdab bo: rang byung ye nas pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma badz+ra swa bhā wa hūm̐: de nas rig ma'i brang la gtad: shes rab yum gyi bha ga ru: thabs kyi kun da sbreng bar bsam: hoḥ stong nyid ye shes rgyun lam du: zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i phyir: zung 'jug bde chen thig gdab bo: sna tshogs lnga ldan lhun gyis grub: om̐ pra dz+nyā su khaṃ pra mo ti ri hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor dag la gdab:

hūm̐: lā s+ye sgeg mo yid 'ong gar: dbyangs can mnyen lcug 'khril zhing ldem: bkra shis lha mo tshe 'dzin grogs: mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du: kun 'byung nor bu'i thig gdab bo: om̐ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na saṃ kṛ ta maṇ+ḍal mu dra de bi dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: zhes pas cha tshad legs par gdab ces pas: de'ang slob dpon rdor dril dang bcas pa'i ngang nas gung mos thig skud bzung*/ 'og nas gyen du gcus te se gol gtog pa la/ nub shar lho byang tshangs thig gdab/ me rlung srin dbang zur thig gnyis/ me dbang rlung srin shar nub logs/ /rlung dbang me srin byang dang lho/ logs te tshangs logs rgyab 'gros dang : zur la de spangs g.yas kho nas/ 'gro ste thig chen brgyad po gdab/ slob dpon nub nas srad bu bsdu/ de nas tshon byin brlab pa ni: 'byung ba rim brtsegs mtshon pa'i phyir: dbus su ljang gu la tām̐ bris: de steng dmar po pām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng dkar po la mām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng ser po la lām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng sngon po la mūm̐ bris la bzhag hūm̐: 'byung ba rang byung bsnol brtsegs thabs: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin tu: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar thim: om̐ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ bh+rūm̐: slar phyogs su bzhag nas/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes bris la/ hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod phrag dog: gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ru lam gyis shar: kun tu gnas 'gyur sa bon bh+rūm̐: om̐ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe haṃ: dang po zhi rgyas dbang drag gam/ phrin las gang du 'jug pa yi/ sa slong dal bcag dri bzang gis: chag chag btab nas thig gdab pa: thig tshad dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad: shes rab gzhi la thabs kyis gdab: slob dpon nub nas shar du gyu: rig ma shar nas langs te bzhengs: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gdab: gnyis pa dbus nas cha bzhi mnyam:

dbus ma'i tshangs thig legs par gdab: tshangs thig bgos pa'i gnyis cha mtshams: g.yas g.yon bya rog rjes rnams btsal: de la gcig btab thabs shes gnyis: bzhi cha gdab pa tshad med bzhi: de nas gnyis gdab phar phyin drug: go cha dang po rnam thar brgyad: gnyis pa stong nyid bcu drug pa: gsum pa dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: des ni gzhung gi thig chen tshang : de nas sa bcad bgo ba ni: nub byang slob dpon dag gis gdab: shar phyogs gsang ba'i rig mas gdab: dang po phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: gnyis pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag: lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: bdun pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: de yis thig chen rtsa gnyis rdzogs: dang po cha chen lta ba la: gnyis pa pad+ma gsum 'khor lo: bzhi pa sgo mtshams blo yis dpag: tshad ni cha chen gcig tu 'dod: chos 'khor la ni cha phran bzhi: gnyis 'das gnyis dang bzhi 'das bzhi: bskor ba klong gur ri mo 'byung : ka zur mun pa cha chung re: glang gur mun pa cha chung gsum: cha chung bzhi cha kha rgyan bskor: mun pa'i skor tshad sgo yi mtshams: ka rgyan steng nas za ra tshags: gyen bskor sna tshogs rdo rje 'byung : pad+ma rdo rwa cha phran re: dur khrod me ri cha chen re: rtsig pa lnga ldan cha chung gcig: 'dod snam dmar po cha chung re: pha gu ser po cha chung gcig: mun nag drwa dkar cha chung gnyis: sham bu sngon po cha chung gcig: mda' yab mchod rten cha chung gcig: ka ba phyogs mtshon ka rgyan mdzes: lcam dang rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog: rta babs sa chu me rlung bzhi: ser sngon dmar ljang cha chung re: ka gdan mdzes tshon cha chung re: chos 'khor ser po cha chung gnyis: char kheb nyi zla cha chung re: de ltar zhib tu rim par gdab: ces so/ de nas tshon gyi tshom bu dgod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor nang dbus tshom bu spyan ras gzigs rigs lnga dang*/

phyi rim du sgo ma bzhi bcas so sor gdab bo/ drug pa rgyan 'god pa ni/ dkyil 'khor steng khri rim gsum mam gnyis yod pa'i 'og mar rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ bdag bskyed mchod gtor logs gang bder bzhag /sgrub rdzas spyir sku gzugs tsakli rgyud dam gzhung pod/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan shel rdo bcas sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sgrub pa'i gtor chen sman raka /tshe 'brang tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar myang grol sgrub pa dang 'brel na ril bu bum pa sogs sgrub rdzas khyad par can dmigs bsal du 'byung ba rnams bkod/ zhi rgyas dbang drag dang bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma spyi dang khyad par gter srung gza' klu btsan gsum gtor ma dang*/ dbang rdzas tshang ma dkyil 'khor rgyan rdzas sogs ci 'byor ba stegs bu'i steng du bkod/ slar 'dzab dbyangs bya ba'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyis dril spos 'dzin pas thog drangs rten sgrub mchod pa'i rdzas rnams thogs pa'i ser sbreng gis dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ mdun du 'khod de dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: yi dam mchod cing dngos grub blang ba dang : dam can dgyes bskang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bkod pa ni: bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang : dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyan du che: sman raka gtor bcas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : gdugs dang bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan dang : mda' dang gri dang tshon skud drwa ba 'brel: dar sham smad dkris dur khrod rdzas mchog bkram: mthun pa'i rdzas mchog dgyes pa'i dkor cha sogs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru yongs rdzogs gsal: zhes dbyangs dang zhi rol bcas bya zhing sgrub rdzas rnams: las slob sogs kyis nor 'khrul med cing bag dro lhun chags dwang ba 'dren par bkod:

dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgrub pa'i rdzas kyi gtso bo thod pa rnam bum myong grol bum pa sogs khri'u khar bkod/ gdan khri gong mar sku gsung thugs rten/ rgyab ngos su bye brag gi gtor chen rgyan spros can dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rwa'i steng khro bcu'i phur pa/ mtha' skor shar du mchod yon nas brtsam ste nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin bcas/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhi mda' dar me long can bzhi btsugs pa tshon skud kyi drwa bas sbrel/ gzhan yang zur bzhir rgyal mtshan logs bzhir 'phen dar gyi drwa phyed sogs so so'i phyag len las byung ba ltar mdzes brjid chags pa dang*/ steng na dar gyi gdugs phub/ gsham du stag gzig gi sgab dkris kyis bskor/ dkyil 'khor mdun rgyab gang bder mchod gtor kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa'i g.yon du chos gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gi gtor 'bul chad brtan rgyun bzhag rgyun gso'i chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar phyi mchod brgya rtsa sogs yod na mtha' skor stegs bu rim pa can la go rim ma 'dzol bar bkod/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin 'bul rgyu'i chos skyong gi gtor spungs chad mdo brtan ma tshogs kyi yo byed kyis mtshon phrin las la dgos pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor byang phyogs su lcags snod du nyul le'i liṅga dang las phur phur stegs bcas yungs dkar sogs thun rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsams te nang mchod/ rdor dril/ las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog snod rnams bzhag /mchod pa rnams la spyi khyab tu/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mkha' khyab tu spel bar bya'o/ bdun pa tshogs sgrub kyi las la 'jug rung gi bya ba sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa ni/

las kyi rdo rje'i thod chang yar bzed nas tshig gis bstun so so la drang ba sogs lag len ltar byas la/ rgyal thebs kyis stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len gyis/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dug lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas: ston pa'i sgron mer mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes dang rgyal tshab la: hūm̐: bla ma'i gdung 'tshob sku gsung thugs kyi sras: dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang dngos grub spel: dbang bskur phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa: rgyal tshab ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: yum la: gnyis med bde skyed mtshan nyid rab tu bzang : kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdo rje las sar: phrin las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad: rdo rje karma mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: ging la: bar gcod bgegs bsgral gzugs phung lha la stob: rdo rje ging mchog mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs:

mtshams par: phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad srungs: rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: spyan pa: dngos grub bgegs gnyis dus dang drod tshad mkhyen: rdo rje spyan pa mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: dus mtshams par: phrin las skabs sbyor dus 'dzin nam tshod mkhas: rdo rje dus mtshams mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: phyag tshang par: phud gtsang g.yos mkhas phyi nang bya byed mkhas: rdo rje phyag tshang mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: byin por: gsal dag dzap mkhas dad ldan brtson par bzhugs: gser phreng mched lcam mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdul phyags pa la: kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod: rdul phyags skyes bu mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes so sor mnga' gsol zhing rang gral du 'khod pa las nam yang ma 'khrugs par bya'o/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis zhal bkod gdab pa ni: hūm̐: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon rgyal tshab gzungs ma dang : rdo rje karma ging mchog mtshams pa dang : spyan ma phyag tshang rdo rje rdul phyags pa: rdo rje gser phreng la sogs mched dang lcam: rang rang gral bzhugs bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gyis: tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas bya ba yi: byang chub sgrub la gsang ba'i lam mchog 'dir: sngon sbyangs tshogs bsags 'bras bu dus 'dir smin: da res sgrub mchog 'dir bzhugs skal pa bzang : tshe 'di blos thong sgrub la snying rus bskyed: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ngo e ma hoḥ zhi khro'i rigs sogs la de'i rjes 'brel du chas su zhugs shing rtags gdab dgos pas chas rnams las rdor sogs kyis thogs/ rgyal tshab pas gtong thun sngon du 'gro ba'i dbyangs bor len tshul gyis zhi chas la: hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder gshegs dngos su gsal: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do:

stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rab tu spras: dri mchog ngad ldan brgyan pa po: 'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes: khro chas la: hūm̐: don dam spros med sgyu ma'i khong gseng nas: ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan gsol: 'khor ba ma spangs mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: skye 'chi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gsol: sku gsum lhun grub thod phreng tshar gsum gsol: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: ma rig nags sreg ye shes me dpung gsol: zhing bcu yongs sgrol dpal gyi chas bcu 'di: dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: zhes rjes zlos dang bcas tshig dang bstun nas dpal gyi chas rnams las kyi rdo rjes rgyal tshab par rim par phul la rdo rje slob dpon sogs thams cad kyi gnas so sor bgo zhing rgyan pa'i tshul bya'o/ brgyad pa brda sbyar ba la/ brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skye med ka dag zhal mjal phyir: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'thib sgo bcad: zang thal rig pa'i 'char sgo phyes: gsal stong de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis 'dzin mnyam pa nyid du bshags: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta bas mchod: bla med ye grol chen por bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya badz+ra a ti pu ho dz+nyā na shud+dhe hūm̐: shin tu bsdu na gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i sgo glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas bcad pa rig pa ye shes kyi brda mjal bas lhag ge phye bar bsams la/ bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brda sgo dbye/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ci ltar shar yang rang rig las gud du med pa'i gnas lugs chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur rtogs pas/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes brda phyag 'tshal ba tsam gyis kyang grub bo/ dgu pa bsre bsnan bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir dbang ma thob pa'i mched gsar bu rnams dkyil 'khor byang shar lta bu logs su phye/

slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril bdud rtsi yungs thun sogs bkod nas/ las byang bdud rtsi byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ sman mchod khā hi bcas bya/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid las kyi dpal chen he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ya las lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa 'phros: de las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas slob bu'i sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par gyur: par bsam zhing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla zhing yungs thun gyis brab/ las byang ltar bka' sgo bgegs bskrad brjod/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pa rol mo sogs 'tsham rngam gyis bgegs bskrad gsar bu rnams kyi rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir rjes zlos byar gzhug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing sa la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re yod par bsgom: byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rdo rje'i lce thog tu lan gsum bzhag nas/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang : byang chub sems dang rdo rje 'dzin: de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa: de dag la ni snying ring na: rdo rje yak+sha gnod sbyin gyis: khyod kyi snying la zhugs te 'thung : snying la yang dag gnas pa'o: 'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed:

dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub: ces bdud rtsi byin pas slob mas kyang*/ i dan+te na ra kan sa ma ya yak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes myong la snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo/ 'dres gral bsnan pa'i rgyal tshab pas bdud rtsi g.yon skor du gsar rnying thams cad la bran zhing*/ gtso sngags dzap dbyangs lan gsum mjug tu 'jam rol dang bcas pas bdud rtsi myong nas thams cad kyis/ om̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ā sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes dang slob dpon gyis/ deng phyin chad mched gsar rnying thams cad skal pa mnyam zhing dam tshig gcig tu 'dus pa yin pas dam tshig gzhung bzhin du bsrung bar gyis shig: ces bsgo/ thams cad kyi phyag thal sbyar gyi bar me tog bzung nas: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched dang lcam dral gyis: sgrub mchog rnams su byin gyis brlabs pa yi: bka' drin rjes su dran phyir gtang rag gtong : zhes drin lan gyi me tog 'thor/ de nas rdo rje'i gral du bzhag pa ni/ mched gsar pa rnams rang rang gral du 'khod nas/ phyag thal sbyar bar me tog bzung la/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang : bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi bstan cing bsgrub pa dang :

yi dam lha tshogs 'dzab bsnyen bgrang ba'i phyir: dam tshig rdo rje'i gral du mchis par gnang : zhes brjod cing mched gsar pa rnams rang gral du 'khod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'du 'bral med pa'i gzung thag la: dam tshig srog gis bsdus pa'i mched dang lcam: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod de dam tshig gi bslab bya rgyas par bya/ de nas thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ om̐ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor ba dang*/ om̐ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐: zhes dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes thugs kar 'khyud rgya byas la dril bu dkrol ba dang*/ rol chen brgya brdung sogs/ rol mo'i sgra cher bsgrag go /bcu pa lha bstim zhing byin dbab pa ni/ rang gral nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhengs la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam rol mo bcas pas/ hūm̐: spros med rtog bral mkha' dbyings dag pa nas: skye med rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba: 'gro don rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas: stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi: sprul pa dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: ces dang gtso 'khor sngags mthar/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ zhes btags pa brjod/ gong du sta gon byas nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa de nyid dkyil 'khor la bstims par mos/ bsdu na spyan 'dren bskos gdab 'dir ma byas kyang chog go byin dbab pa ni/ 'brel dang byin rlabs che ba nyang gter bde 'dus las 'byung ba ltar na/ sgrub pa po rnams zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/

dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas tshig bdun gyis sna drangs te/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po'i bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ rang gzhung byin 'bebs 'dir bya: zhes mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum mthar grol lo/ gnyis pa lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa dngos la gsum/ 'dzab dgongs bzlas pas dngos grub sgrub pa de'i bar gcod bsal ba/ dus grangs rtags tshad kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ phrin las dang 'brel dgos pas las gzhung nyid nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug /'bring nyin lan gnyis mtshan lan gnyis te dus bzhi/

tha mas kyang nyin mtshan gnyis la tshar re bsrang dgos pas/ las gzhung mang nyung dang bstun la/ rab 'bring gnyis gang bder lag tu blangs te/ thun dang po la rnam 'joms nas bzung*/ theg chen dgu ldan/ gnas ri so dgu/ gsol 'debs shau lo ka kha shas nas brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas brtsam sngon 'gro rnams rgyas par btang*/ dang po dmigs bsal can ma gtogs ting 'dzin gsum gyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgoms la ye shes 'khor lor bstim zhing mchod bstod bya/ bzlas pa'i mgor dzap khang phyes te gzung thag blangs la/ dzap dbyangs lan gsum/ bdag mdun dbyer med sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag mdun gnyis kyang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par bya dgos so/ bsnyen rgyun pa rnams kyis kyang grub na lha'i rgyun khyer lta bu'i mngon rtogs la gsal gdab la sngags rgyun blang*/ de nas bzung grol nyin tha ma'i bar sngags sgra skad cig kyang ma chad par bya/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams kyis lhag chad kha bkang zhing nus pa brtan par byas la stong tshig phul nas nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa la dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor byang shar du slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs/ mdun du hoṃ khung nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams 'god la rten bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ sogs nas lus can du gyur par bsams la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud? sogs mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ khyad par ging chen bcu gnyis bskul ba ni/ gser skyems dang gtor ma bshams gri sha'am sha chen gyis gsur btang lag tu rdo thun dang gri lpags g.yab cing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di ni gnas chen bye? sogs dz+wa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram me bshor btang zhing byin 'bebs pa ni/

sgrub pa po rnams zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/ dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas tshig bdun gyis sna drangs te/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po'i bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ

mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum mthar grol lo/ de dag gis thun dang po grub/ gnyis pa la mchod kha gsos la brgyud 'debs nas bzung las byang 'bring po longs sku ltar sgrub chog khrigs ltar bsnyen pa yan mthar chags su btang*/ stong tshig phul/ rgyal chen kha gso zur gsal ltar bya/ nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa sogs sngar ltar ram stabs bde byed na/ rdo rje mtshams pas gu gul dud pa dang thun brab ste dkyil 'khor bskor la drag sngags so lnga pa dang*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sder mo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas tshar bcad la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ mthar byin 'bebs rgyas pa'am bsdus pa ni/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab sogs?tsam gyis 'thus/ thun gnyis pa grub/ thun gsum pa yang de dang mtshungs la bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub pa dang*/ chos skyong sde lnga sogs rang lugs bka' gter srung ma'i gtor chog spyi dang khyad par gter srung gza' klu btsan gsum sogs rgyun ltar bya'o/ de nas na raka bskang bshags dang gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan 'dren bar song nas/ tshogs byin mchod nas phyi snod srid gsum sogs gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ skong ba rgyas bsdus nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ bskul chos skyong gtor 'bul dang las gzhung chad brtan rta bro bya/ tshe sgrub spyir btang du bya bar mos na mda' dar g.yab bzhin 'di skad do/

tshe zan bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥlas tshe dpag med dkar po tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis bskor bar gyur/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa 'gugs bstim/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku gsum bdag nyid dbyings nas bzhengs: snang srid kun gyi tshe khug la: deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la stsol: hūm̐: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba chu yi bcud bsdus la: mā ma kī yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba sa yi bcud bsdus la: sangs rgyas spyan mas tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba me yi bcud bsdus la: gos dkar mo yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba rlung gi bcud bsdus la: dam tshig sgrol mas tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba nam mkha'i bcud bsdus la: dbyings phyug ma yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: de yi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas bum nang du bskyil bar gyur: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: ci nus bzlas/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ nongs bshags dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum brjod brtan bzhugs rang rang gzhung las gsal ba'am/ spyi ltar du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol: khyad par du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du

rdul tshon yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du mchan/ de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes 'bru 'thor/ shis brjod bcas grub nas mun rub tsam du nyul le bskrad nas byin 'bebs dzap dbyangs lan gsum bcas grol lo/ mtshan thun gsum por 'don 'grig nyin thun gnyis pa dang mtshungs la thun mjug so sor nyul le bskrad gzer dang byin 'bebs pa ma chad par bya'o/ 'byor mkhos can gyi spros pa rgyas par byed na nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir rdor sems 'khor 'das rang grol dang*/ bar chad bsal ba'i phyir rdo rje mtshams pa rnams zur du bzhag nas yang phur las byang rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten na gal che'o/ rgyud las 'khor la bka' bsgo dge sbyong bskul/ zhes khyad par du gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis sgrub mchod rnams skabs skabs su blang dor gyi bslab bya dang dam tshig bshad nas/ bskyed bzlas kyi dmigs pa go sla don 'dus bshad grub na legs pa'i yan lag go / gnyis pa dngos grub la bar du gcod pa bsal cing byin rlabs gzi byin dbab pa ni/ slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs mdun du hoṃ khung du/ nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams dgod la/ rten bskyed pa ni: e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i log par lta ba'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid kyang nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur par bsams la: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang :

ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dbang chen he ru ka bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyi 'gugs gzhug byas la/ phur thun tshom bur bskor ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur bstan pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: drag po'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pa thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ gsang zil las byung ba'i gnas nyul rang lugs ltar/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di nas gnas chen bye ba stong dang phrag: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'bar ba yi: zla ba dkar mo khro chu khol ma'i klong : nyi ma dmar ser rak+ta 'khrigs pa'i dbus: ljang nag rlung ri bu yug 'tshubs pa'i dkyil: ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: las kyi ging chen yab yum bcu gnyis te: ye shes ging chen dkar gsal drag tu 'khros:

g.yas g.yon phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rdo rje ging mo myur mgyogs chu shel mdog: phyag na g.yang gzhi bhan+dha rlon pa thogs: tho rangs nam langs rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ging chen ser nag mi sdug gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na 'khor lo thod khrag dkrugs: rin chen ging mo gser mdog 'od kyis 'gengs: g.yang gzhi bhan+dha thogs shing stong khams 'grim: nyi shar nyi dros rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sor rtog ging chen dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na me thun bhan dmar thogs: pad+ma ging mo zangs mdog mche ba gtsigs: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing tshogs khang nyul: nyin phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bya grub ging chen ljang nag khrag 'thung gzugs: rdo rje phur pa 'dzin cing nyon mongs bsgral: las kyi ging mo rlung mdog shugs ldan ma: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar rak+ta dkrug cing 'thung : nyi thal mun 'tshub rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos dbyings ging chen mthing nag gtum pa'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri thun gri zor 'dzin: bud+dha ging mo lcags mdog 'khrul snang gzhom: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing stong gsum g.yo: srod dang srod 'khor rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'gyu byed ging chen nag po dug gi gdong : g.yas g.yon phyag na spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin: sha za ging mo mun pa'i zug rngu can: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing dpag tshad khyab: nam phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim phyir gshegs su gsol:

sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ghṛ wa ṣa ṭa kro ta dza dzaḥ hūm̐: bskul lo ging chen pho mo rnams: mdzod cig nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul: rbad do rnal 'byor nyams grib sol: brten no nyon mongs zug ngu sregs: 'bod do dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: rnal 'byor dam tshig chag nyams rnams: bshags so rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: ging chen lha tshogs dus la bab: nyon mongs lhong gsum dgra dar na: ging chen thugs dam dus la bab: dam tshig gnas nas bskul ba'i tshe: ging phos rdo thun sha ra ra: ging mos me zor wa la la: dmar nag ral pa sa la gzhol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: rgyu ma'i zhags pa na ra ra: stag lpags sham thabs khrigs se khrig: rngam rgyug gar stabs lings se lang : rkang gling phaṭ sgra 'u ru ru: bshugs sgra ljags glu kyu ru ru: bgegs bskrad gad mo lhangs se lhang : phyi yi rnam rtog bdud dgra chom: nang gi nyon mongs bdud dgra chom: gsang ba'i na tsha rkyen ngan phrol: dug lnga'i 'khrul pa da shigs la: nga bdag 'gong po dbyings su sgrol: dam sri gnod byed rmang nas phyungs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i bar chad thal bar rlog: oṃ kro ta ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed nyon mongs bdud thams cad gardza gardza phaṭḥ oṃ kro ti shwa rī ghṛ ni bh+yoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel ngan pa thams cad da ha da ha dz+wa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram me bshur btang*/ de nas sgrub pa ma grol bar bgegs che na/ dus bcu gnyis sam/ drug tu cha yang gsal 'bud pa re re btang bas gegs sel lo/ khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thabs rgyal mo bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug:

bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg: bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs: bgegs la bab na rū pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs: dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yak+ṣa byi na: yak+ṣa byi na: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsit+ta rbad nan: om̐ sum+bha ni? om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rak+ṣa rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang khyad par gyi dbyug pas brdeg cing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ de ma thag dngos grub ster ba'i ltas 'byung bas byin rlabs dgos par gsungs pas chas sogs sngon bshad ltar byas la byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la:

o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po'i bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ spro bar mos na gzhung gi byin 'bebs 'dir byas la dzap dbyangs lan gsum du gyer ro/ ye shes pa brtan pa'i phyir me tog 'thor ba ni/

hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: rten 'brel dam tshig rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la: brtan par bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'grub par gyur cig badz+ra sa ma ya: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: gsum pa tshang ma dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus ni smin slob la zla ba drug /mos slob kyi dbang du byas na zla ba gcig gam/ zhag po bdun nam nyin zhag gsum gyi mthar brten par bsgrubs pas kyang*/ dus dang dbang po dang mthun par dngos grub ci rigs pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ grangs dang rtags ni gsang ba spyi dang so so'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar ro/ gal te rtags tshad ngan pa byung na nyul le sprad/ rta bro brdung dam sel ltas byung na yig brgya bzla zhing bshags rgyud bklag /grib mi gtsang pa la rnam 'joms sme brtsegs saugs kyi bum khrus bya/ rtags tshad bzang ngan gang la yang re dogs dgag sgrub med par dbyings su bsre ba gnad yin/ dngos grub kyi ltas bzang nges pa can byung na de nyid du rgyun gyi dngos grub smin pa gnad du che bas/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba mdun du bzhag hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: lha yi dge bsnyen dam ldan thams cad kyis: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes nus mthu dang : srid nor zas dang 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol: a la la hoḥ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi myang ngo*/ gsum pa bsgrubs nas dngos grub blang ba sgrub pa chen po'i las rim ni/ dang po sbyor sgrol la bsten pa yin kyang mos slob kyi skabs su rdzas la bsten nas blang pa la gsum/ dngos grub kyi rdzas bshams pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro/ cho ga dngos so/

sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring dgong thun nas dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas bshams te dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar po'i steng du gro yi g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil du bris pa'i dbus su rin po che snod 'bru bzang gi phye ma mngar gsum dang zho mar 'o mas sbrus pa'i nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs dang phyogs bzhi las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas bza' bca' sna tshogs pas bskor ba g.yas su mngar gsum thud dang bsres pa'i ril bu dang*/ g.yon du bhan+dha bzang por 'bru bcud bdud rtsi a mṛ ta btab pa'ang bsham/ dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bebs par gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags sham du/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzla/ phyir nang thor thun phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong stong tshig bcas grub nas bsnyen rgyun snga ma grol/ dngos grub blang ba'i sngags btags pa rgyun bsnyen gtor bsngos tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par byed/ tshogs tha ma'i skabs nyul le'i liṅga mer bsreg la chos skyong gtor mar bstab/ yang phyag len phal mo cher dngos grub kyi rdzas de nang rang du bsham/ snga nub dmigs bzlas 'di mi byed pa'ang yod pas long skabs dang bstun chog /gnyis pa dngos grub la mi dbang ba'i blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ las byang ltar bgegs bskrad cing drag sngags phur thun sogs 'tshams rngam byas la srung 'khor bsgom/ spos rol g.yab cing byin dbab/ spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog lta bu brjod la 'khon bcugs sbyang*/

gsum pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/ lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrang : bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mthar ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐: dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang : bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang : tshogs lam sbyor lam gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dang : bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rnams kyis zhal bzhes ltar: sgrub mchog bdag la sngon gyi smon lam mthus: tshe dang chos dang las bzhi lhun grub dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : srid dang zas nor mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar rtse gcig thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro drug sems can rgyud sbyang mkha' khyab kyi: bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dgyes par bskyed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dngos grub tshur bsdus bdag dang sgrub rdzas la: thim pas 'chi med bdud rtsi dwangs ma che: dngos grub kun gyi snying po 'khyil bar gyur: zhes gsal btab la bsnyen sgrub lha sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ sham bur/ kā ya sid+dhi om̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa sid+dhi trām̐: karma sid+dhi hrīḥ sarba lo ka dz+nyā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes btags pa stong phrag gam brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzlas la/ dngos grub thams cad 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa bdag nyid gnas lngar thim par gyur/ skya rengs 'char kha dang bstun sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sogs sgrub rdzas las rdor gyis btegs la dngos grub len pa ni/

hrīḥ ye shes lus can 'gran du med pa yi: gzi brjid sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshangs pa'i dbyangs la chos kyi char chen 'bebs: nus pa sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gzungs dran ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse yongs kyi gzhi: 'od gsal snying po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bum pa bzang : 'dod 'byung gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gdul bya so so'i mos pa ji bzhin du: thogs med 'jug pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srung dang zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs: thun mong las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mkha' spyod ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs sogs: khyad par grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshe dang yo byad 'dod rgu bsgyur la sogs: phyi nang dbang bcu'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mthong thos dran rig gdul bya smin cing grol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes dang rang gzhung byung ba'i dngos grub bskul tshig ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang bla med thugs dam gcig bsdus pa: byin rlabs gter chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rmad byung ting 'dzin 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ mthar sngags brjod pas gnas gsum du bzhag /rdzas rnams bza' btung byas te longs spyod pas/ stan thog de nyid du dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag gi tshul du thob par bsams la/ dgongs pa'i gdeng bzung ngo*/ gzhan don dbang bskur na rgyas bsdus gang yin pa skabs 'dir sbrel lo/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rjes chog phyi mtshams bkrol ba slob dpon la sku drin gsol zhing smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o/

dang po ni/ dngos grub blang ba kho na'am dbang bskur grub pa'i rjes su/ rnying ma spyi yi phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang las thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phyir zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg skabs 'dir bya srol yod pas grub na gal che'o/ lhag chog btang zhing sngar btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang lhan cig sgrub khang lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i sar bskyal/ de nas gnas nyul gtor ma'i nang du sngar lhag ma'i ras ma cung tsam dang*/ gser skyems thogs la/ hūm̐: ging chen bcu gnyis gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: rnal 'byor stangs 'byed ting 'dzin drod nyul ma: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bya ba mtha' ru phyin: lhag ma dang ni gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: om̐ dz+nyā na ghṛ wa kro ti satwaṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul nas badz+ra muḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rnams ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram rten bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo dmigs bsal byed na spyi tsam du/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di: bla med sku gsung thugs su rgyas btab nas: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel te: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra hrīḥ.āḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: stong pa'i go cha bla na med: chos sku skye med rdo rje yin: mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcom nas: chos kyi dbyings su rgyas btab pas: sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na: gnod byed bgegs kyis ga la mthong : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: om̐ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes rgyas gdab bo/ gnyis pa mtshams bkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal tho bzhi la zlum gtor bzhi sgo byang gnyis la dmar gtor re re dang*/ phyi mchod bcas bsham/ phyi rol shar gyi tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs phyi yi dung sgo phyes: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: zhi ba'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas lho yi tho rtsar phyin la mchod gtor rnams/ byin brlab sngar ltar ram bsdu na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs la/ om̐ bai rū dha kā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha'i tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs phyi yi gser sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs:

rgyas pa'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs phyi yi zangs sgo phyes: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: dbang gi las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs phyi yi lcags sgo phyes: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: drag po'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phye ru gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ 'byung ba rnams bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: nyi zla rlung sa 'byung ba bzhi: de ring dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: rgya yi gdams pa dkrol du gsol: 'byung ba rang byung mkha' la thim:

zhes rgya bkrol la gser skyems mchod/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: om̐ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ de yang khro bcu'i phur pa bsdu ba ni/ nang du sleb ma thag slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pa dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod la 'og gi phur bu'am nub kyi phur bu phyi ma lag gnyis skam pa'i rgya dang bcas/ om̐ badz+ra kī la ya ut+kī la ya badz+ra dha rod a dz+nyā pa ya te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: blangs te/ om̐ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā:

zhes phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas te dril bu dkrol zhing*/ ā kā ro? sogs sngags brjod bzhin 'jam rol bcas ras bris sam dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ rang lugs ltar na/ om̐ swa bhā wa laṃ san te hoḥ zhes rdul tshon bsdu'o/ gsum pa thog mar nongs bshags bya ba ni/ mched lcam rnams phan tshun du phyag byas la res mos tshul gyis/ hoḥ thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral te: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob ma dam mnos nas: kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la: mnyam nyid ngang las legs nyes dbyer med kyang : lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung las nyams shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: rnam dag bsam pas mi gnas tshig 'dis bshags: 'dzin med ngang du bzod par bzhes mdzod la: rang bzhin dag pa'i tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: a a āḥ de na rdo rje slob dpon la gtang rag 'bul zhing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thams cad kyi phyag bya lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal mchog ldan: gsung rab rgya mtshos lha mi'i 'dren pa'i dpal: yang dag don ston 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs: 'jig rten 'di na pha ma'i tshul du gnas: bka' drin bzang yang gnyen bkur rngo ma thog: sdom gsum bsrung bya dam tshig gang nyams kyang : nyes ltung sgrib par mi 'gyur 'dag bya'i phyir: mthol bshags bzod par gsol gyis tshangs par stsol: zhes zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bla ma spyi gtsug tu 'bral med bzung ngo*/ nongs bshags dang bka' drin gsol ba gnyis so/ spros med skabs ma byas kyang chog go /de nas smon lam spyi ltar gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ kye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes chos kyi dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos lhun grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog: 'di lta bu yi dkyil 'khor rtag tu brtson:

bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang : lu gu rgyud kyi 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshogs par smon: bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar: sa lam mthar phyin 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces rtse gcig pas yid kyis smon lam gdab/ khyad par mar me'i smon lam bya ba ni/ thams cad kyis lag g.yas su mar me dang g.yon du spos ring thogs la/ rgyal thebs pas stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len byas te/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dbu mdzad nas: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched dang lcam dral rnams: deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'khyams shog: gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi skye dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar gnas su mi ltung zhing : gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags shing : mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi phog shog: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin che ba dang : mtshan ldan gzungs ma rdo rje mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos 'chi ba'i dus bzung tshe: ma rig dbang gis 'khor bar ltung srid na: snang gsal mar mes ma rig sdug bsngal sel: nyon mongs dbang gis rigs drug gnas 'khyams na: snang gsal mar mes 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel: rgyu mchog 'di yi sa bcu yongs sgrol te: shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs phyir mi ldog par shog: snang gsal go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di: bde gshegs yongs la phul ba'i mthu byin gyis: sa bcu 'das te sa rnams yongs non shog: kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad+ma'i spyan: 'khor lo tshogs chen stug po bkod pa'i sa:

de wa ko sha kun bzang dbyer med sa: rdo rje sems ming lcang lo can gyi gnas: bla ma'i sa dang srid gsum gzhi rdzogs sa: rtsod bral lhun po'i sa la thig le yi: sa lam 'gro rnams ma lus lhun bgrod nas: gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don yongs rdzogs shog: ces dang rang lugs bka' brgyad kyi mar me'i smon lam gnyis gang bde bya'o/ gzhan yang spro na theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par rgya cher gdab pas/ dus gnyan pa'i phyir 'grub par 'gyur ro/ de nas zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs/ gzhan so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/ me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyis dge legs su bya'o/ kha skong dang las myur du 'grub pa'i sbyin sreg grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing gnas srung dang dga' ston sogs mtha' rgyas gzhan du bshad pa ltar ci 'grub byas pas phyin chad legs tshogs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ rig 'dzin bye ba gshegs pa'i shul/ /tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i thabs/ /so zur gnubs kyis bka' drin las/ /deng yang ma nyams bzhugs 'di rmad/ /'di bgyid nor dang ma 'brel sogs/ /'gal ba mchis la snying nas bshags/ /dge bas snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /'phel rgyas bstan 'gror btsas smin shog /ces pa'ang rang lugs tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi sgrub khog snang gsal sgron mer gzhir bzhag 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i rnying ma spyi 'gros sgrub chen khog dbub gcig shes kun grol las kha bkang ste tshe sgrub rnam bzhi bla ma zhi drag sogs spyi'i sgrub khog 'chi med bdud rtsi 'dod 'jo bum bzang zhes bstan 'dzin pad+ma phrin las kyis chog bsgrigs mdzad 'dug pa 'di bzhin deng dus bdag 'dra'i blo dman rnams kyis so so'i gzhung dang zhi drag gi rnam dbye lha sngags kha bsgyur dang rigs 'gres sogs tshul bzhin lag len thebs dka' bar brten gab 'khrugs bsal nas bklag chog tu bkod par gal che zhes rang slob ri bla karma'i mtshan can dang o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon kho nar sbyar chog pa'i dbang du byas te sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pa kho bo gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas rab byung bcu bdun pa chu rta lo nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes nyin dus sbyor dge bar bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling gnam lcags sgrub sde ru spel bas yi ge pa'ang bskul ba po phyi mas bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa 'di nyid 'phel rgyas yun du gnas pa dang 'brel thogs bde chen zhing du bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// slar yang thugs rje'i shugs dang byin rlabs dngos grub gzi brjid 'od du 'bar te sgrub rdzas dang ril bu la thim pas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug skur gyur nas gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro don mdzad pa phrin las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ri ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes bsnyen pa bya'o/ zhes pa bsnyen dmigs dgos zhes mchog sprul rin po ches bka' bzhin gang de'i thugs dgyes pa'i phyir/ bka' gyen du ma ldog par bum sgrub kyi thun mtshams su ār+ya dh+wa dzas bris te phul ba'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ chos sku ltar sgrub thabs ye shes snying po bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// // na mo gu ru dharma kā ya ye/ de yang thugs rje chen po'i rigs bdag chos sku'i sgrub thabs ni/ dang po dkyil 'khor bkod bsham sogs ji ltar bgyid tshul gter gzhung las/ dkyil 'khor las gzhung lta bu la: dbus su mtshan ldan bum pa ni/ dri bzang chu yis sum gnyis bkang : de steng bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : li khri byugs pa'i ril bus gtams: dar tshon sna lngas kha bcad de: rdo rje dag gis rgyas gdab bo: gang yang 'tshams pa'i gzhi yi khar: pad gzhong rin chen nang du ni: chos sku'i gtor ma zlum po la: ril bus bskor zhing rgyan bkra ni: mdzes tshon nyi zla nor bus spras: gdan yang pad+ma 'dab bzhi'o: gzhan yang phyi nang mchod rdzas bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'du bya la/ dngos gzhi nyams su len pa yang*/ de nyid las/ rang nyid bde ba'i gdan la 'khod: rnam snang rdo rje skyil krung bya: rang rig yid kyi mdung mo de: kun snang sgyu ma'i mkha' la gtad: mi rtog gnyug ma'i rten bca' ste: rtog pa rtsal sbyong bsgrub pa bya: zhes pa ltar phrin las dngos la 'jug par/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus mtshams par btang la/ skye ba kun tu sogs gsol 'debs rjes/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma bde chen zhing gi mgon po'i lha tshogs la phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ thog mar sngon 'gro la bzhi/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa bdag gnas yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ: mtshan ldan brdal khyab stong nyid e yi snod: āḥ rang byung snying po ye shes mchod pa'i rdzas: hūm̐: kun tshang yid 'ong zad med gter gyi mdzod: hrīḥ byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i sprin phung spros pa yi: haḥ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag yas 'geng ba'i tshogs: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig:

phaiṃḥ snang srid zang thal dkyil 'khor lha ru gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī ha ho phaiṃ phaiṃ: zhes phyi nang dkyil 'khor rnams dus gcig la byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi dang po la'ang brgyad/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu+ud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las e las rang byung nam mkha' 'byung lnga yongs su gyur pa las: chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa: rtse mor rin po che sna tshogs tog gis mdzes pa: 'ja' 'od thig le pha gu rin chen drwa bas legs par spras pa: de yi dbus su zla gam sgo gcig pa'i nang du: gyad dang seṅge rta mchog rma bya shang shang gis btegs pa'i khri yi steng du: pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru nyi zla kha sbyor gdan dang sa bon srog yig hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'ub kyis sdud: hrī la thim: hrī dran rdzogs ngo bo snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba: sku mdog dmar gsal dri med pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ltar gzi brjid cher 'bar ba: thugs rje'i spyan gyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs shing : zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa: lta ba mi shigs rdo rje'i gtsug tor 'khyil zhing mtho ba: gsal stong phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zung gis 'jug pa: mi 'gyur ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te: gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs mnga' 'od klong gong bu rab tu rgyas te: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi la ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi thig le zer phreng dang bcas pa'o:

de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing khams nas: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma skyes skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: mi shigs 'khor lo rgyas pa'i khri steng du: snang mtha' chos sku ye shes lha tshogs rnams: chu zla lta bur rnyog med brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med snying po sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kha dog bral yang ma 'gags sna tshogs 'char: kun rgyu shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba'i sku: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings rig 'od stong rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: ka dag dang po kun gzhi rig pa'i rgyal: skal bzang thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyad pa bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ hoḥ rang rig bla ma chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mtha' skor du: a mi dhe wa'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: lus kun khyab ste bde gsal mi rtog ngang :

'byung 'jug rlung gi rang sngags sgrog par gyur: rang rig bla ma 'od ma'i 'gyur ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng 'khor bas: lus phyi nang thams cad gang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag: slar yang 'phros pas snang srid snod bcud kyi tshe bsod bkrag mdangs thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas: thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim pas: gzi brjid dang mthu stobs rgyas shing : kun gzhi rgyu yi rig pa mngon du gyur

par bsam: bsnyen sgrub gcig dril gyi sngags ni/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags lhag chad med pa sgra ma nyams pa gces so/ gzhung las/ spros med bya na rang nyid kyi: phung po gzhal yas dkyil 'khor lha: rang byung rang shar ngang la bsgrub: sngags bzlas 'byung 'jug rlung gi sgra: 'gyu 'gros dag dang bstun te bzla: rang rig lta ba chos kyi sku: gang shar 'dzin med lhug par bsgrub: zhes gsungs pa ltar rlung bzlas rdor bzlas ci nus bya ba dang*/ mthar dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang du rang ngo skyong zhing mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /sham bu sbyar bar spro na gzhung chen mo ltar bya'o/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stongs tshig sogs spyi ltar dang*/ de nas tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la drug las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku gsum 'khor 'das zil gnon lha tshogs rnams/ /tshogs la gshegs shing gnas 'dir byin chen phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : bzhi pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams:

ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can/ /lhag la dbang rnams bka' yi pham phab bzhes/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍa ma ma bhak+ṣa si bha ling+ta khā hi/ lhag gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul 'dir bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings rig 'od stong rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: ka dag dang po kun gzhi rig pa'i rgyal: skal bzang thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: snang mtha' chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/

hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang : brtan bzhugs spyi ltar byas la/ lnga pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses bla ma chos sku ltar sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa zhes bya ba bal yul gsang sngags phur pa gling du gnam lcags gsang sngags ming gis smras rim bzhin 'phrul yig tu 'du byed po gi li gsang sngags kyis bgyis pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams yun du gnas shing ma rgan sems can rnams bde chen zhing du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa pad+ma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud/

de yang longs sku ltar sgrub pad+ma'i phreng ba nyams su len pa la/ gzhung las/ sngon 'gro las kyi rim pa ni: dben zhing spro la dge ba'i yul: bkra shis yid 'ong byin chags gnas: rgyud dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su: yar tshes dge ba'i nyin dag la: dkyil 'khor spyi mthun gzhung bzhin gdab: dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris: dkar ser dmar ljang lha yi mdog: tshom bu sa bon zhib tu bkod: mu khyud 'ja' 'od gur kyang bris: longs sku'i 'dra 'bag gsung rten bkram: bum pa rgyan dang sngags phreng bcas: rigs lnga me long shel rdo dang : dam rdzas sman raka phud kyang bsham: gtor ma rin chen nor bu'i gzugs: pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba la: 'khor yang bshos chung brgyad kyis bskor: rtse mor phyag mtshan mdzes tshon spras: gzhan yang phyi nang mchod pa bshams: zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyor ba lag len gyi rim pa sngon du song nas dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la 'jug par sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ de nyid las/ dang po skyabs yul sngon 'gro song nas: mchod pa byin rlabs la sogs gzhung chen mo nas blang : zhes gsal ba ltar/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la'ang drug /dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas:

ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor bsngo ba ni/ bgegs gtor byin rlob pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis dgug sarba bigh+nān na ma sarbghṛh+na daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro rgyal khrag 'thung thugs khros nas: phye mar brlag cing gtor bar gdon mi za/ /de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu dha dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom/ drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon:

yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dgu las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid zang thal klong : khyab brdal rang bzhin 'byung lnga bsnol ba yi: lhun grub gsal stong 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo rdzogs rgyan dang rta babs mdzes: rin chen tog mdzes 'ja' zer 'od klong gtibs: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshugs longs sku'i dbu rgyan la: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan dbyings la bskyod: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu thal mo sbyar: sku stod lha rdzas dar sngon rgyan gyis bklubs: sku smad dar dmar mdzes pa'i ang rag gsol: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs par spras: rdo rje skyil krung mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i tshul: snang stong 'ja' lus sgrib med gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: shar phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po kha sar+pa ṇi mthing : longs sku'i cha lugs mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin tshul: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐:

lho phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po sa snying sku mdog ser: dgyes bzhad mdangs mnga' longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas chos 'chad g.yon pas mnyam bzhag can: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal po dmar: mdzes chags 'dzum ldan longs sku'i rgyan spras ldan: phyag gnyis las kyi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: hūm̐: byang phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ljang : khro 'dzum mdzes ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas zil gnon can: zhabs gnyis gshib cing ldem pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: thams cad shel phreng pad dkar mdzes tshul bsnams: gsal stong gzi 'bar ma bcos lhang nger gsal: hūm̐: mtshams bzhi pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar sgeg mdzes pa mo: ral pa'i thor tshugs rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis spras: zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin mdzad: sna tshogs mdzes ldan 'greng thabs tshul gyis bzhugs: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: chu zla dang ni 'ja' tshon lhags pa ltar: gsal stong ma bcos spros bral ngang la bskyed: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min bde chen bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing khams nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la/

sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma skyes skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: mi shigs 'khor lo rgyas pa'i khri steng du: 'gro 'dul longs sku ye shes lha tshogs rnams: chu zla lta bur rnyog med brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med snying po sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kha dog bral yang ma 'gags sna tshogs 'char: kun rgyu shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba'i sku: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: zil gnon longs sku'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lhar/ /dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod/

brgyad pa dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang bla med thugs dam gcig bsdus pa: byin rlabs gter chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rmad byung ting 'dzin dzap kyis rgyud bskul la: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: dgu pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi/ thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar: sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas phyi nang sdig sgrib dag: lus kun khyab pas mchog thun dngos gru+ub thob: slar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod: tshur 'dus byin rlabs gzi brjid bdag la thim: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ yum gyi sngags/ oṃ ār+ya tā re tu re swā hā: gcig dril sgrub sngags ni: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus su bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig sogs spyi ltar bya/ de nas tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la drug las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis rlob pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku gsum 'khor 'das zil gnon lha tshogs rnams/ /tshogs la gshegs shing gnas 'dir byin chen phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

gsum pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : bzhi pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can/ /lhag la dbang rnams bka' yi pham phab bzhes/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍa ma ma bhak+ṣa si bha ling+ta khā hi/ lhag gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul 'dir bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: zil gnon longs sku'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lhar/

/dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod/ gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang : brtan bzhugs spyi ltar byas la/ lnga pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma
