bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses bla ma longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs pad+ma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcags shing ma hā gu ru pad+ma sam+bha wa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa dang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka'i rgyud lung man ngag rnams nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i gnas mchog rgyal po bal yul yang le shod ces bya bar rang gnas gsang sngags phur pa gling gnam lcags sgrub sde ru rab gnas chu pho rta lo'i nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes 6gi nyin sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pa phyogs nyul sprang po gu h+yas spel bas yi ge pa ni rang slob au ḍī ming can gyis bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/

// thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ sprul sku he ru ka rta nag lcags ral gyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs rab 'jigs rdo rje'i me phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang thugs rje chen par 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi sprul sku he ru ka ltar sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ gter gzhung las/ dang po bca' gzhi'i rim pa ni: dkyil 'khor mthing nag dal kyang bcag: thig gdab las rim spyi mthun bya: dbus su lte ba chos 'byung dang : phyi rol rtsibs chen bzhi ru bya: tshom bu lha mdog legs par bkod: gzhan yang sku 'bag rten sogs bkram: bum pa rnam rgyal rdzas kyis gtams: sman raka dang ni phyi mchod bsgrig: gtor ma zlum po zur gsum pa: lte bar chos 'byung gdengs ka can: pad 'dab bzhi dang gtor zur bzhi: legs par bskor te bhan+dhar bskyil: rtse mor me ri dag kyang 'dzugs: mthing nag gur phub spyan gzigs bkram: gzhan yang spyi mthun zhal shes gces: zhes pa ltar de nyid nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba'o/ thog mar spros pa bya na sngon 'gro longs sku'i cho ga nas blangs shing mchod pa byin gyis brlab: zhes gsal bas gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus mtshams par btang la/ skye ba kun tu sogs gsol 'debs rjes/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab/ de la dang po sngon 'gro la'ang bzhi las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang :

snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi dang po la'ang brgyad/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e nam mkha' mthing nag rgya gram rlung gis btegs shing 'byung ba bsnol brtsegs su chags pa'i steng du: bh+rūm̐ las sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod kyi bkod pa shin tu 'jigs pa: de yi dbus su bhan+dha skam rlon gyi pho brang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa:

bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag 'khrigs pa'i dbus su: paṃḥlas pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor cher 'bar ba: rgyal bsen pho mo gan rkyal du bsnol ba'i steng du: yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: dgra bgegs 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad: 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyil zhing : sma ra dang smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad lhang lhang 'tsher ba: thod skam gyi dbu rgyan: sbrul nag gi skra chings: dar nag gi cod pan sogs rgyan du mas spras pa: phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gri klad la phyar bas: dgra bgegs dum bur gtub pa: g.yon pas 'dzin byed me yi lcags kyus dam nyams gdug pa'i snying rtsa 'dren pa: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing : dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba: zhabs gnyis gyad kyis dor stabs bgrad cing dam sri'i snying khar brdzis pas sa gsum rab tu sngangs pa: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal bar gyur: gtso bo'i shar du dam sri dang pad nyi'i gdan la zhi ba'i rta mgrin dkar po: lhor gre bo dang pad nyi'i gdan la rgyas pa'i rta mgrin ser po: nub tu 'byung po dang pad nyi'i gdan la dbang gi rta mgrin dmar po: byang du klu srin dang pad nyi'i gdan la drag po'i rta mgrin ljang nag: de rnams kyang gtso bo'i cha lugs dang mthun pa: bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil du gsal ba'o: gtso 'khor rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas:

bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren zhing dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sgrub la dbang bskur byin chen phob: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes pas dbang bskur/ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gdan du: khro rgyal rta mgrin lha tshogs rnams/ dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal lha tshogs la/ gus pas bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal: che mchog dpal chen rngam mdzad pa: phrin las bzhi ldan 'grub par stsol: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod dbang po'i me tog dang: nang mchod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med 'di: dbang chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo: chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags mchog dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag gyur pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐:

gzhan yang rigs kyi bdag po chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: longs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku he ru ka dbang chen rta mgrin nag po dpa' bo lha lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma sring ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang rigs drug sems can thams cad dbang chen rta mgrin chen po'i lha tshogs gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi phul/ ham̐'u: dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis mchod pa'i bcud drangs te gsol bas: mnyes shing tshim par gyur te sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag sel zhing thugs dam bskang bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi:

zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung lhun grub pho brang nas: rig rtsal mngon gyur dpal chen he ru kaḥ mthu stobs gzi byin dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: phyi nang gdon tshogs 'byung po tshar gcod pa: dbang chen rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ brgyad pa snying po sngags kyi spro bsdu ni/ rang nyid dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs kar yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' bskor sngags phreng mgal me ltar 'khor bas/ lus kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas snod bcud brtan cing g.yo ba'i rang bzhin thams cad me ri dang khro bo'i rang bzhin du gyur: rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsa tur ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gcig dril sngags ni/ oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa kro ta pañca hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams lhag chad med par bzlas/ las sbyor sham bu sbyar na gzhung ltar bya/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig sogs spyi ltar bya/ ༈ gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la bdun las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis rlob pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis me rlung chu'i: bag chags 'khrud phyir tshogs la phog: bzang ngan sme bar 'dzin pa rnams: sbyangs bkrus gtor ba'i bdud rtsir bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ gsang chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: dbang chen rta mchog rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa:

'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can/ /lhag la dbang rnams bka' yi pham phab bzhes/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍa ma ma bhak+ṣa si bha ling+ta khā hi/ lhag gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod dbang po'i me tog dang: nang mchod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med 'di: dbang chen lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi:

gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung lhun grub pho brang nas: rig rtsal mngon gyur dpal chen he ru kaḥ mthu stobs gzi byin dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: phyi nang gdon tshogs 'byung po tshar gcod pa: dbang chen rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar byas la/ lnga pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses sprul sku he ru ka ltar sgrub kyi chog khrigs rab 'jigs rdo rje'i me phreng zhes bya ba 'di'ang gtso bo gter gzhung sor bzhag la sngon rjes rnams gzhung chen mo las blangs shing kha 'geng dgos pa rnams rang lugs rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus nas bsab ste kha bsgyur cung zad dang bcas mchog dbyangs rnam sprul sgo chen rgyal ba'i skyes mthar 'bod pas sprang ban gu h+yas dbang chen grub pa'i gnas mchog dur khrod lhun 'grub brtsegs pa'i nye ba'i char gu rus sgrub gnas a su ra'i brag phug dang 'brel ba'i rang gnas phur pa gling gi bsam gtan gyi khang bur rab gnas chu rta lor zla ba gsum pa'i tshes 9nyin sbyar bas yi ge pa yang rdo ban o rgyan gsang sngags kyis bgyis pas snying po'i bstan pa ring du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i tshe sgrub bklag chog tu bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma 'jam dpal dpa' bo la/ /btud de tshe sgrub cho ga'i khrigs/ /pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes rmad/ /'dir sdeb rjes gnang byin rlabs stsol/ de yang 'jam dpal dmar po'i tshe sgrub bklag chog tu bkod pa la/ gzhung las/ dang po sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bstan pa ni: tshe bum rnam rgyal kha rgyan mgul chings spras: myong grol sgrub sman rdzas kyis sum gnyis bkang : zhes pa ltar/ dbus su rnam rgyal bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings kyi spras par rab tshe sgrub rnam bzhi gang rung las bshad pa'i myong grol tshe rdzas ril bu'am ma 'dzoms na sman sgrub sel med kyis sum gnyis bkang ba'i steng me long la oṃ a ra pa tsa na: dbus la dhīḥbris pa'i kha bkab/ ma 'dzoms na tshe gtor bum gzugs nor bus mtshan pa kho na'i chog /g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du bhan+dha bdud rtsis gtams/ rgyab tu mda' dar bcas tshags su bya/ zhib par srog 'khor sogs tshad ldan bca' bar mos na gter gzhung la blta bar bya'o/ thog mar gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rung song nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab/ de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la'ang lnga las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang :

brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ swā hā: hūm̐: 'dzam gling khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sna bdun rnam lnga mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: sman gtor rak+ta spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: sku 'khor srog rten 'chi med bsgrub pa'i sman: bum pa gzhal yas bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams: sku gsum yig 'bru'i byin rlabs rab bskul nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ga lak+ṣa pā da dharma o ṇa a mṛ ta badz+ra hrī dha ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā: zhes phyi nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs byin gyis brlabs/ lnga pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med sku mchog rdo rje'i dal bzung nas: mi 'da' dam tshig snying gi srog lta bur: mi gtong bsgrubs te rtse gcig gnas byas nas: 'jam dpal tshe bdag go 'phang thob gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐: dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi dang po la drug yod pa las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/

hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐/ gnyis pa gzhal yas gdan dang lha gsal ba ni: hūm̐: e mthing nam mkha' rlung ljang rgya gram brtsegs: me mched chu khol sa gzhi ri rab brjid: de steng sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram steng : bh+rūm̐ las 'chi med tshe yi gzhal yas ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor tog: phyi nang mtshan nyid kun tshang rgyan gyis spras: srung gur pad+ma rdo rwa dur khrod dang : ral gri bsnol thabs me ri phyogs bzhir 'khrigs: phra mo'i rlung yang mi bgrod gzhal yas dbus: dhīḥyig dmar po gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: mkhas mchog gzhon nu shes rab 'jam dpal dbyangs: tshe bdag mgon po li khri dbang gi mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro 'dzum chags pa'i mdangs: dkar dmar mthing zhal spyi bor rigs lngas brgyan: rin chen rgyan ldan dar ljang stod g.yogs gsol: g.yas g.yon dang pos ral gri po ti phyar: bar gnyis rdo rje pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzin: mtha' gnyis mnyam gzhag 'chi med tshe bum bsnams: dar dmar smad dkris zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs: gsang ba'i yum mchog dmar mo dbyangs can ma: mda' dar tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gsal: phyogs bzhir tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: gzhon tshul gnyen lcug nu ma bha ga rgyas: lang tsho mdangs mnga' mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur bzhi: 'byung bzhi'i tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i tshul du gsal: gtso 'khor gnas lnga'i yig 'bru'i 'od zer gyis: dbyings rig 'od stong 'chi med pho brang nas: tshe bdag 'jam dpal gtso 'khor spyan drangs gyur: oṃ ā yur pa ti mañju shrī ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/

hūm̐: mi shigs 'od stong drwa ba'i pho brang nas: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: mi g.yo rdo rje nyi zla pad gdan steng : deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs su gsol: bdag cag rtse gcig sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: mos gus rab tu gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ā yur pa ti mañju shrī ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dzaḥ pad+ma kā ma la ye satwaṃ/ a ti pū hoḥ pratīts+tsha hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i gar ma gzugs: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya glu dbyangs gar: sgeg mo phreng ba la sogs yid 'ong gis: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs mchod par bgyi: rang byung snod mchog rin chen 'dzam gling khyon: legs par bkang ba'i sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: tshe bdag 'jam dpal lha tshogs mchod par bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin shrī singha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: yi dam tshe bdag 'jam dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba dbyangs can mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshe bdag mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: ḍāk+ki ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang snang srid rigs drug thams cad tshe bdag 'jam dpal gyi skur gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang gi srin lag gis bdud rtsi blangs te gnas lngar thig le bya/

'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub par bsgom/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag 'od gsal 'chi med klong yangs dbus: tshe bdag mgon po 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi phyed skyil bzhugs: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku la rab bstod pa: rtsa zhal dmar po chags mdangs mdzes pa ni: 'jam dpal gzhon nu tshe bdag mgon po'i brda: g.yas zhal dkar po 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa ni: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: g.yon zhal mthing nag dgyes la khro ba ni: bar chad tshe bdud ma rungs bsgral ba'i brda: dbu skra lcang lo spyi bor bcings pa ni: mi bskyod rigs bdag theg chen gter mdzod brda: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i brda: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa ni: dgos 'dod re skong dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: dar ljang na bza' stod la g.yogs pa ni: tshogs drug sna tshogs sgyu mar grol ba'i brda: phyag g.yas dang po ral gri phyar ba ni: shes rab mtshon gyis nyon mongs gcod pa'i brda: g.yon gyi dang pos po ti bsnams pa ni: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i brda: g.yas kyi bar pas rdo rje gdengs pa ni: 'khor 'das zil gnon ting 'dzin brtan pa'i brda: g.yon gyi bar pas pad phreng bsnams pa ni: thugs rje'i 'od zer 'gro drug 'dren pa'i brda: mtha' gnyis 'chi med tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mchog grub pa'i brda: sku smad dar dmar ang rag dkris pa ni: nyon mongs srid pa'i skyon gyis ma bgos brda: zhabs bzhi phyed skyil pad zlar bzhugs pa ni: tshad med bzhi ldan lam bzhi mthar phyin brda: mdzes pa'i sku la gzi brjid ldan pa ni: sku gsum ngang la 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: yon tan rab rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: dbyangs can dmar mo lang tsho ldan pa ni: ma dad log lta zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i dbus na 'gying ba'i brda: thugs rjes chags pas yab la gzigs pa ni: yid 'phrog gzugs 'dzin mchog gi gtso mo'i brda: mda' dar tshe bum mgul nas 'khyud pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang lam yin pa'i brda: nu 'bur bha ga rgyas shing bde drod ni: tsaṇ+ḍa gtum mo a haṃ bskul ba'i brda: zhabs gnyis zung 'jug sked la 'khril ba ni: mi zad dga' bzhi bde stong 'byung ba'i brda: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing brda skad 'byin pa ni: gsung dbyangs drug cus rig 'dzin sdud pa'i brda: rat+na'i rgyan dang dar dpyangs mdzes pa ni: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rtsa rlung grogs mo'i brda: sku la nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar ba: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod lam gyi sa mkhan brda: mtshan dpes rab brgyan dpa' mo'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: tshe 'dzin lha mo gar mo yid 'phrog bzhi: rdo rje tshe 'dzin dkar gsal mdzes pa ni: sa yi bcud 'dzin nad gdon zhi ba'i brda: rin chen tshe 'dzin ser gsal sgeg pa ni: chu yi bcud 'dzin longs spyod 'phel ba'i brda: pad+ma tshe 'dzin dmar gsal chags pa ni: tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba'i brda: las kyi tshe 'dzin ljang gsal bzhad pa ni: bdud bzhi tshar gcod tshe srog brtan pa'i brda: thams cad thor tshugs rigs lnga mdzes pa ni: 'byung lnga'i dbang bsgyur ye shes lnga ldan brda: phyag gnyis mda' dar tshe bum bsnams pa ni: phyogs bcu'i tshe 'gugs byin rlabs bskyil ba'i brda: nu ma bha ga rgyas shing ldem pa ni: dug lnga'i bag chags rang sar dag pa'i brda: mnyen lcug ldan zhing zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ni: ye shes rtsal bcus mkha' dbyings bgrod pa'i brda: 'od sku drwa ba'i rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ni: phyi nang dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i ma sring tshogs la bstod:

hūm̐: de ltar bla med brda bzhi'i bstod pa yis: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char chen phob: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje srog sgrub la: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad dbyings su gtor: mi shigs sra brtan g.yung drung gzhi tshugs nas: sra mkhregs tshe yi pho brang bh+rūm̐ stsol cig:

drug pa bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ston pa ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid tshe bdag 'jam dpal gsal ba yi: thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab drug steng : g.yung drung ljang gsal sra shing brtan pa'i dbus: nyi ma yar bstan zla ba mar phub pa'i: gwa'u kha sbyor nang du hrī dhīḥnṛ: ye shes rlung gi g.yo 'gul med par 'dzin: phyi rol pad+ma 'dab drug lte ba ru: oṃ dang a ra pa tsa na drug gsal: pad+ma nyi zla'i mtshams kyi mu khyud la: 'chi med tshe 'dzin yi ge dmar ser nyid: 'od zer dmar po'i phreng thag rnam par sbrel: 'byung 'jug rlung gis bskyod pas g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer de las gcig las gnyis mched tshul: rang lus gang ste sngags phreng zhal nas thon: yum gyi lam brgyud thugs ka'i mūm̐ la phog: gzi brjid cher 'bar sngags phreng mgal me ltar: chos 'byung gnas nas lte bar yar drangs te: bar med 'khor bas snod kyi gzi brjid dang : tshe bsod thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas su: snying kha'i hrī dhīḥnṛ yig la thim pas: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe srog 'grub gyur cig: rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ ā yur nṛ dhī muṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: sgrub sngags ni / oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ ā yur nṛ dhīḥtshe bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐: bdag gi tshe bsod thams cad rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe yi gwa'u sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ pad+ma rā ga ā yur ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: 'gro ba'i tshe bcud gzi byin dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig sogs spyi ltar bya/ gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la drug las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis rlob pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal tshe bdag lha tshogs rnams/

/zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /byin chen phob la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bzhi pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can/ /lhag la dbang rnams bka' yi pham phab bzhes/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍa ma ma bhak+ṣa si bha ling+ta khā hi/ lhag gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul 'dir bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs:

ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: 'jam dpal tshe bdag lha la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sku yi ye shes gzi brjid stobs dang ldan: gsung gi ye shes rdo rje'i sgra dang ldan: thugs kyi ye shes 'gro blo'i mun pa sel: sku gsung thugs mchog 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar byas la/ lnga pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/

zhes pa 'di'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses 'jam dpal dmar po'i tshe sgrub bklag chog tu bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba sor bzhag la sngon rjes rnams gzhung chen mo las blangs shing kha 'geng dgos pa cung zad gzhan nas gsab ste slob dpon bha su dha ra'i sgrub gnas yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub khang du sri zhur sgrub pa po gnam lcags pa 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba kun 'dul gyis bgyis pas gsang sngags 'gro 'dul dang gsang sngags ye shes rgya mtsho gnyis nas yig bris dang zhus dag gi mthun 'gyur mdzad pa 'dis kyang bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan zhing mdzad phrin phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs 'don khrigs su bgyis pa rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so// na mo ār+ya tā re ye/ bla ma dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ sgrub rten gtso bo'i sku brnyan sogs bkram pa'i mdun dbang bzhi spyi ltar bshams la/ mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ de nas gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho: ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen dpa' bo 'khor lo sdom pa la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

dus gsum rgyal yum sgrol ma rigs lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig 'dzin kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba 'debs po rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyi rlobs: snyan brgyud mthar phyin ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab lung zin sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dkyil 'khor slob dpon rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung lam 'byongs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang 'grub gyur cig: ces gsol ba btab: rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma 'phags ma stangs dpyal la phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la 'jug par sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la'ang bzhi/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs:

gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung lnga rnam dag pa'i: sna tshogs 'ja' 'od las grub gzhal yas khang : phyi nang zang thal ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: mtshan nyid bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'khor lo sdom pa khyab bdag he ru kaḥ mthing nag khro gtum rdo rje dril bu bsnol: thor tshugs rigs lnga rin chen rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyad kyi 'gros thabs bzhugs: gsang ba'i yum mchog rje btsun sgrol ma mthing : bcu drug lang tsho ldan zhing rigs lngas brgyan: rdo rje pad+ma yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril:

yab yum zung 'jug snang stong bskyed pa yi: khog pa'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: yaṃ dang a haṃ la sogs gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: mdun du chu rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma dkar mo zhi tshul tshe 'dzin ma: g.yas su sa rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma ser mo dpal bskyed sgeg pa mo: rgyab tu me rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma dmar mo dbang sdud chags pa mo: g.yon du las rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro ma: sgrol ma ljang mo bdud dpung 'joms mdzad ma: thams cad mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can: g.yas pas nor bu g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs kar tāṃ yig rang mdog lta bur gsal: hoḥ de ltar lha tshogs gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur: slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma spyi gtsug nas yar lud de snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma skyes skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: mi shigs 'khor lo rgyas pa'i khri steng du: 'gro 'dul sprul sku 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: chu zla lta bur rnyog med brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med snying po sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kha dog bral yang ma 'gags sna tshogs 'char: kun rgyu shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba'i sku: dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod bskang ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: phyi mchod sna tshogs mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dang :

nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod dang : sbyor sgrol tshogs mchod mthun pa'i yo byad tshogs: 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum rigs bzhi la: mchod pa 'bul zhing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub mchog stsol zhing : rtsa rlung dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: khyab bdag drug pa'i rnam rol 'khor lo sdom: in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs can 'khyug pa'i sku: bde stong gzi 'bar drwa ba'i dpa' mo 'khyud: dri za'i dbyangs can bskrun pa'i sgeg mos bskor: mkhyen brtse'i dpung chen rab bkod rgyas la bstod: bdun pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ thugs kar tāṃ yig ljang gu yi/ /mtha' bskor sngags kyis phreng bas bskor/ /'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas/ /snod bcud 'phags ma'i zhing du blta/ rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ tāṃ tu tā re swā hā: yum sngags ni/ oṃ ār+ya tā re tu tā re swā hā: sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sngags ni/ oṃ yaṃ dz+nyā na pañca tāṃ tu tā re dza dzaḥ

'dir thun min gyi rlung sgrub zab mo zhig 'dug pa zur du blta bar bya'o/ thun mthar bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya'o/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum re brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: khyab bdag drug pa'i rnam rol 'khor lo sdom: in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs can 'khyug pa'i sku: bde stong gzi 'bar drwa ba'i dpa' mo 'khyud: dri za'i dbyangs can bskrun pa'i sgeg mos bskor: mkhyen brtse'i dpung chen rab bkod rgyas la bstod: ces bstod/ gsum pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi: dam tshig nyams pa bshags shing gsos su gsol: gzhan yang so thar nyan thos bslab pa yi: khas blangs dam 'gal bag med bshags su gsol: mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings 'od stong 'khyil ba'i klong yangs nas: zab rgya'i dbang phyug kun 'dus 'khor lo sdom: gsang mdzod rig pa'i gter chen shes rab sgron: 'ja' lus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bzhi bskur thob shog: oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ tāṃ tu tā re pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang zhing brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya'o/ lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ rang byung sgyu ma bdag med stong pa'i klong : brdal khyab gnyug ma 'khor 'das ye grol lha:

ma 'gags shar grol ye shes ngang la gshegs: a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs par bya'o/ de yang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses sgrol ma rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs 'don khrigs su bgyis pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang ma hā gu ru'i sgrub gnas a su ra'i brag phug dang 'brel ba'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i ngo mtshar thugs rjes snang brnyan chu bur mig gis mngon gsum du mjal du yod pa'i sgrol ma rang byon zhes bya ba'i nye 'gram g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling du sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pas khrigs bsdebs su rab gnas chu rta lo'i nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes 6gi nyin spel ba yi ge pa ni rdo bla au ḍī ming can pas bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/ // rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum phyi gsal nang gsal dar mthing gi gur phub pa lta bu'i sku dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chu shing gyi ldem bu ltar du drang ba/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ mthing zhun gyi khu ba ltar sngo ba/ til gyi zhun me ltar gsal ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa la 'khor lo lnga dang bcas gsal btab bzhin bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan du bzung la/ de yi tshe dmigs pa ni rlung gi ngo bo tho rangs sgrol ma dkar mo 'od du zhu ste chu rlung dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam zhing sngar bzhin bum can dang bar rlung bzung ba la ci nus su 'bad par bya'o/

des zhe sdang gi rtog pa 'gag: sku yi yon tan thams cad rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de bzhin du nam langs sgrol ma ser mo: 'od du zhu ste sa rlung ser po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam: des nga rgyal gyi rtog pa 'gag: yon tan gyi nyams rtog thams cad 'char bar 'gyur ro: nyin phyed yab yum gyi rlung zung 'jug 'od du zhu ste nam mkha'i rlung mthing kha'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam: des gti mug gi rtog pa 'gag: thugs kyi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gyur ro: phyed yol sgrol ma dmar mo 'od du zhu ste me rlung dmar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam: des 'dod chags kyi rtog pa 'gag: gsung gi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gyur ro: srod la sgrol ma ljang mo 'od du zhu ste rlung gi rlung ljang gu'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam: des phrag dog gi rtog pa 'gag: phrin las kyi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gyur ro: thun lnga la rlung brgya dang bcu yan chag med 'dzin/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ phyag rdor pha rol 'joms byed kyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs log 'dren klad 'gems gnam lcags thog char bzhugs so// bla ma thugs mchog gsang bdag rdo rje gtum por phyag 'tshal lo/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ phyag na rdo rje pha rol 'joms byed kyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs su spel ba la chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de la dang po sgrub pa bca' bsham gyi rim pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ mthing nag dal gyi lte ba ru:

gnam lcags 'khor lo rdo rje bris: de steng bum pa bdud rtsis gtams: rdo rje me long tsakli bzhag: dar nag gur phub srog sngags gzugs: bhan+dhar chos 'byung bsnol ba'i steng : dpal gtor zlum po zur gsum la: 'khor lo me ri'i rgyan kyang brgyab: spyi mthun mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsham: zhes gsal bar gsungs pas slar ma spros la/ thog mar gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus 'tshams par btang la/ skye ba kun tu sogs gsol 'debs rjes/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ de yang nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim pa la gnyis kyi dang po bzhi/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dngos gzhi la drug gi dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i lha bskyed pa ni/ hū?m̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid drag po'i zhing : gtum drag 'byung ba rim bzhin bsnol mar brtsegs: sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod me dpung klong : bh+rūm̐ las sra mkhregs gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog: de dbus nyi zla ti ra bam chen steng : mthing nag hūm̐ la gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhan+dha skam po'i rigs lnga dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcings lhu tshigs brgyan: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la: za byed rngam pa'i khro bcu me ltar 'bar: g.yon pas me yi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu+u las: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal:

hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pa'i drag sngags can: g.yas pas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i byad ma 'joms par bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer las: gsang bdag gtum po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gsum pa spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dbus: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas pho brang dbus su bzhugs: sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: phyi mchod sna tshogs mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod dang : sbyor sgrol tshogs mchod mthun pa'i yo byad tshogs: gsang bdag gtum chen ḍā ki rigs bzhi la/ mchod pa 'bul zhing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub mchog stsol shog /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ aḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/

oṃ aḥhūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po pha rol g.yul 'joms kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: byad bzlog khro mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag shul rngam pa'i dpa' stobs gar dgus brgyan: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs: las la chas byed srog bdag khro mo'i tshogs: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms mdzad bzhi la bstod: drug pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me dpung nyi ma 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: phar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: yang 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs 'joms: tshur 'dus snod kyi gzi byin thim: slar yang khro mo 'khor la phog: rab 'phros pha rol byad kha bzlog: kun kyang gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: gtso bo'i bsnyen pa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo'i sngags: oṃ kro ti baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtum po'i sngags grub rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla: khro mo las su rung tsam khri yis chog: skabs su las sbyor byad bzlog gi sngags sbyar bar spro na/ hūm̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he kro ta kā la so na tsakra lo hi tsakra raṃ ṭi tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: oṃ badz+ra kro ti ma tri baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha raṃ ha la ya pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bzlog sngags ni: hūm̐ trig rā dza ya thun bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la rbad: raṃ ha la mā ra ya bh+yoḥ

dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: krag had pa nā ga ya bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: shag rak+ṣa rbad tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bh+yo dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bh+yo dun bh+yo thun bh+yo rak+sha bh+yo byad ma rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ gnyis pa la bcu/ dang po tshogs byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bla med spel: tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ dharma shud+dhe āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod pho brang nas: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po la: sprul pa bka' skyong srung mas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa skong bshags ni/

hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: gsang bdag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag sor chud nyes ltung bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs yig brgya brjod/ lnga pa bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐: lcags khang nang du ru tra mngon sum gsal: mchog gsum bden pas dgra bo'i gzugs la phob: phur thun mtshon cha 'bar bas bsgral gtubs nas: dpal chen gtum po'i lha tshogs zhal du mchod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing smon lam gdab/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan gnas nyul lhag sdud ma: mi sdug gzugs 'chang dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: sha khrag la dgyes ging chen laṅka srin: lhag ma 'di bzhes gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ ma tri rak+sha ṇa yak+sha u tsi ta kha kha khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen sol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka kro ti shrī tsaṇ+ḍa a i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: brgyad pa chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang me ri 'bar ba nas: lha srin sde dpon dregs sdes khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: ma rungs dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ta kro ti he ru ka la yak+sha ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma skyong ba'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan spras gar sgyur gtor ma longs: 'dzam gling 'di ru bdag gnas yul gru'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bkra shis spel: om̐ ma ma ting ting rak+mo rak+sha i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas:

dam sri bsgral nas gtor bro rdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo nas rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bdun/ dang po dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang snying po bla med he ru kaḥ gsang bdag gtum po'i sku gsung thugs yon gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la dbang bskur stsol: mchog thun dngos grub 'dod rgu thob gyur cig: oṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta ghu ya gu h+ya sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blang*/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ phyi mchod sna tshogs mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod dang : sbyor sgrol tshogs mchod mthun pa'i yo byad tshogs: gsang bdag gtum chen ḍā ki'i tshogs la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ aḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi/ gsum pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzhi pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: yang dag ye shes dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: skye med ngo bo rang byung stong pa'i dbyings: ma skyes lhun grub chos dbyings mkha' la thim: snod bcud gzugs snang sgyu ma'i ngo bor ldang : a a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas:

gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: smon lam sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses phyag na rdo rje pha rol 'joms byed kyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs log 'dren klad 'gems gnam lcags thog char zhes bya ba 'di'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba sor bzhag la sngon rjes rnams gzhung chen mo las blangs shing kha 'gengs dgos pa cung zad rang lugs dpal chen dreg pa zil gnon nas kha bkang ste bltas chog tu bkod pa 'di yang tshe rabs du mar rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i bstan zhabs su skyes shing mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa lung zin ār+ya dh+wa dza'i skyes mthar 'bod pa'i ku su lu gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang gis zhal snga nas bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal zhes ming gi cod pan spyi bo'i rgyan du bstsal zhing zab gter ring lugs 'di nyid 'chi kha'i srog mthud kyi byed po khyod la bab pas ces kyang mi nub rgyun 'dzin dang nyams pa slar gso'i thabs la 'bad dgos zhes rdo rje'i bka' stsal 'gom par ma nus shing bstan par sri zhu dmigs pas zab gter dpe rgyun gang bzhugs dpe skrun dang 'brel 'dir thugs rje chen po'i yan lag chos sde rnams cung zad chog khrigs su gdab pa 'dis kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs zag med kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa dang*/ bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu rta lor hor zla gsum pa'i tshes 10ma hā gu ru'i o rgyan rgyal khams su bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus tshes khyad par can gyi snga snur du grub par bgyis pa'i yi ges ris su 'du byed po'ang rang slob o rgyan gsang sngags dang zhus dag pa ri bla karma'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//

// thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po dril ba bzhugs so// thugs rje chen po'i lha la 'dud/ de ltar rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro ni/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang bas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sku phyag rgya bskyed pa'i rim pa la gsum las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub pa la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ e hoḥ ye nas ka dag mtha' dbus bral: zang thal dmigs med rgya yan pa: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gnas: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na saṃ bha trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ gnyis pa kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ hoḥ rang byung rol rtsal sna tshogs shar: kun tu rtog bcas rtog med kyi: dran rig stong gsal 'gag med 'phro: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/

hoḥ rang bzhin lhun grub ngang nyid las: ma bcos spros bral rgyu yi hūm̐: kun gzhi khyab brdal dbyings la shar: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ti baṃ dharma hrīḥ.āḥ e sa ra ṇa: yam̐ ha ra ṇa: ram̐ tsakra ṇa: kham̐ ha ra ṇa: sum̐ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa: keṃ swa bhā ṇa: bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa: ma sūr+ya ṇa: a tsan+d+ra ṇa: pam̐ pad+ma ṇa: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ bzhi pa rten dang brten par bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: oṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hoḥ sna tshogs lnga ldan khri 'phang steng : ma bcos longs sku thabs kyi mdog: mnyam bzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: shes rab rdo rje pad+ma 'khyud: zung 'jug ngang la phyed skyil gsal: cod pan dmar ser mnyam bzhag can: hoḥ tshogs brgyad rnam shes gnas dag pas: mthing ser dmar ljang tshad med bzhi: longs sku gar stabs rgyan ldan mdzes: shel phreng pad dkar phyag rgya bzhi: 'byung bzhi rdo rje dung dmar 'khyud: rigs bzhi tshad med sgo skyong ma: ma bcos gdod nas de ltar gsal: gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ lhun grub rang shar lha tshogs gtso 'khor gyi: thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar: sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas phyi nang sdig sgrib dag: lus kun khyab pas mchog thun dngos gru+ub thob: slar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod: tshur 'dus lha mi'i gzi brjid bdag la thim: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: snying po ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ yeng med chu bo'i rgyun ltar ci nus bzlas/ gsum pa thugs 'od gsal de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: mnyam bzhag chos sku'i lta ba dang ma bral bar ci nus su rang ngo bskyang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bus ngang slar ldang nas/ dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas:

ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ spyod lam sgyu ma lta bus lam khyer la slob/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab pa ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / zhes rgyun khyer nyams su len bde 'di ltar dgos zhes rang slob au ḍī ming nas ched bskul ngor gter gzhung kho na bcos bslad med par gu h+yas bsdebs te sbyar ba dge'o// ༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈༈/༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa lam bzang gsal snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang thugs rje'i gter chen 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi/ bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa la bzhi/ rang don bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga phrin las kyi byang bu dang*/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan don gnas lung gi cho ga /gnyis ka'i don du mtha' bsdus tshogs kyi mchod pa'o/ dang po la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ gzhung las/ 'phags mchog byang chub sems dpa' yi: zhabs kyis bcags shing dben pa'i yul: yid 'ong dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal: g.ya' gangs sam ni ri yi sul: yang na sa gzhi pad+ma'i mthil: 'dab brgyad rgyas pa lta bu'i sa: gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs: shin tu yid 'ong lha yi gnas: rnam rgyal khang bzang lta na sdug: legs bkod mdzes pa'i dbus shed du: rnam g.yeng bag med rab gzhom nas: mthun pa'i rdzas dang cha rkyen bsags: dkar zhing 'jam pa'i sa dag la: dkyil 'khor bcag cing thig gdab bo:

tshon dang lha mdog tshom bur bsgyur: sku rten bkram zhing mchod rdzas bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ 'phags pa'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar dkyil 'khor kheb ldan steng thugs rje chen po'i sku rten bkram pa'i mdun dbus su bla gtor gdan zlum po sum brtsegs khar phyogs bzhir rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa gzhan yang g.yas g.yon du chad brtan 'bul gtor sman raka rig 'dzin srog sgrub sogs bsham pa'i mdun zhi ba'i nyer spyod/ mchod rdzas rgyan rdzas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du bya la/ bde ba'i gdan la 'khod nas/ rang mdun du las bum ḍā dril 'thor nas nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i chas rnams tshags su tshud par bya'o/ thog mar sngon 'gro skyabs yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ na moḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan: chos sku snang mtha' mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: dmar gsal gzi brjid mdangs ldan lham me ba: 'ja' lus mi shigs rdo rje'i sku ru bsgom: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du: thugs rje chen po dkar gsal shel gyi mdog: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: sna tshogs rgyan ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur bsgom: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du: gu ru pad+ma he ru ka pa'i chas: rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer 'dzin: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: rgyab tu nyi zla pad+ma'i khri steng du: ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar mo yum chen tshul: sna tshogs rgyan ldan ral gri glegs bam 'dzin: 'dzum mdangs phyed skyil dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: mdun du pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i steng : dbang chen rta mgrin mthing nag ber chen gsol: ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin cing dor stabs bzhugs: rtsa gsum skyabs yul lnga ldan lha tshogs la: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskor: ma skyes 'ja' tshon gsal stong sku ru bsgom:

na mo: chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas: dug lnga bag chags brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: gnas lugs mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rang byung zhing khams nas: bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams nas: ma dad 'khrul snang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: pad 'byung rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab spyod bde chen drwa ba'i zhing khams nas: mtshan 'dzin phung po brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: ye shes mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs: rtsa rlung bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs: gtum drag me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas: rta mchog dbang chen sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi'i bar chad sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog pad+ma shel gyi sgrub phug nas: dam chos zil gnon rgyud la gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya gnyer gtad drag po'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong gza' mchog rgyal por gsol ba 'debs: bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs: gdung bas rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: ma gyur pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog:

ces dbyangs snyan pos gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la'ang bcu/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba la/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ skyabs yul mchog gsum brgyud pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thams cad 'od zhu snang mtha'i sku la thim: snang mtha'i gnas gsum yig 'bru 'od du zhu: rang la zer 'phros sgo gsum bag chags dag: dbang bzhi rdzogs nas dbyer med chu thim ltar: sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu mngon gyur cig: ces pas skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par bsam/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor bsngo ba ni/ bgegs gtor byin rlob pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rta mchog khro rgyal dbang chen gyi: thugs ka'i zer las pho nya dpag yas 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ kro ta hūm̐ gardza ya: gnod byed 'byung po aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma kha phyir bsgyur la/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro rgyal khrag 'thung thugs khros nas: gzi byin stobs kyis drag po'i mtshon char 'bebs: phye mar brlag cing rdul phran bzhin du gtor: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu dha dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom zhing ting 'dzin brtan pa'i ngang la/ drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bdun pa sman raka gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: glang chen rta mchog khyi dang ba glang sha: mchog chen māṃ sa mi yi sha la sogs: dri chu dri chen dmar chen byang sems rnams:

dung khang rdo rjes bsrubs pas bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: dung dmar snod du rak+ta rba klong phyur: zhag g.yo kyu mo lang ling rba rlabs phyur: an dza mu la mu ṭa pad+ma dang : 'bri mog rgya skag rang byung 'byung ba'i khrag: mkha' dbyings rak+ta dmar chen bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: rin chen las grub gtor snod yangs pa'i dbus: dam rdzas bha ling bshos bu ri ltar spungs: dbang po lnga sogs dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: mdangs ldan bcud mchog rgyas pa'i gtor kyus bskor: rmad byung gtor mchod bla med mchod rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes pas bdud rtsi dkrug cing bdun nam gsum gyis sbyang*/ brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang mtha' yab yum byin phob cig: ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: spyan gzigs yab yum byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig: mi 'gyur longs spyod pho brang nas: yi dam lha tshogs byin phob cig: dam tshig gsang ba'i pho brang nas: ma sring mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: thogs med las kyi pho brang nas: dam can gter srung byin phob cig: rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs byin phob cig: hūm̐: thugs rje gzi byin spungs se spung : nus rtsal dbang bskur sha ra ra: bkrag mdangs 'ja' zer kyi li li: gnas 'dir 'od dpung thibs se thib: dkyil 'khor gzi brjid ta la la: sgom pa'i lha tshogs sangs se sang : ma bsgoms ting 'dzin lhun gyis grub: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan: dgu pa brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/

hūm̐: skye med ka dag zhal mjal phyir: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'thib sgo bcad: zang thal rig pa'i 'char sgo phyes: gsal stong de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis 'dzin mnyam pa nyid du bshags: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta bas mchod: bla med ye grol chen por bstod: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya badz+ra a ti pu ho dz+nyā na shud+dhe hūm̐: bcu pa dam bca' bzung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong nyid ting 'dzin ngang can gyi: rang bzhin rtsal las longs spyod rdzogs: 'phags mchog dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dran rig mi gtong de bzhin sgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes pas dam bca' drag po 'dzin par bya/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: ye nas ka dag mtha' dbus bral: zang thal dmigs med rgya yan pa: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gnas: thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na saṃ bha trām̐ hrī āḥ gnyis pa kun snang rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ āḥ rang byung rol rtsal sna tshogs shar: kun tu rtog bcas rtog med kyis: dran rig shes pa phra mo 'gyu: stong gsal 'gag med lam gyis 'phro: oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dharma: gsum pa rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang nyid las: ma bcos spros bral rgyu yig hūm̐: kun gzhi khyab brdal dbyings la shar: 'od gsal klong dgur sa bon bh+rūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ.a hoḥ bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ hūm̐: e las chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram ljang : ram̐ las ye shes me ri dmar: kham̐ las chu yi dkyil 'khor sngo: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi dkar: keṃ las rang byung ri rab brjid: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas gsal: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ti ra baṃ dharma hrīḥ e sa ra ṇa: yam̐ ha ra ṇa: ram̐ tsakra ṇa: kham̐ dha ra ṇa: sum̐ tiṣ+ṭha ṇa: keṃ swa bhā ṇa: bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa: ma sūr+ya ṇa: a tsan+d+ra ṇa: paṃ pad+ma ṇa:

badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ lnga pa rten gzhal yas bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rnam bzhi mdzes: ka ba brgyad ldan bcu drug gdung ma bres: dral lcam thog steng rin po che las grub: sna lnga'i rtsig pa 'dod snam lha mo'i gar: pha gu drwa phyed g.yer kha'i sgra snyan sgrog: mda' yab pu shu sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rta babs bzhi ldan chos 'khor nyi zlas brgyan: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dar dpyangs 'phur: 'ja' 'od thig le zer thag bkrag mdangs rgyas: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa pad+ma'i phreng : ye shes me dpung srung ba'i gur bcas gsal: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa: snang gsal 'od 'khyil nyi zla'i gdan khri'i steng : thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon sku: dkar gsal 'od sku shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi 'bar lham me ba: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: rin chen sna tshogs snyan rgyan mgul rgyan spras: g.yas g.yon mnyam gzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: stod g.yogs lha rdzas mthing kha'i dar yug gsol: sku smad phyed skyil dar dmar ang rag bklubs: phyag gdub zhabs gdub ga shal dar dpyangs mdzes: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyangs can sku la 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: lcang lo thor tshugs dar ljang cod pan 'phur: rus pa'i rgyan dang phyag gdub zhabs gdub mdzes: rdo rje pad phreng yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis bde stong zung 'jug sked la 'khril: snang stong lhun grub ma bcos ngang la gsal: yab yum spyi gtsug sna tshogs pad zla'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: dmar ser mnyam gzhag skyil krung ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i khri 'phang du: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog mthing :

rat+na spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ser: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dmar: karma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ljang : bzhi ka 'gying bag brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: rin chen phyag gdub zhabs gdub rus pa'i rgyan: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan nor bu pad+ma 'dzin: gsang ba'i rig ma 'byung bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: sngo ser dmar ljang rin chen rgyan kun rdzogs: lcang lo thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis bde chen sku la 'khril: thabs shes mtshan dpe gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gros lcags kyu pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen mkha' 'gros zhags pa nor bu 'dzin: pad+ma mkha' 'gros lcags sgrog dung dmar 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gros dril bu me long 'dzin: thams cad gar stabs rgyan ldan ling nge ba: nyon mongs bdud bzhi dug lnga khegs par bsgom: gzhan yang phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: gsal snang 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rang bzhin ltar: 'dzin med zang thal ngang nas gsal bar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas yi dam 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ drug pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas/ hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po gshegs su gsol: rnam dag lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: 'phags mchog longs sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas: thugs rje'i bdag nyid rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: tshad med rnam thar sgo 'byed pho brang nas: sgo skyong phyi nang dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol:

oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: sra brtan mi shigs sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya: skyon bral yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs pa: lhun grub rang byung pad+ma nyi zla'i khrir: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgyad pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas lugs skye med rang byung ngo bo'i rtsal: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'khor 'das zil gnon 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ dgu pa phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul yid 'phrog mdzes ma 'phro: lang ling gang ba mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu pa nyer spyod lnga yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin dga' ba'i mdangs ldan ma: dbang po rnam lnga'i reg byas tshim mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ bdag lus phung po ri rab maṇ+ḍal la: rtsa 'khor ye shes lnga ldan tshom bus brgyan: dug lnga rnam dag rang rig maṇ+ḍal 'di: mchog gsum skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bla med byang chub bde dge'i mthu stobs kyis: 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol shog: bcu gnyis pa rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo nor bu glang po rta mchog mdzes: btsun mo blon po dmag dpon rin chen 'di:

thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra sarba swa na ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la sa mu dra āḥhūm̐: bcu gsum pa bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rin chen gdugs dang bum pa dpal be'u rgyan: 'khor lo pad+ma gser nya chos dung sgra: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ maṅga la ku ṭa badz+ra bha me dz+nyā na s+pha ra ṇa āḥhūm̐: bcu bzhi pa gar gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gar sgyur brda skad bde ba'i sgra sgrogs ma: glu ma gar ma ging mo sgeg pa mo: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ mā l+ye lā s+ye gīrti nīrti badz+ra pra mo ti āḥhūm̐: bco lnga pa sman mchod ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum yangs pa'i snod mchog bhan+dha ru: bdud rtsis khengs pa'i mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi:
