bcu drug pa bdud rtsi sman mchod mchog ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ka ni srid gsum yangs pa thabs kyi snod/ /pā ni shes rab rtsa brgyad stong sbyar rdzas/ /la ni bde stong zung 'jug 'chi med bcud/ /sor bcu rigs lnga yab yum ngo bo nyid/ /sbyangs spel bsgyur zhing bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod/ hrīḥ rigs kun khyab bdag chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rab 'byams bde gshegs sku dngos spyan ras gzigs/ /rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs grub dbang pad+ma 'byung*/ /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ e waṃ zab gsang smin grol gdams pa'i mdzod/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro gter brgyud la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ skad gnyis smra ba bud+dha dz+nyā na'i mtshan/ /bka' bab tshig brgyud mchog gi brgyud pa la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ gter gling mi 'jigs mchog gi sprul sku sogs/ /shog ser brgyud pa gsang sngags sdong po la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mchog gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po che/ /byams mgon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/

ye shes bzhi po mngon gyur grub pa'i gzugs/ /'gag med rmad byung rigs bzhi yab yum la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ tshad med rnam bzhi bde stong rol pa'i rtsal/ /ye shes sgo skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ bka' gsang yang zab gnyan po'i lde mig 'dzin/ /gza' klu lha yi btsan rgod 'khor bcas la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ /sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ gzhan yang snang srid thams cad 'phags pa'i sku/ /sgra grags yig drug dran rig spyan gzigs tshogs/ /'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo grub gnyis char 'bebs stsol/ /sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ /'bru gsum yi ge sku gsum sa bon mtshan/ /gnas gsum dbang bskur mchog gi dngos grub thob/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ bcu bdun lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dung chen snod du rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil: bla med gsang mchod mkha' dbyings bdud rtsi 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bco brgyad pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum nyi zla yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: brjid chags bha ling dkar dmar rgyan ldan 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu dgu pa bstod pa ni/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can: mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku: me shel mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'khyud pa'i dpal: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' 'od dpag med: rtog med chos sku'i spyan rtsa phyogs bcur gzigs:

ma rig nyon mongs gzhom pa'i 'dzum mdangs can: 'od gsal ngang tshul mnyam bzhag skyil krung mdzad: dus gsum mtha' yas mgon gyur lham me ba: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla med 'od gsal rdo rje lta ba'i sku: ting 'dzin sna tshogs drwa ba'i gar sgyur ba: longs spyod rdzogs sku thugs rje'i gter chen po: legs par 'byin pa'i dbang po 'phags mchog sku: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku: shel dkar mdangs ldan 'dzum bag spyan rtsa 'khyil: ral pa'i zur phud thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan: nor bu snyan rgyan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i dar mthing stod g.yogs gsol: rin chen sna tshogs mgul rgyan gdub bu 'khrol: dar ljang ga shal sna tshogs se mo do: phyag g.yas 'od zer rdo rje shel phreng dkar: g.yon pas bde stong pad dkar yu ba 'dzin: dar dmar ang rag smad g.yogs rgyan mdzes bklubs: rdo rje skyil krung thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: zil gnon thugs rje chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shes rab rang byung bde stong bskyed pa'i yum: mdangs ldan rā ga 'od stong gzi 'bar ba: mdzes 'dzum chags la gsang ba'i brda skad sgrog: thor tshugs lcang lo sil bus sku rgyab gnon: rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan dbyings su bskyod: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan 'phyangs khro lo lo: rus pa'i chas mdzes g.yer kha si li li: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas shes rab pad phreng chun po bsnams: bde ba'i rang bzhin nu ma bha ga rgyas: zung 'jug ldan phyir zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: gsal stong 'dzin med drwa ba'i rnal 'byor ma: dbyangs can lha mo dbyings phyug yum la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi rim pa bzhin: rnam thar bzhi ldan tshad med ngo bo nyid:

shar phyogs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku: rnam snang spyan gzigs in+d+ra nī la'i mdog: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: tshogs lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: rnam snang spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: lho phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku: rin 'byung spyan gzigs swa na sa snying mdangs: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog ser mo mā ma kī: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: sbyor lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: rin 'byung spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku: snang mtha' spyan gzigs pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug gos dkar mo: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: mthong lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: pad+ma spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: byang phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: don grub spyan gzigs sgra gcan rlung gi mdog: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan 'gying bag gar stabs can: rin chen dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: nor bu pad+ma thabs shes phyag rgya can: gsang ba'i yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma ljang : rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: sgom lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa:

don grub spyan gzigs yab yum la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi tshad med bzhi ldan sgo skyong ma: rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i: zhi ba'i rang bzhin dkar gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: lha bu'i bdud bcom lcags kyu pad+ma 'dzin: byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: shar sgo lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i: rgyas pa'i rang bzhin ser gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: phung po'i bdud bcom rin chen zhags pa 'dzin: snying rje tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: lho sgo zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bde bar lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa'i: dbang gi rang bzhin dmar gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: nyon mongs bdud bcom lcags sgrog dung dmar 'dzin: dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: nub sgo lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sdug bsngal lta ba ma spangs gnas dag pa: drag po'i rang bzhin ljang gsal 'dzum ldan ma: mnyen lcug gar stabs nu ma bha ga rgyas: 'chi bdag bdud bcom dril bu me long 'dzin: btang snyoms tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: byang sgo dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor phyi nang khor yug la gnas pa'i: ging dang laṅka ma sring gnas nyul ma: phra men la sogs skyong ma bye ba 'bum: yang 'khor phrin las sna tshogs grub mdzad pa'i: pho brang 'bar ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab pa'i lha: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: gzi byin phrin las gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: sems can sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i dus la bab: mtha' yas sems can 'dren pa'i dus la bab: mtha' med 'khor ba stong pa'i dus la bab:

nyon mongs rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor bshig pa'i dus la bab: dug lnga'i bag chags gtor ba'i dus la bab: las ngan rnam smin byang ba'i dus la bab: rigs drug sa bon bsreg pa'i dus la bab: sgo lnga'i skye sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: thugs rje'i byin rlabs lcags kyu myur du phyungs: mtha' yas sems can 'gro drug ma lus kun: sdug bsngal rab dben phyir mi ldog pa'i lam: rnyed de 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub gyur nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sbubs su mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: rtsa ba gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags la 'jug pa la/ dang po dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hrī hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dbye/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa yi/ /gnyis ka'i thugs srog yi ge'i mthar/ /sngags phreng sgra bcas 'khor ba las/ /'od zer dpag yas 'phro bar gyur/ bsnyen rkyang skabs 'di mi dgos kyang*/ sgrub pa dang dmigs gsal dbang bdag 'jug gnas 'dren sogs kyi skabs ye shes rtsal 'bar gyi tshul du mdun bskyed dbye la bdag mdun dus gcig bya ba yin pas skabs phyed par bya'o/ gnyis pa dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang bla med thugs dam gcig bsdus pa: byin rlabs gter chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rmad byung ting 'dzin 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: gsum pa bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rta mgrin dmar po pad+ma bhañja bsnams pa:

de'i thugs ka'i 'od klong du zla dkyil hrīḥyig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal bar byas: thams cad kyi thugs srog sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad mchod cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod: 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud ye shes thams cad bdag la thim pas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal zhing brtan par gyur: gnubs chen rnam 'phrul dri med kun dga'i thugs chen nas so/ de nas rtsa sngags bsnyen pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes pa'i sgra rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin rtsa sngags bye ba bzlas: de nas las sngags ni: oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ las sngags 'bum ther ro: sa ma ya: dzap byang rgyas par spro na/ hūm̐: ka dag rang byung chos sku ngo mtshar che: rang rig lhan skyes gnyug ma'i lha zhal mjal: bde gsal mi rtog 'dzin med lhag ge ba: chos sku snang mtha' kun bzang logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ bhi dh+wa swa bhā dharma hūm̐: hūm̐: ma skyes klong nas rtog med 'gyu ba yi: grags stong ngo bo zang thal lam gyis rtogs: stong gsal dbyer med ma bcos sa le hrig: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ dz+nyā na lo ki shwa ra hūm̐: hūm̐: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i rig pa so mar gnas: shar grol ngo bo 'dzin med rjen ne ba: sangs rgyas sprul sku byang sems logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ saṅgā bo dhi kun+dha hūm̐:

hūm̐: ma 'gags rtsal chen dbang po'i gzhu lta bu: shar ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar: gsal la ris med mtha' gnyis ngo bo stong : legs par rtogs mdzad dran rig skyes bu'i mchog: dbyings kyi rang bzhin gzhal ba'i yul las 'das: dpag yas khyon gyi bkod pa lhug par rdzogs: smra brjod bral ba'i dmigs med rgyun gyis phyug: ci bzhin mkhyen pa'i dgyes mdzad rang rig sems: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor logs na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hṛ da ya badz+ra sa ma ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes sku gsum rang byung lhan skyes kyi ngang la snying po grags stong bsam blo bral bar rang rig lta ba'i rnal 'byor gyis shugs la bzlas/ las sbyor zhi ba la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ nyon mongs bdud bzhi dug lnga las gyur pa'i bag chags ngan pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes gdag /de bzhin rgyas pa la rtsa sngags sham du/ ye shes lnga dang rtsa rlung thig le thams cad rgyas shing tshe bsod nams thams cad 'phel bar gyur cig: oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

dbang la rtsa sngags sham du/ snang ba dbang du 'dus shing snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bran du 'byung bar gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la rtsa sngags sham du/ sngon las 'phral rkyen dang byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: hūm̐: mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces las bzhi rim bzhin shes par bya'o: sham bu rnams ni khri tsho dag tu 'don: de ltar bsgrubs pas 'jig rten dbang phyug gi: lha zhal mjal zhing go 'phang thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum re'i mjug tu stongs tshig 'bul ba ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: sgrub pa'i skabs thun gtor 'bul bar spro na gtor snod du thun gtor bzhag la: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: thugs dam bskul phyir rgyan ldan mchod pa bzhes: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod: zhes thun gtor 'bul la rgyun mchod du med kyang rung*/ bdag 'jug bya ba la gnyis/ dang po bshams bkod ni/ ras bris maṇ+ḍal steng*/ 'bru tshom lha grangs ltar bkod/ dbus lding khri'i khar bum pa mgul chings dkar po bum rdzas so lngas bkang ba kha rgyan gseb tu thugs rje chen po'i sku tsaka kyang gzug /thog tu thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du chos sman chang sbyar bkang ba'i steng du me long chang gis brlan pa la sin+dhu ra brdal te chos 'byung bris pa'i lte bar mūm̐ḥha ri ni sa bris pa bkod dar dmar gyi gur phub me long dang shel rdo dar sna lnga lha tsaka rnams bkod/ nye logs su chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i dam chu/ mig dar/ me tog bgegs gtor sogs dang rang rang mdun nang mchod rdor dril sogs nyer mkho tshang bar bya la/

gnyis pa sgrub mchod ni/ las byang brgyud 'debs nas bzung bsnyen bstod mthar dbang sgrub bdag 'jug gnas lung sogs kyi skabs su 'dir rnam bum sgrub pa ni/ dung chu bum pa'i khar bzhag la/ gzung thag 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ bdag lhar gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang bum nang gi thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'phros nas gzung thag gi lam brgyud bum lha'i zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma tshe dang ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad dang*/ sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi tshul du tshur 'dus/ dkyil 'khor mu mtha' med par yongs su khyab snang srid la phog pas rigs drug sems can kun gyi tshe rabs kyi bag chags sgrib gnyis sbyangs te sku gsum bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su bkod/ ye shes lnga yi yon tan cig car du rdzogs par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ de ltar sngags phreng rnams lu gu rgyud sbrel ba ltar 'phros nas bum pa'i lha la phog ste thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar bsam/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can:

khro bo rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum re'i mjug tu stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ bum chu bkye la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ gsum pa bdag 'jug dngos la maṇ+ḍal phul/ spro na bgegs bskrad bya/ bsdu na hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ om̐ tsak+ṣu āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐: zhes mig dar 'chang me tog gtad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma nyid: rdo rje slob dpon rigs kyi bdag: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: bdag 'jug bka' stsal zhu ba'i rten: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang: zhing khams yul zhing chung ma bcas: 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya dang: grangs med 'jig rten dang bcas te: 'dzam gling 'di ru bkod nas kyang: maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bkram pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na: dbang bskur rjes su gnang bar stsol: om̐ badz+ra bhū mi i pa maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: maṇ+ḍal phul/ skyabs semams sdom gzung ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do:

sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung : hoḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po yi: dam tshig srog ltar srung ba 'di: snying la ye shes lha rnams gnas: dam nyams rnams la gshin rjer 'gyur: om̐ lo ha biṣatshas ha la i dan+te swā hā: dam chu myangs/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du : rang nyid skad cig gis hrī las thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku mdog dkar gsal 'od du 'bar ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi zer las shel phreng dang pad dkar yu ba 'khril ba longs sku'i cha byad can mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa: sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing : zhabs phyed pa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa: yum dbyangs can ma dmar mo dung dmar mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: de yi spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag thog ma'i mgon po sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs pa: phyogs bzhir thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon la: sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba sku che ba ri rab tsam chung ba nas 'bru tsam/ yang sprul rdul phran tsam/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin byon nas sib sib thim par mos shig om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rdo rje rgya gram bya/ om̐ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces mig dar bsal/ thams cad kyis me tog mtheb srin bar du bzung la/

om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā yu ṣe swā hā: me tog spyi bor bkod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ hūm̐: bum pa longs sku'i gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des sku yi dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas gsung bhan+dha thogs la/ bhan+dha bde ba chen po'i pho brang du bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i dkar dmar byang sems bhan+dhar 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha ye shes 'khor lo lnga: byang sems 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: sngags dbang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des gsung gi dbang thob ngag gi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad bzlas brjod dang rlung sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par byas so: de nas thugs kyi dbang me long ngam dkyil 'khor gang rung thogs la/ gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i shes rab ma snyems ma'i ngo bo pang du 'khod par bsams la/ hūm̐/ 'di bsten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi lam/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /dga' bzhi ye shes rgyas par shog /karma mu dra dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes 'du shes sum ldan gyis rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba brtan par bsams la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā kau3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs su lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad bde ba chen po thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ deng phyin chad yid ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ de nas rigs lnga'i tshom bu dang shel rdo thogs la/ hūm̐: snang stong lha sku grags stong sngags: dran stong shes rab ye shes sku: sna tshogs gsal stong ngo bo nyid: ngo sprod tshig gi dbang bskur ro: om̐ dharma swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sgo gsum chags mnyam gyis bsags pa'i bag chags dri ma dag lam khregs chod thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: sa gzhi spos sogs? bsod nams 'di yis? ༈ bdag 'jug rgyas par mi spro na/ dbang bskur gnas 'dren rab gnas sogs la 'brel ba'i tshe rgyas par bya na bdag 'jug len pa yin yang bsdu na rig pa'i me tog dor ba 'di tsam gyis chog gsungs pas/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/

/phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ dbang bskur gyi tshe bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs kyang gnang ba zhu ba 'di ni nges par bya dgos so/ gong gsal 'di bzhin gsang chen snga 'gyur gong ma'i phyag bzhes te bka' gter yongs kyi chings yin pas phyag len tu thebs pa gal che'o/ ༈ gsum pa gzhan don gnas 'dren bya ba ni 'og tu blta bar bya'o/ bzhi pa gnyis ka'i don du tshogs mchod bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir gsol kha spyi dang bye brag thugs rje chen po'i sgos srung rnams grub nas spro na na raka skong bshags sogs spyi ltar byas la rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan 'dren yan song*/ de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhes lan gsum gyis sbyang : dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhan+dha lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar khengs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bhi sho dha ya bh+yo bhi sho s+pha ra ṇa me gha āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang snang mtha' chos sku'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang byung lhun grub 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon longs sku lha tshogs rnams:

zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs ma 'gags drwa ba'i pho brang nas: sprul sku rig 'dzin pad 'byung lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs yon lnga ldan zhing khams nas: thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi yab yum rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnam thar bzhi ldan tshad med pho brang nas: rigs bzhi sgo ma ḍāk+ki'i tshogs bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ngo mtshar bkod pa lhun grub pho brang nas: bka' sdod srung ma dam can gter bdag rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lha tshogs rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u g.yer kha si li li: rus pa'i rgyan ldan gar thabs shigs se shig: snang glu brda skad ldem 'gros khyugs se khyug: thugs rje'i nus rtsal byin rlabs sha ra ra: tshogs la gshegs shing gnas 'dir byin chen phob: dbang bzhi bskur la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ:

gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bya ba'i rim pa ni/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs spyan gzigs bsham: rol mo dbyangs snyan dri zhim bcas: kun tshang 'byor ldan bgyis nas su: skong bshags cho gar 'bad par bya: sa ma ya: dang po thugs dam bskang phyir spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje sprul sku sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mi shigs 'khor lo pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: gdung shugs gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: lta ba rang rig ka dag mngon gyur pa'i: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags rtsal chen ngo bo so sor rdzogs: longs sku spyan gzigs yab yum thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes thabs mkhas gang 'dul der ston mchog: he ru ka pa sprul sku'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi sdug bsngal 'joms: rat+na spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi sdug bsngal 'joms: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : phrag dog rnam dag lha min sdug bsngal 'joms: karma spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gti mug rnam dag byol song sdug bsngal 'joms:

bud+dha spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : ser sna rnam dag yi dwags sdug bsngal 'joms: kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sa khams rnam dag mngal skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs dam bskang : chu khams rnam dag sgong skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen mā ma kī yi thugs dam bskang : me khams rnam dag drod skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen gos dkar mo yi thugs dam bskang : rlung khams rnam dag brdzus skyes sgo gcod ma: yum chen dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: byams pa tshad med tshogs lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong lcags kyu dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : snying rje tshad med sbyor lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang : dga' ba tshad med mthong lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong dmar mo lcags sgrog thugs dam bskang : btang snyoms tshad med sgom lam mtha' ru phyin: sgo skyong dril bu ljang mo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: 'dzam gling dpag yas khyon ltar 'gengs pa yi: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos ma dang : glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin ma: mchod sprin lha mo spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med mchod pa'i sprin:

ga ṇa longs spyod mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: dngos 'byor sna tshogs snang stong mchod pa'i sprin: ḍā dril bla med grags stong so so'i skad: yid sprul blo bral kha dog brjod las 'das: don dam gnas lugs rang byung mchod sprin 'dis: snang mtha' 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku he ru ka pa'i thugs dam bskang : rigs bzhi 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi lha mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sel gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐ bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ngang la sbyor: bsgral du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ka dag zang thal chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags zang thal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:

longs sku spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : ma bcos spros bral gnas lugs ngo bo nyid: sprul sku yab yum rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : tshad med bzhi ldan rnam thar lam 'byed pa: rigs bzhi sgo ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor srung zhing mu ran skyong mdzad pa: yongs rdzogs lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med gzhi yi bskang : mchod du med de 'gag med lam gyi mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ro gcig sbyor: bsgral du med de 'khor 'das gnyis med sgrol: bshags su med de blang dor bral bar bshags: brjod du med de rang byung chen por gsal: bcol du med de khams gsum stongs par mdzod: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med dam 'gal dbang gyur pa'i: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal sngags bzlas sgra zur nyams: mchod rdzas phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : lo zla dus kyi skong bshags mchod pa chad: so thar khas blangs bslab sdom dam tshig nyams: sbyor ba 'dod sred sgrol ba zhe sdang skyes: ting 'dzin ma rtogs tshogs drug 'khrul par 'khyams: nga bdag ru tras bdag gzhan dge ba bcom: rigs drug sems can pha mar chags sdang bsags: zang zing rgyu la dge bcu zong du bcug: rang 'dod ched du sangs rgyas sku la smad: snyan grags 'dod phyir gsang sngags khrom du gtor: rang bslu dkor sdud dge 'dun ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor khas blangs nyams: bag med dam 'gal le lo rnam g.yeng sogs: mi dge'i sdig ltung ci mchis mthol lo bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs:

bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la ma bcos bzo med shes pas bshags/ drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni/ tshogs kyi tha ma gtor snod du bzhag: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang phyag rgya sngags dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma'i liṅga 'di dang gnyis su med par khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: ka dag chos sku'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin thugs rje'i sa bon 'phros: gnas 'gyu dran rig phur bu 'di: khyab brdal gnyug ma'i ngang gis bsgril: rtsol ba gzhom pa'i stobs kyis 'debs: sgrol cig ma rig bdud la ya: gtub bo dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: ye shes chen po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya ha la pañca mā ra ya rbad rbad: brgyad pa gtub cing 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ blo 'das khyon ltar yangs pa'i zhal phyes shig: rgyud drug dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: a 'thas 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: byang chub 'thob phyir dgyes par bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: dgu pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas chen mchog: rmad byung yon tan kun tshang 'di: 'dir 'dus ya mtshan gnang bar stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ gzigs shig gsang gsum bla med chos: ro gcig ting 'dzin zas mchog 'di: bzang ngan blang dor bral bar spyod: rtog med ye shes a la la hoḥ zhes tshogs la rol zhing dga' ston dgyes tshul rgya che bar bya: bcu pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po'i phud bdag bla ma yi dam lha: bar du tshogs la ma sring mkha' 'gro dgyes: tha ma lhag sdud dbang phyug laṅka ging :

dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can: la la dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshul: la la dam tshig mkha' 'gro sha za'i tshul: la la sman mo dur khrod ma mo'i tshul: la la bud med rgas shing 'khogs pa'i tshul: la la mdangs ldan sman shar btsun mo'i tshul: la la yid 'ong mdzes ldan bran mo'i tshul: la la 'dod sred smad tshong nag mo'i tshul: la la srin mo dur khrod 'dre mo'i tshul: la la 'bar ma yams bdag ma mo'i tshul: la la gcan spyang dur bya sha rngam tshul: sku mdog ma nges don la chos sku yi: klong las sprul pa'i ma sring phra men ma: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing ro la za: skyems bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing rgyu ma 'dren: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhan+dha thogs: rnal 'byor drod nyul rtogs pa'i stangs byed ma: sgyu 'phrul dbang gis mi bzad skur ston tshogs: dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma dam tshig can: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇ+ḍi ma bhak+ṣa si i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag stobs bcu 'gyed pa'i lha: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang snang mtha' yas: rol pa las byung 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: rang bzhin dbyings nas thugs rjes skur bzhengs shig: bdud bzhi nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: bdag 'dzin ru tra 'joms pa'i dus la bab: dug lnga'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma dag rigs drug 'dren pa'i dus la bab: 'khor ba'i sa bon skem pa'i dus la bab: srid 'khor skye sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: bskul lo thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i rtsal phyungs shig:

du ma ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khams gsum stong zhing sdug bsngal byang gyur nas: bla med 'bras bu thob pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hiḥ bcu gnyis pa chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog tu: thog ma'i sangs rgyas dbyings phyug yab yum gnyis: ris med chos sku'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: dug lnga zil gnon 'gyu bas khas blangs bzhin: rang rig lta ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbyings rig zang thal phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og tsit+ta ri bo tā la ru: spyan ras gzigs dbang dbyangs can rig ma gnyis: rtsal snang longs sku'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: phyi nang ro gcig tshogs drug khas blangs bzhin: kun tu shes pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ka dag khregs chod mngon pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og brag dmar ār+ya pa gling du: rig 'dzin chen po pad 'byung yab yum gyis: slob ma'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: dkyil 'khor bka' gtad kha byang 'bogs pa'i tshe: ma sring srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: mthun rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byin chen thugs rje mngon pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sbas yul pad+ma shel phug gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum gling pa gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnyis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: gza' klu gter srung khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: tha tshig dam la gnas pa yi: rin chen gter gyi srung ma'i tshogs: sngon gyi khas blangs ma g.yel bar: dam tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍāk+ka ḍāk+ki sarba bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor du:

dam tshig bka' la bzhag pa yi: 'jig rten skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: ma sring ya ma bcu gnyis po: sna tshogs ma nges rta la chibs: phyung rdeg mtshon cha phyag na thogs: lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang ldan: sil snyan g.yer kha'i sgra chen sgrog: rgyangs glu bshugs sgra di ri ri: dur khrod gnas brgyad nyul mdzad ma: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang srung : dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs: bod khams skyong mdzad bcu gnyis kyis: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le taṃ taṃ dza dza i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bcu bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe dbang chen mkha' dbyings su: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: mtshan 'dzin ru tra rtsad nas bshig: de 'og zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: rigs bzhi ging chen bro brdungs pas: log lta bar chod rdul du brlag: da lta rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bro: dam sri bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: drag sngags nus stobs bro rdung ngo : g.yas pa za byed khro bo'i bro: g.yon pa gsod byed ma mo'i bro: gnyis med he ru ka pa'i bro: dug lnga'i bag chags mgo la chem: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ ru tra satwaṃ bha ya nan: a mu ka satwaṃ bha ya nan: ha la pañca satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya satwaṃ bha ya nan:

zhes 'khrab cing rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan/ de nas gtor gzhong kha yar slong zhing me tog 'thor/ bco lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med klong yangs chos dbyings pho brang nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin chen rgyud bskul la: 'chi med tshe dpal 'dzad med nor gyis phyug: zab chos rgyas shing snyan dang grags pa'i gtam: khams gsum dbang sdud mthu stobs rtsal gyi mchog: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: mchog thun thob cing dbang bzhi bskur du gsol: oṃ gu ru rat+na ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ dbang blang zhing dngos grub zhu/ bcu drug pa tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mda' dar dang tshe chang thogs la/ hūm̐: tshe yi bdag po 'chi med dbang gi lha: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: 'ja' lus rdo rje tshe yi srog sgrub cing : rig ma mkha' 'gro ḍāk+ki mched lnga yis: steng 'og phyogs bcu kun gyi bcud bsdus la: sgrub po'i lus la 'od dpung ltem gyis thim: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na pad+ma dha ra hrī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes dbang blang zhing tshe dpal thams cad 'dus par bsam/ rjes chog la bdun/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: zil gnon longs sku'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza khā hi: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lhar/ /dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod/

gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya'o/ bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ klong yangs rgyal ba rab 'byams longs sku'i zhing : sna tshogs sgyu ma cho 'phrul dkyil 'khor lha: rang byung rang shar rig pa'i klong du bsdu: skye med ka dag zang thal ngo bor āḥ lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag zhes pas dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ yis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ ho: bsngo bya chos dbyings ye grol lta ba'i klong : bsngo byed gnas lugs dran pa rig pa'i rgyal: bsngo yul 'khor 'das bdag gzhan blo las 'das: bsngo 'bras ka dag mtha' bral ngang du bsngo: dmigs med bsngo bas 'khor gsum yongs dag shog: drug pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bdag 'dzin ru tra srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: myong bzhin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rigs drug tshogs: legs par sel mdzad sa gsum skye dgu'i mchog: mgon mdzad rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra yi: go 'phang grub ste don gnyis mthar phyin nas: ma 'ongs rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs par shog: bdun pa bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag rang rig mngon gyur bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su bkra shis shog:

yi dam bkra shis rta mchog dbang gi rgyal: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mas: rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis ki kang rā hu las: dgra bgegs tshar bar gcod pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis gsang ba 'od ldan mas: zab gter mthar phyin rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis pad+ma shel gyi phug: gnas brtan byin chen 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog: lo yi bkra shis sra brtan lcags glang lo: brgyud 'dzin mi g.yo brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: zla ba'i bkra shis spre'u byang chub lo: bshad sgrub spel ba'i yul gling bkra shis shog: zhag gi bkra shis nyer lnga chu tshod rta: gegs med mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: zhal rgyas bkra shis zla tshes bcu yi nyin: sngags bstan gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis brjod cing bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ gsum pa gzhan don du gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bag chags sbyong byed bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ thog mar yo byad bsag pa la/ mtshan byang bye til yungs dkar sbyong chas/ me long khrus gzhong las bum zas bsngo mar me sogs 'du bya/ gnyis pa cho ga dngos/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po brgyud 'debs nas brtsams sbyor ba dngos gzhi'i cho ga las byang bzlas pa yan song nas/ 'dir las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bya bar spro na/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ yig ge drug ma'i mthar/ sham bu ni/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btags pa bzlas pas/ bum sgrub ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus: bh+rūm̐ dang paṃ las bum pa gzhal yas khang : kha khyer rgyas shing mgrin pa ring la mdzes: lto ba che la mchu ni rab tu 'phyang : zhabs mthil zhum ste pa tras rnam mdzes pa: le brgan dkar dmar zung gi chun po spras: sgro phod mdangs ldan dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing : gzungs thag sna lnga rdo rje'i cod pan mdzes: snang gsal 'od 'byin me long la sogs pa: kha rgyan rten 'brel bla med rdzas mchog gsal: nang ni gzhal yas bcud ni yi dam lha: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar lhags: snang stong so so'i thugs kar hrīḥmuṃḥmathar: rang sngags sgrogs shing thugs dam bskul bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ga lak+ṣa a mṛ ta dhe wa ga na sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa swā hā: zhes bum pa sgrub/ de nas gzungs bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum du skad cig gis thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gsal ba'i sku las dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe/ ma ṇi pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta/ dha ri sha ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ su pra bhe bi ma le sā ga ra/ gam+bhi re hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bud+dha bi lo ki te/ gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā/ pad+mo dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas mthar mchod cing bstod la/ mchod yon gyi chu phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gi gsol kha dang bshags skong sngon du song bas tshogs byin rlabs nas drang ba'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ de nas gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga dngos la 'jug pa ni/ dang po rang nyid sngon 'gro skyabs yul gsal gdab la/

na mo: ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la skyabs su mchi'o ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams rnam dag ri bo tā la nas: 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la skyabs su mchi'o 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par gyur cig: mkha' spyod ye shes dbyings kyi gzhal yas chen po nas: pad 'byung yab yum sku la skyabs su mchi'o tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog: thugs rje 'od klong mi shigs pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi'o ngan song las sgrol cig: ma skyes gsal stong rdzogs pa'i pho brang chen po nas: yongs rdzogs 'gro mgon rnams la skyabs su mchi'o byin rlabs myur thob shog: gnyis pa tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong ba ni/ na mo: sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing las ngan srid pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig: sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dam pa'i mchog don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od gsal rdo rje theg chen gyi 'bras bu dang ldan par gyur cig: sems can thams cad ma rig gzung 'dzin gyi rgyu re dogs bag chags kyi ngan goms nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la ji srid kyi bar du gnas par gyur cig: gsum pa dmigs rten mdun du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsang chu 'thor: hoḥ mdun du pad+ma'i gdan la tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad can phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad rdzogs par gsal bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra rū pa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ bzhi pa rnam shes 'gugs pa la rang nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje chen por gsal te hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ hoḥ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du song ba'i chaiga'i rnam par shes pa srid pa gsum gang du gnas kyang rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig:

oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na hūm̐ dzaḥ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs su gyur pa: snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pas: bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'am 'das ma'i chaig mo'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra nṛ a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥs rnam shes lan gsum gyis bstim/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūm̐: gis sdig pa bkug nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa/ rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam pa rten la thim par bsam/ lnga pa bgegs dang phral ba ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: drug pa 'gugs pa ni/ oṃ sarba bhū ta rā dza ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: gnod byed 'byung po za 'dre shi gshed rigs: srog gcod dbugs sdud tshe len bla khyer dang : gson bdud gshin lcags thar lam gegs byed pa: tshe 'das 'di la gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs kun: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ gtor ma gsum rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba sogs lan gsum gyis zhi ba/ ting lo dang changs bu g.yon du bskor zhing*/ sum+bha ni gsum gyis drag po/ rang nyid rigs kyi khro bo gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang bcas/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro thar lam gegs byed na: bdag nyid khro rgyal dpa' bo thugs khros nas: gti mug gzhom phyir rdo rje ser chen 'bebs:

nga rgyal rtsad gcod rin chen phur bu 'debs: 'dod chags rab 'joms pad+ma zangs gri bsnun: phrag dog gtor mdzad las kyi drag sngags brdeg: dpa' bo brtul shugs stong khams me yis 'geng : kun rdzob don dam nyi zla cha lang brdeb: gzi byin stobs kyis nga bdag ru tra 'joms: gar dgu theg chen hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: nyon mongs tshogs skem phaṭ sgras sa gsum bsngang : che btsan mi bzad 'bar ba'i rtsal phyung gi: de bas bgegs rnams rang rang gnas su dengs: na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta he ru ka h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ ghṛ ha na ghṛ ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ghṛ ha na pa ya ghṛ ha na pa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a na ya ho bha ga wān bhū ta rā dza mā ra ya gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces phye mar sbyongs shing thun gyis brab cing gu gul kyang bdug /brgyad pa tshe 'das bla rten bca' ba ni/ hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: mtshan byang 'di la lus kyi bla rten chos: rol mo 'di la ngag gi bla rten chos: mar me 'di la sems kyi bla rten chos:

gdugs phran 'di la gos kyi bla rten chos: smyug ma 'di la srog gi bla rten chos: pad+ma 'di la sdod pa'i bla rten chos: 'dod yon 'di la zas kyi bla rten chos: rin chen 'di la rgyan gyi bla rten chos: dar thag 'di la grogs kyi bla rten chos: bla ma lha la skyabs pa'i bla rten chos: tshe 'das rnam shes rten du pheb pa bcu: sa bcu lam lnga bgrod par 'dun pa bskyed: ma rig las kyi bag chags sbyang slad du: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs chos shig: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ dgu pa sdig sgrib bsreg pa ni/ g.yas g.yon du me/ chu/ mdun du til cung zad bcas 'du bgyis la/ til srin mdzub dang mthe bong gi bar la thogs te/ phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ ho tshe las 'das pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ gyis mtshan pa'i rlung gyen du g.yos: lte 'og ram̐ la phog ste me rab tu 'bar: snying khar las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i paṃ nag po de: ye shes kyi me yis ded nas ro rkyang gi lam la brgyud de shangs sgor bslebs pas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pa can du gyur nas sbyong byed til la thim par gyur: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ye swā hā:

yi ge brgya pa sogs brjod de til la phu btab: de nas sngags re re dang sbrags nas til mer bsreg: ho skad cig gi mdun du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gdan gyi steng du: he ru ka khro bo rdo rje nag po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can du gsal ba'i zhal du til gsol bas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong zhing bsreg par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: lan gang rung gis/ oṃ badz+ra a wa ra ṇa ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra rā ga he sha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra mo ha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ma hā tsar+ya ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a ri sha ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ sarba ha la pañca ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ a su nṛ tri pre du ye kha kha khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: ho 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe dus las 'das pa chaig mo'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bcu pa khrus bya ba ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor sogs rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sku khrus gsol/ hūm̐: chos kyi sku la kha dog mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das lus kyi bag chags sbyang slad du: thugs rje sprul skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos kyi gsung la sgra zur mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das ngag gi bag chags sbyang slad du:

longs spyod rdzogs skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos kyi thugs la skye 'gag mtha' bral yang : tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du: ka dag chos skur khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: yang dag chos skur phyi nang ris med kyang : tshe 'das dug gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: nyon mongs rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas spyi khrus 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'od gsal bla med chu: dbyings rig ka dag thugs rje'i klong : byin rlabs ting 'dzin khrus bstsal bas: gnas lugs ye shes don rtogs shog: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza a dhiṣ+ṭha na a be sha ya ho bhi dh+wa na ye swā hā: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib bral phyir/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐: rnam dag lha rdzas las grub 'jam legs mdzes: rang byung ye shes lnga yi dar tshon gyis: rgyal ba'i sku la byi dor 'di bgyis pas: tshe 'das las kyi bag chags dag gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya wāk+ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: khrus chus slar bum pas ming byang ngam rten la bkru zhing*/ hūm̐: 'di ni me long ye shes chu: zhe sdang dri ma sbyang slad du: snang stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: shes sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni sor rtog ye shes chu: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang slad du:

grags stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: bag chags sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te wāk+ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes chu: gti mug sgrib pa sbyang slad du: gsal stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: las sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes chu: nga rgyal sgrib pa sbyang slad du: bde stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rmongs sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ka te ghu ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bya grub ye shes chu: phrag dog sgrib pa sbyang slad du: tshor stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rtog sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: bcu gcig pa 'byung bzhi'i dug bsal ba ni/ sa thogs la/ hūm̐: sa yi snying po byang chub sems: gti mug khyab rten rnam dag pa: tshe 'das ma rig las gyur tshogs: sangs rgyas spyan mas dug bcom mo: sha khams sa la bstim du gsol: oṃ bh+rūm̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa laṃ dz+nyā na mo ha ra ti ye bh+rūm̐ mi ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: chu thogs la/ hūm̐: chu yi snying po byang chub sems: 'dod chags gsher brlan rnam dag pa: tshe 'das bag chags las gyur tshogs: mā ma kī yis dug bcom mo: khrag khams chu la bstim du gsol: oṃ khaṃ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa maṃ dz+nyā na rā ga ra ti ye khaṃ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: me thogs te/ hūm̐: me yi snying po byang chub sems: zhe sdang 'bar mched rnam dag pa: tshe 'das shes sgrib las gyur tshogs: gos dkar mo yis dug bcom mo: drod khams me la bstim du gsol: oṃ ram̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa paṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra ra ti ye ram̐ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

rlung g.yab thogs la/ hūm̐: rlung gi snying po byang chub sems: phrag dog yang g.yo rnam dag pa: tshe 'das nyon mongs las gyur tshogs: dam tshig sgrol mas dug bcom mo: dbugs khams rlung la bstim du gsol: oṃ yam̐ hrī dha ya bo dhi sa twa taṃ dz+nyā na dhe wa kha ra ti ye yam̐ ha la sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bden pa gsum gyis dug bcom pa ni/ hūm̐: dug gsum sku gsum ngo bo nyid: dkon mchog gsum la dug mi mnga': lnga ldan ye shes bden pa yis: tshe 'das dug lnga zhi gyur cig: oṃ dharma ka ya: sam+bho ka ya: nirmā ka ya: bud+dha bha ga: dharma hrī dha: saṅga rat+na: saṃ bha ro pa ya: ha la pañca ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig / ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ bcu gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa la/ mchod pa sna lnga 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlab/ thog mar gzugs thogs la/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: gzugs mdzes mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul: snang stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: sgra thogs la/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: sgra snyan mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul: grags stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: dri thogs la/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: dri zhim mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la 'bul: tshor stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: ro mchog thogs la/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: ro mchog mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul:

myong stong mchod pa bzhes nas kyang : tshe 'das sangs rgyas thob par shog: oṃ lo ki shwa ra rā sa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: reg mchog thogs nas/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: reg 'jam mchod pa ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul: bde stong mchod pa bskyed gyur cig: oṃ lo ki shwa ra spar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: bcu gsum pa lam bstan pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: 'jig rten mi yul 'di yi snang ba nub: gnas khang yul la skad cig sdod dbang med: pha ma spun zla mthong yang 'grogs dbang med: zang zing rgyu la chags kyang 'dzin thabs zad: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: rnam smin bar do'i yid lus mdun nas sgug: nyon mongs las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded: 'jigs gzugs gshin rje'i pho nyas 'dzin cing khrid: dri za lta bur bsam pas stong khams 'khor: skyabs dang gnas khang bral bas sdug bsngal skyes: las rlung mun rum bu yug kha char gtibs: shi bar thag chod dran bzod med pa yis: bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam shes gtad med khyod: skad cig sdod pa'i go skabs ma mchis pas: gnyen 'brel zang zing rgyu la ma chags shig: bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor dran par gyis: phyag 'tshal skyabs 'tshol rtse gcig 'dun pa bskyed: bcu bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ tshe 'das nyid dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ sogs dang*/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: dkyil 'khor slob dpon sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thog ma'i sangs rgyas mngon rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: snying rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug 'dren mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zhe sdang ma spangs dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'dren: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo:

ser sna ma spangs yi dwags 'jig rten 'dren: don grub spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: gti mug ma spangs byol song 'jig rten 'dren: mi bskyod spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod chags ma spangs mi yi 'jig rten 'dren: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: phrag dog ma spangs lha min 'jig rten 'dren: mi 'khrugs spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: nga rgyal ma spangs lha yi 'jig rten 'dren: rin chen spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: sa khams ma spangs lha bu'i bdud bcom pa: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan mar phyag 'tshal lo: chu khams ma spangs phung po'i bdud bcom pa: yum chen mā ma kī la phyag 'tshal lo: me khams ma spangs nyon mongs bdud bcom pa: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung khams ma spangs 'chi bdag bdud bcom pa: yum chen dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo: rtag lta ma spangs byams pa mtha' ru phyin: shar sgo lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: chad lta ma spangs snying rje mtha' ru phyin: lho sgo zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'dzin ma spangs dga' ba mtha' ru phyin: nub sgo lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo: stong lta ma spangs btang snyoms mtha' ru phyin: byang sgo dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas dge legs byed pa ni/ hoḥ de ltar phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gsol 'debs pa'i: ma dag rigs drug skye ba'i sgo bcad nas: rnam dag 'od gsal lam la drangs du gsol: pha rol song ba'i tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: byang chub lam bstan gegs med bgyis mdzad pa: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: rang byung ka dag 'od gsal snying po yi: gnas lugs mngon sum 'bras bu smin mdzad des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: zhi ba chags bral dam chos brgyad khri'i dpal: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gter chen des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde:

drang srong grub thob kun gyi 'byung gnas des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: rtsa gsum ngo bo skyabs yul kun 'dus mchog: sna tshogs sprul sku dkyil 'khor lha tshogs des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i mched lcam bden pa'i tshig: rtse gcig thogs med 'grub pa'i smon lam des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: brgya byin la sogs stong gsum 'byung po'i tshogs: byang chub thob nas sdug bsngal bral ba des: tshe 'das khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur: mthu chen stobs kyis tshe 'das byin brlabs nas: nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs 'byung gyur cig: bco lnga pa dbang bskur ba ni/ sa gzhi spos? maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar nas btud de/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung : de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni/ hoḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po yi: dam tshig srog ltar srung ba 'di: snying la ye shes lha rnams gnas: dam nyams rnams la gshin rjer 'gyur: om̐ lo ha biṣatshas ha la i dan+te swā hā: dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t skad cig gis khyed rang 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dag pa chos sku'i klong nas sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar gyur/

snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la rol mo sgrog tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ bum pa thogs la: bum pa 'di nyid phyi bum pa'i rnam pa nang du 'og min bde ba can sogs rigs lnga'i zhing khams/ gsang ba ltar na thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rigs lnga sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'dus pa'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bum pa rnam dag ye shes gzhal yas khang : bcud ni yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mchog rab thob ste: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing der skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: sna tshogs rang byung thugs rje chen po'i lha: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: snang ba mtha' yas sku mchog rab thob ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: gsal stong ma 'gags 'od gsal snying po can: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste: 'thug po bkod kyi zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la: hūm̐: sdug bsngal g.yul las rgyal ba'i bla med rdzas: byang chub 'phags pa'i nor bdun mtshon pa'i brda: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rin chen 'byung ldan sku mchog rab thob ste: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sna tshogs rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: ting 'dzin mi shigs sna tshogs rdo rje'i sku: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: don yod grub pa'i sku mchog rab thob ste: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing du skye bar shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dbang thob pas dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang sku lnga ye shes lnga mngon du byas 'bras bu sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: bum pa longs sku'i gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra kā ya wāk+ka tsisarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: sku yi bkra shis mdzad du gsol: de ltar dbang bskur bas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi tshul du thob pas lus ngag yid gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bcas pa sbyang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par byas pa yin no/ de nas dbang lha rnams kyang khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcu drug pa zas gtad pa ni/

tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ 'dod yon gyi dngos po rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon gyi dngos po zad mi shes pa nam mkha' gang bar bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song zhing tshe las 'das pa chaig mo'i mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa: rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa: sna yi yul du dri zhim pa: lce yi yul du ro mngar ba: lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa: yid kyi yul du dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig: ces pas bsngo zhing gsur btang : hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: zad med rin chen mdzod kyi gzhong pa ru: 'dod yon longs spyod lnga ldan bcud kyis bkang : ting 'dzin hom du bsreg cing bsngos pa yis: zad mi shes pa'i gter la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: oṃ ma hā paṇ+ye s+pha ra ṇa pa ri wā ra ye kha kha khā hi: bcu bdun pa lam bstan nas rnam shes 'og min rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim par bsam: hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam shes gtad med khyod: sgrib med gsal stong yi ge a ru bsgom: dbu ma ka dag bde chen zhing khams su: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru: rtsal chen ye shes rlung gis rab btegs nas: rnam shes a yig skar mda' chad pa ltar: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim gyur cig: phaṭḥ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ ces chos sku'i thugs kar bstim: bco brgyad pa byang bu sbar ba ni:

slar yang rnam shes gshegs pa'i byang bu sdig sgrib dang mnyam du ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing sbyangs par mos te/ hoḥ mdun du skad cig gis khro bo dmar nag bag chags sreg pa'i he ru ka stobs ldan gsal bar gyur: oṃ he ru ka ram̐ pā paṃ bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu: bdag 'dzin srid pa'i phung po la: rang byung ye shes me sbar ro: rnam rtog dug lnga'i bud shing la: sku lnga lhun grub me sbar ro: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro: rnam shes tshogs drug bud shing la: pha rol phyin drug me sbar ro: yul brgyad bdag 'dzin bud shing la: sems dpa' brgyad kyi me sbar ro: shes bya brgyad kyi bud shing la: lha mo brgyad kyi me sbar ro: rtog pa dgu yi bud shing la: theg pa rim dgu'i me sbar ro: lus ngag yid kyi bud shing la: sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar ro: phung po nga bdag bsregs gtor nas: bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ byang ro'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i āḥdakar po'i 'od zer 'phros/ de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam la/ yig brgya dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chus bkru/ rtsa sngags dang yig brgya spel tshig can bzla bzhin par sāts+tsha gdab/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnas/ dben gnas sam chu klung chen por spyan 'dren par bya'o/ bcu dgu pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang : khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: grub thob rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: yongs grags rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba ye shes kyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol:

de dag gi nus mthu la brten nas gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang mnyam par gyur cig: da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams su la'ang phan thogs pa thams cad sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bzang ba dang : mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur cig: khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi thugs kyis g.yel ba med pa'i grogs mdzad par gyur cig: 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang : lo 'bras rtag tu rgyas shing dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi nas mtshon gyi bskal pa ngan pa nyams par gyur cig: yul gyi mi nad phyugs nad 'go ba'i nad gdon dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig: rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po de rnams kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i skal pa dang ldan nas rten 'brel dge ba'i legs tshogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du 'phos zhing : chaiga'i 'das pa 'das ma de nyid kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs: lam sgrib gnyis byang : 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig: dkon mchog gsum la bkur sti dang rim gro bgyis te: zang zing gi chos bcu mi zad ting 'dzin bsgoms pa la sogs pa drang don nges don gyi chos thams cad smon lam brda ma log par rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rgya chen po thob nas nam yang mi 'khrul zhing rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du phan thogs pa'i skye ba len nus par gyur cig:

rigs mtho zhing cho 'brang dang ldan pa'i skye ba len nas chos dang 'phrad nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du gyur nas mtha' yas 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nus par gyur cig: tshe 'phrang bdud las sgrol nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub ste: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal mngon sum du mjal ba dang lung bstan te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur cig: nyi shu pa smon lam ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag bkod pa zhing khams bde ba can: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas dbus: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: rgyal sras sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: ngo mtshar bkod pa blo las 'das pa yi: ting 'dzin longs spyod gtum mo gos kyi mchog: byang chub chu rgyun mi zad longs spyod pa: snang stong lha yi khye'u pho mo grogs: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rin chen gter mdzod can: ye shes lnga yi sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: 'od gsal snying po ma rig ka nas dag: kun tshang bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa yis: mkha' spyod phun tshogs zhing khams de nyid du: tshe 'das rnam shes skad cig 'phos ma thag: ma nor bstan pa'i lam mchog rab rnyed nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skyes nas kyang : sprul pas phyogs bcu'i gzhan don nus par shog: ces smon lam gang rung gis mtshams sbyor bya'o/ de dag gis thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi bsnyen bsgrub kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa lam bzang gsal snang zhes bya ba 'di'ang gsang sngags phur pa gling du 'di ga'i sgrub mchod rgyun 'dzugs dang gson gshin dkor sbyang slad lo ltar gnas 'dren bya srol rgyun 'jags su 'jog ched gter gzhung tshan mang du bzhugs pa rnams 'don chog tu bsdebs te kha 'gengs cung zad rigs mthun gzhan nas bsabs pa dang*/

go rim rnams gsang ba spyi dang mthun par 'khrugs bsdebs cung zad dang bcas thugs rje chen po'i zab chos yongs rdzogs dbu can du bsgyur zhing 'phrul dpar gyi lam la drangs te grangs tshad lnga brgya tham pa dpe skrun bgyis pa'i skabs dang bstun gsar spel byed po gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis phyi lo 2003zla 4tshes9rang lugs dbo zla ba'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin grub par bgyis pas yi ge pa ni o rgyan gsang sngags pas bgyis pa yin no/ 'di ltar byas pa la bsre bslad dkrugs pa'i nyes 'gal mchis na rtsa gsum lha la bshags shing dge ba'i cha mchis tshe ma rgan pad yag gtsos pa'i bzang ngan gyi 'brel thogs ma lus pa bde ba can du mgon po 'od mtshan stong 'bar gyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar bklag chog bkod pa bzhugs so/ snying rje'i dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon la/ /btud nas gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi/ /lhan thabs sbyin sreg bklag chog 'dir bkod na/ /bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ de yang gang zhig thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag gis gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor bar snying rje'i go bgos te gshin don sbyin sreg rtsom par 'dod pas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro zhing gang du bya ba'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin shing bka' bsgos/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas sa la bzhag ste rta sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas a nyer gcig brjod la stong nyid du rgyas btab/ thabs stegs ba byung dri bzang bcas pa byugs la zhi thab dkar po zlum bskor dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phyi rol pad phreng 'od gyi mu khyud zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khar ro khang phyi brtsegs dang nang du phung po tshod ran pa mdun gyi rtsa bar spar khung sked par rdzas khung rtse mo dud khung ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mdzes par brtsegs la dkar rtsi gsol/

ma nus kyang dkyil 'khor thog thab rgya che bar brtsegs pas kyang rung*/ khrus chog la mkho ba'i bgegs gtor mar me can/ mchod pa rnam lnga/ thub sku me long khrus dar dug phyung til nag me kong gru gsum/ gsur rdzas sa chu me rlung*/ rlung g.yab/ dbang chas bcas so/ de nas sreg blugs kyi rdzas dang mkho ba'i cha rkyen ni/ rang mdun thab kha sprod la zhi bar 'os pa'i yo byad/ g.yas su mchod rdzas mchod pa sna bdun/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya spar btab pa'am gang rigs/ sman raka gtor ma/ me lha gnyis kyi gtor ma/ g.yon du bsreg rdzas dpal 'bar rlung g.yab/ mar khu/ yam shing*/ rdzas gsum ni/ ku sha dūrba bil ba gsum/ zas mchog khrum dang go yu sbrus pa/ sman sna tshogs/ bcud bzang gi rtsi ka ra bu ram sbrang dang mar khu/ rin chen phye ma sogs rin po che sna tshogs/ dar zab sna lnga sogs gos sna/ gro swa ba sran ma sogs 'bru sna/ shing thog rgun 'brum se 'bru sogs shing 'bras sna tshogs/ ming ma smos pa'i zas sna tshogs sam rdzas spungs bcas 'jig 'das gnyis la phreng tshar gnyis/ me dar rlung g.yab sna lnga ku sha rgya gram bcings pa lnga sogs 'don cha'i tshig bstun dgos mkho tshang bar bya'o/ slob dpon rigs lnga dang chas gos dkar por bsgyur la kha shar du phyogs/ mdun stegs khebs ldan dkar po'i thog las bum 'thor nas ḍā dril gzar blugs sogs 'du bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ las byang gsol 'debs nas bzung bstod pa'i mjug bar btang la dzap khang dbye/ dzap bskul bsnyen dmigs mthar bsnyen sgrub las gsum rnam bum dang las bum sgrub/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya mchod bstod grub nas 'od zhu bya/ bdag 'jug gam rig me dor ba gang rung mthar gsol ka dang tshogs drang ba nas lhag ma'i bar mthar chags su btang*/ skabs 'dir ltung bshags sngon du 'gro bas rang gzhung gnas 'dren gshin don bag chags sbyong byed skyabs sems nas brtsams rnam shes 'gugs pa/

bgegs phral ba/ khrus sbyong til sbyong*/ sogs nas lam bstan gshegs gsol bar song nas snga bar phung po gtsang mar khrus la dri bzang byug btags grol rig pa don ldan spyi bor btags pa'i gnas lnga ru sngags 'di shog bu la bris la sbyar: oṃshrīmūm̐lām̐badz+ralok+kishwarimahātsit+tabodhisatwahūm̐hrīḥ tshelasa'adasapa'isdigasgribabagachagasathamasacada.abaranaduḥkhabhishwadhashān+tiṃkuruyeswāhā: zhes 'phreng gcig tu bris/ btags grol ma rnyed na 'di shog dril byed nas spyi bor btags/ rigs lnga'i rgyan dang dar dkar gyi khyogs la stegs la lha yi rnam par bsam la ro khang rnying pa las bton nas thab dbus dkyil 'khor steng phung po drang srong tsog pu'am skyil krung bya la kha ni shar ram shar lhor bstan la bzhag slar gu gul bdug yungs thun brab/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ khrus dang bcas gzhugs su gsol ba yin no/ de nas rdor dril byin rlob chos spyod ltar dang*/ mchod pa bsang sbyang ni/
