oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ zhes pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod rin po che las grub pa so so'i nang du mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bcud phun sum tshogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin las byung ba zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gis byin brlabs/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hā: rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ āḥswā hā: zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī ri swā hā: 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dzā+aiṃ swā hā: rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā: dgang gzar la reg nas/ oṃ e shu ne pradz+nyā su khaṃ su rtaṃ k+ṣe swā hā: ram̐ nṛ ra k+ṣaṃ: yam̐ su dz+nyā k+ṣaṃ: kham̐ kun+ta k+ṣaṃ: oṃ a i u aṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes reg tsam gyi rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab bo/ thab bsang sbyang ni las bum chus bran la thab bsang sbyang gi sngags ni: oṃ ram̐ shu pa dhaṃ swa ra ta ye haṃ li la ye swā hā: de nas me lha bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ las phyi snod rang byung gi gzhal yas khang rgya chen po rgya khyon g.yo bas btegs pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar bsnol ba'i tshad dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su ma rig bud shing sreg pa'i ye shes kyi ram̐ dmar mthing cung zad dkar ba'i 'od 'phro ba: de yongs su gyur pa las nyon mongs zhi byed kyi me lha sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa he ru pa gyad kyi dor stabs can: g.yas tsan+d+ra dang g.yon sūr+ya bsnams pa:

sku yi cha ru 'khod pa'i rgyan ye shes kyi rigs lnga phar phyin gyi rgyan drug shes brgyad kyi dur khrod chas: ye shes dpal chas bcu ldan pa: yum las kyi ma mo'i rang bzhin du 'khril zhing bskul ba ste: skye mched bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa'i 'khor tshad med bzhi yi rang me'i kha dog 'bar zhing mched pa ltar la tshe 'das kyi phung po dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dam tshig par gsal ba'o: de yang gang zag mchog yin na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ltar bskyed la rdzas mchod pa ru dmigs nas 'bul ba yin/ phal pa yin na dug lnga ye shes su bsgyur ba dang phung po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mchod pa ru bsgyur nas 'bul ba yin no/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren shing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba la/ de ltar brten snang ba mi dmigs chu zla ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar baṃ: lte 'og ram̐: gsang bar yam̐: zhabs gnyis kyi mthil du ha hus mtshan pa'i 'od 'phros pas: yam̐ yam̐ phaiṃ phaiṃ heṃ heṃ he he we we rnams me ltar mched pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas: dam tshig pa dang dbyer ma mchis par gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na pañca ku la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las nam mkha'i snying pos dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ ga ga e a badz+ra a haṃ ti sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes spur khang la las bum chus khrus bstsal te/ oṃ: gzugs rnams snang stong sku yi lha khrus gsol: āḥ sgra rnams grags stong gsung gi sngags khrus gsol: hūm̐: yid rnams gsal stong thugs kyi don khrus gsol: hrīḥ rgyal ba de bzhin ye shes khrus gsol bas: tshe 'das rnam shes phung khams skye mched rnams: ka dag bde chen 'od skur grol bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra he ru ka dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

de nas dbang rtags kyi ku sha bum pa'i kha nas blangs shing spur khang gi phyogs bzhir dbus lngar 'dzugs/ hūm̐: sgyu lus mi dmigs snang stong bum pa'i dbyings: dug lnga gnas grol ye shes ston pa'i phyir: rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ku sha a wa rtswa: dbang rtags 'di phul ye sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ dz+nyā na mu ku ṭa bi shwa sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas spyan drang ba'i dam ye bsre ba ni/ hūm̐: zhe sdang sreg byed rdo rje rigs kyi me: nga rgyal sreg byed rin chen rigs kyi me: 'dod chags sreg byed pad+ma rigs kyi me: phrag dog sreg byed karma rigs kyi me: gti mug sreg byed bud+dha rigs kyi me: rang byung ye shes me yi lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dam tshig dbyer med phyir: 'bar ba'i shugs 'chang ston phyir ram̐ gyi dal: nyon mongs bud shing bsreg phyir bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku tsam du phyag 'tshal nas: longs sku'i thugs dam sgyu mar bskul ba'i phyir: rang bzhin chos sku'i me dpung bskyed du gsol: oṃ ram̐ dz+nyā na pañca badz+ra sa ma ya dz+wa la de wa pradz+nyā ye badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: a ti pu hoḥ gdan 'bul ku sha rgya gram dbus dang phyogs bzhir bzhag /mtha' nas ku sha ba glang mjug ma ltar mnan te dpal 'bar sbar la shar nas me sbar shing rlung g.yab dkar po g.yab la/ hūm̐: me long ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing gyen rgyu'i rlung g.yabs te: shar dkar zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer dkar po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ si ta ka swā hā: rlung g.yab la mda' dar dkar po shar du 'dzugs/ de bzhin du lho nas me sbar shing rlung g.yab ser po g.yab la/ hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing me nyams rlung g.yabs te: lho yi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer ser po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ rat+na dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ so na ka swā hā:

mda' dar ser po lho ru 'dzugs/ nub nas me sbar shing rlung g.yab dmar po g.yab la/ hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing thul ser rlung g.yabs te: nub kyi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer dmar po'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ pad+ma dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ rā ga ti ka swā hā: mda' dar dmar po nub tu 'dzugs/ byang nas me sbar shing rlung g.yab ljang khu g.yab la/ hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing khyab byed rlung g.yabs te: byang gi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer ljang gu'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ karma dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ marga ti ka swā hā: mda' dar ljang gu byang du 'dzugs/ dbus nas me sbar shing rlung g.yab sngon po g.yab la/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngang gi me: sbar zhing srog 'dzin rlung g.yabs te: dbus kyi zhing khams don mthun phyir: 'od zer mthing kha'i brda 'di zungs: oṃ bud+dha dz+nyā na ram̐ yam̐ ni lam̐ ti ka swā hā: rlung g.yab/ mda' dar mthing kha dbus phyogs su btsugs/ dbang rtags lha dang dkyil 'khor gzhung ltar gsal gdab/ de nas tshogs drug gi zhan pa bshig pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs phyir gzugs kyi sku longs spyod rdzogs par sbyang ba dang*/ longs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba mtshon byed rten 'brel tsam rang gzhung bla med rgyud kyi dgongs pa ru nges la gzhan gyi rgyud dang mi 'gal ba phyir snang tshul tsam mchod rdzas 'bul bar bya ba yin no/ dang po me lha'i byon skyems mar khu 'bul ba ni/ de nas/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur: bar bsams la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung dpal chen he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu can: ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā:

mar khu blugs gzar lan bdun gyis 'bul/ tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: de nas rang byung lha la rang grol gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: tshe 'das tshogs drug rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra shab+da sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: yang gang zag mchog yin na kha bsgyur 'di ltar bya la/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i 'brel thog gi gtsos pa'i 'brel thog tshe las 'das pa 'das ma rnams kyis nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ de yang rnal 'byor pa'i spangs rtogs la rag las so/ 'dod yon lnga la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ

bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das dug lnga rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: nang mchod la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das sgo bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta au ṇa rak+ta bha ling+ta ye sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: yam shing la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das tsaṇ+ḍa rang byung bud shing 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog:

oṃ mu la de wa mu la wa ra mu la shrī yaṃ ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: rdzas gsum 'bul ba la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das sgo gsum rang grol mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ su ram̐ ke ta pu le ha yan bhi wa shu ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zas mchog la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das ro gcig lta ba'i zas mchog 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba puṇ+yai pur+ṇa gha na ma ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā:

tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: sman sna tshogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das nyon mongs rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra au ṇa bhai ṣañja bi shwa dha swā hā:sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: rtsi sna tshogs la/

hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das bde stong rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ a mṛ ta sarba me gha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: rin chen sna tshogs thogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das sku bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sarba sid+dhi pū dza ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: dar zab sna tshogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha:

tshe 'das 'gag med shar grol mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ pañca li ka shrī rā sa spar+she ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: 'bru sna tshogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das zhen pa rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ge pa ra ti la tha su k+ṣa ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das snang srid rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ bi ra dze bī wa dze bhi mu la ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa

chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: ming nas ma smos pa'i zas sna tshogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das snod bcud rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra a brta ya ho pū dza ye swā hā: sogs kyi rdzas ma rdzogs bar 'bul la mthar 'dod gsol/ mar khu la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung bla med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshe 'das dga' bzhi rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ su khaṃ pra mo ti pa ra mi ta ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: de nas me lha'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan ye shes rab 'bar rol pa'i sku: dug lnga sreg mdzad mdangs lnga lhun gyis grub: rnam dag pho nya rlung gi rab g.yo ba: 'bar zhing mched pa tsaṇ+ḍa'i gzi 'od kyis:

nyon mongs rtsa mdud rgya yi 'tshang grol nas: a haṃ bskul ldan dngul chu 'dzags pa yis: mched cing 'bar ba'i 'od ldan 'khrugs 'khyil ba'i: bsdus bya snyigs lam sdong po'i 'khril gzhom ste: kun byed dbu ma'i zom du rab btegs pa'i: nus pas mkha' lding g.yo ba nyid la bstod: bskul bas 'pho ba chen po'i gsang lam du: ldog med ye shes 'phrul gyis rab 'degs nas: gdod ma'i dbang phyug go 'phang rtsal mngon shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra hṛ da ya sarba gar+bha hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas yungs dkar thab la gtor te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du stob dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol la ro sreg 'di ye shes me lha gshegs par gsungs pas/ oṃ ag+ne ye gats+tsha: zhes dbyug gu'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bar gyur zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par phyag tshang mdzad nas dbul bar gyur: par bsam mo/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ snga ma bzhin du me bsang ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las ye shes ram̐ lnga rang bzhin du mched pa 'byung 'jug tu mched pa rdo rje'i rang sgra chen po kun nas kun tu g.yo ba'i dbus su gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gdan pad+ma nyi zla gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba'i lte bar hrī yig mdangs ldan nyi ma 'bum 'khyil ba'i zer ltar blta bas mi bzod pa de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu gzhal du med pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i 'khor lo rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i byin rlabs thugs rjes 'ub kyis 'dus srid pa de srid kyi sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs: ting nge 'dzin gyi go 'phang la bkod:

slar yang tshur 'dus hrī yig mi 'gyur ba'i byad kyi gnas 'gyur de yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs mnyam bzhag gdod ma'i klong du ma 'dres so sor gsal zhing snang la rang bzhin bral ba 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o: de nas las byang lha bskyed ni: hrīḥ rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rnam bzhi mdzes: ka ba brgyad ldan bcu drug gdung ma bres: dral lcam thog steng rin po che las grub: sna lnga'i rtsig pa 'dod snam lha mo'i gar: pha gu drwa phyed g.yer kha'i sgra snyan sgrog: mda' yab pu shu sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rta babs bzhi ldan chos 'khor nyi zlas brgyan: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dar dpyangs 'phur: 'ja' 'od thig le zer thag bkrag mdangs rgyas: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa pad+ma'i phreng : ye shes me dpung srung ba'i gur bcas gsal: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa: snang gsal 'od 'khyil nyi zla'i gdan khri'i steng : thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon sku: dkar gsal 'od sku shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi 'bar lham me ba: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: rin chen sna tshogs snyan rgyan mgul rgyan spras: g.yas g.yon mnyam gzhag shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: stod g.yogs lha rdzas mthing kha'i dar yug gsol: sku smad phyed skyil dar dmar ang rag bklubs: phyag gdub zhabs gdub ga shal dar dpyangs mdzes: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyangs can sku la 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: lcang lo thor tshugs dar ljang cod pan 'phur: rus pa'i rgyan dang phyag gdub zhabs gdub mdzes: rdo rje pad phreng yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis bde stong zung 'jug sked la 'khril:

snang stong lhun grub ma bcos ngang la gsal: yab yum spyi gtsug sna tshogs pad zla'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: dmar ser mnyam gzhag skyil krung ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i khri 'phang du: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog mthing : rat+na spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ser: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dmar: karma spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog ljang : bzhi ka 'gying bag brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: rin chen phyag gdub zhabs gdub rus pa'i rgyan: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan nor bu pad+ma 'dzin: gsang ba'i rig ma 'byung bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: sngo ser dmar ljang rin chen rgyan kun rdzogs: lcang lo thor tshugs rigs lnga cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis bde chen sku la 'khril: thabs shes mtshan dpe gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gros lcags kyu pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen mkha' 'gros zhags pa nor bu 'dzin: pad+ma mkha' 'gros lcags sgrog dung dmar 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gros dril bu me long 'dzin: thams cad gar stabs rgyan ldan ling nge ba: nyon mongs bdud bzhi dug lnga khegs par bsgom: gzhan yang phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: gsal snang 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rang bzhin ltar: 'dzin med zang thal ngang nas gsal bar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas yi dam 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po gshegs su gsol:

rnam dag lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: 'phags mchog longs sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas: thugs rje'i bdag nyid rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: tshad med rnam thar sgo 'byed pho brang nas: sgo skyong phyi nang dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: sra brtan mi shigs sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya: skyon bral yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs pa: lhun grub rang byung pad+ma nyi zla'i khrir: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: gnas lugs skye med rang byung ngo bo'i rtsal: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'khor 'das zil gnon 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas byon skyems mar khu 'bul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin pa: 'jig rten mgon gyur 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: thabs mkhas chen po 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i sreg rdzas 'bul: tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bla med mngon sangs rgyas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ri ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul yid 'phrog mdzes ma 'phro: lang ling gang ba mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: so sor 'bul la rdzas lhag bzhag /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin dga' ba'i mdangs ldan ma: dbang po rnam lnga'i reg byas tshim mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor lo nor bu glang po rta mchog mdzes: btsun mo blon po dmag dpon rin chen 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra sarba swa na ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la sa mu dra āḥhūm̐: bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rin chen gdugs dang bum pa dpal be'u rgyan: 'khor lo pad+ma gser nya chos dung sgra: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ maṅga la ku ṭa badz+ra bha me dz+nyā na s+pha ra ṇa āḥhūm̐: gar gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gar sgyur brda skad bde ba'i sgra sgrogs ma: glu ma gar ma ging mo sgeg pa mo: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ mā l+ye lā s+ye gīrti nīrti badz+ra pra mo ti āḥhūm̐:

sman mchod ni: hūm̐: stong gsum yangs pa'i snod mchog bhan+dha ru: bdud rtsis khengs pa'i mchod sprin lha mo'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dung chen snod du rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil: bla med gsang mchod mkha' dbyings bdud rtsi 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: stong gsum nyi zla yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: brjid chags bha ling dkar dmar rgyan ldan 'di: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: yam sh-ing 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: nyon mongs sreg mdzad yam shing phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ mu la dhe wa mu la wa ra mu la shrī yaṃ ye swā hā: rtsa sngags dang las sngags mthar / bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i thog drangs sems can thams cad gyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: rdzas 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rten 'brel rdzas mchog rnam gsum phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ su ram̐ ke ta pu le ha yan bhi wa shu ye swā hā: bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i thog drangs sems can thams cad gyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zas mchog 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ro brgya'i bcud ldan zas mchog sna tshogs 'bul: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ sarba puṇ+yai pur+ṇa gha na ma ye swā hā: sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug lnga'i nad sel sman mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ badz+ra au ṇa bhai ṣañje bi shwa dha swā hā: rtsi mchog la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bcud bzang ngad ldan rtsi mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ a mṛ ta sarba me gha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: rin chen la:

hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dgos 'dod yid bzhin rin chen 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sarba sid+dhi pū dza ye swā hā: reg bya la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: lha reg mdzes ldan sna tshogs 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ pañca li ka shrī rā sa spar+she ye swā hā: 'bru 'bul ba na: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'phel byed 'bru mchog sna tshogs 'bul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ge pa ra ti la tha su k+ṣa ye swā hā: shing 'bras 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: shing 'bras dkar mngar skyur sogs phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi ra dze bī wa dze bhi mu la ye swā hā: zas sna 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: longs spyod 'dzad med zas mchog phul ba'i mthus: tshe 'das sdig sgrib bag chags byang gyur cig: oṃ sarba bi pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya ho pū dza ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ mthar rtsa sngags kho na'i rdzas rdzogs par 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i rjes su/ oṃ a mi dhe wa ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg phyi nang gi mchod pa 'di phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/

dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i thog drangs sems can thams cad gyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: mchod sngags so so'i mgor rtsa sngags kyis mnan te yam shing nas zas sna 'bul ba yan re re la grangs brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci rigs phul mthar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad rnams kyi zhal du bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba dang tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: yungs dkar thab tu gtor: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can: mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong zla ba'i sku: thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod: ces gsol ba gdab pas bzod gsol ni: dgang blugs 'bul zhing : hūm̐: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ yig brgya bzlas/ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad: bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: ci bder bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badz+ra muḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i skabs dkyil 'khor bdag dang tshe 'das rnam shes bcas dkyil 'khor gtso bo la bsdu gtso bo hūm̐ hūm̐ skar mda' 'phang ba ltar/ bde ba can gyi zhing 'od dpag med la thim par dmigs/

de rjes dmigs med du bzhag /rjes kyi las rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lhar gtang rag 'bul zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bsang sbyang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ lan bdun 'bul zhing me lha gsal gdab/ hūm̐: gzi brjid chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub cing : thugs rjes sems can don byed pa: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne ye sarba pū dza ram̐ sogs/ dang po me lha'i byon skyems mar khu 'bul ba ni/ de nas/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung dpal chen he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu can: ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: zag med bde stong rol pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: mar khu blugs gzar lan bdun gyis 'bul/ de nas sngar rdzas lhag rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba la dang po mchod sngags dang bstun mchod pa rnams me la stobs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rang byung skye med he ru kaḥ bag chags 'joms byed 'bar ba'i gar dgu 'chang : ye shes lnga ldan me lha'i dkyil 'khor la: tshe 'das tshogs drug rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas ngan song skye sgo khegs par shog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra shab+da sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/

de bzhin 'dod yon lnga la/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she sarba pū dza ye swā hā: nang mchod sman rag gtor ma la/ oṃ sarba a mṛ ta au ṇa rak+ta bha ling+ta ye sarba pū dza ye swā hā: yam shing la: oṃ mu la de wa mu la wa ra mu la shrī yaṃ ye swā hā: rdzas gsum 'bul ba la/ oṃ su ram̐ ke ta pu le ha yan bhi wa shu ye swā hā: zas mchog la: oṃ sarba puṇ+yai pur+ṇa gha na ma ye swā hā: sman sna tshogs la/ oṃ badz+ra au ṇa bhai ṣañja bi shwa dha swā hā: rtsi sna tshogs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta sarba me gha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: rin chen sna tshogs thogs la/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sarba sid+dhi pū dza ye swā hā: dar zab sna tshogs la/ oṃ pañca li ka shrī rā sa spar+she ye swā hā: 'bru sna tshogs la/ oṃ ge pa ra ti la tha su k+ṣa ye swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la/ oṃ bi ra dze bī wa dze bhi mu la ye swā hā: ming nas ma smos pa'i zas sna tshogs la/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra a brta ya ho pū dza ye swā hā: mar khu la: oṃ su khaṃ pra mo ti pa ra mi ta ye swā hā: sarba pū dza ram̐ a hu te dz+wa la dz+wa la a dhi bhi a dhi bhi ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya ag+na ye ag+na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pañca satwaṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra hrī dha ya a ti tan+t+ra tad+ya thā shrī gu h+ya ghar+bhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba duḥkha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: me lha byon zin nas mar khu bar bdun re 'bul/ phrin bcol spyi ltar byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra tam bu la ye swā hā: zhes so rtsi 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā: zhes gos zung 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan ye shes rab 'bar rol pa'i sku: dug lnga sreg mdzad mdangs lnga lhun gyis grub:

rnam dag pho nya rlung gi rab g.yo ba: 'bar zhing mched pa tsaṇ+ḍa'i gzi 'od kyis: nyon mongs rtsa mdud rgya yi 'tshang grol nas: a haṃ bskul ldan dngul chu 'dzags pa yis: mched cing 'bar ba'i 'od ldan 'khrugs 'khyil ba'i: bsdus bya snyigs lam sdong po'i 'khril gzhom ste: kun byed dbu ma'i zom du rab btegs pa'i: nus pas mkha' lding g.yo ba nyid la bstod: bskul bas 'pho ba chen po'i gsang lam du: ldog med ye shes 'phrul gyis rab 'degs nas: gdod ma'i dbang phyug go 'phang rtsal mngon shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra hṛ da ya sarba gar+bha hūm̐ phaṭḥ me lha'i gtor ma dgang blugs khar bzhag la/ hūm̐: ka dag bde chen dbyings rig dkyil 'khor nas: ma 'gags longs sku rgyal ba he ru kaḥ sna tshogs sprul pa'i rtsal las shugs phyin pa: rang byung ye shes ngang nas sbar ba'i lha: nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms mdzad dkyil 'khor la: bsreg rdzas ba ling+ta yi gtor ma 'bul: dge 'dis tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs smin zhing : slar yang nga bdag phung po rab gshags nas: kun bzang ye grol snying po'i don rtogs stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na shrī la ye ghar+bha ram̐ dz+wa la sarba pū dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs?yig brgya bzlas/ bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyod kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa pa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: me dar blang la dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ rang byung ye shes 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la: zhi ba me long rdo rje dbyings su bsdu: rgyas pa mnyam nyid rin chen dbyings su bsdu: dbang rnams sor rtog pad+ma'-i dbyings su bsdu: drag po bya grub las rab dbyings su bsdu: chos dbyings lhun grub skye med mkha' ru bsdu:

phyi nang dkyil 'khor bdag med dbyings su bsdu: rmi lam 'ja' tshon chu zla ci bzhin du: zang thal ngo bo gnas lugs ā ru ldang : a a āḥ gshegs gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong chen po me yi lha: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ zhes dkyil 'khor rnams bsdu zhing mthar las gzhung tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐: tshe yi bdag po 'chi med? sogs pha la hūm̐: tshe rdzas rol mchod bstod bzod gsol yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya nas/ bkra shis bsdu chog bsngo smon bcas gzhung ltar bya'o/ tshogs bsngo smon bkra shis las byang ltar mtha' dbyung*/ rjes shes skye med ka dag ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ rus bu rnams bsdus la gsham gsal bzhin rus sgrub tshad ldan byas la sats+tsha btab pa'am/ ma nus na thal sol rnams gtsang chab chen por 'dor ram sa mig bzang por sba bar bya ba yin no/ de ltar thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi gshin chog bag chags sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar gter gzhung rtsa ba dang de yi zur 'gebs lag len zin bris bcas dkyus gcig tu bsdebs la man ngag gzhan nas kyang zur brgyan te bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di yang ri smad dgon rgyal mtshan mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' yi pho nya 'brong bla karma lung rig seṅge dang rdo bla o rgyan gsang sngags zung nas ched bskul ngor/ sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul ming 'dzin pa man+t+ra shā sa dhā ras nub gling skye med yi ge'i ming ldan rgyal khab chen po nang tshan mong tran na e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du rab byung 17chu lug lo'i dbo zla'i dmar phyogs tshes 10mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin grub par bgyis pa'i ma rgan gtsos pa'i 'brel thogs sems can kun bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig

sarba maṅga laṃ// //spar byang smon tshig ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed gcig bsdus pa/ /snying rje'i gter chen nam mkha'i rgyal po zhes/ /'khor 'das ma lus zil gyis gnon byed pa/ /lha gcig phyag na pad+mo gtan gyi skyabs/ /gangs can yul 'dir 'phags pa'i gdul bya zhes/ /ston pa'i lung bstan don la gnas pa'i tshul/ /'phags pa'i sprul pas mi yi 'gro ba spel/ /sprul pa'i rgyal pos dam chos srol du btod/ /pad dkar 'chang ba rim byon la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i phrin las stod smad ljongs 'dir khyab/ /de phyir gangs can lha skal 'di yin zhes/ /mtha' dbus stod smad yongs la rlung ltar grags/ /ma bris rdo la yig drug rang byon mang*/ /ma bslabs byis pa'i ngag sgo bye ba nas/ /ma ṇi 'dren shes yod phyir bod yul gyi/ /ma chos yin nges yi ge drug ma yin/ /des na snga rabs mes pos bzhag pa'i shul/ /phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi bgo ba'i skal/ /thugs rje chen po 'di las ma dmigs pas/ /kun gyis lhag pa'i lha ru 'di bzung rigs/ /de skad chos med sprang po gu h+ya yis/ /chos sbyin par du bskrun skabs smon tshig cig /bris zhes rang slob au ḍis nan bskul ngor/ /bgyis 'dis 'gro kun bde chen zhing bgrod shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
